1.zh: 读入一串整数，再读入一个目标和。在这串整数里找出两个互不相同的位置，使这两个位置上的数值相加恰好等于目标和。同一个位置不能使用两次，输入保证有且仅有一组这样的位置。把这两个下标写出来，先后次序随意。
1.en: Read a list of integers together with one target sum. Find two different positions in that list whose stored values add up exactly to the target. The same position may not be chosen twice, and the input is guaranteed to contain exactly one such pair. Write the two indexes on one line in either order.

2.zh: 读入两条都不为空的单向链表。每条链用结点保存一个非负整数，个位放在链头，更高的数位顺着指针往后排，每个结点只放一位。把两个整数相加，得到的和也用同样的低位在前的链表表示。除了数值本身就是零，输入不会带多余的高位零。写出代表这个和的链头。
2.en: Read two singly linked chains that are both non-empty. Each chain stores a non-negative integer with the ones digit at the front and higher places farther along, and every node holds exactly one digit. Sum both integers and represent that total with a chain in the same low-place-first layout. Neither input carries an extra high-place zero unless the value itself is zero. Write the head of the chain that stands for the total.

3.zh: 读入一段文本。从中截取连续的一段，这一段里面任何一个字符都不能出现第二次。在所有符合条件的截取中，找出字符个数最多的那段，并把个数写成整数。只含单个字符的截取也合法。若文本里没有任何字符，把个数写成 0。
3.en: Read one piece of text. Cut out a contiguous segment in which no character occurs a second time. Among every segment that meets this rule, find the one that contains the most characters and write that count as an integer. A segment of a single character is allowed. If the text contains no characters at all, write 0.

4.zh: 读入两列已经按升序排好的整数，长度分别是 m 与 n，两列不会同时没有任何元素。把两列中的数合在一起看成升序的整体，找出这个整体的中间值。整体个数为奇数时，写出正中那个数；个数为偶数时，写出正中相邻两数的算术平均。答案以小数形式写出。完成这项工作时，比较的规模应保持在 m 与 n 之和的对数级别。
4.en: Read two columns of integers that are already sorted in ascending order, with lengths m and n. The two columns are never empty at the same time. Combine every integer into one ascending whole and find its middle value. When the count is odd, write the central value. When the count is even, write the arithmetic mean of the two central values as a decimal. Keep the amount of comparison work within a logarithmic scale of m plus n.

5.zh: 读入一条长度从 1 到 1000 的文本，字符只含数字和英文字母，字母大小写都允许。找出其中一段连续片段，使它从前往后读与从后往前读逐字相同，并且在所有这样的片段里长度最大。把该片段本身写出来。长度并列时写出任意一条即可。
5.en: Read one text whose length is at least 1 and at most 1000. Every character is a digit or an English letter, and both letter cases are allowed. Find a contiguous fragment that is identical when scanned front to back and back to front, and whose length is the greatest among all such fragments. Write that fragment itself. If several fragments tie for the greatest length, write any one of them.

6.zh: 读入一条文本以及一个正整数作为行数。文本长度从 1 到 1000，行数从 1 到 1000，字符只含英文字母、逗号和句点。把字符依次填进行列：先沿一列向下，碰到底边后改为斜向上，碰到顶边后再向下，如此往复直到字符用完。然后从最上面一行开始，每行由左至右读出，拼成一条新的文本并写出。
6.en: Read a text and a positive integer that tells how many horizontal bands to use. The text length runs from 1 to 1000, the band count also runs from 1 to 1000, and each character is an English letter, a comma, or a period. Drop characters down a column, then move diagonally upward, then drop down again, repeating until every character has a place. Afterward, scan each band from its left end to its right end, starting at the top band, and write the joined result.

7.zh: 读入一个 32 位有符号整数，把十进制表示中的各位数字前后对调，负号仍然留在最前。可表示的闭区间是负的二的三十一次方，直到二的三十一次方减一。对调之后如果落在区间外面，写出 0；如果仍在区间里面，写出对调得到的整数。对调后出现的高位零要去掉。
7.en: Read one signed integer that fits in 32 bits. Swap the decimal digits end for end, and keep a minus sign at the front when the input is negative. Values that can be stored lie on the closed span from negative two raised to the thirty-first power through two raised to the thirty-first power minus one. If the swapped result falls outside that span, write 0. If it stays inside, write the swapped integer. Drop zeros that would sit at the high end after the swap.

8.zh: 读入一条文本并写出它对应的 32 位有符号整数。开头若有空格，只跳过这些空格，这里的空白仅指空格字符。紧接着可以有一个正号或负号，用来决定符号；两者都没有时按正数处理。然后连续收下数字字符，一旦遇到非数字或者文本结束就停，后面剩余内容全部丢掉。一个数字都没有时，数值记为 0。小于负的二的三十一次方的结果抬到这个下界，大于二的三十一次方减一的结果压到这个上界。数字尚未开始时若出现其他字符，也要立刻停止。
8.en: Read a text and write the signed integer it encodes, held in 32 bits. Skip spaces that sit at the very front, and treat only the ordinary space as that kind of gap. A following plus or minus may set the sign, and if neither mark appears the value stays positive. Then take digit characters in a row and stop at the first non-digit or at the end, throwing away whatever is left. When no digit appears, the value is 0. Lift any result below negative two to the thirty-first power up to that floor, and press any result above two to the thirty-first power minus one down to that ceiling. Stop at once if some other character shows up before the first digit.

9.zh: 读入一个整数，判断它的十进制写法是否左右对称，也就是从高位读到低位与从低位读到高位得到的数字序列完全一致。带负号的数缺少这种对称，应判为否。写出布尔结果，对称为真，否则为假。整数 121 的各位左右对称，应当写成真。
9.en: Read one integer and decide whether its decimal writing is symmetric, meaning the digit sequence from the high place down to the low place matches the sequence taken in the opposite direction. A negative integer fails this test because of the sign. Write a boolean, true when the digits match and false otherwise. The integer 121 has matching digits from either end, so the written result for it is true.

11.zh: 读入一排非负整数高度。下标为 i 的竖线站在横轴坐标 i 处，上端高度为给出的整数，下端贴着横轴。任取两根不同的竖线，它们和横轴围出的面积等于下标距离乘以较矮一根的高度。找出面积最大的那一对，把面积写成整数。这个面积是非负整数，49 是它可能取到的一个具体数值。
11.en: Read a row of non-negative integer heights. The upright at index i stands at horizontal coordinate i, with its top at the stated height and its foot on the horizontal axis. Pick any two different uprights. The area they enclose with the axis equals the gap between their indexes times the shorter height. Find the pair with the greatest area and write that area as an integer. The area is a non-negative integer, and 49 is one concrete value it can take.

12.zh: 读入闭区间 1 到 3999 内的一个整数，把它写成罗马数字后输出。基本符号及面值为 I 是 1、V 是 5、X 是 10、L 是 50、C 是 100、D 是 500、M 是 1000。一般按面值从大到小由左向右书写。允许的六种减法写在左侧：I 位于 V 或 X 之前表示 4 或 9，X 位于 L 或 C 之前表示 40 或 90，C 位于 D 或 M 之前表示 400 或 900。别的情况不要把较小符号放到较大符号前面。
12.en: Read an integer inside the closed span from 1 to 3999 and write it with Roman symbols. The basic symbols and their weights are I for 1, V for 5, X for 10, L for 50, C for 100, D for 500, and M for 1000. Normally place heavier weights to the left of lighter ones. Exactly six subtractive layouts are legal: I standing ahead of V or X means 4 or 9, X standing ahead of L or C means 40 or 90, and C standing ahead of D or M means 400 or 900. In every other case, do not put a lighter symbol ahead of a heavier one.

13.zh: 读入一条罗马数字，它对应的整数落在 1 到 3999。把它换算成十进制整数并写出。各符号面值是 I 代表 1、V 代表 5、X 代表 10、L 代表 50、C 代表 100、D 代表 500、M 代表 1000。由左至右查看相邻符号：当前面值大于等于右边时加上当前面值，当前面值小于右边时改为减去当前面值。扫描结束后的累计值就是所求整数。
13.en: Read one Roman symbol string whose integer value lies from 1 through 3999, and write that integer in decimal. Weights are I as 1, V as 5, X as 10, L as 50, C as 100, D as 500, and M as 1000. Walk from the left and look at neighboring symbols. Add the current weight when it is greater than or equal to the weight on its right, and subtract the current weight when it is smaller. The total after the walk is the integer to write.

14.zh: 读入 1 到 200 条字符串，每条长度从 0 到 200，并且只包含小写英文字母。找出一段开头片段，它是所有字符串共同拥有的，而且在满足这一点的片段里最长。所谓拥有，是指每条字符串的起始部分与该片段逐字相同。把这段片段写出来。若大家没有任何共同的起始字符，就写出空结果。
14.en: Read from 1 to 200 strings. Each string has length from 0 through 200 and holds only lowercase English letters. Find the longest opening fragment that every string owns, where ownership means the start of each string matches that fragment character by character. Write the fragment. If the strings own no opening character in common, write an empty result.

15.zh: 读入一组整数。在不同的位置上选取三个数，使三个数相加得到 0。把所有这样的选取都找出来，但内容相同的选取只保留一次：比较时只看每个数值出现了几次，不看位置。写出保留后的每一组三个数。组与组谁先谁后都行，组内三个数的排列也行。
15.en: Read a collection of integers. Choose three numbers from three different positions so that the three numbers add to 0. Find every such choice, but keep a choice only once when another choice holds the same numbers the same number of times, ignoring positions. Write each kept group of three numbers. The order among groups may vary, and the order inside a group may vary too.

16.zh: 读入一组整数，再读入一个目标整数。从三个不同位置取出数值并求和。找出一组取出方式，使这个和与目标的绝对差值达到最小。每份输入只有一个这样的最优和。把这个和写出来，三个被取出的数值本身不用写出。
16.en: Read a collection of integers and then one target integer. Take values from three different positions and add them. Find a way of taking those values so that the absolute gap between their total and the target is as small as possible. Each input has only one best total. Write that total. The three taken values themselves should not be written.

17.zh: 读入一条仅由数字 2 到 9 构成的文本。数字与字母的对应跟电话键盘一致：2 对应 abc，3 对应 def，4 对应 ghi，5 对应 jkl，6 对应 mno，7 对应 pqrs，8 对应 tuv，9 对应 wxyz。按文本从左到右，每个数字挑选它对应字母中的一个，拼出所有可能的字母文本。把这些字母文本全部写出，排列顺序任意。
17.en: Read a text built only from the digits 2 through 9. Digits match letters the way a phone keypad does: 2 matches abc, 3 matches def, 4 matches ghi, 5 matches jkl, 6 matches mno, 7 matches pqrs, 8 matches tuv, and 9 matches wxyz. Moving from the left of the text to the right, pick one letter for each digit and form every possible letter text. Write all of those letter texts. Any arrangement among them is acceptable.

18.zh: 读入一组整数以及一个目标和。在四个不同位置各选一个数，使四数相加等于目标和。找出全部选择，但若两组所含数值的种类和次数都一样，只写一次。把留下的每组四个数写出来。组的顺序以及每组内部的顺序都没有限制。
18.en: Read a collection of integers and one goal sum. Pick one number from each of four different positions so the four numbers add up to the goal. Find every pick, yet when two picks contain the same values the same number of times, write that pick only once. Write each remaining group of four numbers. Neither the order of groups nor the order inside a group is fixed.

19.zh: 读入一条单链和一个正整数 n。链上结点个数 sz 满足 1 小于等于 sz 小于等于 30，结点中的整数满足 0 到 100，n 满足 1 到 sz。从尾端向前数到第 n 个结点，把该结点移出链条，其他结点原来的先后关系保持不变。写出移出之后的链头。如果链条因此变空，写出空结果。
19.en: Read one singly linked chain and a positive integer n. The node count sz satisfies 1 less than or equal to sz less than or equal to 30, each integer stored in a node lies from 0 to 100, and n lies from 1 through sz. Count n nodes forward from the tail and detach that node, keeping the earlier relative order of every other node. Write the head that remains after the detachment. If the chain becomes empty, write an empty result.

20.zh: 读入一条文本，字符只能是圆括号、方括号和花括号的左右形式。判断这些括号是否一一正确闭合。每种开括号都要用相同形状的闭括号来收尾，后打开的必须先收尾，不允许互相交叉。没有任何字符的文本算作正确。把判断写成真或假。
20.en: Read a text whose characters can only be opening or closing round, square, or curly brackets. Decide whether the brackets close in a fully correct way. Each opener must be finished by a closer of the same shape, a later opener must be finished before an earlier one, and pairs may not cross. A text with no characters counts as correct. Write true or false for the decision.

21.zh: 读入两条按结点中的整数从小到大连接好的单链。把两条链上的结点全部接到一条新的单链里，新链同样从小到大。允许改写每个结点指向后继的指针，不允许改写结点里的整数。写出新链的头。任何一条输入链都可以是空的，空链不提供结点。
21.en: Read two singly linked chains whose stored integers already run from small to large along each chain. Attach every node from both chains into one fresh chain that also runs from small to large. Changing the pointer from a node to its successor is allowed, but changing the integer inside a node is not. Write the head of the fresh chain. Either input chain may be empty, and an empty chain supplies no nodes.

22.zh: 读入非负整数 n。使用 n 个左圆括号和 n 个右圆括号，找出每一个能够正确闭合的排列。正确闭合指：从头数到任何一个位置，左括号的累计个数都不少于右括号，并且整段里两者个数相等。把每个合格排列写成一条文本。这些文本之间的先后不限。
22.en: Read a non-negative integer n. Using n opening round brackets and n closing round brackets, find every arrangement that closes correctly. Correct closing means that, from the start up to any position, the running count of openers is never below the running count of closers, and the whole arrangement has equal counts. Write each accepted arrangement as its own text. The order among those texts is not fixed.

23.zh: 读入 k 条单链，k 可以为 0。每一条单链内部，结点里的整数已经从小到大排好。把所有链上的结点汇成唯一一条单链，汇合后的整条链也要从小到大。可以改指针，不可以改结点中的整数。写出汇合后的链头。一个结点都没有时，写出空结果。
23.en: Read k singly linked chains, and k may be 0. Inside each chain, the integers in the nodes already run from small to large. Gather every node from all chains into exactly one chain, and that combined chain must also run from small to large. Pointers may be rewritten, but integers inside nodes may not. Write the head of the combined chain. When no node exists, write an empty result.

24.zh: 读入一条单链。从链头起，把结点分成前后相邻的一对一对，每对内部两个结点互换位置。链长为奇数时，最后那个落单的结点留在原处。只许改变结点之间的链接关系，每个结点保存的整数保持原值。写出互换完成后的链头。
24.en: Read one singly linked chain. From the head, group the nodes into successive neighboring couples, and inside each couple exchange the two nodes' places. When the length is odd, the final unpaired node stays in its original place. Only the links between nodes may change, and the integer saved in each node keeps its original value. Write the head once the exchanges are finished.

25.zh: 读入一条单链和一个正整数 k，k 不超过结点总数。从链头起每满 k 个结点，就把这 k 个结点的链接方向整个倒过来。尾部不足 k 个的结点保持原有方向。额外占用的存储只能维持在常数规模。结点中的整数不可以改动。写出处理完毕的链头。
25.en: Read one singly linked chain and a positive integer k, where k is no larger than the node total. From the head, each time a full block of k nodes is available, turn the links of that whole block around. Nodes left at the tail in a block shorter than k keep their original direction. Extra storage may stay only at a fixed size. Integers inside nodes must not be altered. Write the head when processing finishes.

26.zh: 读入一段已经从小到大排序的整数。在原有存储里压缩这段整数，使每个不同的值只保留一次，且保留值仍按升序相邻。不要再申请一段同样长度的新存储，额外空间维持常数。写出压缩后有效部分的长度。该长度后面的格子里留下什么都可以。
26.en: Read a stretch of integers that is already sorted from small to large. Compact that stretch inside its current storage so each distinct value is kept once and the kept values stay adjacent in ascending order. Do not request a second stretch of the same length, and keep spare space at a fixed size. Write the length of the compacted live part. Cells after that length may contain anything.

27.zh: 读入一段整数，再读入一个叫 val 的目标整数。在原存储中去掉每一个等于 val 的元素，其余元素留下来，留下来的元素可以改变彼此的先后。不要申请另一段同样长度的存储，额外空间维持常数。写出留下来的元素个数。个数范围之外的格子无需抹掉。
27.en: Read a stretch of integers and one target integer named val. Inside the current storage, drop every element equal to val and keep the rest. Kept elements may change order relative to one another. Do not request another stretch of the same length, and keep spare space at a fixed size. Write how many elements stay. Cells outside that count do not need to be wiped.

28.zh: 读入两段文本，前一段叫干草堆，后一段叫针。找出针作为连续片段第一次出现在干草堆中的起始位置，位置从 0 开始计数。针若从未出现，写出 -1。针若是空文本，写出 0。逐字符比较，英文字母区分大小写。
28.en: Read two texts. Call the first text the haystack and the second text the needle. Find the starting position of the first time the needle appears as a contiguous fragment inside the haystack. Positions are counted from 0. If the needle never appears, write -1. If the needle is an empty text, write 0. Compare one character at a time, and treat uppercase and lowercase letters as different.

29.zh: 读入两个 32 位有符号整数，先出现的是被除数，后出现的是除数，除数不会是 0。用后出现的那个数去除先出现的那个数，小数部分直接舍去，使结果朝向 0 取整。整个计算不许用乘法、除法或取余运算。能保存的整数范围是负二的三十一次方到二的三十一次方减一。结果若超出范围，写出二的三十一次方减一；否则写出该结果。
29.en: Read two signed integers stored in 32 bits. The first is the dividend and the second is the divisor, and the divisor is never 0. Compute how many times the divisor fits into the dividend, dropping any fractional part so the result is rounded toward 0. The calculation must not use multiplication, division, or a remainder operation. Stored integers stay between negative two to the thirty-first power and two to the thirty-first power minus one. If the result falls outside that span, write two to the thirty-first power minus one. Otherwise write the result.

30.zh: 读入一段源文本，以及若干个长度彼此相等的单词。把这些单词各取一次，按任意先后紧贴着拼起来，中间不许塞进别的字符。在源文本里找出每一处与这种拼法完全吻合的连续片段，并把每个片段起点的下标全部写出来。片段可以互相重叠，也可以分开，有几处就写几处。若一处都没有，结果为空。
30.en: Read one source text and several words that all have the same length. Join those words in any order, using each word a single time and putting no extra characters between them. Find every place where a contiguous piece of the source matches such a join, and write the starting index of each place. Overlapping pieces and separate pieces all count. When no place matches, the written result is empty.

31.zh: 读入一列整数，列长介于 1 与 100 之间，每个整数介于 0 与 100 之间。把这一列就地改成字典序中刚好紧挨着的更大排法，并仍写在原来的位置上。若已经不存在更大的排法，就改成从小到大的最小排法。除这一列本身以外，额外占用的辅助位置数量必须保持固定，不能随列长增长。
31.en: Read a sequence of integers. Its length is from 1 to 100, and each integer is from 0 to 100. Rewrite that same sequence into the next greater ordering under dictionary order, keeping the new ordering in the original slots. When no greater ordering exists, rewrite the sequence into the smallest ordering, increasing from left to right. Extra scratch space must stay a fixed amount and must not grow with the length.

32.zh: 读入一串只含左右圆括号的文本，长度可以从 0 一直到 3 乘以 104。从中找出一段连续片段，片段里的括号配对完全正确，并且这段的字符数在所有正确片段里最长。把这个长度写出来。正确指每个左括号都能配上右括号，嵌套或并排都算。若整串里没有任何正确片段，长度写 0。
32.en: Read a text that contains only opening and closing round parentheses. Its length runs from 0 up to 3 times 104. Find a contiguous slice whose parentheses pair correctly, and choose the slice with the greatest number of characters. Write that length. A correct slice pairs every opening mark with a closing mark, and both nesting and side by side pairs are allowed. When the text has no correct slice, write 0.

33.zh: 读入一列互不相同的整数，以及一个待查数字。这列整数曾经从小到大排好，随后绕着某个事先没有告知的支点转过一次，于是后半截被搬到了前半截的前面。判断待查数字是否出现在这列里。出现就把对应下标写出来，没有出现就写 -1。下标从 0 起算。
33.en: Read a list of distinct integers and one number to look up. The list was once ordered from small to large, then turned once around a pivot that is not announced ahead of time, so a tail section now sits in front of the former head. Decide whether the looked up number occurs. Write its index when it occurs, and write -1 when it does not. Indexes start at 0.

34.zh: 读入一列已经从小到大排好的整数，以及一个要定位的数。数列里允许相同的值相邻。找出这个数最早出现的下标和最晚出现的下标，按先早后晚写成两个整数。若这个数一次都没有出现，两个位置都写 -1。只出现一次时，两个下标相同。下标从 0 起算。
34.en: Read a list of integers already arranged from small to large, together with one number to locate. Equal values may sit next to each other. Write two indexes: the earliest slot where that number appears and the latest slot where it appears. When the number is absent, write -1 in both places. When it appears only once, the two indexes are equal. Indexes start at 0.

35.zh: 读入一列从小到大排好的整数，彼此都不相同，再读入一个要安放的数。若这个数已经在数列中，把它当前的下标写出来。若还没有，写出按现有顺序把它插进去之后应当占据的下标，插好以后整列仍然从小到大。下标从 0 开始。插在最前时下标为 0，插在最后时下标等于当前长度。
35.en: Read a list of distinct integers arranged from small to large, then read one number to place. When that number already occurs, write the index of its current slot. When it does not occur, write the index it should take so that inserting it there keeps the list increasing. Indexes begin at 0. Placing it before every current value yields 0. Placing it after every current value yields the present length.

36.zh: 读入一张九行九列的格子表。每格要么是 1 到 9 的数字，要么是表示空位的点号。判断已经写下的数字有没有互相打架，空位可以跳过，也不必判断整张表以后能否填完。任意一行里同一个数字至多写下一次，任意一列里同样如此，每个三行三列的小方块里也如此。符合就写成立，否则写不成立。
36.en: Read a grid of 9 rows and 9 columns. A cell holds a digit from 1 through 9, or a dot when it is blank. Decide whether the digits already written conflict with each other. Blank cells may be ignored, and you need not decide whether the grid can later be completed. In any row, any column, and any block of 3 rows by 3 columns, a digit may be written at most once. Write yes when this holds, and write no otherwise.

37.zh: 读入一张九行九列的格子表。点号表示待填的空位，其余格子已经是 1 到 9。给每个空位填上一个数字，使每一横行恰好含有 1 到 9 各一次，每一竖列也各一次，每个三行三列的小方块同样各一次。已知这样的填法有且只有一种。把填完后的整张表写出来。
37.en: Read a grid of 9 rows and 9 columns. Dots mark cells still open, and every other cell already holds a digit from 1 through 9. Fill each open cell with a digit so that every row contains 1 through 9 once each, every column does likewise, and every block of 3 rows by 3 columns does likewise. Exactly one such filling exists. Write the grid after every open cell has been filled.

39.zh: 读入一串互不相同的正整数，再读入一个目标和。找出所有和刚好等于该目标的取法，并把每种取法中的数写出来。同一个数可以在一种取法里反复出现许多次。两种取法若包含的数值以及各自次数都相同，只算一种，即使书写顺序不同也不要再写一遍。取法中的每个数都必须来自读入的那一串。
39.en: Read a list of positive integers with no repeated values, then read one target total. Find every selection of values from that list whose sum equals the target, and write the values in each selection. Inside one selection the same value may be picked again and again. Two selections that hold the same values the same number of times count as one, even when their written order differs, so write that selection only once. Every picked value must come from the list.

40.zh: 读入一串可以出现相同数值的正整数，再读入一个目标和。找出所有和刚好等于该目标的选法。在同一种选法里，读入序列的每一个位置最多被取走一次，数值相同也要按不同位置分别计算。若两种选法里的数值及其次数完全一致，只保留一份。把每一份保留下来的选法写出来。
40.en: Read a list of positive integers that may repeat, then read one target total. Find every selection whose values add up to that total. Inside one selection, each position of the list may be taken at most once, so equal values still belong to separate positions. When two selections contain the same values the same number of times, keep a single copy. Write every selection that remains after those copies are dropped.

41.zh: 读入一串尚未排序的整数，其中可以夹着负数、零以及重复的值。从 1 开始向上检查正整数，找出最小的那个没有在这串数里出现过的正整数，并把它写出来。判断时只看实际读到的这些数，不要自行假定一个写在题目旁边的固定上界。若 1 本身就没有出现，答案就是 1。
41.en: Read an unordered list of integers. Negatives, zeros, and repeated values may all appear. Starting at 1 and counting upward through the positive integers, find the smallest one that never occurs in the list, and write it. Base the decision only on the values actually read, without assuming a fixed ceiling printed beside the task. When 1 itself is absent, the answer is 1.

42.zh: 读入一排非负整数。每个整数是一根竖条的高度，每根竖条宽度都是 1，它们从左到右紧靠着立在同一条水平底边上。雨水落下后会积在较矮的凹陷处。把整排能积住的雨水体积加总，写出这个总量。竖条自身占据的部分不算进雨水。高度为 0 的位置没有竖条，但仍然占着一格宽度。
42.en: Read a row of non-negative integers. Each integer is the height of one vertical bar, every bar has width 1, and the bars stand side by side on one flat baseline. After rain falls, water can settle in the lower gaps. Add the volume of water held along the whole row and write that total. The solid bars themselves are not part of the water. A height of 0 means no bar, yet that slot still occupies width 1.

43.zh: 读入两段仅由数字字符构成的文本，每段长度至少 1、至多 200。把每段看成一个非负整数。除了整数 0 本身，两段都不会以多余的 0 开头。求出这两个整数相乘的结果，再用一串数字字符把乘积的十进制写法写出来，不要加空格，也不要加正号。乘积可能比任意一段输入都更长。
43.en: Read two texts made only of digit characters. Each text has length at least 1 and at most 200. Treat each text as a non-negative integer. Except for the integer 0 itself, neither text starts with a spare 0. Multiply the two integers and write the product as decimal digit characters, with no spaces and no plus sign. The product may contain more digits than either input text.

45.zh: 读入一串非负整数，长度介于 1 和 1000 之间，每个数都不超过 10^5。人从最左侧的格子出发。停在某一格时，格子上的数表示从这里向前最远可以跨出的格数，少跨几格也可以。写出到达最右侧格子所需的最少跨步次数。题目保证最右侧一定能够到达，所以答案总是一个有限的正数或零。
45.en: Read a list of non-negative integers. The length is between 1 and 1000, and every value is at most 10^5. A person starts on the leftmost cell. The value in the current cell is the farthest number of cells that person may leap forward, and a shorter leap is allowed. Write the smallest number of leaps needed to land on the rightmost cell. Reaching that cell is always possible, so the answer is a finite count.

46.zh: 读入一串彼此数值都不相同的整数。把这些整数能够排成的每一种先后次序全部列出来。次序只要有一个位置上的数不同，就算另一种结果。每一种次序里，同一个整数恰好出现一回，不能多也不能少。读入时的原始次序也要包含在结果中。写出所有这些次序。
46.en: Read a list of integers in which all values differ. Write every ordering those integers can form. Two orderings are different as soon as some position holds a different integer. Inside any one ordering, each integer appears exactly once, no more and no less. The ordering that matches the input must be included along with every rearrangement. Write all of those orderings.

47.zh: 读入一串允许数值相同的整数。列出这些整数能够形成的每一种看起来不一样的次序。若两种次序从左到右完全一致，只保留一份。把两个相等的数值对调之后样子没有变化，这种情况不要重复写出。每种保留下来的次序里，各个数值出现的次数必须和读入时一致。把这些次序全部写出来。
47.en: Read a list of integers that may contain equal values. Write every ordering that looks different from the others. When two orderings agree from left to right, keep only one copy. Swapping two equal values leaves the ordering unchanged, so do not write that case again. In every kept ordering, each value must occur as many times as it does in the input. Write all of those orderings.

48.zh: 读入一张正方形整数表，行数与列数相等，用来表示一幅图。把整幅图按顺时针方向转过九十度，转完的内容写回原来的格子。转过之后，原先的第一行变成最右边的一列，后面各行也按同样方式挪过去。不要再申请一张同样大小的表来存放结果，临时使用的额外格子数量应当固定不变。
48.en: Read a square table of integers, with as many rows as columns, standing for a picture. Turn the whole picture ninety degrees clockwise and store the result back in the original cells. After the turn, the old first row becomes the rightmost column, and each later row moves in the same fashion. Do not request a second table of equal size to hold the result. The amount of temporary extra cells should stay fixed.

49.zh: 读入若干个只含小写英文字母的单词。如果两个单词用到的字母种类相同，而且每种字母的个数也相同，仅仅前后次序不一样，就把它们算作同一组。按照这个标准把全部单词分成若干组，一组里的单词写在一起。组与组的先后可以任意，组内单词的先后也可以任意。每个单词恰好属于一组。
49.en: Read several words that contain only lowercase English letters. When two words use the same letters and the same count of each letter, and differ only by order, place them in one family. Split the full list into such families and write the words of each family together. Families may be written in any order, and words inside a family may be written in any order. Every word belongs to exactly one family.

50.zh: 读入一个实数底数和一个整数指数。底数严格大于 -100，并且严格小于 100。指数是 32 位有符号整数，落在负的 2 的 31 次方到 2 的 31 次方减 1 这个闭区间里。算出底数的指数次方，把得到的实数写出来。指数为 0 时结果是 1。指数为负时，结果等于对应正指数次方的倒数。
50.en: Read a real base and an integer exponent. The base is strictly above -100 and strictly below 100. The exponent is a 32-bit signed integer lying in the closed span from negative 2 to the power 31 through 2 to the power 31 minus 1. Compute the base raised to that exponent and write the real value. An exponent of 0 yields 1. A negative exponent yields the reciprocal of the power with the exponent made positive.

51.zh: 读入一个正整数，它既是棋盘边长，也是要摆上的皇后枚数。在这个正方形棋盘上摆放这些皇后，使任意两枚都不共享横行、竖列或斜线，从而不能互相吃子。找出每一种不同的摆法。皇后用大写字母 Q 表示，空格用点号表示。把每种摆法按行从上到下写出来。
51.en: Read one positive integer. It is both the side of a square board and the number of queens to place. Place the queens so that no pair shares a row, a column, or a diagonal, and therefore no pair can capture another. Find every different placement. Mark a queen with the capital letter Q and mark an empty cell with a dot. Write each placement from the top row downward.

52.zh: 读入一个正整数。它同时表示正方形棋盘的边长和要摆放的皇后枚数。统计有多少种摆法可以让这些皇后互不攻击，也就是任意两枚都不在同一横行、同一竖列或同一条斜线上。只把这个种数写出来，不要展开每一张棋盘。边长至少是 1。所占格子集合不同才算不同摆法。
52.en: Read one positive integer. It sets both the side of a square board and how many queens must be placed. Count the placements in which no two queens attack, meaning no two share a row, a column, or one diagonal. Write only that count. Do not print each board. The side is at least 1. Placements differ only when the sets of occupied cells differ.

53.zh: 读入一串整数，里面可以出现负数。从这串数里圈出一段连续区间，区间中至少要留下一个数。把区间里的整数全部相加，要使这个和在所有合法区间中最大，并把该和写出来。如果每个数都是负数，答案就是其中最大的那一个单独的数。只写这个和，不必写出区间的起止下标。
53.en: Read a list of integers that may include negative values. Choose one contiguous span from the list. The span has to keep at least one value. Add the integers inside the span and write the largest total that any allowed span can produce. When every integer is negative, the answer is the greatest single integer in the list. Write the total only, not the endpoint indexes of the span.

54.zh: 读入一张由整数组成的表格，行数和列数都至少为 1。从左上角那一格出发，顺着顺时针方向一圈又一圈向里走，每个格子只经过一次，直到走完所有格子。把经过的整数按访问先后依次写出来。只有一行或只有一列时，路径就是顺着这条直线走完。不要漏掉格子，也不要重复经过。
54.en: Read a table of integers with at least one row and at least one column. Start at the top-left cell and walk clockwise, ring after ring, toward the center. Pass each cell once until every cell has been passed. Write the integers in the order of those visits. A table that has only one row or only one column is a straight walk along that line. Do not skip a cell and do not pass a cell twice.

55.zh: 读入一串非负整数。人站在最左边的格子上。某一格写下的数字，是从该格向前最多可以迈出的步数，迈得更少也同样允许。判断在这些限制下能不能到达最右边的格子。能够到达就写能，不能到达就写不能。这里只需要这个是否成立的结论，不必报告具体用了多少步。
55.en: Read a list of non-negative integers. A person stands on the leftmost cell. The number written in a cell is the largest forward distance that person may step from there, and any shorter step is also allowed. Decide whether the rightmost cell can be reached under those limits. Write yes when it can be reached, and write no when it cannot. Only that decision is required, not a count of steps.

56.zh: 读入若干条闭区间，每条用左端点和右端点两个整数表示。当两条区间互相交叉，或者只在端点上碰上，就把它们收成一条更长的区间，新的两端要能盖住原先的两段。不断重复，直到剩下的区间两两都不再碰上。把最后留下的每条区间写出来，并按左端点从小到大排列。
56.en: Read several closed ranges. Each range is given by two integers, a left end and a right end. When two ranges cross, or meet at an endpoint, replace them by one longer range whose ends cover both original pieces. Keep doing this until the ranges that remain no longer meet. Write every range that is left, ordered by increasing left ends. A shared endpoint is enough to join two ranges.

57.zh: 读入一组闭区间，它们已经按左端点从小到大排好，而且彼此既不相交也不相接。再读入一条新的闭区间。把这条新区间放进原来的一组。凡是与新区间相交，或在端点上相接的旧区间，都要并成一条，两端覆盖所有被并进去的部分。写出并完之后的整组区间。与新区间完全分开的旧区间保持原样。
57.en: Read a list of closed ranges already ordered by left ends. Those ranges neither cross nor touch. Then read one extra closed range and place it into the list. Join it with every existing range that overlaps it or meets it at an endpoint, using ends that cover every joined piece. Write the full list after the joins. Ranges that stay completely clear of the extra one remain as they were.

58.zh: 读入一段长度从 1 到 104 的文本，其中只有英文字母和空格。空格把文本隔成若干单词，而且至少存在一个单词。一个单词是一段连续字母，内部没有空格。找出最靠右端的那个单词，把它包含的字母个数写出来。这个单词前后的空格都不算进个数。即使文本末尾还有空格，最后那个单词仍然按字母计数。
58.en: Read a text whose length is from 1 to 104. The text holds only English letters and spaces. Spaces divide it into words, and at least one word is present. A word is a stretch of letters with no space inside. Find the word closest to the right end and write how many letters it holds. Spaces before or after that word do not raise the count. Trailing spaces at the end of the text still leave the final word counted by its letters.

59.zh: 读入一个正整数，用它作为正方形的边长。做出一张边长相同的方表，把从 1 起的连续整数填进格子，一直填到边长的平方为止。填写从左上角开始，沿顺时针绕圈并逐步向内收，每个格子恰好填入一个整数。把填好的方表按行从上到下写出来。边长为 1 时，表里只有整数 1。
59.en: Read one positive integer and use it as the side of a square. Build a square table of that side and fill the cells with the successive integers that begin at 1 and end at the square of the side. Start at the top-left cell, then move clockwise and inward so each cell receives exactly one integer. Write the finished table from the top row downward. When the side is 1, the table holds only the integer 1.

60.zh: 读入两个正整数 n 与 k。将 1、2、直到 n 这几个数各取一次，组成所有互异的先后次序，并按字典序由小到大编上号码，最小的一串记为 1 号。找出号码刚好是 k 的那一串，把各位数字紧贴着连成一段文本写出来。n 的范围是 1 到 9，k 的范围是 1 到 n 的阶乘，所以所求的那一串必定存在。
60.en: Read two positive integers n and k. Take the values 1, 2, and so on through n, each once, and form every distinct ordering. Rank those orderings by dictionary order, smallest first, and number them from 1. Find the ordering whose rank equals k. Write its digits packed into one text with nothing between them. The integer n lies from 1 through 9, and k lies from 1 through the factorial of n, so the requested ordering always exists.

61.zh: 读入一条单链表，以及一个不小于零的整数 k。把整条链朝右循环挪动 k 步：从尾部数出 k 个结点，整块接到表头之前，其余结点彼此的前后关系保持原样。若 k 大于结点总数，先用总数取余数再挪。写出挪完之后从新的表头到新的表尾的结点值。空链则仍然为空。结点值按它们在新链中的先后写出。
61.en: Read one singly linked list and one integer k that is zero or positive. Cycle the chain rightward by k steps. Count k nodes from the tail, move that block to the front, and leave the relative order of every other node unchanged. When k exceeds the node count, replace k by its remainder modulo that count before moving anything. Write the node values from the new head through the new tail. An empty chain stays empty. Keep the values in the order of the new chain.

62.zh: 读入两个正整数，分别当作行数 m 与列数 n。一枚棋子从网格最西北的格子出发，要走到最东南的格子。每一步只许进入正南方紧邻的格子，或正东方紧邻的格子，不许朝北、朝西、斜向，也不许原地不动。请统计不同走法的种数并写出来。格子上没有任何阻挡，每条走法都是一串这样的步伐。m 和 n 都至少为 1。
62.en: Read two positive integers, the row count m and the column count n of a grid. A piece begins on the northwest cell and must stop on the southeast cell. A step may enter only the cell directly south or the cell directly east. Northward steps, westward steps, diagonal steps, and staying still are all forbidden. Count the distinct routes and write that count. No cell is blocked, and each route is a sequence of those steps. Both m and n are at least 1.

63.zh: 读入一张 m 行 n 列的格子图。格子里的 0 代表可以踏入的空地，1 代表不能踏入的阻挡。棋子从最西北出发，想到达最东南。每一步只能走进南边紧邻或东边紧邻的空地。若出发格或终点格本身是阻挡，种数就是 0。请把避开全部阻挡的不同走法种数写出来。中途踏进阻挡的走法一律不算。
63.en: Read a grid with m rows and n columns. A cell that stores 0 is open ground, and a cell that stores 1 is a block that cannot be entered. A piece starts at the northwest cell and wants the southeast cell. Each step may enter only the open cell next to it on the south side or the east side. When the starting cell or the ending cell is a block, the count is 0. Write how many distinct routes avoid every block. Any route that steps on a block is ignored.

64.zh: 读入一张 m 行 n 列的表，每格是一个大于或等于零的整数。从最西北的格子出发，走到最东南的格子，每一步只能踏入南边相邻或东边相邻的格子。把经过的每一格里的数都加进总和，出发格和到达格也要加。找出所有走法里这个总和的最小值，并把该值写出来。若好几条走法的总和一样小，写出这个最小的和就够了，不必列出具体走法。
64.en: Read a table of m rows and n columns. Every cell holds an integer that is zero or positive. Start on the northwest cell and finish on the southeast cell. Each step may land only on the neighboring cell to the south or the neighboring cell to the east. Add the integer in every cell you touch, including the start and the finish. Find the smallest total among all routes and write that total. When several routes share that smallest total, writing the total is enough.

65.zh: 读入一行文本。判断它算不算一个合法的十进制数值，算就算写出 true，不算就写出 false。正文要么是整数，要么是带点的小数，后面还可以接上指数。指数用字母 e 或 E 开头，后面必须再跟一个整数。整数可以先写加号或减号，符号之后至少要有一个数字。小数同样可以先写符号，符号之后只能是这三种样子：若干数字再加一个点、若干数字再加一个点再加若干数字、或者一个点再加若干数字。指数里的整数不能再出现点。两个符号挨在一起、指数缺了数字、混进其它字母、或者只有点而没有任何数字，都算不合法。
65.en: Read a single string s. Print true when s is legal as a decimal numeral and print false otherwise. The whole text is a whole number or a fraction, and it may then carry an exponent. An exponent is the letter e or the letter E, then a whole number. A whole number may start with a plus or a minus, and after the sign it needs at least one digit. A fraction may also start with a plus or a minus. After that sign, the rest must be digits and then a dot, or digits and then a dot and then digits, or a dot and then digits. The exponent whole number cannot itself contain a dot. Two signs in a row, a missing exponent, a stray letter, or a dot with no digit anywhere all make s illegal.

66.zh: 读入一个非空数组，它从高位到低位记下某个不小于零的整数，每位只放一个 0 到 9 的数字。除了数值本身就是 0 的情况，最高位不会是 0。请把这个整数增加 1，仍按高位在前的顺序把每一位写出来。末尾若是一连串 9，进位要继续向高位传递；若最高位也产生进位，结果会多出一位。只输出增加之后的各位数字。
66.en: Read a non-empty list of digits that records a zero-or-positive integer, with the high digit at the left. Each entry is one digit from 0 through 9. The high digit is 0 only when the whole value is 0. Add 1 to that integer and write every digit of the sum, still with the high digit at the left. When the tail is a stretch of nines, keep carrying toward the high end. When the high end also carries, the written result gains one extra digit. Write only the digits of the increased value.

67.zh: 读入两条非空的文本，每条只由字符 0 和字符 1 组成，把它们当作二进制整数相加，再把和写成二进制文本输出。相加时右边是低位，某一位的和达到 2 或更大时，向左边进 1。两条文本长度可以不一样，短的那条在高位一侧当作补了 0。不要在结果里插入空格。公开样例里出现过和为 10101 的二进制结果，写出时要保留它的每一位有效数字。
67.en: Read two non-empty texts. Each text uses only the character 0 and the character 1. Add the two values as binary integers and write the sum as a binary text. The right end is the low bit. When a column adds up to 2 or more, carry 1 toward the left. The texts may have different lengths; treat the shorter one as if zeros were placed on its high side. Do not insert spaces into the result. One public sample has a binary sum of 10101, and the written form must keep every significant bit of that sum.

69.zh: 读入一个不小于零的整数 x。找出最大的整数 r，使 r 与 r 的乘积仍然不超过 x，并把 r 写出来。当 x 开方后带有小数时，把小数直接丢掉，不要四舍五入到更大的整数。x 等于 0 时，写出的结果也是 0。只写这一个整数，不要附加单位或解释。r 本身也必须是不小于零的整数。
69.en: Read an integer x that is zero or positive. Find the largest integer r whose product with itself is still no greater than x, and write r. When the true root has a fractional part, drop that fraction rather than rounding up to a larger integer. When x equals 0, the written result is 0 as well. Write that single integer, with no unit and no explanation beside it. The integer r itself must also be zero or positive.

70.zh: 读入一个正整数 n，表示从地面到楼顶一共有 n 级台阶。每一次向上可以跨过 1 级，也可以跨过 2 级，两种跨法都能反复使用。跨法的先后不同，就记成不同的方法。请统计从地面到达楼顶的方法种数并写出来。不许向下走，也不许一次跨过 3 级或更多。n 最小是 1。只把方法种数写出来，不必逐条列出每次怎么跨。
70.en: Read a positive integer n. It is the number of stairs between the ground and the top. Each move may cover one stair or two stairs, and either choice may be used again on later moves. Different orders of those choices count as different methods. Count the methods that start on the ground and reach the top, and write that count. Moving downward is forbidden, and a single move may not cover three stairs or more. The integer n is at least 1. Write only the count, not a list of the moves.

71.zh: 读入一条以斜线开头的绝对路径，书写风格与 Unix 相同。请把它整理成规范写法并输出。单独一个点表示当前目录，应当删去；连续两个点表示回到上一层目录。连续出现的多条斜线要收成一条。规范结果永远以一条斜线开头，目录名之间只用一条斜线分隔，结尾不再额外加斜线，只有整条路径就是根目录时才可以只剩一条斜线。若回到上一层的次数已经超过现有层数，就停在根目录。除了单个点和两个点之外，其它目录名按原样保留。
71.en: Read an absolute path that starts with a slash and is written in the same style as Unix. Rewrite it into a cleaned form and print that form. A lone dot means the directory you are already in and must be removed. A pair of dots means go back one directory level. Repeated slashes collapse into a single slash. The cleaned form always opens with one slash, puts one slash between names, and adds no extra slash at the end, except that the root itself is a single slash. If parent steps outnumber existing levels, stay at the root. Any name other than a lone dot or a pair of dots is kept unchanged.

73.zh: 读入一个整数矩阵，行数 m 与列数 n 都在 1 和 200 之间，包含两端。只要原始矩阵某处的数是 0，就把同一横行的每一格改成 0，也把同一竖列的每一格改成 0。若干个 0 的影响要合并。哪些行和列需要清空，只能根据改写之前就已经是 0 的格子来决定，改写途中新写成的 0 不得继续蔓延。请直接改这份矩阵，并把改完的每一行写出来。
73.en: Read an integer matrix whose row count m and column count n are both from 1 through 200, ends included. Whenever a cell of the original matrix holds 0, change every cell of that same horizontal line to 0, and change every cell of that same vertical line to 0. Effects from several zeros combine. Choose the lines to clear only from cells that were already 0 before any edit, so a 0 written during the edit must not spread. Edit this matrix directly and write every finished row.

74.zh: 读入一个 m 行 n 列的整数矩阵，再读入一个目标整数。矩阵满足两条规律：在同一行内部，从左侧走向右侧时数值越来越大；任意一行最左侧的数，都严格大于它正上方那一行最右侧的数。判断目标整数有没有在矩阵中出现，出现就写出 true，没有就写出 false。没有任何格子的矩阵视为未出现。各行长度一致。
74.en: Read a matrix of integers with m rows and n columns, then read one target integer. Two facts hold. Inside a single row, values become larger while moving from the left side toward the right side. The leftmost value of any row is strictly larger than the rightmost value of the row sitting just above it. Decide whether the target integer occurs in the matrix. Write true when it occurs and false when it does not. A matrix with no cells counts as absent. Every row has the same length.

75.zh: 读入长度为 n 的一列整数，每个数只能是 0、1 或 2。0 代表红色，1 代表白色，2 代表蓝色。请把这一列重新排好，使所有 0 位于所有 1 之前，所有 1 位于所有 2 之前，相同的数彼此靠在一起。重排直接发生在原来的那一列上，然后把排完的整列写出来。不要再申请一块同样长度的新存储来抄写这些数。
75.en: Read a list of n integers. Each integer can only be 0, 1, or 2. Zero stands for red, one stands for white, and two stands for blue. Rearrange the list so that every 0 sits before every 1, and every 1 sits before every 2, with equal values gathered together. Do the rearrangement inside the original list, then write the whole list after that change. Do not request another block of storage with the same length just to copy these numbers.

76.zh: 读入两段文本，源文本叫 S，目标文本叫 T。请在 S 里找出一段连续区间，使 T 里每个字符被覆盖的次数不少于它在 T 中出现的次数，区间里也可以夹着 T 完全没有的字符。在所有满足条件的区间中，写出最短的那一段。若存在满足条件的区间，最短的一段只有一个。若一段都没有，就写出空文本。大写字母与小写字母视为不同字符。
76.en: Read two texts, a source named S and a target named T. Inside S, find one contiguous stretch that covers T. Covering means every character occurs in the stretch at least as many times as it occurs in T. Characters absent from T may still sit inside the stretch. Among stretches that cover T, write the shortest one. If any covering stretch exists, only one stretch has that shortest length. If no stretch covers T, write an empty text. Uppercase letters and lowercase letters count as different characters.

77.zh: 读入两个正整数 n 和 k。从 1 到 n 的整数中取出恰好 k 个，取出时不计较先后，只看最终有哪些数。把每一种互不相同的取法都写出来。同一种取法内部按从小到大书写这些数。所有取法之间按字典序排列。不要遗漏，也不要把同一种取法写上两遍。当 k 比 n 大时，一种取法也没有。每个被取出的数都必须来自 1 到 n。
77.en: Read two positive integers n and k. From the integers 1 through n, pick exactly k values. The order of picking does not matter; only the final set of values matters. Write every set that can be formed this way. Inside one set, write the values from smaller to larger. Arrange the sets themselves in dictionary order. Do not leave a set out, and do not write the same set twice. When k is larger than n, no set exists. Every picked value must come from 1 through n.

78.zh: 读入若干个彼此不同的整数。写出它的每一个子集。子集是保留其中一部分数的结果，一个都不留的空子集要算上，全部留下的结果也要算上。子集内部各数的左右次序与它们在输入里的左右次序相同。同一个子集不要输出两次。每个整数都可以是负数或者零。输出必须覆盖全部子集，不能只写非空的那些。
78.en: Read several integers that all differ from one another. Write every subset of that list. A subset keeps some of the values, and it may keep none of them or keep all of them. Inside a subset, the left-to-right order of values matches their order in the input. Do not emit one subset two times. Any integer may be negative or zero. The written result must cover every subset, not only the subsets that contain a value.

79.zh: 读入一块由字母填满的二维格子，再读入一个单词。判断这个单词能不能沿着格子被逐字连出来，能就写出 true，不能就写出 false。连线必须依照单词里字母的先后。每一步只能走到上、下、左、右四个方向上紧挨着的格子，不能走斜线。在同一次连线中，一个格子至多贡献一次。格子边界以外不能进入。大写与小写算作不同字母。
79.en: Read a two-dimensional grid filled with letters, then read one word. Decide whether the word can be traced cell by cell across the grid. Write true when a trace exists and false when it does not. A trace must follow the letters of the word from its first letter to its last letter. Each step enters a touching cell above, below, left, or right, and never moves on a diagonal. During one trace, one cell may contribute at most one time. A step may not leave the grid. Uppercase and lowercase count as different letters.

80.zh: 读入一列已经按非递减次序排好的整数。请在这同一列上删掉多余的重复项，让每个数值至多留下两个，留下的那些数仍保持原先的相对次序。把留下部分的长度写出来。留下的数要靠在列的前部，长度之后的位置不必关心。不要另开一列同样长度的新数组来保存这些数。输入本身已经从左到右不下降。
80.en: Read a list of integers already arranged in non-decreasing order. On that same list, delete extra copies so that each value is left at most two times, while the values that remain keep their previous relative order. Write the length of the part that remains. Pack the remaining values at the front of the list. Slots after that length do not matter. Do not open another array of the same length to store those values. The input already does not decrease from left to right.

81.zh: 读入一列整数和一个目标数。这列整数起先按非递减次序排好，后来在一个没有事先说明的位置被切开，右面那一段被整段搬到左面那段的前面。列中允许出现相同的数。判断目标数是否还在这列里面，在就写出 true，不在就写出 false。切开的位置可以落在任何地方，也包括实际上没有搬动的情形。相同的数可以分布在切开处的两侧。
81.en: Read a list of integers and one target number. The list was first arranged in non-decreasing order. It was later cut at a position that was not announced in advance, and the piece on the right was moved in front of the piece on the left. Equal numbers may appear. Decide whether the target number is still present. Write true when it is present and false when it is absent. The cut may fall at any position, including the case in which nothing actually moved. Equal numbers may sit on both sides of the cut.

82.zh: 读入一条单链表，结点里的数值已经按非递减次序排好。某个数值只要出现了两次或者更多次，就把带着这个数值的结点全部抹掉，一个不剩。只保留在整条链表里仅仅出现过一次的数值，并维持这些结点原来的相对次序。写出抹掉之后剩下的链表。若最后没有任何结点，结果就是空链表。出现次数按整条链表统计，而不是只看相邻的一小段。
82.en: Read a singly linked list whose stored numbers are already arranged in non-decreasing order. If a number shows up two times or more, erase every node that stores that number, so none of them remain. Keep only numbers that show up a single time in the whole list, and keep the earlier relative order of those nodes. Write the list left after the erasing. When no node remains, the result is an empty list. Count occurrences across the whole list, not inside a short fragment only.

83.zh: 读入一条单链表，结点里的数值已经按非递减次序排好。请去掉重复出现的结点，使每个数值只留下最先遇到的那一个结点，稍后再次出现的相同数值都要去掉。不同数值之间原来谁先谁后，要保持不变。写出整理之后的链表。这条规则要求留下一份，而不是把出现过多次的数值整组清掉。空链表整理之后仍是空的。
83.en: Read a singly linked list whose stored numbers are already arranged in non-decreasing order. Drop repeated nodes so that each number keeps only the first node that stores it. Later nodes that store that same number are removed. Distinct numbers keep the order they already had relative to each other. Write the list after this cleanup. Under this rule a number that appears is still kept once, rather than being wiped out as a whole group. An empty list stays empty after cleanup.

84.zh: 读入若干根竖直柱子的高度。每根高度都是不小于零的整数，每根柱子都只占一个单位宽，这些柱子从左向右紧挨着立成一排。请在这排柱子形成的轮廓内部找出一个实心矩形。矩形的底边落在连续的若干根柱子上，矩形的高不能超过这段柱子里最矮的一根。写出这样的矩形所能达到的最大面积。附图里的那个例子，最大面积等于 10。
84.en: Read the heights of several upright bars. Every height is an integer that is zero or positive. Every bar occupies one unit of width, and the bars stand next to each other from left to right. Find a solid rectangle inside the outline those bars form. The base of the rectangle rests on a contiguous run of bars, and the height of the rectangle cannot pass the shortest bar in that run. Write the largest area such a rectangle can reach. In the figure that comes with the task, that largest area equals 10.

86.zh: 读入一条单链表和一个整数 x。把结点分成前一块和后一块，再把前一块接到后一块的前面。结点里的数若比 x 小，就进入前一块；其余结点进入后一块。前一块里面，结点之间原先的相互次序不要改动。后一块里面也同样不要改动。写出接好以后的整条链表。比较时只看结点中存放的那个数。等于 x 的结点归到后一块。
86.en: Read a singly linked list and an integer x. Divide the nodes into a front block and a back block, then place the front block ahead of the back block. A node enters the front block when the number it stores is smaller than x. Every remaining node enters the back block. Inside the front block, do not change how the nodes stood relative to one another. Inside the back block, do the same. Write the full list after the blocks are joined. Compare only the number stored in a node. A number equal to x belongs in the back block.

88.zh: 读入两个已经从小到大排好的整数列，以及它们当前各自存放的元素个数 m 和 n。第一列的尾部留有空位，空位个数不少于 n，因此第二列的全部元素都能放进来。请把两列元素合成一列仍然从小到大的序列，结果存放在第一列里。写出合成之后前 m 与 n 之和那么多个元素。已有的元素一个都不能丢，结果也不能变成无序。
88.en: Read two lists of integers that are already arranged from small to large, plus the counts m and n of values currently stored in each list. The first list has empty slots at its tail, and the number of empty slots is at least n, so every value from the second list can fit. Combine both groups into one sequence that still runs from small to large, and store that sequence in the first list. Write the leading entries, as many as m plus n. Keep every existing value, and do not leave the stored sequence out of order.

89.zh: 读入一个不小于零的整数 n，它表示每个码字使用的二进制位数。请写出一列整数，个数等于 2 的 n 次方。每个整数都落在 0 与这个方幂减 1 之间，包含两端。这列的开头一项必须写成 0。任意前后相邻的两项，在补齐到 n 位二进制之后，恰好只有一位不一样。最后一项不要求和第一项也只差一位。按从前往后的顺序把这些整数写出来。
89.en: Read an integer n that is zero or positive. It is the number of bits in each code word. Write a list of integers whose length is 2 raised to the power n. Every integer lies from 0 through one less than that power of two, and both ends are included. The opening term of the list must be written as 0. Any two terms that stand next to each other differ in exactly one bit after both are padded to n bits. The final term does not have to differ from the opening term by one bit. Write these integers from front to back.

90.zh: 读入一列整数，相同的数值允许反复出现。写出所有互不相同的子集。一个子集由输入中的若干个位置挑选而成，同一个位置不能被选两次，因此某个数值出现了几次，就最多被选几次。若两种挑选得到的数值及其次数完全相同，只保留一份。空子集也要写出来。每个子集内部保持这些数在输入中的相对次序。负数和零都可以出现在输入里。
90.en: Read a list of integers. The same value may appear more than once. Write every subset that is different from the others. A subset is made by choosing some positions from the input, and one position cannot be chosen twice, so a value may be chosen only as many times as it appears. When two choices produce the same values with the same counts, keep a single copy. Write the empty subset as well. Inside each subset, keep the relative order those values had in the input. Negative numbers and zero may appear in the input.

91.zh: 读入一条非空文本，其中每个字符都是数字。编码把 A 记为 1，把 B 记为 2，按字母表继续，直到把 Z 记为 26。请统计这条数字文本一共有多少种合法的读法，并把种数写出来。单独的 0 不能代表任何字母。相邻两位组成的数，只有落在 10 到 26 这个闭区间内，才可以当成一个字母。切分时可以混用一位和两位，每种不同的切分都要计数。若没有任何合法切分，种数写成 0。
91.en: Read a non-empty text in which every character is a digit. The code records A as 1, B as 2, and continues through the alphabet until Z is recorded as 26. Count how many legal readings the digit text has, and write that count. A lone 0 does not stand for any letter. Two neighboring digits form a letter only when the number they make lies from 10 through 26, ends included. A reading may mix pieces of one digit and pieces of two digits, and every different cutting counts. When no legal cutting exists, write 0.

92.zh: 读入一条单链表，以及两个从一开始计数的位置，分别叫做左端与右端。左端不会晚于右端。把闭区间内的结点整段倒过来，区间外的结点保持原先的先后与连接。改完以后按从头到尾的新顺序把每个结点的值写出来。链表至少含有一个结点，位置都落在链表长度之内。
92.en: Read a singly linked list and two positions counted from one, called the left end and the right end. The left end is never later than the right end. Reverse the nodes that lie inside that closed span, and keep every node outside the span in its original order and linkage. After the change, write each node value from the head toward the tail in the new order. The list contains at least one node, and both positions fall inside its length.

93.zh: 读入一串仅由数字字符构成的文本。把它分成四节，使每一节都能充当地址中的一段：长度是一、二或三，对应的整数在零与二百五十五之间，并且除了数值本身为零以外不得带前导零。四节连起来必须恰好用完整个文本。找出每一种符合这些限制的分法，各写成用圆点隔开的四节，顺序不限，全部打印出来。
93.en: Read a text composed only of digit characters. Divide it into four sections so that each section can act as one piece of an address. A section has length one, two, or three, its integer value lies between zero and two hundred fifty five, and it must not carry a leading zero unless the value itself is zero. The four sections together must use the entire text exactly. Find every division that meets these limits, print each as four sections separated by dots, and accept any order.

94.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，每个结点保存一个整数，缺失的孩子用空位表示。按中序收集结点上的整数：对任一结点，先处理它的整个左侧，再记下它自己，最后处理它的整个右侧。把收集到的整数按此先后排成一行写出来。整棵树为空时写出空的结果。输入用层序描述树形，输出只含结点的值，不要求改动原来的树。
94.en: Read a binary tree in which each node keeps an integer and a missing child is an empty spot. Collect the integers in inorder: for any node, handle its entire left side first, record the node itself next, and handle its entire right side last. Write the collected integers in that sequence on one line. When the whole tree is empty, write an empty result. The input describes the shape by levels, and the output contains only node values. Leave the original tree unchanged.

95.zh: 读入一个至少为一的整数，当作结点值的上界。用从一到该上界的每个整数恰好一次，搭出每一种形状不同的二分查找树。任意结点的左侧只能出现更小的值，右侧只能出现更大的值。同一组值不得少用或多用。把每一种形状都完整写出来，使读者能看出父子关系。上界很小，但你仍要覆盖全部互异的形状，不能漏掉旋转之后才出现的那种。
95.en: Read an integer that is at least one and treat it as the upper bound on node values. Using each integer from one through that bound exactly once, build every binary search tree whose shape differs from the others. The left side of any node may hold only smaller values, and the right side may hold only larger values. The same set of values may not drop or repeat a member. Write every shape in full so that parent and child links are visible. Cover every distinct shape, including ones that appear only after a rotation.

96.zh: 读入一个非负整数作为上界。上界为正时，结点值是从一连续取到该上界的全部整数，每个用一次。每个结点左侧只放更小的值，右侧只放更大的值。只计算这样的二分查找树有多少种不同形状，不要把树本身打印出来。上界为零时存在恰好一种空树，此时写出一。其他情况把形状的种数写成一个整数。
96.en: Read a non-negative integer and use it as an upper bound. When the bound is positive, the node values are every integer from one through that bound, each used once. Each node keeps only smaller values on its left and only larger values on its right. Count how many distinct shapes of binary search tree satisfy that rule, and do not print the trees. When the bound is zero there is exactly one empty tree, so write one. In every other case write the number of shapes as a single integer.

97.zh: 读入三条由小写英文字母组成的字符串，叫做甲、乙、丙。判断丙能否由甲与乙交错得到。交错时把甲、乙各自切成若干非空的连续小段，两串提供的小段个数相差至多一，并且从甲或从乙开始都可以。按选定的先后把小段首尾相接，两串都要刚好用完。甲与乙的长度各不超过 100，丙的长度不超过 200。能得到就写出是，否则写出否。
97.en: Read three strings of lowercase English letters, called first, second, and third. Decide whether the third can be obtained by weaving the first and the second. A weave cuts each source into non-empty contiguous pieces, the two piece counts differ by at most one, and either source may supply the opening piece. Joining the pieces in the chosen alternating order must use both sources exactly. The first and the second each have length at most 100, and the third has length at most 200. Write yes when such a weave exists and no otherwise.

98.zh: 读入一棵每个结点存放整数的二叉树。判断它是否处处符合二分查找树的规矩：任意结点的左侧只含严格更小的整数，右侧只含严格更大的整数，而且左右两侧自己也符合同一规矩。出现相等的整数就算不符合。空树算符合。把判断写成是或否。比较时要沿着整条祖先链看上下界，不能只看父子两层。
98.en: Read a binary tree in which every node stores an integer. Decide whether it obeys the binary-search rule everywhere: the left side of any node holds only strictly smaller integers, the right side holds only strictly larger integers, and both sides themselves obey the same rule. Equal integers fail the test. An empty tree passes. Write yes or no. Comparisons must respect the bounds inherited from every ancestor, not only the parent and child pair.

99.zh: 读入一棵本来应当满足二分查找顺序的二叉树，可是恰好两个结点里的整数被互相换错了。父子之间的连接一律保持原样，只把这两个整数放回能使顺序恢复的位置：每个结点左侧重新全是更小的值，右侧重新全是更大的值。不要增加结点，也不要删掉结点。完成后按要求的形式把整棵树写出来。
99.en: Read a binary tree that should have followed search order, but exactly two stored integers were exchanged with each other. Keep every parent and child link exactly as it stands. Put those two integers back into the places that restore the order, so each node again has only smaller values on its left and only larger values on its right. Do not insert a node and do not delete a node. When the repair is finished, write the whole tree in the required form.

100.zh: 读入两棵结点中存放整数的二叉树，空着的孩子也属于形状的一部分。判断二者是否完全一致：同一个位置要么两边都有结点，要么两边都空，而且成对的结点必须存放同一个整数。形状有一处差别，或者任一整数不同，都应当判为不一致。两棵皆空则视为一致。把结论写成是或者否。
100.en: Read a pair of binary trees. Each node stores an integer, and an absent child belongs to the shape. Decide whether the two trees agree completely. At every position both sides have a node or both sides are empty, and paired nodes must store one identical integer. A single difference in shape, or any mismatch among the integers, means they disagree. Two empty trees agree. Write the conclusion as yes or no.

101.zh: 读入一棵结点中存放整数的二叉树。判断它沿竖直中线看去是否成镜像。根的左侧与右侧必须互相映照：靠外的结点与靠外的结点配对，靠内的结点与靠内的结点配对，配对结点上的整数相等，空位也必须成对出现。只有一个根，或者整棵是空的，都算成立。把结论写成是或否。
101.en: Read one binary tree whose nodes store integers. Decide whether the tree forms a mirror across a vertical center line. The left side of the root and the right side must reflect each other: outer nodes pair with outer nodes, inner nodes pair with inner nodes, paired nodes store equal integers, and empty spots must occur in pairs. A lone root and a completely empty tree both count as success. Write the conclusion as yes or no.

102.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点上存放整数，空孩子仍要参与分层。自根向下逐层收集：同一层从左向右排列，每一层单独作为一组，根所在层是第一组。按从高到低的组序把全部分组写出来。没有任何结点时写出空的分组列表。结点里的整数可以是 20，也可以是别的整数，分组规则不依赖这个具体数字。
102.en: Read a binary tree whose nodes store integers, and let absent children take part in the leveling. Collect levels from the root downward. Inside one level, arrange nodes from the left toward the right, keep that level as its own group, and let the root level be the first group. Write every group from the highest group toward the lowest group. When there are no nodes, write an empty list of groups. A stored integer may be 20 or some other integer, and the grouping rule does not depend on that particular number.

103.zh: 读入一棵存放整数的二叉树。仍然一层一组地收集结点，但相邻层的方向相反。第一层从左走向右，紧接着的一层从右走向左，以后各层继续轮换。组与组之间仍按从根走向更低层的次序排列。写出全部分组。树为空时写出空列表。某个结点的整数可以等于 20，方向规则对其他整数同样适用。
103.en: Read a binary tree that stores integers. Still collect one group for each level, but flip the direction between neighboring levels. The first level travels from the left toward the right, the immediately following level travels from the right toward the left, and every later level keeps switching. Keep the groups themselves in order from the root toward lower levels. Write every group. An empty tree writes an empty list. Some node integer may equal 20, and the direction rule applies to every other integer as well.

104.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。找出从根出发走到一片叶子时，沿途所含结点个数的最大值，这个最大值就是树高。只有根的时候树高是一。一个结点都没有的时候树高写成零。叶子指不再拥有孩子的结点。把树高写成一个整数。结点中出现的数字可以包含 20，数高度时只数结点个数，不读取这些数字。
104.en: Read a binary tree. Find the largest count of nodes on a route that starts at the root and stops at a leaf. That count is the height. A tree holding only the root has height one. A tree holding no node at all has height zero. A leaf is a node that no longer has a child. Write the height as one integer. Numbers stored in nodes may include 20. While measuring height, count nodes only and do not read those numbers.

105.zh: 读入两条长度相同的整数序列。第一条按前序记下某棵二叉树的访问次序，第二条按中序记下同一棵树的访问次序。所有结点值互不重复。前序开头那个值是根，在中序里它左边的一段构成左侧，右边的一段构成右侧，两侧再用同样的办法继续拆分。把还原出来的树写出来。两条序列都可以是空的，空序列对应空树。
105.en: Read two integer sequences of equal length. The first records a preorder visit of some binary tree, and the second records an inorder visit of that same tree. All node values are distinct. The opening value of the preorder sequence is the root. In the inorder sequence the segment on its left forms the left side and the segment on its right forms the right side. Split both sides by the same rule. Write the rebuilt tree. Either sequence may be empty, and empty sequences correspond to an empty tree.

106.zh: 读入两条长度相同的整数序列。前面一条是某棵二叉树的中序访问次序，后面一条是它的后序访问次序。结点上的整数没有重复。后序末尾那个值是根，再到中序中定位这个根，它左方的一段是左侧，右方的一段是右侧，然后对两侧重复同样的划分。写出还原得到的树。两条序列若为空，结果就是一棵空树。
106.en: Read two integer sequences that share one length. The earlier sequence is an inorder visit of a binary tree, and the later sequence is a postorder visit of that tree. Integers stored on the nodes do not repeat. The final value of the postorder sequence is the root. Locate that root in the inorder sequence: the segment to its left is the left side, and the segment to its right is the right side. Repeat the same division on both sides. Write the restored tree. If the sequences are empty, the result is an empty tree.

107.zh: 读入一棵结点存放整数的二叉树。先按从顶向下、每层由左到右的方式把结点分成若干层，再把这些层的先后整个倒过来，使最接近叶子的一层排到最前面，根所在的一层排到最后面。每一层仍然单独成组。写出倒转之后的各组。空树写成空列表。结点值允许等于 20，也允许是任何其他整数。
107.en: Read a binary tree whose nodes hold integers. First split the nodes into levels from the top downward, ordering each level from the left to the right. Then reverse the sequence of those levels so the level closest to the leaves stands first and the level that contains the root stands last. Each level remains a separate group. Write the groups after that reversal. An empty tree is written as an empty list. A node value may equal 20 and may also be any other integer.

108.zh: 读入一个已经按从小到大排好的整数数组。把它组织成一棵二叉查找树，并且要求每一个结点左右两侧的高度相差都不超过一。高度按从该结点向下最长路线上的结点个数来算。只要满足查找顺序和这个高度限制，任何一种形态都可以接受。把你造出的那棵树写出来。数组为空时结果是空树。
108.en: Read an array of integers that is already arranged from small to large. Organize it as a binary search tree, and require that the left side and the right side of every node differ in height by at most one. Height is the count of nodes on the longest downward route from the node in question. Any shape is acceptable when it keeps search order and this height limit. Write the tree you build. An empty array produces an empty tree.

109.zh: 读入一条已经按从小到大连接好的单链表，每个结点携带一个整数。用这些整数造一棵二叉查找树，使每个结点的左右子树在深度上最多相差一。深度是从该结点往下数到最远后代的结点个数。查找顺序必须保持：左侧更小，右侧更大。满足这两条的任意形状都算正确。写出造好的树。空链表对应空树。
109.en: Read a singly linked list already linked from small values toward large values, with one integer on each node. Build a binary search tree from those integers so that, at every node, the left subtree and the right subtree differ in depth by at most one. Depth counts nodes from that node down to its farthest descendant. Search order must hold: smaller values sit to the left and larger values sit to the right. Any shape that meets both rules is correct. Write the finished tree. An empty list corresponds to an empty tree.

110.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。判断是否每一个结点都满足下面的条件：它的左子树高度与右子树高度相差最多为一。只要存在一个结点破坏该条件，整棵树就不平衡。空树算作平衡。高度定义为从当前结点走向最远后代时所数到的结点个数，叶子的高度是一。写出是或否。结点值里可以出现 20，这个判断完全不看结点值。
110.en: Read a binary tree. Decide whether every node satisfies the following condition: the height of its left subtree and the height of its right subtree differ by at most one. If even one node breaks the condition, the whole tree is unbalanced. An empty tree counts as balanced. Height is defined as the number of nodes counted while walking from the current node toward its farthest descendant, and a leaf has height one. Write yes or no. The value 20 may appear among node values, and this decision ignores node values completely.

111.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。找出从根走到最近叶子所经过的结点个数，该个数称为最小深度。叶子是指左右孩子都不存在的结点。如果根只有一边连着孩子，必须继续往下走到真正的叶子，不能把根当成终点。仅有根时答案是一，空树的答案是零。把答案写成整数。存储的整数里可以包含 20，深度与这些整数无关。
111.en: Read a binary tree. Find how many nodes are visited on the shortest walk from the root to a nearest leaf. That count is called the minimum depth. A leaf is a node whose left child and right child are both absent. If the root connects to a child on only one side, keep walking until a real leaf, and do not treat the root as the end. A root alone answers one, and an empty tree answers zero. Write the answer as an integer. Stored integers may include 20, and the depth is unrelated to those integers.

112.zh: 读入一棵整数二叉树，再读入一个目标和，这个目标可以是 22，也可以是别的整数。判断有没有一条从根一直走到叶子的路线，使路线上全部结点的整数相加正好等于目标。叶子是左右都没有孩子的结点。走到一半时即使累加结果已经等于目标，只要还没到叶子，就不能算成功。把判断写成是或否。
112.en: Read an integer binary tree and one target total. The target may be 22 or another integer. Decide whether there is a walk that runs from the root all the way to a leaf and whose node integers add up to exactly the target. A leaf is a node that has no left child and no right child. If a walk matches the target halfway but has not reached a leaf, it does not succeed. Write the decision as yes or no.

113.zh: 读入一棵由整数结点构成的树，同时读入一个需要命中的总和，这个总和可以等于 22。找出每一条从根开始、在叶子结束、沿途整数之和恰好等于目标的完整路线。叶子指没有任何孩子的结点。每条路线都要按从根到叶的顺序保留结点。把全部这样的路线写出来。一条都没有时写出空的集合。停在中间结点上的片段即使和已经相等，也不要写出。
113.en: Read an integer binary tree and a target total that may equal 22. Find every complete walk that begins at the root, finishes on a leaf, and has integers along the walk adding to exactly the target. A leaf means a node with no children at all. Keep the nodes of each walk in order from the root to the leaf. Write all such walks. When there are none, write an empty collection. Do not write a fragment that stops on an inner node even if its running total already matches.

114.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。不要另外申请一条新链，就在原来的结点上把它拉成只通过右孩子向后延伸的一条单链。结点的排列遵循前序：先当前结点，再原来的整个左侧，再原来的整个右侧。原来挂在左边的结点要改挂到这条右链上，每个结点的左孩子最后都变成空。写出变形之后的树。空树仍然为空，结点中的整数保持不变。
114.en: Read a binary tree. Do not allocate a fresh chain. Using the existing nodes, stretch the tree into one chain that extends only through right-child links. Order the nodes by preorder: the current node first, then its former entire left side, then its former entire right side. Nodes that used to hang on the left must be reattached along that right chain, and every left-child link ends empty. Write the tree after this reshape. An empty tree stays empty, and the integers inside nodes stay unchanged.

115.zh: 读入两条由英文字母组成的字符串，分别作为源串与目标串。计算有多少种删除方式，能使源串中保留下来的字母按原来的相对次序恰好变成目标串。可以一个字母都不删，也可以删掉任意多个，但不许把留下的字母重新排序。选中的删除位置不同，就要分成不同的次数来计，哪怕剩余文本看起来一样。每条串的长度不超过 1000。答案能放进三十二位有符号整数。把次数写出来。
115.en: Read two strings made of English letters, one source and one target. Count the ways of deleting letters from the source so that the letters which remain, still in their original relative order, become exactly the target. Deleting nothing is allowed, and deleting any positive count is allowed, but the surviving letters may not be reordered. Distinct choices of which positions to delete count as distinct ways, even when the remaining text looks alike. Each string has length at most 1000. The answer fits inside a 32-bit signed integer. Write the count.

116.zh: 读入一棵完美二叉树：除叶子以外每个结点都有左孩子和右孩子，全部叶子处于同一深度。每个结点另有一个指向右邻的指针，初始时全是空。把该指针改到同一层中紧靠其右侧的结点；这一层最右端的结点没有右邻，指针继续为空。整棵树的结点个数少于 4096，每个结点值的绝对值不超过 1000。改完指针后把树写出来。
116.en: Read a perfect binary tree: every node except the leaves has both a left child and a right child, and all leaves sit at one common depth. Each node also has a pointer toward its right-hand neighbor, and every such pointer starts empty. Retarget that pointer to the node immediately on its right in the same level. The rightmost node of a level has no right-hand neighbor, so its pointer stays empty. The tree contains fewer than 4096 nodes, and the absolute value of each node value is at most 1000. After the pointers change, write the tree.

118.zh: 读入一个非负整数，表示需要写出的行数。按杨辉三角形的规则产生开头的这么多行。最顶上的一行只含有一个数字一。之后每一行的两端都是数字一，中间的每个数字等于它正上方彼此相邻的两个数字之和。从上往下把这些行全部打印出来。若要求的行数是零，就写出空的结果，不要凭空多添一行。
118.en: Read a non-negative integer that states how many rows are required. Produce that many opening rows under the rule of Pascal's triangle. The topmost row holds only the digit one. Every later row has the digit one at both ends, and each inner digit equals the sum of the two neighboring digits sitting directly above it. Print all of these rows from the top toward the bottom. If the required count of rows is zero, write an empty result and do not invent an extra row.

119.zh: 读入一个从零开始编号的行号，它的取值范围是零到 33，含两端。只写出杨辉三角形里这个行号对应的单独一行，它上方的那些行都不要输出。该行的左右两端是数字一，中间各项等于上一行中左右相邻的一对数字之和。行号为零时，这一行只有单独的数字一。按从左到右的顺序打印这一行里的每个数字。
119.en: Read a row number that starts at zero. Its allowed range is the closed interval from zero through 33. Write only the single row of Pascal's triangle selected by this number, and do not output any row that sits above it. Both ends of that row are the digit one, and each inner entry equals the sum of one neighboring pair taken from the row above. When the row number is zero, the row holds only a lone digit one. Print every digit of this row from the left toward the right.

120.zh: 读入一个由整数排成的三角形。第几行就有几个整数，因此往下的每一行都比上一行恰好多一个数。从最顶上那一个数出发，每走一步只能到达下一行里与当前数相邻的某个位置，并且必须一直走到最底下一行。在所有这种走法中找出沿途整数相加以后最小的和，把这个和写出来。三角形至少包含一行。
120.en: Read a triangle laid out with integers. A row of index k holds k integers, so each row farther down is exactly one entry longer than the row above it. Start from the single number at the very top. Each step may land only on a position adjacent to the current number in the next lower row, and the walk must continue until the bottom row. Among all such walks, find the smallest sum of the integers collected along the way, and write that sum. The triangle contains at least one row.

121.zh: 读入一串按日期排好的股价，下标从左到右就是时间先后。只允许买入一次再卖出一次，卖出日必须严格晚于买入日。收益等于卖出价减去买入价。若后面再也没有更高的价格，收益按零计。找出所有合法日期对里最大的那一笔收益并写出来。
121.en: Read one price for each day, listed from earlier days to later days. A single trade buys on one day and sells on a strictly later day, and no second trade is allowed. Profit equals the selling price minus the buying price. When no later price is higher, the profit is zero. Find the largest profit among all legal pairs of days and write that number.

122.zh: 读入一串按日期排好的股价，下标从左到右就是时间先后。允许完成任意多次买入与卖出，但同一时刻手里最多持有一股，因此下一次买入必须等上一次卖出结束。把每一笔卖价减买价的差累加起来。写出能获得的最大总收益。全程没有上涨时写零。
122.en: Read one price for each day, listed from earlier days to later days. You may buy and sell as many times as you wish, but you can hold only one share at a time, so a new purchase waits until the previous sale has finished. Add up each sale price minus its matching buy price. Write the largest total you can obtain. Write zero when the prices never rise.

124.zh: 读入一棵非空二叉树，每个结点保存一个整数，整数允许为负。一条路径是由父子边串起来的结点序列，两端可以落在任意结点上，不必经过根。路径中至少含有一个结点。把路径上的整数相加，在全部路径里找出和最大的一条，并把这个和写出来。
124.en: Read a non-empty binary tree in which every node stores an integer, and negative integers are allowed. A path is a sequence of nodes joined by edges between a parent and a child. Either end may be any node, and the path need not pass through the root. The path includes at least one node. Add the integers along the path, find the path whose sum is largest, and write that sum.

125.zh: 读入一行文字，里面可以有空格、标点、数字和大小写字母。检查时丢掉字母与数字以外的一切符号，并把大写字母改成小写。若剩下的字符顺着读和倒着读完全相同，写出真，否则写出假。一个字符都没剩下的空结果也视为成立，同样写出真。
125.en: Read a single line that may hold spaces, punctuation, digits, and letters of either case. For the test, discard every character that is not a letter or a digit, and fold uppercase letters into lowercase. Write true when the remaining characters are identical forward and backward. Write false otherwise. When nothing remains after the discards, treat the line as valid and write true as well.

126.zh: 读入起始单词、目标单词和一份单词表。两个单词都非空且彼此不同，所有单词长度一致，只含小写字母，表内没有重复项。每一步只能替换一个字母，替换之后的单词必须能在表里找到，起始单词不必先在表里。把从起点走到目标的每一种最短单词序列都写出来。一种都不存在时写空列表。
126.en: Read a starting word, a target word, and a dictionary list. Both words are non-empty and different from each other. Every word has the same length and uses only lowercase letters, and the list has no repeated entries. Each step replaces exactly one letter, and the word produced by that step must be found in the list. The starting word itself need not be listed. Write every shortest sequence of words that reaches the target. Write an empty list when none exists.

127.zh: 读入起始单词、目标单词和一份单词表。两个单词都非空且彼此不同，所有单词长度一致，只含小写字母，表内没有重复项。每一步只能替换一个字母，替换之后的单词必须能在表里找到，起始单词不必先在表里。找出到达目标的最短单词序列，把序列中含两端在内的单词个数写出来。走不到时写零。
127.en: Read a starting word, a target word, and a dictionary list. Both words are non-empty and different from each other. Every word has the same length and uses only lowercase letters, and the list has no repeated entries. Each step replaces exactly one letter, and the word produced by that step must be found in the list. The starting word itself need not be listed. Find one shortest sequence that reaches the target and write how many words it contains, including both ends. Write zero when the target is unreachable.

128.zh: 读入一组次序打乱的整数，允许重复。数值上彼此正好相差一的数可以组成一段，它们在数组里不必相邻。重复的值在同一段里只算一次。找出最长的一段，把这段里不同整数的个数写出来。整个过程消耗的步数要与整数个数成正比。
128.en: Read a collection of integers that may be unordered and may contain repeats. Values that differ by one form a run even when they are not neighbors in the input. Count a repeated value only once inside a run. Find the longest run and write how many distinct integers it includes. The amount of work must stay proportional to how many integers were read.

129.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，每个结点只存放从 0 到 9 的一位数字。从根向下走到没有子结点的叶子，把沿途数字按高位到低位连成一个整数。例如依次经过 1、2、3 就得到 123。每条根到叶的走法都生成一个整数，把这些整数求和后写出来。
129.en: Read a binary tree in which every node holds a single digit from 0 to 9. Walk from the root down to a leaf, meaning a node that has no child, and join the digits from that walk into one integer, high digit first. Passing through 1, then 2, then 3 produces 123. Build one integer for every root-to-leaf walk, add those integers, and write the sum.

130.zh: 读入一块矩形棋盘，格子里只有字母 X 和字母 O。如果某个 O 不在四条外边之上，并且靠上下左右也走不到任何位于边上的 O，就把这一片 O 全部改写成 X。边上的 O 以及与它们四向相连的 O 保持不动。斜着挨在一起不算相连。把修改之后的棋盘原样写出来。
130.en: Read a rectangular grid whose cells contain only the letter X or the letter O. When an O is not on any of the four outer edges, and it also cannot reach an O that sits on an edge by moving up, down, left, or right, replace that whole group of O cells with X. O cells on an edge, together with O cells joined to them by those four moves, stay unchanged. Touching at a corner does not count as a join. Write the grid after the replacements.

131.zh: 读入一个字符串。把它切成若干段首尾相接的连续片段，这些片段合起来必须正好覆盖原串，而且每一段从左读到右都与从右读到左相同。一个字符单独成段始终符合这个条件。找出每一种切法，按片段在原串中的先后顺序把各段写出来。
131.en: Read one string. Cut it into contiguous pieces that follow one another and together cover the original string exactly. Each piece must match itself when its characters are read from the left and from the right. A piece made of one character always qualifies. Find every way to place those cuts. For each way, write the pieces in the order they occur in the original string.

134.zh: 读入长度同为 n 的两列整数，n 的范围是 1 到 10^5。下标 i 处的加油站存有 gas 升油，开到下一站要消耗 cost 升，每个油量和消耗都在 0 到 10^4 之间。这些站围成环，汽车油箱初始为空且容量不限，只能沿环朝一个方向开。找出一个起点编号，使油量在回到起点前始终不小于零。答案若存在则唯一，否则写 -1。
134.en: Read two integer arrays that share a length n, where n runs from 1 to 10^5. Index i stores gas units at that station, and driving onward to the following station consumes cost units. Each of those amounts lies between 0 and 10^4. The stations form a loop, the tank begins empty with no capacity limit, and the car drives in one direction only. Find a start index that keeps the fuel from falling below zero before the car returns. The start is unique when it exists. Write -1 when it does not.

135.zh: 读入站成一排的 n 名孩子的评分。n 至少为 1，并且 n 与每名评分都不超过 2 乘 10^4，评分可以是 0。每人至少分到 1 颗糖。只要某名孩子的评分严格高于紧挨着的左邻或右邻，他的糖就必须严格多于该邻居。两侧都更高时两边都要满足。写出满足全部要求时糖的最少总颗数。
135.en: Read ratings for n children who stand in a single row. n is at least 1, and both n and every rating are at most 2 times 10^4. A rating may be 0. Each child must receive at least 1 candy. Whenever a child has a strictly higher rating than the neighbor immediately on the left or on the right, that child must receive strictly more candies than the neighbor. Satisfy both sides when both neighbors are lower. Write the smallest total number of candies that meets every requirement.

136.zh: 读入一个非空的整数数组。里面恰好有一个数值只出现一次，其他每个数值都出现两次。把那个只出现一次的数值找出来并写上。扫描和更新的步数要与数组长度成正比，额外占用只能是若干个与长度无关的变量。整数可以是负数或零，相同的两次出现不必相邻。
136.en: Read integers stored in an array that contains at least one entry. Exactly one value occurs a single time, and every remaining value occurs two times. Find that unique value and write it. The steps you take must stay proportional to how many entries were read, and extra memory must be only a few variables whose count does not depend on that length. Entries may be negative or zero, and the two copies of a value need not be adjacent.

137.zh: 读入一个非空的整数数组。里面恰好有一个数值只出现一次，其他每个数值都出现三次。把那个只出现一次的数值找出来并写上。扫描和更新的步数要与数组长度成正比，额外占用只能是若干个与长度无关的变量。三次出现可以分散在不同位置，整数可以是负数或零。
137.en: Read integers stored in an array that contains at least one entry. Exactly one value occurs a single time, and every remaining value occurs three times. Find that unique value and write it. The steps you take must stay proportional to how many entries were read, and extra memory must be only a few variables whose count does not depend on that length. The three copies may sit in separate places, and entries may be negative or zero.

138.zh: 读入一条含 n 个结点的链表，n 至多 1000。每个结点带整数 val，范围从 -10000 到 10000，还带一个随机指针，该指针要么为空，要么指向这条链表中的任一结点。写出一份深拷贝：新结点复制 val，随机指针改指到新链表中对应的结点。新旧链表不得共享结点。
138.en: Read a linked list of n nodes, where n is at most 1000. Every node stores an integer val between -10000 and 10000, plus a random pointer that is either null or aimed at any node of this list. Write a deep copy. Each new node copies val, and its random pointer aims at the corresponding node in the new list rather than at the original node. The new list and the old list must not share nodes.

141.zh: 读入一条链表，结点中存有整数。判断沿后继指针走下去会不会回到已经走过的某个结点。会回到则说明形成了环，写出真。一直走到空指针则没有环，写出假。检查过程只能保留固定个数的指针，不能按照结点数量去开辟一段新的存储。空链表写出假。
141.en: Read a linked list whose nodes store integers. Decide whether following successor pointers can bring you back to a node you have already visited. Write true when that return happens, which means a cycle is present. Write false when the walk reaches an empty link instead. During the check, keep only a fixed count of pointers and do not allocate storage that grows with the number of nodes. An empty list writes false.

142.zh: 读入一条链表以及整数 pos。pos 等于 -1 时，尾部没有后继，整条链表不构成环。否则尾部后继指向下标 pos 的结点，下标从 0 开始。若有环，写出环开始的那个结点。若无环，写出空。环的开始处是后继路线上第一次被第二次走到的结点。只允许使用固定个数的指针。
142.en: Read a linked list together with an integer pos. When pos equals -1, the tail has no successor and the list forms no cycle. Otherwise the tail links to the node at index pos, with indexes starting at 0. If a cycle is present, write the node at which the cycle begins. If it is absent, write null. The beginning is the first node that the successor walk enters for a second time. Use only a fixed count of pointers.

143.zh: 读入一条单链表。把结点重新链接成这样的次序：表头、表尾、第二个、倒数第二个、第三个、倒数第三个，直到所有结点各出现一次。不允许改写结点内部保存的整数，只允许改后继指针。把重排后的链表写出来。没有任何结点或只有一个结点时，链表保持原状。
143.en: Read a singly linked list. Relink the nodes into this order: the head, the tail, the second node, the node second from the tail, the third node, the node third from the tail, and so on until every node appears once. Do not rewrite the integer stored inside a node. Change only successor pointers. Write the list after that relinking. When the list has no node or only one node, leave it unchanged.

144.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点上是整数，左孩子或右孩子都可能缺失。按先记录根结点、再展开左子树、最后展开右子树的顺序，把访问到的整数依次写出来。缺失的孩子直接跳过。树中只有根时，只写出根上的整数。整棵树是空的时候，写出空的序列。每棵子树都遵守同一顺序。
144.en: Read a binary tree. Each node stores an integer, and either child may be absent. Record the root value first, then expand the left subtree, then expand the right subtree, and write the integers in that visiting order. Skip a child that is absent. When the tree is only a root, write that single integer. When the tree is empty, write an empty sequence. Every subtree follows this same order.

145.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点上是整数，左孩子或右孩子都可能缺失。按先展开左子树、再展开右子树、最后才记录根结点的顺序，把访问到的整数依次写出来。缺失的孩子直接跳过。树中只有根时，只写出根上的整数。整棵树是空的时候，写出空的序列。每棵子树都遵守同一顺序。
145.en: Read a binary tree. Each node stores an integer, and either child may be absent. Expand the left subtree first, then expand the right subtree, and record the root value only after both subtrees are done. Write the integers in that visiting order. Skip a child that is absent. When the tree is only a root, write that single integer. When the tree is empty, write an empty sequence. Every subtree follows this same order.

146.zh: 做出一个会淘汰最久未使用项的缓存。容量是 1 到 3000 的整数。键位于 0 到 3000，值位于 0 到 104。get 和 put 加在一起最多调用 3 乘 104 次。get 在键存在时写出它的值，不存在时写 -1，并且这次读取算一次使用。put 负责写入或覆盖。键的数量即将超过容量时，先删除最久未被 get 或 put 碰到的键，再存入新键。
146.en: Build a cache that discards the item left unused for the longest time. Capacity is an integer from 1 to 3000. Keys run from 0 to 3000 and values run from 0 to 104. Calls to get and put together number at most 3 times 104. get writes the stored value when the key is present and writes -1 when the key is absent, and that read counts as a use. put writes a new pair or overwrites an old one. When the count of keys would exceed capacity, delete the key that has gone the longest without a get or a put, then store the new key.

147.zh: 读入一条由整数结点连成的单链表，数值可以重复，也可以为负。用插入的方式排成非递减次序：已有序的一段起初只含第一个结点，之后每次取出下一个尚未放入的结点，把它插到已有序一段中第一个大于或等于它的结点之前。整数仍留在原结点里，只移动链接。把排完的链表写出来。
147.en: Read a singly linked list of integer nodes. Values may repeat and may be negative. Order the nodes into non-decreasing order by insertion. The ordered section begins as the first node alone. Each following step takes the next node that is not yet placed and inserts it just before the first node in the ordered section whose value is greater than or equal to it. Keep each integer on its original node and move links only. Write the list when every node has been placed.

148.zh: 读入一条由整数结点连成的单链表，数值可以重复，也可以为负。把结点排成非递减次序后写出来。比较与搬移的总次数须保持在 n 乘以 log n 这一量级，其中 n 为结点个数。额外空间只许是固定的几个指针和计数器。不要为了抄写数值去新建结点，只调整原有链接。空表或单结点保持不动。
148.en: Read a singly linked list of integer nodes. Values may repeat and may be negative. Arrange the nodes into non-decreasing order and write the list. The total of comparisons and moves must stay on the order of n times log n, where n is the number of nodes. Extra space may be only a fixed few pointers and counters.
