Do not create new nodes in order to copy values. Adjust the existing links only. An empty list or a one-node list stays as it is.

150.zh: 读入一列记号。每个记号或是一个整数，或是加号、减号、乘号、除号之一。记号按逆波兰顺序书写，遇到运算符时，它作用于紧挨在前面的两个结果，较先出现的那个是左操作数。除法向零截断，只留下整数商。表达式保证可以求完，且不会用零做除数。把最后的整数写出来。
150.en: Read a sequence of tokens. Each token is either an integer or one of add, subtract, multiply, and divide. Tokens are written in reverse Polish order. When an operator appears, it acts on the two results sitting just before it, and the earlier result is the left operand. Division truncates toward zero and keeps only the integer quotient. The expression can always be finished and never uses zero as a divisor. Write the final integer.

151.zh: 读入一行文字，行首、行尾或单词之间都可能有空白。连续的非空白字符构成单词。把单词的先后整个颠倒，使原来排在最后的单词变成排在最前，单词内部的字符保持原样。结果的两端不能留白，相邻单词之间只留一个空格。把这一行写出来。若一个单词都没有，写出空行。
151.en: Read one line of text. Spaces may appear at the start, at the end, or between words. A word is a maximal run of characters that are not spaces. Reverse the sequence of words so the word that was last becomes the word that is first, and keep the characters inside each word as they were. The result must not keep spaces at either end, and neighboring words are separated by one space only. Write the line. Write an empty line when there is no word.

152.zh: 从一串整数里圈出一段连续区间，这段区间至少要含有一个整数。把区间中的数依次相乘，使乘积在一切合法区间中达到最大，然后把该乘积写出来。整数可以是负数或零，零会让所在区间的乘积变为零，负数会改变符号。若整串只有一个数，写出这个数。
152.en: Read a list of integers that may contain negative numbers and zeros. Choose one contiguous span from the list. The span has to include at least one integer. Multiply the integers inside the span in order, find the span whose product is the largest any legal span can reach, and write that product. A zero makes the product of its span zero, and a negative number changes the sign. When the list contains only one integer, write that integer.

153.zh: 读入一列整数。它们原先从小到大排列，随后在一个未知的下标处被截断，右段被整体搬到左段之前。搬完之后可能不再全程递增。列中不出现重复数值。找出最小的整数并写出来。若搬动之后看起来仍是从左到右递增，最小整数就是最左端那个。列的长度至少是一。
153.en: Read a row of integers. They began in increasing order, then an unknown index split the row and the right portion was moved in front of the left portion. After that move the row may no longer increase all the way. No integer appears more than once. Find the smallest integer and write it. If the row still increases from left to right, the smallest integer is the leftmost one. The row length is at least one.

154.zh: 读入一列整数。它们原先从小到大排列，随后在一个未知的下标处被截断，右段被整体搬到左段之前。这一问允许相同整数反复出现，因此搬完后可能看到连续的相等值。找出最小的整数并写出来。若有多个位置上的值同为最小，写出该值一次即可。列的长度至少是一。
154.en: Read a row of integers. They began in increasing order, then an unknown index split the row and the right portion was moved in front of the left portion. This task allows the same integer to appear repeatedly, so equal values may sit next to each other after the move. Find the smallest integer and write it. When several positions share that smallest value, write the value once. The row length is at least one.

155.zh: 维护一个后进先出的整数容器，并处理四类调用。压入时把给出的整数放到最上面。弹出时丢掉最上面的整数。取顶时把最上面的整数原样写出来，同时把它留在容器里。取最小时，在仍留在容器里的全部整数中找出最小的一个并写出来。容器开始时没有任何整数。弹出和取顶只会在容器里已经有整数时出现。这四类调用各自消耗的步数都必须是固定的，不能因为存进的整数变多而变长。按照调用到来的先后，把每一次取顶和每一次取最小的结果依次写出来。
155.en: Read a series of calls that keep an integer stack. A push call places the supplied integer on top. A pop call discards the integer that currently sits on top. A top call writes that same top integer and leaves it in place. A getMin call finds the smallest integer still stored and writes it. The stack begins with nothing in it. Pop and top arrive only when at least one integer is present. Each of the four calls must finish in a fixed amount of work that does not grow as more integers are stored. Write every top result and every getMin result in the order those calls arrive.

160.zh: 两条单向链各自串着若干结点。每个结点装着一个整数，并有一条指向后继的箭头。两条链有可能在某个结点汇合，汇合之后共用后面那一截。找出最先被两条链同时指到的那个结点，并把它写出来。若始终没有共用的结点，就写空。做完之后，每条箭头都要和一开始完全一致，不能为了方便而改写结构。整张图里也不存在绕回去的圈，可以按这个前提来读。
160.en: Read two singly linked chains. Each node stores an integer and one arrow to its successor. The chains may meet at a node and then share the following tail. Find the earliest node that both chains reach and write that node. If they never share a node, write null. After the answer is produced, every arrow must still match the chains you started with. No node anywhere leads back into a loop, so you can rely on that fact while reading the chains. Prefer work that grows with the number of nodes and extra memory that stays fixed.

162.zh: 读入一列相邻两项都不相等的数。把下标越界的两侧都当成负无穷。某个位置上的数如果严格大于紧挨着的左邻和右邻，这个位置就是一个峰。整列里可以同时存在好几个峰。找出任意一个峰，把它从零起算的下标写出来。比较次数要随着列长按对数增长，不能从左到右把每一项都看一遍。端点只要大于它仅有的那个邻居，也算峰。
162.en: Read a list of numbers in which every pair of neighbors differs. Treat both missing ends as negative infinity. A position is a peak when its value is strictly larger than the value beside it on the left and the value beside it on the right. Several peaks may sit in the same list. Write the zero-based index of any one peak. The number of comparisons must grow like the logarithm of the length, so walking across every entry is not acceptable. An endpoint counts when it is strictly larger than its only neighbor.

164.zh: 读入若干非负整数，每个整数都能放进 32 位有符号整数的范围。按从小到大的次序理解这些数，再看排好之后彼此紧挨的两项，把它们差值里最大的那个写出来。若个数不足两个，直接写 0。运算步数和额外占用都要与个数成正比。相等的数挨在一起时，它们的差是 0，真正要找的是所有相邻差里的最大值。
164.en: Read unsorted non-negative integers. Every value fits inside a signed 32-bit range. Imagine them ordered from small to large, then look only at values that become neighbors in that order. Write the largest difference between any such neighboring pair. If fewer than two values are present, write 0. Both the running time and the extra memory should grow in proportion to how many values were read. Equal neighbors contribute a difference of 0, and the written result is still the widest neighboring gap.

167.zh: 读入一列已经从小到大排好的整数，以及一个目标和。找出两个不同位置，使这两个位置上的整数相加正好等于目标和。同一个位置不能使用两次。位置编号从 1 开始，而不是从 0 开始。先写较小的编号，再写较大的编号。输入保证恰好存在一组这样的位置，不要写出第二组。若目标和可以由两端的数凑出，也按同样的编号规则书写。
167.en: Read integers already ordered from small to large, together with one target total. Find two different positions whose values add up to that total. The same position cannot be used twice. Number the positions starting at one rather than at zero. Write the smaller position number first and the larger position number second. Exactly one pair meets the total, so do not write a second pair. If the total is formed by the first value and the last value, still write those position numbers under the same rule.

168.zh: 读入一个正整数，把它换成表格软件里的列标。列标只由大写英文字母组成。数字 1 写成 A，26 写成 Z，27 写成 AA，28 写成 AB。更大的数字沿用同一套二十六进的字母计数，把对应的字母串写出来。至少要能处理到 701，这个数对应 ZY。只写字母本身，不要附加别的符号或解释。输入保证是正整数，不会出现 0 或负数。
168.en: Read one positive integer and write the spreadsheet column label that names it. Labels contain only uppercase English letters. The integer 1 writes A, 26 writes Z, 27 writes AA, and 28 writes AB. Larger integers follow the same base-26 letter counting, and you write the resulting letters. The value 701 must be handled and writes ZY. Write the letters alone, with no extra symbols or commentary. The input is a positive integer, never zero and never negative.

169.zh: 读入一列非空整数，长度记为 n。其中有一个整数出现的次数严格大于 n 的一半向下取整，把它找出来并写出来。可以认为这样的整数一定存在，而且只有一个。其余整数的出现次数都达不到这个标准。n 至少为 1。当 n 为 1 时，那唯一的整数就是要写的结果。不要把出现次数恰好等于一半的数当成答案。
169.en: Read a non-empty list of integers whose length is n. One integer appears strictly more often than the floor of n divided by two. Find that integer and write it. You may rely on it always being present, and on there being only one such integer. Every other integer appears too few times to qualify. The length n is at least 1. When n is 1, the single stored integer is the result you write. An integer that appears exactly half the time, when that can happen, is not the answer.

171.zh: 读入一串表格列标，列标只含大写英文字母。把它换算成对应的正整数并写出来。A 对应 1，B 对应 2，一直到 Z 对应 26，AA 对应 27，AB 对应 28。同一套二十六进的字母计数也适用于更长的列标。ZY 必须能算出 701。空串不会出现。只写这个整数，不要再写字母。列标从左到右是高位到低位。
171.en: Read a spreadsheet column label made only of uppercase English letters. Convert that label into its positive integer and write the integer. A stands for 1, B stands for 2, and so on through Z for 26. AA stands for 27 and AB stands for 28. The same base-26 letter counting applies to longer labels. The label ZY must produce 701. An empty label never arrives. Write only the integer. Letters run from high place to low place, left to right.

172.zh: 读入一个非负整数 n。按定义，n 的阶乘是从 1 连乘到 n 的积，而 0 的阶乘定为 1。把这个积写成十进制，数出末尾连续有多少个 0，把这个个数写出来。中间出现的 0 不算，只数贴在最右边的那一串。计算所用的步数要随着 n 按对数增长，不要把完整的阶乘逐位乘开再去数零。n 可以大到直接展开会溢出。
172.en: Read a non-negative integer n. By definition, n factorial is the product of every integer from 1 through n, and 0 factorial is 1. Write how many zeros sit together at the very end of that product when it is shown in base 10. Zeros that appear only in the middle do not count. The amount of work should grow like the logarithm of n, so do not expand the full product digit by digit and then count. n may be large enough that the full product would overflow a fixed integer.

173.zh: 读入一棵二叉查找树的根。每个结点保存一个整数，左子树里的整数都更小，右子树里的整数都更大。做出一个按从小到大逐个报出结点值的游标。next 每次写出还没报过的整数里最小的那个。hasNext 判断后面是否还剩没报过的整数。可以认为调用 next 时后面确实还有数。平均说来，next 和 hasNext 都只做固定的几步，额外占用与树的高度成正比。空树不会被拿来初始化。
173.en: Read the root of a binary search tree. Each node stores an integer. Every integer in a left subtree is smaller, and every integer in a right subtree is larger. Build a cursor that reports those integers from small to large. Each next call writes the smallest integer that has not been reported yet. Each hasNext call tells whether any unreported integer remains. Assume next is called only when a remaining integer exists. On average both calls do a fixed amount of work, and extra memory stays proportional to the height. An empty tree is not used to start the cursor.

174.zh: 读入一张矩形整数格子。骑士从左上角出发，公主在右下角。每一步只能向右走一格或向下走一格。走进某一格时，把该格上的整数加到生命上：负数是扣血，零是不变，正数是补血。生命一旦落到 0 或更低就立刻失败。写出出发前至少要准备的正整数生命，使得存在一条路线能活着走到右下角。生命没有上限。起点那一格和终点那一格同样可能扣血或补血。
174.en: Read a rectangular grid of integers. A knight begins in the upper-left cell and must reach a princess in the lower-right cell. Each step moves one cell right or one cell down. On entry, add that cell's integer to health: a negative value removes health, zero changes nothing, and a positive value restores health. Health that falls to 0 or below fails at once. Write the smallest positive starting health that still leaves some path alive to the princess. There is no cap on health. The starting cell and the final cell may also remove or restore health.

179.zh: 读入一串非负整数。重新安排它们的先后，再按这个先后把十进制写法首尾粘成一个数。在所有安排方式里，找出能粘出的最大的那个数，并用字符串把它写出来。结果可能非常长，不能塞进固定宽度的整数。若所有粘法都只剩下零，就写成一个字符 0。整数本身的前导零不会出现在输入里，但粘接之后最高位可能是 0。
179.en: Read several whole numbers that are zero or larger. Reorder them, then glue their decimal writings together in that order to form one numeral. Among every possible order, find the numeral that is largest and write it as text. The text may be far too long to fit in a fixed-width integer. If every gluing is nothing but zeros, write a single character 0. Inputs do not arrive with leading zeros on an individual integer, yet the glued text may still need a single zero when nothing else remains.

187.zh: 读入一条只含字母 A、C、G、T 的字符串，把它当作一段遗传序列。在其中找出每一个长度刚好是 10 的片段，并且这个片段在整条字符串里至少出现了两次。每个这样的片段只写一次，书写顺序随意。若没有任何片段重复出现，就写空的结果。片段必须是连续的十个字符，不能跳着取。重叠的窗口只要内容相同并且出现超过一次，也要算进去。
187.en: Read one string that uses only the letters A, C, G, and T, and treat it as a genetic strand. Find every slice of length exactly 10 that shows up at least twice anywhere in the strand. Write each such slice a single time. The order of the written slices does not matter. If nothing of that length repeats, write an empty result. A slice must be ten characters in a row, not a scattered sample of letters. Overlapping windows count whenever the same ten characters occur more than one time.

189.zh: 读入一列整数和步数 k。把整列向右转动 k 格：从右端转出去的数按原有相对次序补到左端，然后把转动之后的整列写出来。长度 n 满足 1 小于等于 n 小于等于 2 乘 10 的 4 次方。每个整数介于负的 2 的 31 次方与 2 的 31 次方减 1 之间，两端都包含。k 满足 0 小于等于 k 小于等于 10^5。k 可以大于 n，只要最终次序正确即可。
189.en: Read a list of integers and a step count k. Rotate the whole list toward the right by k places. Values that leave the right end come back at the left end and keep their relative order. Write the list after that rotation. The length n satisfies 1 <= n <= 2 * 10^4. Each integer lies between -2^31 and 2^31 - 1, including both ends. The step count satisfies 0 <= k <= 10^5. k may be larger than n. Any method is fine as long as the written order matches a right rotation by k places.

190.zh: 读入一个宽度为 32 位的整数，把它的二进制位左右对调：原来的最低位变成最高位，宽度始终保持 32 位，缺的一侧用 0 补上，再把对调后的整数写出来。有些语言没有无符号类型，这时读到的和写出的都是有符号数，但对调的仍是同一串二进制。在补码表示下，读入 -3 时必须写出 -1073741825。不要因为符号而改对调规则。
190.en: Read a 32-bit integer and reverse the order of its bits. The old low bit becomes the high bit. Keep the width at 32, filling open places with 0, and write the integer named by the reversed bits. In languages without an unsigned type, both the value you read and the value you write are signed, but you still reverse that same bit pattern. Under two's complement, reading -3 must write -1073741825. Do not alter the reversal because a sign bit is set.

191.zh: 读入一个整数，数一数它的二进制里有多少位是 1，把这个个数写出来。等于 0 的位不要计入。这个个数也就是该位模式的汉明重量。如果所用语言只有有符号整数，仍然按给出的位模式来数，不要先把负数改成绝对值。补码下显示为 -3 的输入，也要数它各位里的 1。常见宽度是 32 位，高位的 0 不增加计数。
191.en: Read an integer and write how many of its bits are equal to 1. Bits equal to 0 add nothing to the count. That count is the Hamming weight of the bit pattern. If the language offers only signed integers, count the bits of the given pattern anyway, and do not first turn a negative value into its absolute value. An input shown as -3 under two's complement still contributes every 1 in that pattern. The usual width is 32 bits, and high zeros do not raise the count.

198.zh: 沿街有一排房子，读入每间房子里存放的现金，现金都是非负整数。同一夜如果同时进入两间紧挨着的房子，警报就会响起，所以被选中的房子彼此不能相邻。允许跳过任意多间，也允许一间都不选。写出这一夜能够拿走的现金总和的最大值。房子的顺序就是读入的顺序，不能把不相邻的限制理解成别的距离。只有一间房子时，结果就是这间房子里的现金。
198.en: Read a line of houses as non-negative integers, each integer the cash stored in one house. If two houses that stand next to each other are both entered on the same night, an alarm sounds. Chosen houses therefore cannot be neighbors. Skipping any number of houses is allowed, and choosing no house is allowed. Write the largest sum of cash that can be taken on that single night. House order is the order you read. With only one house, the result is the cash in that house.

199.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点上各有一个整数。设想观察者站在树的右侧朝左看，同一层里被更靠右的结点挡住的内容都看不见。每一层只保留视线碰到的第一个结点。从上往下把这些看得见的整数依次写出来。空树就写空结果。某一层如果只有左侧的结点伸得更深，那个更深的结点仍然算被看见，不能因为它不在最右脊柱上就丢掉。
199.en: Read a binary tree whose nodes each store an integer. Imagine an observer standing on the tree's right and looking left. On one level, a node farther right hides whatever sits behind it. Keep only the first node the gaze meets on that level. Write those integers from the upper level downward. An empty tree produces an empty result. If a left-hand node is the only one that reaches a deeper level, that deeper node still counts as seen and must be written.

200.zh: 读入一张字符网格。字符 1 表示陆地，字符 0 表示水。上下左右四边相接的陆地属于同一块，仅斜角碰到不算接上。网格四条边界的外面一律当作水。数一数一共有多少块分开的陆地，把块数写出来。整张网格都是水时写 0。单独一格陆地也算一块。陆地块内部可以有任意形状，只要四向连通就算同一块，不要把同一块拆成多块来数。
200.en: Read a grid of characters. The character 1 means land and the character 0 means water. Land cells that share an edge, whether up, down, left, or right, belong to one piece. Touching only at a corner does not join them. Treat the outside past every border as water. Write how many separate land pieces the grid holds. A grid that is entirely water yields 0. One land cell alone is one piece. A piece may have any shape, and edge-connected cells stay one piece.

201.zh: 读入两个整数 m 和 n，它们满足 0 小于等于 m，m 小于等于 n，并且 n 小于等于 2147483647。把从 m 到 n 的每一个整数都做按位与，m 和 n 两端都要包括，把运算得到的结果写出来。当 m 和 n 相等时，结果就是这个整数本身。按位与对每一位独立进行，某一位只有在范围内每个整数的该位都是 1 时，结果的该位才是 1。
201.en: Read two integers m and n such that 0 is less than or equal to m, m is less than or equal to n, and n is less than or equal to 2147483647. Fold every integer from m through n, counting both ends, with bitwise AND, and write the folded result. When m and n are equal, the result is that integer itself. Each bit is handled on its own: a bit in the result is 1 only when that bit is 1 in every integer of the closed span.

202.zh: 读入一个正整数。反复用它各位数字的平方相加得到下一个数，位数按十进制拆开。如果某一次得到 1，就判断它是快乐数并写真。如果落入一个永远碰不到 1 的循环，就写假。1 本身是快乐数，因为它会停在 1。不要改用别的进制去拆每一位。过程可能在到达 1 之前绕很长的圈，只要最终能到 1 就算快乐。
202.en: Read one positive integer. Form the next value by adding the square of each decimal digit, and keep doing that. If a value becomes 1, judge the starting integer happy and write true. If the values enter a loop that never contains 1, write false. The integer 1 is happy because it stays at 1. Split digits in base 10 only. The chain may wander for a long time before it hits 1, and it still counts as happy whenever 1 appears.

203.zh: 读入一条由整数结点组成的单向链，再读入一个目标值。把链上每一个等于目标值的结点去掉，留下来的结点保持原来的先后次序，写出去掉之后的链。如果一个结点都不剩，就写空。头结点也可能等于目标值，那时新的头是后面第一个留下来的结点。目标值可能一次都不出现，这时整条链原样写出。结点里的其他整数不要改写。
203.en: Read a singly linked chain of integer nodes and one target value. Delete every node whose integer equals the target. Keep the surviving nodes in their original order and write the chain that remains. If no node survives, write null. The head node may equal the target, and then the new head is the first node that stays. The target may match nothing, in which case you write the original chain unchanged. Do not rewrite the integers stored in the nodes you keep.

204.zh: 读入一个非负整数 n。统计严格小于 n 的质数一共有多少个，把这个个数写出来。质数是大于 1、且除了 1 与它自身之外没有别的正因数的整数。若 n 小于 2，个数就是 0。1 不是质数，不要把它算进去。2 是最小的质数。这里只计数，不要求把每个质数本身都列出来。n 等于某个质数时，该质数本身不计入，因为它并不小于 n。
204.en: Read a non-negative integer n. Count the primes that are strictly smaller than n and write that count. A prime is an integer greater than 1 whose only positive divisors are 1 and itself. If n is smaller than 2, write 0. The integer 1 is not a prime and must not be included. The integer 2 is the smallest prime. Write only the count, not a list of the primes themselves. When n itself is prime, leave it out of the count because it is not smaller than n.

205.zh: 读入两条长度相等的字符串。判断第一条里的字符能否按规则替换成第二条。每一种字符在整条字符串里必须换成同一种字符，两种不同的字符不能换成同一个字符，但某个字符可以换成它自己。替换不改变各个位置的先后。若存在这样的替换方式就写真，否则写假。两条字符串的长度相同是已知条件。字符按出现位置一一对应，不能打乱顺序再匹配。
205.en: Read two strings that have the same length. Judge whether characters in the first string can be replaced to produce the second. Every occurrence of one character must turn into the same character, and two different characters must not turn into one shared character. A character may turn into itself. Replacement keeps the order of positions. Write true when such a replacement exists and write false otherwise. Equal length is given. Characters correspond by position, so you cannot shuffle either string before matching.

206.zh: 读入一条单向链表。每个结点保存一个整数，并指向下一个结点。把所有后继箭头反过来，让原来的尾结点变成新的头结点，原来的头结点变成新的尾结点。写出反转后的链表。空链表的结果仍是空。只有一个结点时，结果还是这个结点。结点中保存的整数保持不变，只调整箭头。反转之后，从新头走到新尾，整数的次序与原来完全相反。
206.en: Read one singly linked chain. Each node stores an integer and points at the next node. Reverse every successor arrow so the old tail becomes the new head and the old head becomes the new tail. Write the chain after that reversal. An empty chain stays empty. A chain of one node stays that same node. Integers stored in the nodes stay unchanged; only the arrows move. Walking from the new head to the new tail visits the integers in the opposite order from the chain you read.

207.zh: 读入课程总数 n，课程编号是从 0 到 n 减 1 的整数。再读入若干先修配对。配对里前面的编号表示想学的课，后面的编号表示必须先学完的课。例如配对 0 与 1 表示学 0 之前要先学完 1。这些配对是边的列表，不是矩阵，并且没有重复的边。判断全部课程能否都学完。先修关系如果绕成环，就写假，否则写真。n 可以为 0。
207.en: Read an integer n, the count of courses, labeled with integers from 0 through n minus 1. Then read prerequisite pairs. In a pair, the first label is the course you want and the second label is the course you must finish earlier. For example, the pair 0 with 1 means course 0 waits until course 1 is done. Pairs arrive as a list of edges, not as a matrix, and no edge repeats. Judge whether every course can be finished. Write false when the prerequisites form a cycle, and write true otherwise. n may be 0.

208.zh: 做出一个专门存放小写单词的前缀字典，并响应三种调用。insert 把一个非空单词存进去，重复存入同一个单词仍然表示它存在。search 判断这个完整单词是否已经存过，存过就写真，否则写假。startsWith 判断是否至少有一个已存单词以给定片段开头，有就写真，没有就写假。所有输入只包含从 a 到 z 的字母，而且都不是空串。片段可以比已存单词短。
208.en: Build a dictionary for lowercase words and answer three calls. insert stores one non-empty word, and storing the same word again still means it is present. search tells whether that entire word was stored, writing true or false. startsWith tells whether at least one stored word begins with the supplied fragment, writing true or false. Every input contains only letters from a through z and is never an empty string. A fragment may be shorter than a stored word. Calls may arrive in any mix after the dictionary is created.

209.zh: 读入一串正整数，再读入一个正整数 s。找出一段连续的片段，使片段内的数相加大于或等于 s，并且片段含有的个数要尽量少。把这个最少的个数写出来。如果怎样取都不满足，就写 0。片段里至少要有一个数，不能是空段。数组中的每个数都是正数，没有零和负数。片段必须在原序列里连续，不能把不相邻的数抽出来相加。
209.en: Read a sequence of positive integers and one more positive integer s. Find a contiguous block whose values add to at least s and that contains as few values as possible. Write that smallest count of values. If no block can reach s, write 0. A block includes at least one value and is never empty. Every value in the sequence is positive, so zeros and negatives do not appear. The block must stay contiguous in the original order. You cannot pull apart nonadjacent values and add those instead.

210.zh: 读入课程门数 n，编号从 0 连续排到 n 减 1。另有若干条先后限制，每条用一对编号表示，前一个编号必须等后一个编号学完才可以开始。写出一种能把每一门都学完的先后次序。合法次序若有多种，写出任意一种即可。若这些限制绕成环，使得至少一门永远无法开始，则写出空的编号列表。
210.en: Read the course count n. Identifiers run from 0 up to n minus 1. Also read ordering rules, each given as a pair of identifiers: the first cannot begin until the second is finished. Write one sequence that includes every course. When several sequences work, any one of them is enough. If the rules form a loop so that at least one course can never begin, write an empty list of identifiers.

211.zh: 维护一个只收录小写英文单词的词表，并完成两类调用。第一类把一个新单词登记进去。第二类送来一条查询，查询中每个字符要么是小写字母，要么是点号。点号可以顶替任意一个小写字母，而且只顶替一个位置。判断词表里有没有与整条查询长度相同、逐位都对得上的单词。有则写出 true，没有则写出 false。
211.en: Keep a word list that stores only lowercase English words, and support two calls. The first call records one new word. The second call brings a query in which every character is either a lowercase letter or a dot. A dot may stand in for any one lowercase letter and for exactly one position. Decide whether the list holds a word of the same length that agrees at every position. Write true when it does and false when it does not.

212.zh: 读入一块填满小写字母的矩形格子，以及若干互不相同的待查词。一个词能被拼出，是指可以从某一格出发，每次只迈向共用一条边的邻格，按顺序走出这个词，并且拼这一个词时同一格不得再次进入。把所有能这样拼出的待查词都找出来并写上。同一个词只写一次。格子外不能走，斜方向也不算相邻。
212.en: Read a rectangular grid of lowercase letters and a list of distinct words to look up. A word can be spelled by starting at one cell and stepping only to a cell that shares a side, following the letters in order. While spelling that one word, a cell may not be entered again. Write every lookup word that can be spelled this way, each word once. Steps may not leave the grid, and diagonal neighbors do not count.

213.zh: 房屋排成一个圈，因此第一间与最后一间也相邻。每间屋里放着一笔非负整数现金。同一夜不能进入两间彼此相邻的房屋，否则警报会响。读入每间房屋的现金，算出在警报不响的前提下，一夜能拿走的现金总和的最大值，并把这个最大值写出来。可以跳过任意多间房屋，全部跳过时总和是 0。
213.en: Houses stand in a circle, so the first house and the last house are neighbors. Each house holds a non-negative integer amount of cash. On the same night you must not enter two houses that touch, or an alarm rings. Read the cash in every house and write the largest total you can carry while the alarm stays silent. Any number of houses may be skipped. Skipping every house yields a total of 0.

215.zh: 读入一串整数和一个正整数 k。把这些整数从大到小排成一列，相等的数值按重复次数各占一个位置，不要先合并成一个。写出这一列上第 k 个位置的数值。k 始终介于 1 和整数个数之间。答案是那个位置上的原数值，不是下标。
215.en: Read a list of integers and a positive integer k. Line the integers up from largest to smallest, and let equal values occupy separate places according to how often they occur. Do not merge equals into a single place first. Write the value sitting at place k in that line. k is always from 1 through the count of integers. The answer is the original value at that place, not an index.

216.zh: 读入两个正整数 k 与 n。从 1 到 9 里挑选恰好 k 个互不相同的数，使它们相加正好等于 n。把每一种选法都写出来。若两种选法含有的数字集合相同，只保留一种，不要因为书写先后不同而各写一遍。没有任何选法时，写出空的结果。每个数字在同一次挑选里最多出现一次。
216.en: Read two positive integers k and n. Pick exactly k different integers from 1 through 9 so that they add up to n. Write every such pick. When two picks contain the same set of integers, keep only one, even if the written order differs. When no pick works, write an empty result. Inside one pick, each integer may appear at most once.

217.zh: 读入一串整数。判断其中是否有某个数值出现了不少于两次。只要存在这样的数值，就写出 true；若每个数值都只出现一次，就写出 false。比较只看数值是否相等，不看它们所在的位置。空的序列以及只有一个整数的序列都应当写出 false。
217.en: Read a list of integers. Decide whether some value occurs at least twice. Write true when such a value exists, and write false when every value occurs only once. Compare values for equality only, and ignore where they sit in the list. An empty list and a list that holds a single integer must both produce false.

218.zh: 读入若干座矩形楼。每座楼用左端横坐标、右端横坐标和高度三个整数描述，高度为正，右端大于左端。地面高度是 0，楼与楼可以互相挡住。楼的座数在 0 到 10000 之间，并且已经按左端横坐标由小到大给好。写出外轮廓的转折处：每一处是一段水平轮廓的起点，记下横坐标和那里的高度，并按横坐标由小到大排列。最右端用高度 0 收束。左右相接且高度一样的两段必须并成一段，不能把同一高度拆成紧挨着的两段横线。
218.en: Read several rectangular buildings. Each building is three integers: a left x, a right x, and a positive height, with the right x greater than the left x. The ground is at height 0, and buildings may block one another. The count of buildings is from 0 through 10000, and they already arrive ordered by increasing left x. Write the outline bends. Each bend is the start of one horizontal run, stored as an x value and the height there, ordered by increasing x. Close the outline with a final height of 0. Runs that meet and share a height must be joined, so the same height is never written as two touching horizontal pieces.

219.zh: 读入一串整数以及一个非负整数 k。判断是否存在两个不同的位置，上面的数值相等，而且这两个位置编号相减后的绝对值不大于 k。若存在，写出 true，否则写出 false。数值相等但相距超过 k 的位置不算。k 可以为 0，此时没有任何一对位置能满足距离要求。
219.en: Read a list of integers and a non-negative integer k. Decide whether two different positions store the same value and the absolute gap of their position numbers is at most k. Write true when such a pair exists, and write false otherwise. Equal values farther apart than k do not qualify. When k is 0, no pair of different positions can satisfy the gap, so the answer is false.

220.zh: 读入一串整数，以及两个非负整数 k 和 t。判断能否找到两个不同位置，使位置上的数值之差的绝对值不大于 t，同时位置编号之差的绝对值不大于 k。两个条件要同时成立。成立则写出 true，否则写出 false。只满足其中一个条件的位置对不能算作成功。
220.en: Read a list of integers plus two non-negative integers k and t. Look for two different positions whose stored values differ by at most t and whose position numbers differ by at most k. Both limits must hold together. Write true when such a pair exists, and write false when none exists. A pair that meets only one of the two limits does not succeed.

222.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。除了最深的那一层以外，上面每一层的位置都排满；最深那一层的结点从左向右连续摆放，中间不留空洞。统计这棵树上实际存在的结点有多少，并把这个整数写出来。空树写出 0。缺失的孩子位置不要计入。不要把层号误当成结点数。
222.en: Read a binary tree. Every level above the deepest one is full, and on the deepest level the nodes sit from left to right with no holes between them. Count how many nodes actually exist in the tree and write that integer. An empty tree yields 0. Do not count a missing child slot as a node, and do not treat a level number as the node count.

223.zh: 坐标平面上有两个边与坐标轴平行的矩形。每个矩形给出左下角和右上角的坐标。读入这些坐标，算出两块矩形一起盖住的面积。相交的区域只能计入一次，不能加两遍。没有相交时，就把两块各自的面积相加。结果始终落在 32 位有符号整数所能表示的范围里。
223.en: On a coordinate plane, two rectangles have sides parallel to the axes. Each rectangle is identified by the coordinates of its lower left corner and its upper right corner. Read those coordinates and write the area covered by the two rectangles together. Count an overlapping region only once, never twice. When they do not overlap, add the two separate areas. The result always fits in a signed 32 bit integer.

224.zh: 读入一条算式。它只含加号、减号、圆括号、非负的整数以及空白，并且保证合法。括号中的部分先算，加法和减法按从左到右的次序进行。写出算得的整数。空白可以夹在数字与符号之间，看到后忽略即可。不要调用语言自带的整段算式求值功能。减号既可以表示减法，也可以表示一元负号。
224.en: Read one formula. It contains only plus signs, minus signs, parentheses, non-negative integers, and spaces, and it is always valid. Parts inside parentheses are handled first, and addition and subtraction run from left to right. Write the integer that results. Spaces may sit between numbers and signs and are ignored. Do not call a language facility that evaluates a whole formula at once. A minus sign may mean subtraction or a unary negation.

225.zh: 对外提供一个后进先出的整数容器，手里只能使用队列。需要完成四项动作。push 把一个整数放进容器。pop 去掉并给出最近放进去且还在容器里的整数。top 只查看这个整数，不把它去掉。empty 在容器已经没有任何整数时写出 true，否则写出 false。不会在容器为空时调用 pop 或 top。队列只允许在尾端放入、在首端查看或去掉，以及询问个数和是否为空。
225.en: Offer a last in first out container of integers, and use only queue actions to do it. Support four actions. push places one integer into the container. pop removes and yields the integer that was placed most recently and is still inside. top reports that integer without removing it. empty writes true when the container holds nothing and false when it holds something. pop and top are never called while the container is empty. A queue may only add at its rear, inspect or remove its front, and report its size or whether it is vacant.

226.zh: 读入一棵二叉树的根。对每一个结点，把它的左孩子和右孩子对调，并且整棵树里的每个结点都要这样对调，使树的形状左右颠倒。结点里保存的整数保持原值，只改孩子的链接。写出对调完成之后的树。原本缺失的孩子仍然缺失，不要凭空添上新的整数。
226.en: Read the root of a binary tree. At every node, exchange its left child with its right child, and do that exchange at every node so the shape is mirrored from left to right. Integers stored in the nodes keep their original values; only the child links change. Write the tree after every exchange is finished. A child that was missing stays missing, and no new integer is invented.

227.zh: 读入一条由非负整数以及加、减、乘、除组成的算式，数字和符号之间可以夹着空白。算式长度至少为 1，至多为 3 * 10^5。每个整数都在 0 与 2^31 减 1 之间。算式保证合法，最终结果放得进 32 位整数。乘法和除法比加减更先进行，同一级别从左往右。除法只保留商的整数，余数丢掉。写出这个整数结果。
227.en: Read a formula made of non-negative integers and the operators for addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division. Spaces may appear between numbers and operators. The length is at least 1 and at most 3 * 10^5. Every integer lies between 0 and 2^31 minus 1. The formula is valid, and the final result fits in a 32 bit integer. Multiplication and division are done before addition and subtraction, and operators of one rank run from left to right. Division keeps only the integer quotient and drops the remainder. Write that integer.

228.zh: 读入一串已经由小到大排好、并且彼此都不相同的整数。长度在 0 到 20 之间。每个整数都不小于负的 231，也都不大于 231 减 1。把数值上连续、相邻两项相差恰好为 1 的数收成一段。段内只有一个数时，只写这个数；段内从 a 连到不同的 b 时，写成 a 指向 b。各段按起点由小到大写出。原序列中的每个整数恰好进入一段，段里也不能多出原序列没有的整数。
228.en: Read a list of integers already ordered from small to large, with every value different. The length is between 0 and 20. Each integer is at least negative 231 and at most 231 minus 1. Group values that form a run in which each next value is exactly one larger. When a run holds one value, write that value alone. When a run goes from a to a different b, write a pointing to b. Order the groups by their starting value. Every input integer belongs to exactly one group, and a group must not invent an integer absent from the list.

229.zh: 读入长度为 n 的一串整数。找出所有出现次数严格多于 n 除以 3 之后向下取整所得之数的数值。每个这样的数值在答案里只写一次。若没有数值达到该次数，就写出空列表。阈值用向下取整，不要改成四舍五入。n 为这些整数的个数。
229.en: Read a list of n integers. Find every value whose number of occurrences is strictly greater than n divided by 3, with that quotient rounded down. Write each such value only once. Write an empty list when no value reaches the required count. Use rounding down for the threshold, and do not switch to rounding to the nearest integer. Here n is the count of integers in the list.

230.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树和一个正整数 k。任一结点的左子树里，数值都比该结点小；右子树里，数值都比该结点大；全部数值互不相同。k 总是从 1 到结点总数之间的某个整数。若把树上的数值按从小到大排列，写出排在第 k 位的那个数值。不要写成下标，也不要写出一整条有序列表。
230.en: Read a binary search tree and a positive integer k. In the left subtree of any node, every value is smaller than that node; in the right subtree, every value is larger; all values are different. k is always some integer from 1 through the node count. If the values were lined up from smallest to largest, write the value in place k. Do not write an index, and do not write the whole ordered list.

231.zh: 读入一个整数，判断它能否写成二的某个非负整数次幂。一、二、四、八以及更大的同类数都算成立。成立就写出 true，否则写出 false。零和一切负数都不成立。判断只依据这一个整数，没有第二份输入。次幂的指数必须是整数，不能是分数。
231.en: Read one integer and decide whether it can be written as two raised to a non-negative integer power. The values one, two, four, eight, and larger members of that family all qualify. Write true when it qualifies and false otherwise. Zero and every negative integer fail. The decision uses only this one integer, with no second input. The exponent must be an integer and must not be a fraction.

232.zh: 对外提供一个先进先出的整数容器，手里只能使用栈。需要完成四项动作。push 把一个整数放到容器末尾。pop 去掉并给出最早放入且还留在容器里的整数。peek 只查看这个最早的整数，不把它去掉。empty 在容器已空时写出 true，否则写出 false。不会在容器为空时调用 pop 或 peek。栈只允许在顶端放入、查看或去掉，以及询问个数和是否为空。
232.en: Offer a first in first out container of integers, and use only stack actions to do it. Support four actions. push places one integer at the back of the container. pop removes and yields the integer that was placed earliest and is still inside. peek reports that earliest integer without removing it. empty writes true when nothing is stored and false otherwise. pop and peek are never called while the container is empty. A stack may only add, inspect, or remove its top item, and may report its size or whether it is vacant.

234.zh: 读入一条单向链表，每个结点里有一个整数。从链头走到链尾得到的整数序列，若与从链尾走回链头得到的序列完全相同，就写出 true，否则写出 false。空链以及只有一个结点的链都写出 true。比较的是结点中的整数，不是结点在内存中的位置。
234.en: Read a one-way linked list in which every node stores an integer. Walk from the front to the back to obtain a sequence of integers. Write true when that sequence matches the sequence obtained by walking from the back to the front, and write false when it does not. An empty list and a list of one node both produce true. Compare the integers in the nodes, not the place of a node in memory.

235.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树，以及树上两个不同的结点 p 和 q。所有结点的数值互不相同，p 和 q 都一定在树上。左子树的数值都小于父结点，右子树的数值都大于父结点。找出结点 x，使得 x 是 p 的先辈，也是 q 的先辈，并且在所有符合条件的结点中离根最远。结点可以充当自己的先辈。把 x 写出来。
235.en: Read a binary search tree together with two different nodes p and q. Every node value is unique, and both p and q are present. Values in a left subtree are smaller than the parent, and values in a right subtree are larger. Find a node x that is a forebear of p and also a forebear of q, choosing the forebear farthest from the root when several qualify. A node may serve as a forebear of itself. Write that node x.

236.zh: 读入一棵普通二叉树，以及树上两个不同的结点 p 和 q。所有结点的数值互不相同，p 和 q 都一定出现。这棵树没有左小右大的次序。找出结点 x，从 x 出发沿着孩子方向可以分别走到 p 和 q，并且在所有这样的结点里 x 的深度最大。从结点走到它自己算作可达。把 x 写出来。
236.en: Read an ordinary binary tree together with two different nodes p and q. Every node value is unique, and both p and q occur in the tree. This tree has no rule that left values are smaller than right values. Find a node x from which a walk toward the children can reach p and can also reach q, choosing the deepest such node when several qualify. A walk from a node to itself counts as reaching it. Write that node x.

237.zh: 一条单向链表含有的结点数在 2 到 1000 之间。每个结点的整数互不相同，其绝对值不超过 1000。你得不到链的开头，只能得到必须删去的那个结点，而且它一定不是最后一个。就地改动链接，让这个结点从链上消失，它后面的结点仍按原有次序接好。不要另外新建一条链来替换。写出从原来的开头所能读到的剩余结点。
237.en: A one-way linked list contains between 2 and 1000 nodes. The integer in each node is unique, and its absolute value is at most 1000. You do not receive the opening node. You receive only the node that must be removed, and that node is never the final one. Change the links where they already are so the chosen node disappears and every later node stays in its previous order. Do not allocate a fresh list as a replacement. Write the nodes still readable from the original opening.

239.zh: 读入一串整数以及窗口宽度 k。窗口先盖住最左边的 k 个整数，然后每次向右挪动一格，直到窗口的右端到达序列末尾。窗口里始终正好是 k 个整数。对每一次停靠，找出窗口内部的最大整数，并按从左到右的次序把这些最大整数依次写出来。k 至少为 1，且不会大于序列的长度。
239.en: Read a list of integers and a window width k. The window first covers the leftmost k integers, then shifts one step to the right until the right end of the window reaches the end of the list. The window always contains exactly k integers. At every stop, find the largest integer inside the window, and write those largest integers from left to right. The width k is at least 1 and is never greater than the length of the list.

240.zh: 读入一个 m 行 n 列的整数矩阵，以及一个目标整数。每一行从左到右递增，每一列从上到下递增。行数和列数都是正整数，并且都不超过 20。判断目标整数是否出现在某个格子里。出现则写出 true，未出现则写出 false。相等才算找到，只是大小接近不算。
240.en: Read an integer matrix with m rows and n columns, plus one target integer. Each row increases from left to right, and each column increases from top to bottom. Both m and n are positive integers, and neither exceeds 20. Decide whether the target integer occurs in some cell. Write true when it occurs and false when it does not. Only an equal value counts as found; a merely close value does not.

242.zh: 读入两段只由小写英文字母组成的字符串 s 和 t。判断它们是否含有同样的字母，并且每个字母的出现次数也完全一致。次序不同没有关系。一致则写出 true，否则写出 false。次数不同即使字母种类看起来相近，也要写出 false。空字符串只与另一段空字符串相配。
242.en: Read two strings s and t made only of lowercase English letters. Decide whether they contain the same letters and the same count for every letter. A different order does not matter. Write true when the counts agree and false otherwise. When the counts differ, write false even if the sets of letters look similar. An empty string matches only another empty string.

257.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。从根开始，沿着父子链接一直走到没有孩子的结点。没有左孩子也没有右孩子的结点叫做叶子。把每一条从根走到某个叶子的结点值按自上而下的次序连成一条路径，叶子有多少条就写出多少条。空孩子不写入路径。结点值保持原样，不要改写成别的编号。
257.en: Read a binary tree. Start at the root and follow parent to child links until a node has neither a left child nor a right child. Call that node a leaf. Write every path as the node values from the root down to one leaf, in top to bottom order. Produce one path for every leaf. Do not insert missing children into a path, and do not relabel any node value.

258.zh: 读入一个大于或等于零的整数。把它的十进制各位数字相加，得到一个新的整数。只要这个新整数仍然不少于两位，就再次把各位数字相加。一直做到只剩一位数字为止，并把这个一位数字写出来。零本身已经是一位，直接写出零即可。
258.en: Read one integer that is zero or larger. Add its decimal digits to produce a new integer. As long as that new integer still has two or more digits, add those digits again. Stop when only one digit remains, and write that digit. Zero is already a single digit, so write zero at once.

260.zh: 读入一列整数。其中正好有两个不同的值各自出现一遍，其余每个值都出现两遍。找出这两个只出现一遍的值并写出来。两个答案谁排在前面都可以，两种次序都算正确。不要把出现两遍的值写进答案，也不要漏掉其中任何一个只出现一遍的值。
260.en: Read a list of integers. Exactly two different values occur once each, and every remaining value occurs twice. Find those two once only values and write them. Either order is correct. Do not write a value that occurs twice, and do not omit either of the values that occur once.

263.zh: 读入一个整数，判断它是不是丑数，并把是或否写出来。丑数必须为正，而且全部质因数只能来自二、三、五。数字一算作丑数。零与任何负数都不是丑数。输入是三十二位有符号整数，范围用 32 位来理解，下界为负的二的三十一次方，上界为二的三十一次方再减去一。
263.en: Read one integer and decide whether it is ugly, then write yes or no. An ugly integer must be positive, and every prime factor must be 2, 3, or 5. The integer 1 counts as ugly. Zero and every negative value do not. The input is a signed 32 bit integer, from negative two to the power 31 through two to the power 31 minus one.

264.zh: 读入正整数 n，找出从小到大数起的第 n 个丑数，并把它写出来。丑数是正整数，它的质因数只能取自二、三、五，这三种可以缺某一种。一是序列里的第一个。n 的最小值是 1，最大值是 1690。写出的必须是第 n 个，而不是前 n 个的列表。
264.en: Read a positive integer n and find the nth ugly number when ugly numbers are listed from small to large, then write that number. An ugly number is a positive integer whose prime factors all come from 2, 3, and 5, and any of those three may be unused. The integer 1 is first in the list. n is at least 1 and at most 1690. Write the single nth value, not a list of the first n values.

268.zh: 读入 n 个互不相同的整数。它们选自从 0 一直到 n 的全体整数，但其中恰好缺了一个。找出那个没有出现的整数并写出来。缺失的可以是 0，也可以是 n，也可以是中间的某个整数。输入里不会有重复，也不会有超出这段范围的整数。
268.en: Read n distinct integers taken from the full span of integers that begins at 0 and ends at n. Exactly one integer in that span is absent. Find the absent integer and write it. The absent integer may be 0, may be n, or may sit strictly between them. The input has no repeats and no integer outside that span.

274.zh: 读入一位研究者每篇论文的引用次数，次数都是非负整数，论文总数记为 N。找出最大的整数 h，使得至少 h 篇论文的引用次数各自不少于 h，而其余每篇论文的引用次数至多是 h。把这个 h 写出来。如果多个整数都满足条件，只取其中最大的一个。
274.en: Read the citation count of each paper by one researcher. Every count is a non-negative integer, and N is the paper total. Find the largest integer h such that at least h papers each have h or more citations, and every other paper has at most h citations. Write that h. When several integers satisfy the rule, keep only the largest one.

275.zh: 读入一位研究者每篇论文的引用次数。这些次数已经按从小到大排好，而且全是非负整数，总篇数记为 N。找出最大的 h，使得不少于 h 篇的引用量各自达到 h 或更多，余下每篇都不高于 h。把该 h 写出来。候选不止一个时，仍然只保留最大的候选。
275.en: Read citation counts for one researcher's papers, already arranged from small to large. Every count is a non-negative integer, and N is the paper total. Find the largest h such that at least h papers each reach h citations or more, and every leftover paper stays at or below h. Write that h. If more than one candidate works, keep the largest candidate.

278.zh: 版本号从 1 排到 n，后一个版本总是在前一个版本上继续完成。某个版本一旦不合格，它之后的全部版本也不合格。可以询问任一版本号是否不合格。找出最早的不合格版本并写出来。不合格版本与 n 都至少为 1，并且都不超过 231 减 1。询问次数越少越好，但答案必须是那一个最早的编号。
278.en: Versions are numbered from 1 through n, and each later version is built on the version before it. When one version is bad, every version after it is bad as well. You may ask whether any chosen version number is bad. Find the earliest bad version and write it. The bad version and n are both at least 1 and both at most 231 minus 1. Fewer questions are better, yet the written answer must be that earliest number.

279.zh: 读入正整数 n。把它表示成若干个平方数相加，所用的项数要尽量少，然后把这个最少项数写出来。平方数是某个整数与自身相乘的结果，一、四、九、十六都属于这一类，三和十一则不属于。每一项都必须是平方数，可以重复使用同一个平方数。n 从 1 到 104。
279.en: Read a positive integer n. Express n as a sum of square numbers and use as few terms as possible, then write that smallest term count. A square number is an integer multiplied by itself. The values 1, 4, 9, and 16 belong to this class, while 3 and 11 do not. Every term must be a square number, and the same square number may be used more than once. n runs from 1 to 104.

283.zh: 读入一个整数数组。把里面的每一个零都挪到数组末尾，同时让所有非零整数保持原先的相对先后。必须在原数组里完成改动，不能另外复制一整份数组。改完之后把数组写出来。零与零之间的次序没有额外要求。判断对错时只看非零整数的相对先后是否保持，以及零是否都在末尾。
283.en: Read a list of integers. Move every zero to the end of the list while keeping the prior relative order of every nonzero integer. Perform the change inside the original list and do not copy the whole list aside. Write the list after the change. The order among zeros has no extra requirement. A correct result keeps nonzero integers in their prior relative order and places every zero at the end.

284.zh: 手头已有一个迭代器，它只能回答后面是否还有元素，以及取出下一个元素。在它外面再包一层，让调用方可以先查看下一个即将被取出的元素，而这次查看不会把该元素消耗掉。在真正取出之前，反复查看应该看到同一个元素。真正取出时仍然调用原来的取下一个。把这个可查看下一元素的包装实现出来。
284.en: An iterator is already available. It can only report whether another element remains, and it can only yield the next element. Wrap it so a caller can inspect the upcoming element without consuming that element. Repeated inspections, before a real yield, must show the same element. A real yield still calls the original step that produces the next element. Write this wrapper that can inspect the upcoming element.

287.zh: 读入 n 加 1 个整数，每个整数都在 1 与 n 之间，两端包含在内。这些整数里只有一个值出现了多于一次，该值可以出现三次或更多，其余每个值最多出现一次。数组只允许读取，不允许修改其中任何一个位置。找出那个重复出现的值并写出来。不要改动原数组的内容。
287.en: Read n plus 1 integers. Each integer lies between 1 and n, with both ends included. Exactly one value occurs more than once, and that value may occur three or more times, while every other value occurs at most once. The list may be read but must not be modified at any position. Find the repeated value and write it. Leave the original list contents unchanged.

290.zh: 读入一个模式串和一串单词。单词之间只用一个空格分隔。模式串只包含小写字母，每个单词也只包含小写字母。判断单词串是否与模式完全对应：每个字母只对应一个非空单词，不同字母对应不同单词，并且从左到右逐个对齐。把是否对应写出来。单词不能为空，空格也不能连在一起。
290.en: Read a pattern and a row of words separated by a single space. The pattern contains only lowercase letters, and every word contains only lowercase letters. Decide whether the words match the pattern fully: each letter pairs with one nonempty word, different letters pair with different words, and the pairs line up from left to right. Write yes or no. Words are nonempty and spaces are not doubled.

297.zh: 为一棵二叉树准备两种互逆的操作。先把树写成一段文本，再根据这段文本重建一棵形状相同、结点值也相同的树。空树也必须能够完整地来回转换。结点个数落在 0 到 104 之间。每个结点上的数值，其绝对值不超过 1000。文本采用何种格式都可以，只要重建结果与原树一致。把这两种操作都实现出来。
297.en: Prepare two inverse operations for a binary tree. First turn the tree into one piece of text. Then rebuild, from that text, a tree with the same shape and the same node values. The empty tree must survive a full round trip. The node count lies between 0 and 104. The absolute value of every node value is at most 1000. Any text format is acceptable when the rebuilt tree matches the original. Implement both operations.

299.zh: 读入两串长度相等的数字，第一串是秘密数字，第二串是一次猜测。某一位的数字和位置都相同，算一头公牛。数字在秘密数字中出现、但这一位对不上，算一头奶牛。同一位不能同时计入公牛和奶牛。重复数字按各自出现的次数来配对。把提示写成 xAyB。这里 x 记公牛有几头，y 记奶牛有几头。两串长度从 1 到 1000。
299.en: Read two digit strings of equal length. The first string is the secret and the second string is one guess. A bull is a digit that matches the secret at the same index. A cow is a digit that occurs in the secret but not at that index. One index cannot count both as a bull and as a cow. Match repeated digits by how many times each digit occurs. Write the hint in the form xAyB. Here x counts bulls and y counts cows. Each length runs from 1 to 1000.

300.zh: 读入一列整数，这列整数不一定已经排序。从中选出若干个，保持它们在原列中从左到右的先后，并且后选出的数严格大于先选出的数。中间允许跳过一些数。这样的选取称为严格递增的子序列。找出最长一条的长度并写出来。有多条都达到这个长度时，只写长度，不必列出具体选取。
300.en: Read a list of integers that may not be sorted. Choose some of them so that they keep their original left to right order and each later choice is strictly larger than the choice before it. Skipping values is allowed. Such a choice is a strictly increasing subsequence. Find the length of a longest one and write that length. When several choices share that length, write only the length and do not list the choices.

301.zh: 读入字符串 s。它里面混有英文小写字母，还有左右圆括号。删掉尽量少的括号，使剩下的文本成为合法的括号文本，字母保持原位不动。找出每一种能得到的不同合法文本，排列次序不限，并全部写出来。s 的长度最少是 1，最多是 25。s 里的括号最多有 20 个。不要删除字母。
301.en: Read a string s made from lowercase English letters and round parentheses. Delete as few parentheses as you can so the remaining text is a valid parenthesized text, and leave every letter where it is. Find every different valid text that can result. Any order is fine. Write all of them. The length of s is at least 1 and at most 25. s contains at most 20 parentheses. Do not delete letters.

303.zh: 读入一个整数数组，这个数组在整个过程中都不会被修改。随后会有很多次区间询问。每次给出两个下标 i 和 j，并且 i 小于或等于 j。把下标从 i 到 j 的元素全部相加，两端的元素都要算上，然后把这个和写出来。多次询问之间，数组里的每个元素都保持最初的值。
303.en: Read an integer list that stays unmodified for the whole process. Many range questions follow. Each question gives two indexes i and j, with i less than or equal to j. Add every element whose index runs from i through j, including both ends, and write that sum. Between questions, every element keeps the value it had at the start.

304.zh: 读入一个二维整数矩阵，这个矩阵在整个过程中都不会被修改。随后会有很多次矩形询问。每次用左上角的行号与列号，以及右下角的行号与列号，标出一个闭矩形。把该矩形内部的全部整数相加，边界上的整数也要算进去，然后把和写出来。各次询问都面对同一份最初的矩阵。
304.en: Read a two dimensional integer matrix that stays unmodified for the whole process. Many rectangle questions follow. Each question marks a closed rectangle by the row and column of the upper left corner and the row and column of the lower right corner. Add every integer inside that rectangle, including integers on the boundary, and write the sum. Every question uses the same original matrix.

306.zh: 读入一个只含数字字符的字符串，字符范围是 0 到 9。判断能否把它切成至少 3 个整数，使得从第三个整数开始，每一个都等于紧挨着的前两个整数之和。切出来的整数不允许有前导零，所以像 1、2、03 以及 1、02、3 这样的切法都不合法。把是否能够这样切写出来。
306.en: Read a string whose characters are digits from 0 through 9. Decide whether it can be cut into at least 3 integers so that, starting at the third integer, each one equals the sum of the two integers just before it. A cut integer may not have a leading zero, so cuts such as 1, 2, 03 and 1, 02, 3 are illegal. Write yes or no for whether such a cut exists.

307.zh: 读入一个整数数组。需要支持两种操作。第一种把下标 i 上的整数改成一个新的整数。第二种询问下标 i 到 j 的闭区间之和，并且 i 小于或等于 j。数组只会因为第一种操作而改变。两种操作的调用次数大致均衡。每次区间求和都要把得到的和写出来。下标都落在数组已有的范围内。
307.en: Read an integer list and support two operations. The first replaces the integer at index i with a new integer. The second asks for the sum of the closed index span from i to j, where i is less than or equal to j. The list changes only because of the first operation. Calls of the two operations arrive in roughly equal numbers. Write the sum for every span question. Every index lies inside the existing list.

309.zh: 读入一列股价，每个下标代表一个交易日。可以多次完成先买后卖，但同一时刻手里最多只有一股，必须先卖掉才能再次买入。卖掉之后的下一天禁止买入，要空过那一天，再下一天才允许买入。在这些限制下找出能获得的最大利润，并把该利润写出来。不交易时利润可以是零。
309.en: Read a list of stock prices, with each index standing for one trading day. You may complete many buy then sell cycles, but you hold at most one share at a time and must sell before you buy again. The day after a sale forbids a purchase, so you skip that day and may buy only on a later day. Under these limits, find the largest profit and write it. Doing no trade at all may leave the profit at zero.

315.zh: 读入一列整数。对于每一个位置，统计它右侧有多少个整数严格小于该位置上的整数，从而得到一条与原列等长的计数。按从左到右的原有次序把这条计数写出来。相等的整数不算作更小。左侧的整数不参与该位置的统计。最右端的计数一定是零。
315.en: Read a list of integers. For every position, count how many integers strictly to its right are smaller than the integer at that position, producing a count list of the same length. Write that count list in the original left to right order. Equal integers do not count as smaller. Integers to the left are ignored for that position. The rightmost count is always zero.

318.zh: 读入若干个单词，这些单词里的字符全部是英文小写。找出两个单词，它们不含有任何一个相同的字母，并且两个长度相乘的积要在所有这样的配对里最大。把这个最大乘积写出来。如果每一对单词都会共享至少一个字母，就写出 0。不要把同一个单词和它自己配成一对。
318.en: Read several words, each made only of lowercase letters. Find two words that share no letter at all and whose lengths multiply to the largest product among every such pair. Write that largest product. If every pair of words shares at least one letter, write 0. Do not pair a word with itself.

319.zh: 一开始有 n 盏灯泡，全部处于熄灭。第 1 轮把每一盏都拨成点亮。之后每一轮按固定间隔拨动开关：第 i 轮从第一盏数起，每数到 i 就拨动一次，点亮的变成熄灭，熄灭的变成点亮。一直进行到第 n 轮，那一轮只拨动最后一盏。找出结束时仍然点亮的灯泡数量并写出来。
319.en: Begin with n bulbs, every one dark. On round 1, switch every bulb to lit. On each later round, walk the bulbs with a fixed step: on round i, start at the first bulb and switch a bulb every i steps, so a lit bulb becomes dark and a dark bulb becomes lit. Continue until round n, which switches only the final bulb. Find how many bulbs remain lit at the end and write that count.

322.zh: 读入几种硬币的面额，再读入一个目标金额。每一种面额都可以使用任意多次，也可以一次都不用。找出凑成目标金额所需的最少硬币枚数，并把这个枚数写出来。如果无论怎样组合都无法正好凑成目标金额，就写出 -1。面额都是正整数。硬币的使用次数没有上限。
322.en: Read several coin denominations and one target amount. Each denomination may be selected any number of times, including zero times. Find the smallest number of coins that add up exactly to the target, and write that number of coins. If no selection adds up exactly to the target, write -1. Every denomination is a positive integer. There is no upper bound on how often a denomination is selected.

324.zh: 读入一个尚未排序的整数数组，把它重新排列成摆动形状。从下标 0 起，偶数下标上的数小于紧随其后的数，奇数下标上的数大于紧随其后的数，于是整体呈现小、大、小、大这样交替。输入保证至少存在一种满足该形状的排列。把重排之后的数组写出来。若有多种合法排列，写出任意一种即可。
324.en: Read an unsorted list of integers and rearrange it into a wiggle shape. Starting at index 0, the value at each even index is smaller than the value just after it, and the value at each odd index is larger than the value just after it, so the shape alternates small, large, small, large. The input is guaranteed to have at least one arrangement of this shape. Write the list after rearranging. If several valid arrangements exist, write any one of them.

326.zh: 读入一个整数，判断这个数能不能写成 3 的非负整数次方。1 等于 3 的 0 次方，应当判为成立。0、所有负数，以及无法用整数指数凑出的正数，都判为不成立。只需要回答是否成立，把真或假写出来。
326.en: Read one integer and decide whether it equals three raised to a nonnegative whole exponent. The value one counts as three to the power zero and should be accepted. Reject zero, every negative value, and every positive value that cannot be formed that way. Write true or false.

327.zh: 读入一串整数，再读入两个边界，分别叫做下界和上界。任取一段位置连续的数，把它们相加得到一个合计。位置只能从左往右，不能倒着取，空段也不算。统计有多少段的合计大于等于下界并且小于等于上界。把这个段数写出来。
327.en: Read a list of integers together with a lower bound and an upper bound. Choose any contiguous block of positions, keeping those positions in increasing order, and add the values stored there. Count how many blocks produce a total that is greater than or equal to the lower bound and less than or equal to the upper bound. An empty block does not count. Write that count.

328.zh: 读入一条单向链表。按照结点在链上的位置重新连接：位置从 1 开始数，所有奇数位置的结点先按原有先后连成一段，再接上所有偶数位置的结点，偶数段内部也保持原来的先后。这里看的是位置，不是结点中保存的数值。把重新连接后的链表头写出来。
328.en: Read a one-way linked chain. Reconnect the nodes by their positions, counting the first node as position one. Place every odd-position node first, preserving the order those nodes already had, then append every even-position node, again preserving that group's earlier order. Positions matter here, and the numbers stored in the nodes do not. Write the head of the reconnected chain.

329.zh: 读入一张填满整数的方格表。从任意一格出发，每一步只能走到共用一条边的相邻格子，并且新格子里的整数必须严格大于当前格子。不能斜着走，不能走出表的边缘，也不能从一边绕到对面。找出一条这样的路线最多能经过多少个格子，把这个长度写出来。
329.en: Read a rectangular grid filled with integers. From any cell, a step may enter only a neighbor that shares a full side, and the integer in the new cell must be strictly larger. Diagonal moves are forbidden, leaving the grid is forbidden, and jumping across to the far side is forbidden. Find the greatest number of cells a single route can visit, and write that length.

331.zh: 读入一行由英文逗号分开的记号。每个记号要么是一个整数，要么是一个井号，井号表示空的孩子位置。判断这一行能否成为某棵二叉树的先序记录：访问一个结点时先写下它，再写下它的左子树，最后写下它的右子树。输入不会出现两个逗号紧挨着。把是否成立写成真或假。
331.en: Read a single line of tokens split by commas. Each token is either an integer or a hash mark, and a hash mark means a child is absent. Decide whether the line can be the preorder record of some binary tree: when a node is visited, its token comes first, then the whole left side, then the whole right side. Two commas never sit next to each other. Write true or false.

337.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，每个结点上标着一笔金额。选出若干结点并把金额相加。一旦某个结点和它的直接父结点同时入选，这次选择就无效。结点和更远的祖先可以同时入选。在所有有效选择里找出金额合计的最大值，把这个最大值写出来。
337.en: Read a binary tree in which every node carries an amount of money. Select any collection of nodes and add their amounts. A selection is invalid if it includes both some node and that node's direct parent. A node may be selected together with an ancestor that is farther away. Among valid selections, find the greatest total and write it.

338.zh: 读入一个大于等于 0 的整数 n。对每一个从 0 到 n 的整数，两端都要计入，数出它的二进制写法里数字 1 出现了多少次。按照整数从小到大的顺序，把这些次数排成一列写出来，不要漏掉任何一项。
338.en: Read an integer n that is greater than or equal to zero. For every integer from zero through n, including both ends, count how many times the digit 1 appears in its binary writing. List those counts from the smallest integer to the largest, and write the list.

341.zh: 读入一份可以层层嵌套的结构。结构里的每一项要么本身就是一个整数，要么又是一份同样规则的结构。按照从左到右、外层走完再进入内层的次序，把出现过的所有整数依次暴露出来。需要支持一次取出下一个整数，并在全部取完后停止。把依次取出的整数写出来。
341.en: Read a structure whose pieces may sit inside one another. Every piece is either a single integer or another structure built by the same rule. Expose all of the integers from left to right, finishing an outer piece before entering a nested piece. Support fetching the next integer once per request, and stop after the last integer has been fetched. Write the integers in the order they are fetched.

342.zh: 读入一个 32 位有符号整数。判断它是否等于 4 的某个非负整数次方。4 的 0 次方是 1，应当判为真。0 和所有负数都判为假。其它正数只有在不断整除 4 最终得到 1 时才判为真。把真或假写出来。
342.en: Read one signed integer that fits in 32 bits. Decide whether it equals four raised to a nonnegative whole exponent. Four to the power zero is one, so one must be accepted. Reject zero and every negative value. Accept another positive value only when repeated exact division by four lands on one. Write true or false.

343.zh: 读入一个正整数 n。把它拆成至少两个正整数，这些正整数相加必须恰好等于 n，每个部分至少为 1。部分的个数可以大于二。把所有部分相乘，在全部分法中找出最大的乘积，并把该乘积写出来。
343.en: Read a positive integer n. Partition it into two or more positive whole numbers that add up to exactly n, with every part at least one. More than two parts are allowed. Multiply the parts of a partition. Search every partition and find the greatest product any of them yields. Write that product.

344.zh: 读入一列字符，这些字符都是可打印的 ASCII。把这一列就地首尾交换，使最左边的字符移到最右边，其余字符移到对称的位置。不要另外申请一列来保存结果，额外占用的空间只能是常数。交换完成后，把这一列写出来。
344.en: Read a row of characters, each of which is printable ASCII. Reverse that row where it already lives, so the leftmost character moves to the rightmost slot and every other character moves to its mirrored slot. Do not request a second row to store the outcome, and keep extra memory constant. After the swaps, write the same row.

345.zh: 读入一行字符串。只把其中的元音字母按出现顺序倒过来，辅音、数字和其它符号都留在原地。元音包括 a、e、i、o、u 以及对应的大写字母。字母移动时保持自己原来的大小写。把处理之后的整行写出来。
345.en: Read one string. Reverse only the vowel letters in the order they appear, and leave consonants, digits, and every other symbol where they already stand. Vowels are a, e, i, o, and u, plus the matching uppercase letters. When a vowel moves, keep the case it already had. Write the whole string after the change.

347.zh: 读入一个非空的整数数组，以及正整数 k。先统计每个不同整数出现的次数。再选出出现次数最高的 k 个不同整数。若有次数并列，写出其中任意整数都可以。把这 k 个整数写出来。所花时间必须优于数组长度 n 乘以 n 的对数这一档。
347.en: Read a nonempty array of integers and a positive integer k. First count how many times each distinct integer occurs. Then choose the k distinct integers that occur most often. If several integers share a count, any of them may be written. Write those k integers. The time spent must be better than the bound of n times the logarithm of n, where n is the array length.

349.zh: 读入两个整数数组。找出那些至少在两个数组里都出现过的整数。同一个整数无论在某一侧重复多少次，答案里都只写一次。答案的排列顺序没有限制。把这些互不相同的公共整数写出来。
349.en: Read two arrays of integers. Find every integer that appears at least once in each of the two arrays. No matter how many times a value repeats on either side, write it only a single time. The order of the written values is unrestricted. Write that collection of distinct shared integers.

350.zh: 读入两个整数数组。某个整数只有在两边都出现过时才能进入答案。它在答案里出现的次数，等于它在两个数组里出现次数的较小值。只出现在一侧的整数不要写出。答案顺序可以打乱。把这些整数按上述次数写出来。
350.en: Read two arrays of integers. An integer may enter the answer only when it appears on both sides. The number of times it is written equals the smaller of its two appearance counts. Leave out any integer that is absent from one side. The written order may be shuffled. Write the integers with those repetition counts.

352.zh: 维护一条陆续到来的非负整数记录，开始时一个数都没有。每次可以加入一个整数，取值在 0 到 10000 之间，含两端。任何时候都要把已经见过的整数归纳成若干互不重叠的闭区间，能连成一片的连续整数必须并进同一段，每段用左端点和右端点表示。加入与查询加起来最多进行 3 乘以 10000 次。把当前的区间列表写出来。
352.en: Maintain a stream of nonnegative integers that begins with nothing in it. Each insertion adds one integer whose value is from 0 through 10000, both ends included. Whenever asked, report every integer observed up to now as closed intervals that do not overlap, and integers that form an unbroken run must share one interval. Each interval is reported by its left end and its right end. Insertions and reports together happen at most 3 times 10000. Write the current list of intervals.

354.zh: 读入若干只信封，每一只用两个正整数表示宽度和高度。一只较小的信封要放进另一只，必须宽度更小而且高度也更小，两个方向都是严格小于。不允许把信封转九十度之后再比较大小。问最多能有多少只信封套成一串，里面一只接着一只。把这个数量写出来。
354.en: Read several envelopes. Each one is described by two positive integers, a width and a height. A smaller envelope fits in a larger one only when both its width and its height are strictly less than those of the larger one. Rotating an envelope by a right angle before comparing is forbidden. Find how many envelopes can be nested in one chain, each inside the next, and write that largest count.

357.zh: 读入一个非负整数 n。统计满足 0 小于等于 x 且 x 小于 10 的 n 次方的整数 x 有多少个，并且 x 的十进制各位数字两两不同。0 本身算一个。不要把没有写出来的前导零当成额外的一位。把这个个数写出来。
357.en: Read a nonnegative integer n. Count the integers x such that x is at least 0 and strictly less than ten to the power n, and such that all decimal digits of x are different from each other. The value zero counts as one such integer. Do not treat unwritten leading zeros as extra digits. Write that count.

367.zh: 读入一个正整数。判断它是不是某个整数的平方。如果是，写出真；如果不是，写出假。不能调用语言自带的开平方函数，也不能用浮点库来取平方根。只用整数的乘法、除法或比较来完成判断。
367.en: Read one positive integer. Decide whether some integer multiplies by itself to produce it. Write true if such an integer exists, and write false otherwise. Do not call a square-root function supplied by the language, and do not use a floating-point library to take a root. Use only integer multiplication, division, or comparison to decide.

368.zh: 读入一组两两不同的正整数。数组长度在 1 到 1000 之间，每个整数在 1 到 2 乘 10 的 9 次方之间。挑出一个元素个数最多的子集，使得子集里任意两个数，大的那个能被小的那个整除。如果有多个子集一样大，写出任意一个即可。
368.en: Read a list of positive integers that are all different from one another. The list length is between 1 and 1000, and each integer is between 1 and 2 times 10 to the 9th power. Choose a subset with as many members as possible so that, for every two members, the bigger one is divisible by the smaller one. If several subsets are tied for size, write any one of them.

371.zh: 读入两个整数，记为 a 和 b。计算它们的和。计算过程中禁止使用加号，也禁止使用减号。位运算以及其它不含这两个符号的运算可以使用。两个数都可能是负数，结果要和普通加法一致。把这个和写出来。
371.en: Read two integers called a and b. Compute their total. During the computation the plus sign is forbidden and the minus sign is also forbidden. Bit operations and any other operation that does not use those two signs are allowed. Either integer may be negative, and the result must match ordinary addition. Write that total.

372.zh: 读入一个正整数 a，再读入另一个位数极多的正整数 b。b 的十进制数位从高位到低位存放在数组中，因位数太多而不能先合并成一个普通整数。计算 a 的 b 次幂，再除以 1337，把得到的余数写出来。
372.en: Read a positive integer a, then read another positive integer b that is far too large for a normal machine word. The decimal digits of b arrive in an array from the highest place to the lowest place, so they must not be merged into one ordinary integer first. Compute a raised to the power b, divide by 1337, and write the remainder.

373.zh: 读入两个已经按升序排好的整数数组，再读入一个正整数 k。配对时，前一个数必须取自第一个数组，后一个数必须取自第二个数组。在全部配对中，按照两数之和从小到大选取 k 对。若和相同，保留哪一对都可以。把选出的 k 对写出来。
373.en: Read two integer arrays that have already been arranged in increasing order, and also read a positive integer k. A pair takes its first number from array one and its second number from array two. Look at every pair that can be built this way. Select the k pairs with the smallest totals of the two numbers. If two totals match, either pair may be kept. Write the selected pairs.

374.zh: 有人在 1 到 n 之间秘密选定一个整数，n 的上限是 231 减 1，选定的数也落在这个闭区间里。你可以多次调用现成的 guess 函数去猜。返回 0 表示猜对，返回负数表示秘密数比你猜的小，返回正数表示秘密数比你猜的大。找出秘密数并写出来。
374.en: A hidden integer has been chosen from 1 through n. The upper bound on n is 231 - 1, and the hidden integer lies in that same closed range. You may call a ready-made guess function as many times as you need. A result of 0 means the guess is correct, a negative result means the hidden integer is smaller than the guess, and a positive result means it is larger. Find the hidden integer and write it.

376.zh: 读入一列整数，长度介于 1 和 1000 之间，每个整数介于 0 和 1000 之间。若相邻两项之差严格地正负交替，就称它为摆动，第一处差值的正负不限。少于两个数的列也算摆动。允许删掉若干个数，剩余部分必须维持原先的相对顺序。找出最长摆动子序列有多长并写出来。
376.en: Read a list of integers. Its length is from 1 to 1000 inclusive, and every integer is from 0 to 1000 inclusive. Call the list a wiggle when successive differences strictly switch sign, while the sign of the opening difference may be either one. A list with fewer than two numbers is still a wiggle. Dropping some numbers is allowed, but whatever remains must keep its prior relative order. Write how many numbers sit in the longest wiggle you can obtain.

377.zh: 读入若干个互不相同的正整数，个数在 1 到 200 之间，每个整数在 1 到 1000 之间，另外读入目标值 target，范围同样是 1 到 1000。用这些整数组成序列，每个整数可重复使用，序列各项之和要恰好等于 target。顺序不同视为不同序列。答案保证能放进 32 位整数。把序列的种数写出来。
377.en: Read several positive integers that are pairwise distinct. There are between 1 and 200 of them, each between 1 and 1000, and there is also a target in that same 1 to 1000 range. Form sequences from these integers so the entries add to exactly the target. Reuse of an integer is allowed, and a changed order counts as another sequence. The count is guaranteed to fit inside a 32-bit integer. Write how many sequences exist.

378.zh: 读入一个 n 行 n 列的整数矩阵，以及整数 k。每一行从左到右都是递增的，每一列从上到下也都是递增的。把矩阵中的全部整数按从小到大排序后，取出排在第 k 位的那个数，k 从 1 开始，并且总是满足 1 到 n 的平方这一范围。它并不是按行扫描时遇到的第 k 格。把这个数写出来。
378.en: Read an n-by-n matrix of integers together with an integer k. Each row grows from left to right, and each column grows from top to bottom. Sort every integer in the matrix from small to large and take the one that lands in rank k, where k starts at 1. The rank k is always legal and stays between 1 and n squared. It is not the cell reached by scanning row after row. Write that integer.

382.zh: 读入一条单链表。结点数量在 1 到 10^4 之间，每个结点保存的整数在负的 10^4 到正的 10^4 之间。实现随机返回一个结点数值的操作，链表上每个结点被选中的概率必须相等。这个操作最多会被调用 10^4 次。链表也许非常长，长度可以事先未知，额外使用的空间应当保持为常数。把每次随机得到的数值写出来。
382.en: Read one singly linked chain. It contains between 1 and 10^4 nodes, and each node stores an integer from negative 10^4 to positive 10^4. Provide an operation that returns the stored integer of a node chosen at random, giving every node an equal probability. That operation is invoked at most 10^4 times. The chain might be extremely long and its length might be unknown in advance, so the extra memory used should remain constant. Write each value the operation returns.

383.zh: 读入两段仅由英文小写字母构成的文本，前一段是便条，后一段是剪报来源。两段长度都在 1 到 100000 之间。剪报里的每个字母最多只能剪下来用一次。若便条上的每个字母都能这样配齐，写出 true，否则写出 false。
383.en: Read two texts made only of lowercase English letters. The first text is a note and the second is a pool of letters cut from a magazine. Each length is between 1 and 100000. Every letter in the pool may be used at most once. Write true when the note can be assembled from that pool, and write false when some letter runs short.

384.zh: 用一串互不重复的整数建立对象。长度至多 200，每个数位于负 1000000 与正 1000000 之间。reset 把内部序列还原成建立时的次序并写出整串。shuffle 写出一种随机重排，要求全部排列出现的机会完全一样。这两项操作合计至多调用 5 乘 10000 次。
384.en: Create an object from a list of distinct integers. The list contains at most 200 entries, and each entry lies between -1000000 and 1000000. Calling reset restores the saved order from construction time and writes that full list. Calling shuffle writes one random reordering in which every permutation is equally likely. Those two calls together happen at most 5 times 10000.

385.zh: 读入一条不含空白的字符串，它描述一份由整数层层嵌套而成的清单。成员要么是一个整数，要么是另一份同样规则的清单。文本保证不是空的，格式一定正确，字符只会出现数字、左右方括号、逗号以及表示负数的减号。把这份文本还原成对应结构并写出来。
385.en: Read a single string with no blank characters. It describes a collection whose members are whole numbers or further collections built by the same rule. The text is never empty, its format is always correct, and the only symbols are digits, opening and closing brackets, commas, and a minus sign for negatives. Write the structure recovered from that text.

386.zh: 读入正整数 n，其上限为 5000000。把 1 到 n 的每个整数都写成十进制文本，再按照字典里查单词的方式从小到大排列这些文本。按这个次序把对应的整数整列写出来，一个都不能漏，也不能超出 n。
386.en: Read a positive integer n no larger than 5000000. Turn every integer from 1 through n into decimal text and sort those texts the way a dictionary sorts words. Write the integers in that sorted order. Include every integer in the range and do not write anything beyond n.

387.zh: 读入一串字符。从左向右查找最先出现、并且整串里只露面一次的那个字符，把它从零数起的位置写出来。如果每个字符都至少露面两次，就不存在这样的字符，此时写出 -1。位置按字符下标计算，空位不另计。
387.en: Read one string of characters. Scan from the left and locate the earliest character that appears exactly once in the whole string. Write its position, counting the first character as position 0. If every character appears at least twice, no such character exists, and you should write -1. Count positions by character index only.

389.zh: 读入两段只含小写英文字母的文本，分别叫 s 和 t。t 的来历是先把 s 中的字母次序打乱，再在某个地方多插进一个字母。那个多出来的字母恰好一个。把它找出来并单独写在一行上。
389.en: Read two strings named s and t. Both contain only lowercase English letters. The string t was produced by rearranging every letter of s and then inserting exactly one extra letter at some place. Find that extra letter and write it. There is always exactly one such letter.

390.zh: 准备一列从 1 排到 n 的整数，n 介于 1 与 109 之间。先自左往右删：去掉当前最左边的数，之后每保留一个就再去掉一个，直到这一趟走完。接着自右往左删：去掉当前最右边的数，之后同样每保留一个再去掉一个。两个方向轮流进行，直到只留单独一个整数。写出它。
390.en: Begin with the integers 1, 2, and so on up to n, where n is an integer from 1 to 109. First sweep from the left: delete the current leftmost entry, then alternately keep one and delete one until that sweep finishes. Next sweep from the right: delete the current rightmost entry, then keep one and delete one in the same alternating way. Continue switching direction until a lone integer remains. Write it.

391.zh: 读入若干轴对齐矩形，个数至多是 2 乘 10000。每个矩形由西南角和东北角的横纵坐标给出，四个数都落在负 100000 到正 100000。判断这些矩形拼合之后，是否既不互相压住，也不留下空洞，并且外边界正好构成一个大矩形。是则写出 true，否则写出 false。
391.en: Read up to 2 times 10000 rectangles whose sides line up with the axes. Each rectangle is given by the coordinates of its southwest corner and its northeast corner, and every coordinate lies between -100000 and 100000. Decide whether these rectangles together cover one larger rectangle completely, with no overlap and no hole. Write true when they do, and write false when they do not.

392.zh: 读入两段仅含小写英文字母的文本 s 和 t。t 最长大约 500000，s 的长度不超过 100。判断 s 能否由 t 删掉若干字符（也可以一个都不删）得到，并且留下的字符先后次序保持不变。能得到就写出 true，否则写出 false。
392.en: Read two strings s and t that use only lowercase English letters. The longer string t may contain about 500000 characters, while s contains at most 100. Decide whether s can be obtained by deleting zero or more characters from t while keeping the surviving characters in their original order. Write true if that is possible, and write false if it is not.

393.zh: 读入一串整数，每个整数只用最低的 8 位表示一个字节。判断这些字节是否构成合法的编码。单字节以 0 开头，后面 7 位是码点。多字节字符总长 2 到 4 个字节：首字节先连续放若干个 1，个数等于总字节数，紧接着一个 0，其余字节都以 10 开头。没有用到的位全部属于码点。整段都必须符合上述格式才写出 true，否则写出 false。
393.en: Read a list of integers. Only the lowest 8 bits of each integer form one byte. Decide whether those bytes are a valid encoding. A one-byte symbol starts with 0, and the other 7 bits hold the code point. A longer symbol uses 2, 3, or 4 bytes: its first byte starts with that many 1 bits, then a 0, and every later byte starts with 10. All leftover bits belong to the code point. Write true only when the whole sequence matches these rules, otherwise write false.

394.zh: 读入一条编码过的文本。某个正整数 k 紧挨在一对括号前面时，括号中的片段要原样重复 k 遍。括号可以套括号，先展开内层。文本一定合法：没有多余空白，括号配对正确，字母部分不含数字，数字只表示重复次数。不会出现数字直接贴在字母旁边却没有括号的写法。写出完全展开后的文本。
394.en: Read one encoded piece of text. When a positive integer k sits immediately before a matching pair of brackets, the fragment inside is copied k times in place. Brackets may be nested, and inner fragments expand first. The text is always valid: there is no stray whitespace, brackets match, letters contain no digits, and digits serve only as copy counts. A count glued to a letter without brackets never appears. Write the fully expanded text.

395.zh: 读入只由小写英文字母组成的字符串 s，以及整数 k。s 的长度介于 1 与 10000 之间，k 介于 1 与 100000 之间。在 s 中寻找连续的一段，使得这段里面每种字母的出现量都要达到 k。在所有合格的段里取最长者，写出它的长度。
395.en: Read a string s made only of lowercase English letters and an integer k. The length of s is from 1 to 10000, and k is from 1 to 100000. Look for a contiguous segment of s in which every letter that shows up does so at least k times. Among all segments that qualify, write the length of the longest one.

396.zh: 读入长度为 n 的整数序列，n 在 1 到 105 之间，每个元素在负 100 到 100 之间。把序列顺时针挪动 k 格。得分等于每个下标乘以挪动后该位置上的数，再求和。k 可以是 0 到 n 减 1 的任意整数。写出其中最大的得分。答案保证能放进 32 位带符号整数。
396.en: Read an integer sequence of length n, with n from 1 to 105 and each element from -100 to 100. Shifting the sequence clockwise by k places changes which value sits at each index. The score adds index times the shifted value for every index. k may be any integer from 0 through n minus 1. Write the largest score. The answer always fits in a signed 32-bit integer.

397.zh: 读入正整数 n。当它是偶数时，用它的一半替换它。当它是奇数时，可以加上 1 再替换，也可以减去 1 再替换。重复上述替换，直到数值变成 1。写出能够达成这一目标的最少替换步数，步数本身也是整数。
397.en: Read a positive integer n. If the current value is even, replace it with half of that value. If the current value is odd, replace it with the value plus 1 or with the value minus 1. Keep replacing until the value equals 1. Write the fewest steps that can reach that goal.

399.zh: 读入若干条等式，每条都是一个字符串变量除以另一个字符串变量，商为一个正的浮点数。再读入若干条询问，每条询问同样是两个变量相除。利用等式求出每个询问的商。算得出就写出该浮点数，算不出就写出 -1.0。题目保证输入有效，除数不为 0，等式之间没有矛盾。
399.en: Read several equations. Each equation divides one string variable by another and gives a positive floating quotient. Then read several questions, each also dividing one variable by another. Use the equations to compute every question. Write the floating result when it can be computed, and write -1.0 when it cannot. The input is valid, no divisor is 0, and the equations never conflict.

400.zh: 把全体正整数按从小到大的顺序写成十进制，再把这些写法首尾连成一条没有尽头的数字流。读入位置 n，它至少是 1，至多是 2 的 31 次方减去 1。在这条数字流里从开头数到第 n 位，把那一位上的数字写出来。
400.en: Write every positive integer in decimal, in increasing order, and join those writings into one endless stream of digits. Read a position n that is at least 1 and at most 2 raised to the power 31, minus 1. Count from the start of the stream until you reach place n, and write the digit sitting there.

401.zh: 这块表用上方 4 盏灯表示小时，合法范围是 0 到 11，用下方 6 盏灯表示分钟，合法范围是 0 到 59。每盏灯是一个二进制位，低位靠右。读入非负整数 n，表示亮灯的数量。把所有可能读出的时刻写出来。小时不写前导零，所以 1:00 可以，01:00 不行。分钟固定两位，所以 10:02 可以，10:2 不行。时刻的先后次序可以随意。
401.en: This watch uses 4 lamps on top for the hour, which must stay inside 0 to 11, and 6 lamps below for the minute, which must stay inside 0 to 59. Each lamp is a binary bit with the low bit at the right. Read a non-negative integer n that counts how many lamps are on. Write every time the lamps might display. Hours omit a leading zero, so 1:00 is fine and 01:00 is not. Minutes always have two digits, so 10:02 is fine and 10:2 is not. The times may be listed in any order.

402.zh: 读入非负整数的十进制字符串 num，以及要删除的位数 k。字符串长度小于 10002，且不小于 k，开头也没有多余的零。删掉恰好 k 个数字，保留其余数字的相对次序，使得到的整数尽量小。写出这个结果时去掉前导零；若一个数字都不剩，写出 0。
402.en: Read a decimal string num for a non-negative integer, together with a count k of digits to delete. The string length is below 10002 and is at least k, and the string itself has no leading zero. Delete exactly k digits while keeping the order of the digits that stay, so the integer you form is as small as possible. Write that result with leading zeros removed. If no digit stays, write 0.

404.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。若某个结点是其父结点的左孩子，并且它自己没有任何孩子，就把它算作一枚左叶。把全部左叶上保存的数值加总，写出这个和。一枚左叶都没有时，写出 0。空树同样写出 0。
404.en: Read a binary tree. Treat a node as a left leaf when it is the left child of its parent and it has no child of its own. Add the numbers stored on all left leaves and write that total. When there is not even one left leaf, write 0.

405.zh: 读入一个整数，它保证能放进 32 位带符号的整数。把这个数写成十六进制字符串。遇到负数时按二进制补码来解释。字母 a 到 f 必须使用小写。不要在开头留下多余的零。当数值正好为零时，只写单个字符 0。不得调用库中直接做进制转换或格式化的函数。
405.en: Read an integer guaranteed to fit inside a signed 32-bit integer. Write the number as a hexadecimal string. For a negative number, interpret the bits with two's complement. Letters from a to f must be lowercase. Drop extra leading zeros, and if the number is exactly zero, write one character 0. Do not call a library function that converts or formats the number into hex directly.

409.zh: 读入一串英文字母，里面既有大写也有小写，总长度不超过 1010。大写与小写算作不同符号，因此 Aa 不能被看成回文。允许丢掉一部分字母，也可以重新排列，目标是拼出尽量长的回文。写出能够达到的最大长度。
409.en: Read a string of English letters that may mix capitals and small letters. Its length is at most 1010. Capitals and small letters count as different symbols, so Aa is not a palindrome. You may drop some letters and you may reorder the rest in order to form the longest palindrome possible. Write that maximum length.

410.zh: 读入由非负整数排成的序列，以及正整数 m。设序列长度为 n，则 n 在 1 到 1000 之间，m 在 1 到 50 与 n 两者中较小的那个数之间。把序列切成 m 段，每段都要非空，而且必须保持原先连续的次序。写出一个最小的数，使得存在一种切法，各段之和都不超过这个数。
410.en: Read a sequence of non-negative integers and a positive integer m. Let n be the length. Then n runs from 1 to 1000, and m runs from 1 to the smaller of 50 and n. Cut the sequence into m blocks. Every block must be non-empty and must keep a contiguous stretch of the original order. Write the smallest cap such that some cut keeps every block sum at or below that cap.

412.zh: 读入正整数 n。依次考察 1 到 n 的每个整数：能被 15 整除时写 FizzBuzz，否则能被 3 整除时写 Fizz，否则能被 5 整除时写 Buzz，剩下的情况写出该整数的十进制形式。一行一个，保持递增，不要夹杂其它说明文字。
412.en: Read a positive integer n. Walk through each integer from 1 to n. When the integer is divisible by 15, write FizzBuzz. Otherwise, when it is divisible by 3, write Fizz. Otherwise, when it is divisible by 5, write Buzz. In every remaining case, write the decimal form of that integer. Put one result on each line and keep the increasing order.

413.zh: 读入长度为 N、下标从 0 起的整数数组 A。一对下标 P、Q 若满足 0 小于等于 P，且 P 加 1 小于 Q，且 Q 小于 N，就圈出一段。这段至少要有三个数，并且相邻两数之差始终相等，才算等差片段。数一数这样的片段共有几个，把个数写出来。
413.en: Read an integer array A of length N whose indexes start at 0. A pair of indexes P and Q marks a segment when 0 is less than or equal to P, P plus 1 is less than Q, and Q is less than N. The segment counts only when it contains at least three numbers and the gap between every two neighbors stays constant. Count those segments and write how many there are.

414.zh: 读入一个不含空缺的整数数组。先忽略重复出现的值，再找出第三大的那个值并写出来。如果互不相同的值还不到三个，就改为写出最大的值。完成这项工作所用的时间应当与数组长度成正比。
414.en: Read an integer array that is not empty. Ignore values that appear more than once, then find the third biggest distinct value and write it. If there are fewer than three distinct values, write the biggest value instead. The running time should stay proportional to the length of the array.

416.zh: 读入一个非空数组，元素全是正整数。单个元素不超过 100，数组长度不超过 200。判断这些元素能否放进两个组，使两组的总和一样。每个元素必须而且只能进入一个组。能分成就写出 true，否则写出 false。
416.en: Read a non-empty array whose elements are all positive integers. Each element is at most 100, and the array length is at most 200. Decide whether the elements can go into two groups that have the same total. Each element must enter exactly one group. Write true when the groups can be formed, and write false otherwise.

417.zh: 读入 m 乘 n 的高度矩阵，元素都是非负整数，m 与 n 都小于 150。矩阵左边和上边挨着第一片海洋，右边和下边挨着第二片海洋。水只可以向上、下、左、右移动，而且只能进入高度相等或更矮的格子。找出所有格子，从这些格子流出的水能够抵达两片海洋。写出它们的坐标，次序不限。
417.en: Read an m by n height matrix of non-negative integers. Both m and n are less than 150. The first ocean touches the left side and the top side. The second ocean touches the right side and the bottom side. Water may move only up, down, left, or right, and only into a cell whose height is equal or lower. Find every cell whose water can reach both oceans. Write those coordinates in any order.

419.zh: 读入 m 行 n 列的棋盘，行数和列数都在 1 到 200 之间。字符 X 代表舰体，字符点代表空海。一艘船由同一行或同一列上连续的若干个 X 组成，因此船身是横条或竖条。两艘船至少隔着一格空海，彼此不会贴在一起，斜角也不算相连。写出船的数量。
419.en: Read a board with m rows and n columns, where both m and n lie between 1 and 200. The character X marks part of a ship and a dot marks open water. One ship is a contiguous run of one or more X cells along a single row or a single column, so each ship is a horizontal bar or a vertical bar. Two ships have at least one open cell between them and never touch, including diagonally. Write the number of ships.

421.zh: 读入一列非空整数。每个数都大于等于零，并且严格小于二的三十一次方。可以两次都选同一个下标。对任意一对下标，取出对应的两个整数做按位异或。在全部选法里找出结果最大的那一个，并把这个整数写出来。
421.en: Read a nonempty list of integers. Every value is at least zero and stays strictly below two raised to the thirty-first power. Choose any pair of indexes, including the case where both choices point at one index. Combine the two chosen values with bitwise exclusive or. Among all pairs, find the largest combined result and write that integer.
