423.zh: 读入一段只由英文小写字母组成的文本，长度严格小于 50000。这些字母来自若干个零到九的英文拼写，原来的先后次序已被打乱，而且这段文本保证能够还原成一组数字。找出原来的那些数字，按从小到大排好，连成一串数字字符写出来。
423.en: Read one text built only from lowercase English letters, with a length strictly under 50000. The letters come from the English spellings of digits from zero through nine, but their earlier order has been shuffled. The mixture is always legal and can be restored. Recover those digits, arrange them from smallest to largest, and write them as one digit string.

424.zh: 读入一个只含大写英文字母的字符串，以及一个非负整数 k。允许把任意位置上的字母改成别的大写字母，改动次数不能超过 k。改完之后，找出一段连续片段，使这段里面只出现同一种字母，并把这种片段能达到的最大长度写出来。字符串长度和 k 都不超过 10000。
424.en: Read a string of capital English letters together with a nonnegative integer k. Any character may be changed into a different capital letter, and the number of changes cannot pass k. After those changes, look for a contiguous slice whose characters are all one letter. Write the greatest length such a slice can reach. Both the string length and k stay at most 10000.

429.zh: 读入一棵多叉树。树的高度不超过 1000，结点总数落在 0 到 104 之间。从包含根的那一层开始，一层一层向下走，每一层都从左往右记下结点里保存的整数。按从上到下的顺序把每一层的整数序列写出来。树里没有任何结点时，写出空的结果。
429.en: Read an n-ary tree whose height is at most 1000 and whose node count lies between 0 and 104. Begin at the layer that holds the root, then move down one layer at a time. Inside a layer, record the integers stored in the nodes from the left side toward the right side. Write those layers from top to bottom. When the tree has no nodes, write an empty result.

433.zh: 读入起始基因、目标基因和一份基因库。每条基因都是长度为 8 的字符串，字符只从 A、C、G、T 中选取。一步只改动一个字符。起点本身视为合法，即使库里没有它；起点之后经过的每一条基因都必须出现在库中。起点和终点不相同。找出从起点走到终点所需的最少步数，做不到时写出 -1。
433.en: Read a start gene, an end gene, and a bank of genes. Every gene is a string of length 8 whose letters are chosen from A, C, G, and T. One step alters exactly one letter. The start gene counts as legal even when the bank omits it, yet every gene visited after the start must occur in the bank. The start and the end are different. Find the smallest step count that turns the start into the end, and write that count. If no route exists, write -1.

434.zh: 读入一条字符串，长度在 0 到 300 之间。字符只含大小写英文字母、数字，或者 !@#$%^&*()_+-=',.: 这一组符号，空白只会是普通空格。把连续的一截非空格字符算成一段。统计这样的段一共有多少个，并把这个个数写出来。
434.en: Read a string s whose length runs from 0 through 300. Each character is a lowercase or uppercase English letter, a digit, or one mark from the set !@#$%^&*()_+-=',.: and the only blank is an ordinary space. Treat every run of characters that are not spaces as one segment. Count how many such runs appear and write that count.

435.zh: 读入若干个区间。每个区间的右端点都严格大于左端点。两个区间如果只在端点相接，例如一个在 2 结束、另一个从 2 开始，仍然算作互不交叠。找出最少要删掉多少个区间，才能让留下来的区间彼此完全分开，并把这个数量写出来。
435.en: Read several closed ranges. The right endpoint of every range is strictly larger than its left endpoint. Two ranges that merely meet at a shared endpoint, such as one finishing at 2 and another opening at 2, still count as separate. Find the smallest count of ranges that must be deleted so the ranges that stay never cover a common interior point, and write that count.

436.zh: 读入一组区间。每个区间的右端点都严格大于左端点，而且各区间的左端点互不相同。对每一个区间，寻找另一个区间，使后者的左端点不小于前者的右端点；若有多个候选，保留左端点最小的那个。把该候选在原列表中的下标写出来，找不到时写下 -1。按输入顺序给出每个区间对应的下标。
436.en: Read a list of ranges. Every range has a right endpoint strictly larger than its left endpoint, and no two ranges share a left endpoint. For each range, search for another range whose left endpoint is at least as large as the first range's right endpoint. When several candidates qualify, keep the one whose left endpoint is smallest. Write that candidate's index in the original list, or write -1 when nothing qualifies. Produce one index for every input range, in the same order as the input.

437.zh: 读入一棵二叉树和一个目标和。树中结点个数在 0 到 1000 之间。一条路径必须从祖先走向子孙，只能沿父结点走到子结点，起点不必是根，终点也不必是叶子。找出有多少条路径上的结点值加起来正好等于目标和，并把这个条数写出来。
437.en: Read a binary tree and one target sum. The tree holds anywhere from 0 to 1000 nodes. A path must travel from a parent toward its children, may begin at any node, and may stop at any descendant. Count how many such paths have node values adding up exactly to the target, and write that count.

438.zh: 读入两个只含小写英文字母的字符串 s 和 p。p 不是空串，两个字符串的长度都不超过 20100。在 s 里找出所有连续片段，使片段里每种字母的出现次数都和 p 完全相同，字母的排列可以不一样。把这些片段的起始下标全部写出来，先后次序不限。
438.en: Read two strings, s and p, built only from lowercase letters. The string p is not empty, and neither string is longer than 20100. Search s for every contiguous slice that uses each letter the same number of times as p, even when the letters sit in another arrangement. Write every starting index of those slices. Any order of the indexes is acceptable.

441.zh: 读入一个非负整数 n，它落在 32 位有符号整数能够表示的范围里。要把 n 枚硬币摆成台阶，第 k 行必须恰好放上 k 枚。找出最多能摆满多少行，剩下的硬币如果不够再摆一整行，就不算进行数。把这个完整行数写出来。
441.en: Read a nonnegative integer n that fits inside a signed 32-bit integer. Arrange those n coins into rows so that row number k holds exactly k coins. Find how many rows can be filled before the coins that remain are too few for another whole row, and write that row count.

445.zh: 读入两条非空链表。每条链表表示一个非负整数，每个结点只存一位数字，最高位放在链表头部。除了数字 0 本身，两条链表都没有前导零。把这两个整数相加，再按同样的高位在前的方式写成一条链表。计算时不要打乱输入结点原来的先后次序。写出代表和的链头。
445.en: Read two nonempty linked lists. Each list stores one nonnegative integer, with a single digit in every node and the highest place at the head of the list. Neither integer has a leading zero unless that integer is zero. Add the two integers and write the sum as a linked list that again keeps the highest place at the head. Leave the original node order unchanged while computing. Write the head of the list that stores the sum.

447.zh: 读入平面上 n 个互不相同的点。n 不超过 500，每个坐标都在 -10000 到 10000 之间，两端都包含。若点 i 到点 j 的距离等于点 i 到点 k 的距离，有序三元组 (i, j, k) 就算一个。顺序不同要分开计数。统计这样的三元组一共有多少个，并把这个数量写出来。
447.en: Read n distinct points on a plane. The count n is no greater than 500, and every coordinate lies from -10000 through 10000, including both ends. An ordered triple of indexes (i, j, k) counts when the distance from point i to point j matches the distance from point i to point k. Different orders count separately. Count every such triple and write that total.

448.zh: 读入一个长度为 n 的整数数组。每个数值都落在 1 到 n 这个闭区间里。有些数值出现了两回，其余数值各自只出现一回。在 1 到 n 这整段整数中，找出所有没有在数组里露过面的数值，并把它们全部写出来。
448.en: Read an integer array whose length is n. Every stored value lies between 1 and n, inclusive. Some values show up two times and the other values show up a single time. Find every integer from 1 through n that is absent from the array, and write all of those missing integers.

451.zh: 读入一个字符串。先统计每一种字符各自出现了多少次，再按照出现次数从多到少把这些字符排成一条新的字符串。次数一样的字符，谁排在前面都可以。最后把这条新字符串写出来。若输入本身是空的，结果仍然是空字符串。
451.en: Read one string. Count how many times each character occurs, then build a new string by placing characters so that a higher count comes before a lower count. Characters that share one count may stand in any relative order. Write the rearranged string. When the input itself is empty, the written result stays empty as well.

453.zh: 读入非空的一列整数，这一列的个数记为 n。每一次操作都要挑出其中 n 减 1 个数，把挑中的每个数加上 1，余下的那个数保持原样。找出最少要操作多少次，才能让这一列里的每个数都变成同一个整数，并把这个次数写出来。
453.en: Read a nonempty integer array whose length is n. In one operation, choose any n minus 1 entries and add 1 to each chosen entry, leaving the remaining entry untouched. Find the fewest operations that make every entry the same integer, and write that operation count.

454.zh: 读入四个等长的整数数组 A、B、C、D。公共长度 N 从 0 到 500。每个整数都落在负的二的二十八次方到二的二十八次方减一之间。统计有多少个下标四元组，使四个数组里对应位置的数加起来等于 0。这个组数不会超过二的三十一次方减一。把组数写出来。
454.en: Read four integer arrays A, B, C, and D that share one common length N, where N runs from 0 through 500. Every stored integer lies between negative two to the twenty-eighth power and one less than two to the twenty-eighth power. Count the index tuples (i, j, k, l) for which the sum of the value from A at i, from B at j, from C at k, and from D at l equals zero. That count fits in a signed 32-bit integer and is at most one less than two to the thirty-first power. Write the count.

455.zh: 读入每个孩子的胃口和每块饼干的尺寸，胃口都是正数。每个孩子最多拿一块饼干，每块饼干最多分给一个孩子。只有饼干尺寸不小于这个孩子的胃口时，孩子才算被满足。找出最多能同时满足多少个孩子，并把这个人数写出来。
455.en: Read a positive appetite for every child and a size for every cookie. Each child may receive no more than one cookie, and each cookie may go to no more than one child. A child counts as satisfied only when the cookie handed over is at least as large as that child's appetite. Find the largest number of children that can be satisfied at the same time, and write that number.

456.zh: 读入 n 个整数排成的序列，n 小于 15000。如果存在三个下标 i、j、k，满足 i 在 j 之前、j 在 k 之前，而且第 i 个数小于第 k 个数、第 k 个数又小于第 j 个数，就说明序列里出现了 132 形态。判断是否存在这样的三个下标。存在就写出真，不存在就写出假。
456.en: Read a sequence of n integers where n is less than 15000. A 132 shape means three indexes i, j, and k, with i earlier than j and j earlier than k, while the value at i is smaller than the value at k and the value at k is smaller than the value at j. Decide whether any such triple of indexes exists. Write true when it does and false when it does not.

457.zh: 读入一个环形整数数组，长度在 1 到 5000 之间。每个元素都在 -1000 到 1000 之间，而且都不为 0。正数表示顺着下标增大的方向前进相应步数，负数表示反向后退同样的步数。越过末尾就回到开头，越过开头就落到末尾。判断是否存在循环：从某个下标出发又回到该下标，步数大于 1，并且全程只朝一个方向移动。存在写出真，否则写出假。
457.en: Read a circular array whose length runs from 1 through 5000. Every entry is a nonzero integer from -1000 through 1000. A positive entry moves that many steps toward larger indexes, and a negative entry moves backward by its absolute value. Passing the last index wraps to the first, and passing the first wraps to the last. Decide whether some cycle begins and finishes on one index, contains more than one step, and never mixes the two directions. Write true when such a cycle exists and false otherwise.

458.zh: 读入桶数、死亡等待分钟和总测试分钟。桶数在 1 到 1000 之间，两段时间都在 1 到 100 之间，而且死亡等待不超过总测试时间。这些桶里恰好有一桶是毒药，其余都是水，外观完全一样。可以让一只猪同时喝任意多桶，喝本身不花时间；喝完必须空等死亡分钟，这段时间不能再喂。等到点后，喝过毒药的猪会死，其余的猪还活着。在总时间用完之前，找出确认哪一桶有毒所需的最少猪数，并把这个猪数写出来。
458.en: Read a bucket count, a death wait in minutes, and a total testing time in minutes. The bucket count runs from 1 through 1000, both times run from 1 through 100, and the death wait is at most the total testing time. Exactly one bucket holds poison and the rest hold water, and all buckets look the same. A pig may drink from any number of buckets at once, and drinking takes no time. Afterward you must wait out the death wait before feeding again. When that wait ends, every pig that drank poison dies and every other pig stays alive. Find the smallest number of pigs that can identify the poisoned bucket before testing time runs out, and write that number.

460.zh: 读入容量上限。容量、键和值都不超过 104，随后最多有 100000 次调用。维护一个按使用次数淘汰的缓存。get 在键存在时写出对应的值，否则写出 -1。put 在键已经存在时改写它的值，不存在时放入新的一对；如果当前已经放满，先丢掉使用次数最少的那一项，次数并列时丢掉最久没有被碰到的那一项。某一项的使用次数等于放入之后 get 与 put 再次命中它的次数，丢掉之后次数回到 0。
460.en: Read a capacity limit. The capacity, every key, and every value are at most 104, and there will be at most 100000 calls. Keep a cache that drops entries according to how often they are used. On get, write the stored value when the key is present and write -1 when it is absent. On put, overwrite the value when the key is already stored, or insert the new pair when it is not. If the cache is already full, drop the entry with the smallest use count before the insert; when several entries share that count, drop the one touched longest ago. An entry's use count is the number of later get and put calls that name it, and the count returns to 0 after the entry is dropped.

461.zh: 读入整数 x 与整数 y。二者都大于等于 0，并且严格小于二的三十一次方。先把它们各自展开成二进制，再逐位对照，数一数有多少个位上的 0 和 1 对不上。把这个对不上的位数写出来，该位数称为汉明距离。
461.en: Read two integers x and y. Both are at least 0 and strictly below two to the thirty-first power. Compare their binary writings one bit at a time. Count the bit positions where the two writings differ, and write that count. This count is the Hamming distance between the pair.

462.zh: 读入一个整数数组，长度在 1 到 100000 之间，每个元素都在负的 10^9 到 10^9 之间。一次操作只能把某一个元素加上 1，或者从某一个元素减去 1。找出让全部元素变成同一个值所需的最少操作次数，并把这个次数写出来。
462.en: Read an integer array whose length is between 1 and 100000. Every element lies between negative 10^9 and 10^9. One operation adds 1 to a single element or subtracts 1 from a single element. Find the fewest operations that bring every element to one common value, and write that operation count.

463.zh: 读入一个只含 0 和 1 的矩形网格，宽度和高度各自不超过 100。数字 1 代表陆地，数字 0 代表水。格子只沿上下左右的整条边相邻，斜角碰上不算连在一起。网格外面一圈都是水，里面恰好有一块陆地，这块陆地内部也没有被整块陆地围住的水。每一格都是边长等于 1 的方块。找出这块陆地的周长，并把这个长度写出来。
463.en: Read a rectangular grid of zeros and ones. Its width and its height are each at most 100. A one stands for land and a zero stands for water. Cells join only along a full edge, so a diagonal touch does not connect them. Water borders the whole grid, exactly one land mass is present, and no pool of water sits fully inside that land. Each cell is a square whose side has length 1. Find the perimeter of that land mass and write it.

470.zh: 系统里已经有一个函数 rand7，每次调用都在 1 到 7 之间以相同机会取出一个整数。请写出另一个函数 rand10，让它在 1 到 10 之间以相同机会取出一个整数。实现时不要使用系统自带的 Math.random。每一组测试都会给出一个正整数 n，表示接下来会调用 rand10 一共 n 次。
470.en: A function named rand7 is already supplied. Each call returns one integer chosen with equal chance from 1 through 7. Write another function named rand10 that returns one integer chosen with equal chance from 1 through 10. Do not call the system routine Math.random. Each test supplies a positive integer n, which is how many times rand10 will be invoked.

473.zh: 读入若干根火柴的长度。火柴根数在 1 到 15 之间，每根长度在 0 到 109 之间。任何一根都不许折断，但可以把多根首尾相接，而且每一根都要恰好使用一次。判断这些火柴能不能拼成一个正方形。能拼成就写出真，不能就写出假。
473.en: Read the lengths of several matchsticks. The number of sticks runs from 1 through 15, and each length runs from 0 through 109. Breaking a stick is forbidden, but sticks may be joined end to end, and every stick must be used once. Decide whether those sticks can form one square. Write true when they can and false when they cannot.

474.zh: 读入两个上限 m 和 n，以及若干条只含字符 0 和 1 的字符串。m 和 n 都不超过 100，字符串的条数不超过 600。手里最多有 m 个 0 和 n 个 1，每一个数字最多只能用一次。找出最多能完整拼出多少条给定的字符串，并把这个条数写出来。
474.en: Read two limits m and n, plus a list of strings that contain only the characters 0 and 1. Both m and n are at most 100, and the list holds at most 600 strings. You may spend at most m zeros and n ones, and each digit may be spent only once. Find the largest count of those strings that can be spelled in full, and write that count.

475.zh: 房屋和供暖设备都落在同一条水平直线上。读入每一间房屋的坐标，以及每一台设备的坐标。坐标全是非负整数，而且任何一个坐标都不超过 10^9。房屋的台数与设备的台数各自最多 25000，也允许是零。全部设备只能共用一个加热半径。房屋落在半径里面，或者正好卡在边界上，都算已经供暖。找出能让每一间房屋都得到供暖的最小半径，并把这个整数写出来。没有房屋时，半径写成 0。
475.en: Houses and heaters stand on one shared horizontal line. Read every house coordinate and every heater coordinate. Each coordinate is a non-negative integer no larger than 10^9. The house count and the heater count are each at most 25000, and either count may be zero. Every heater must use one common warm radius. A house is warmed when it lies inside that radius or sits exactly on the boundary. Find the smallest radius that warms every house, and write that integer. When no house is present, write 0.

476.zh: 读入一个正整数，它保证落在 32 位有符号整数能够表示的范围里。先把它写成二进制，最前面不要补零。然后把每一位的 0 换成 1，把每一位的 1 换成 0。再把翻转后的二进制还原成十进制整数，并把这个整数写出来。不要把符号位单独拿出来处理，也不要在最高位前面多塞一个 0 再一起翻转。输入本身不会是负数，也不会是零。
476.en: Read one positive integer that fits inside a signed 32 bit integer. Write it in binary and do not pad any zero in front. Then change every 0 bit into a 1 bit and every 1 bit into a 0 bit. Turn the flipped binary back into a decimal integer and write that integer. Do not handle a sign bit on its own, and do not insert an extra leading 0 before the flip. The input itself is never negative and never zero.

477.zh: 读入一列整数。每个整数都在 0 与 10^9 之间，列长最多 10000。把两个整数写成对齐的二进制后，数一数有多少个位置上的数字彼此不一样，这个个数就是它们的位差。对所有下标不同的配对，各算一次位差，再把这些位差全部相加，写出总和。同一对不要算两次，一个整数也不要和自己配对。列里如果不足两个整数，总和就是 0。
477.en: Read a list of integers. Every integer is between 0 and 10^9 inclusive, and the list holds at most 10000 values. After two integers are written as aligned binary, count the slots whose digits disagree. That count is their bit difference. For every pair of distinct indexes, add the bit difference once, then write the total. Do not add the same pair twice, and do not pair an integer with itself. If fewer than two integers are present, the total is 0.

478.zh: 构造对象时读入三个浮点数：圆心的横坐标、圆心的纵坐标，以及圆的半径。请写出函数 randPoint。每次调用都要在圆盘内部均匀抽出一个点，圆盘各处被抽到的机会相同。正好落在圆周上的点也算在圆内，不要把它丢掉。函数返回长度为 2 的数组，先放随机点的横坐标，再放纵坐标，两个数仍然是浮点数。多次调用之间，圆心和半径保持不变。
478.en: When the object is constructed, read three floating point numbers: the center horizontal coordinate, the center vertical coordinate, and the radius. Write a function called randPoint. Each call must draw one point inside the disk so that every place in the disk is equally likely. A point that lands exactly on the rim still counts as inside, so keep it. Return an array of length 2, with the random horizontal coordinate first and the vertical coordinate second, both still floating point numbers. The center and the radius stay fixed across calls.

480.zh: 读入一列整数，再读入窗口宽度 k。对非空数列，k 始终合法，并且小于数列长度。窗口里一直放着连续的 k 个数，从左端贴住开始，每次只向右挪一格，直到右边贴住末尾。每个窗口先按从小到大看：个数是奇数时，中位值取正中那一个；个数是偶数时，中位值取正中两个数的算术平均，结果可以带小数。按窗口出现的次序把每个中位值写进数组。
480.en: Read a list of integers and a window width k. For a non-empty list, k is always valid and is smaller than the list length. The window always holds k adjacent values. It begins flush with the left end and shifts one step right each time until its right edge is flush with the far end. For each window, look at the values from small to large. If the count is odd, the middle marker is the single central value. If the count is even, the middle marker is the arithmetic mean of the two central values, and that mean may be fractional. Write the markers in the order the windows appear.

483.zh: 读入一个用十进制字符串表示的整数 n。n 至少是 3，至多是 10^18，字符串本身合法，而且没有前导零。如果某个整数进制 k 不小于 2，并且 n 写成该进制之后每一位都是 1，就把 k 称作 n 的好进制。找出最小的那个好进制，再把它写成没有前导零的十进制字符串。写出来的是进制 k，不是那一串 1。相同条件下只保留最小的 k。
483.en: Read an integer n written as a decimal string. n is at least 3 and at most 10^18. The string is valid and contains no leading zero. An integer base k of 2 or more is called good for n when every digit of n in that base is 1. Find the smallest good base and write it as a decimal string with no leading zero. The written text is the base k, not the row of ones. When several bases qualify, keep only the smallest k.

485.zh: 读入一个数组，里面只会出现数字 0 和数字 1。数组长度是正整数，并且不超过 10000。从左到右看，把紧挨着、全是 1、中间不夹 0 的一段叫做一段连续。找出最长那一段里 1 的个数，并把这个个数写出来。如果整个数组都没有 1，答案写成 0。单独出现的一个 1 也算长度是 1 的一段。被 0 隔开的两段不能拼在一起比较。
485.en: Read an array that holds only the digits 0 and 1. Its length is a positive integer and is at most 10000. Scanning from left to right, a run is a stretch of adjacent entries that are all 1 and that contain no 0 inside. Find how many 1 digits sit in the longest run, and write that count. If the array contains no 1 at all, write 0. One isolated 1 still counts as a run whose length is 1. Two runs split by a 0 must not be joined before the comparison.

488.zh: 读入两串彩球。board 是桌面上的那一排，hand 是手里的彩球。颜色只有 R、Y、B、G、W。board 的长度从 1 到 16，hand 的长度从 1 到 5。开局时这一排里没有连续三颗或更多同色球。每一回合从手里取一颗，插进任意两颗之间，或者接到某一端。一旦出现连续至少三颗同色，就把这一段整段消掉；如果因此又形成新的同色段，就继续消，直到不能再消。求出清空桌面最少要用掉几颗手球并写出来；做不到就写 -1。
488.en: Read two strings of colored balls. board is the row on the table, and hand is what you hold. The only colors are R, Y, B, G, and W. The length of board runs from 1 to 16, and the length of hand runs from 1 to 5. At the start, the row has no stretch of three or more balls that share one color. Each turn, take one ball from hand and insert it between two balls or at either end. Whenever three or more adjacent balls share a color, erase that whole stretch. If the erasure creates another such stretch, keep erasing until no such stretch remains. Write the fewest hand balls needed to empty the table. If that cannot be done, write -1.

491.zh: 读入一列整数。列长最多 15，每个整数都在 -100 到 100 之间，允许重复。从中按原来的相对次序挑选若干个数，中间可以跳过，组成一条子序列。子序列长度至少为 2，并且从左到右不许下降，相邻两数相等也算符合。找出所有数值序列互不相同的这种子序列，并把它们全部写出来。几种不同挑法如果得到同一条数值序列，只保留一份。顺序必须来自原列，不能重排。
491.en: Read a list of integers. The length is at most 15, every integer lies from -100 through 100, and repeats are allowed. Pick several values while keeping their original relative order. Skipping values is allowed. Each picked sequence must contain at least 2 values and must never fall from left to right. Equal neighbors still qualify. Find every such sequence whose values differ from the others, and write them all. If several picks produce the same values in the same order, keep one copy. The order must come from the original list and must not be rearranged.

492.zh: 读入一个矩形的目标面积，它是 1 到 10000000 之间的整数。找出整数长 L 和整数宽 W，使两者相乘正好等于这块面积。同时要求 L 不小于 W，而且 L 减去 W 的差尽量小。如果有多组差一样小，仍然只保留 L 不小于 W 的那一组。按先长后宽的顺序把 L 和 W 写出来。不要把面积本身写进答案，也不要把长和宽对调。两边都必须是正整数。
492.en: Read a target area for a rectangle. The area is an integer from 1 through 10000000. Find an integer length L and an integer width W whose product equals that area. L must be at least W, and L minus W must be as small as possible. If several pairs share that smallest gap, still keep a pair where L is at least W. Write L and then W, length before width. Do not write the area itself, and do not swap the two sides. Both sides must be positive integers.

493.zh: 读入一列整数，长度不超过 50000。每个整数都落在 32 位整数能够表示的范围里。当下标 i 严格小于下标 j，而且下标 i 上的数严格大于下标 j 上的数的两倍时，把这一对记作一个翻转对。统计这样的翻转对一共有多少，并把数量写出来。每一对下标只计一次。两数相等不能满足大于两倍，同一个下标也不能和自己组成一对。没有任何一对时，数量写成 0。
493.en: Read a list of integers whose length is at most 50000. Every integer fits in a 32 bit integer. When index i is strictly smaller than index j, and the value at i is strictly larger than twice the value at j, record that index pair as one flip pair. Count how many flip pairs exist and write the count. Count each index pair only once. Equal values fail the twice test, and one index cannot form a pair with itself. When no pair exists, write 0.

494.zh: 读入一列非负整数和一个目标和 S。这一列不是空的，长度不超过 20，各数相加的和不超过 1000。每个整数前面只能放加号或者减号，两种都要纳入考虑。把加上符号之后的所有数求和，统计有多少种放法能让结果正好等于 S，并把这个方法数写出来。答案保证放得进 32 位整数。全是加号和全是减号也要算进去。整数本身的先后不能调动，能改的只有符号。
494.en: Read a non-empty list of non-negative integers and a target sum S. The list length is at most 20, and the integers add up to at most 1000. In front of each integer, place either a plus or a minus. Both choices must be considered. Add the signed integers and count how many placements make the result equal S, then write that count. The count fits in a 32 bit integer. Placements that use only plus signs, or only minus signs, still count. The integers stay in place, and only the signs may change.

495.zh: 读入一串攻击时刻 timeSeries，以及中毒持续秒数 duration。时刻从左到右不会变早，允许相等。时刻个数从 1 到 10000。每个时刻和 duration 都在 0 到 10000000 之间。时刻 t 的攻击让闭区间从 t 到 t 加 duration 再减 1 的每一秒都中毒。如果新的攻击到来时旧区间还没结束，就从新时刻重新计算同样长度的区间。把所有中毒秒合并后，写出不同秒数的总和。重叠的秒只算一次。
495.en: Read attack times in timeSeries and a poison duration in seconds. From left to right the times never get earlier, and equal times are allowed. The count of times runs from 1 to 10000. Each time and the duration lie between 0 and 10000000 inclusive. An attack at second t poisons every second of the closed span from t through t plus duration minus 1. If a new attack arrives before the old span has ended, restart a span of the same length at the new time. Merge every poisoned second and write how many distinct seconds that union covers. Count an overlapping second once.

496.zh: 读入两个没有重复整数的数组 nums1 和 nums2。nums1 中的每个整数都会在 nums2 里出现。两个数组的长度各自不超过 1000。对 nums1 里的每个整数，先在 nums2 中找到它所在的位置，再从这个位置向右寻找第一个严格更大的整数。找到了就写下那个整数，向右一直到末尾都没有就写下 -1。答案顺序跟 nums1 一致。左边的数不算，相等的数也不算更大。
496.en: Read two arrays of integers with no repeats, nums1 and nums2. Every integer in nums1 also appears in nums2. Each array has length at most 1000. For each integer in nums1, find where it sits in nums2, then look strictly to the right of that seat for the first integer that is strictly larger. Write that larger integer when one exists. Write -1 when nothing to the right is larger. Keep the answers in the same order as nums1. Integers to the left do not qualify, and an equal integer is not larger.

497.zh: 读入若干互不重叠的矩形，每条边都与坐标轴平行。第 i 个矩形记为 [x1, y1, x2, y2]，左下角是 x1、y1，右上角是 x2、y2。矩形个数从 1 到 100，每条边的长度都不超过 2000。边上的整数坐标点也算被覆盖。请写出函数 pick。每次调用都在全部被覆盖的整数点里均匀抽取一个，每个整数点机会相同，并以 [p_x, p_y] 返回。pick 最多调用 10000 次。不要按矩形个数平均，而要按点来平均。
497.en: Read rectangles that do not overlap and whose edges stay parallel to the axes. Rectangle i is [x1, y1, x2, y2], with the lower left corner at x1, y1 and the upper right corner at x2, y2. The rectangle count runs from 1 to 100, and each edge is at most 2000 long. Integer points on a border count as covered. Write a function pick. Each call draws one covered integer point so that every such point is equally likely, and returns it as [p_x, p_y]. pick is called at most 10000 times. Make the draw fair across points, not fair across rectangles.

498.zh: 读入一个 M 行 N 列的矩阵，元素总数不超过 10000。请按对角线次序把每个元素写出来，每个元素只写一次。同一条对角线上的格子，行号与列号之和相同。和为偶数时，从该对角线上行号最大的格子开始，朝着行号变小的方向收集；和为奇数时，从行号最小的格子开始，朝着行号变大的方向收集。从和为 0 开始，和每次加 1，直到所有格子都写完。行号和列号都从 0 起算。
498.en: Read a matrix of M rows and N columns. The number of entries is at most 10000. Write every entry in diagonal order, once each. Cells on one diagonal share one sum of row index plus column index. When the sum is even, start at the cell on that diagonal with the largest row index and move toward smaller row indexes. When the sum is odd, start at the cell with the smallest row index and move toward larger row indexes. Begin with sum 0 and add 1 each time until every cell is written. Row and column indexes start at 0.

500.zh: 读入若干单词，每个单词只含英文字母。美式键盘有三行，第一行是 qwertyuiop，第二行是 asdfghjkl，第三行是 zxcvbnm。大写和小写看成同一个字母。找出只用同一行里的字母就能打出的单词，并按输入里的先后顺序写出来。一个字母可以在同一个单词里出现多次。用到两行或者三行的单词不要留下。如果一个单词都不符合，就写出空列表。不要改写单词里的大小写。
500.en: Read words that contain only English letters. An American keyboard has three rows. The first row is qwertyuiop, the second row is asdfghjkl, and the third row is zxcvbnm. Treat uppercase and lowercase as the same letter. Find every word whose letters all sit on a single keyboard row, and write those words in their input order. A letter may show up more than once inside one word. Drop any word that needs two rows or three rows. If no word qualifies, write an empty list. Do not change the letter case stored in a word.

503.zh: 读入一个循环整数数组。最后一个元素的后一个位置就是数组的第一个元素。对每一个元素，从它后面一格开始，顺着这个环向前找第一个严格更大的数。找到了就把那个数写下来；绕回自己之前仍然没有更大的数，就写 -1。答案长度与原数组相同，第 i 个答案对应第 i 个元素。元素自己不算更大，相等也不算更大。寻找时必须沿环的前进方向，不能反向。
503.en: Read a circular list of integers. After the final entry, the walk continues at the opening entry. For every element, start one seat ahead of it and walk forward around the circle until you meet the first strictly larger value. Write that value when it exists. Write -1 when a walk that returns to the start finds nothing larger. The answer has the same length as the input, and answer i belongs to element i. An element is not larger than itself, and an equal value is not larger. Walk only forward around the circle, never backward.

504.zh: 读入一个整数 num，范围从 -10000000 到 10000000。把它换算成七进制，再写成字符串。正数和零不要加正号。负数先对绝对值做七进制换算，然后在字符串最前面放一个减号。除了这个减号，字符串里只能有数字字符。不要继续留在十进制，也不要漏掉最高位。零的结果写成单个字符 0。换算必须按七进制的位权，而不是在十进制数字上做别的替换。
504.en: Read an integer num from -10000000 through 10000000. Convert it into base 7 and write a string. Do not add a plus sign when the value is positive or zero. When the value is negative, convert the absolute value into base 7 and put a minus sign at the front of the string. Aside from that minus sign, the string may hold only digit characters. Do not leave the value in base 10, and do not drop the highest digit. Write zero as the single character 0. Use base 7 place values during the conversion.

506.zh: 读入 n 名运动员的得分。n 从 1 到 10000。每个得分都是 0 到 1000000 之间的整数，而且彼此都不相同。得分最高者是第 1 名，次高者是第 2 名，后面依次类推。第 1 名写成 Gold Medal，第 2 名写成 Silver Medal，第 3 名写成 Bronze Medal。第 4 名直到第 n 名，写成名次的十进制数字字符串。答案长度是 n，第 i 项对应第 i 名运动员。不要用中文奖牌名替换这三串英文。
506.en: Read the scores of n athletes. n runs from 1 to 10000. Each score is an integer from 0 to 1000000, and all scores differ. The highest score is place 1, the next highest is place 2, and later places follow in that order. Write Gold Medal for place 1, Silver Medal for place 2, and Bronze Medal for place 3. From place 4 through place n, write the place number as a decimal string. The answer has length n, and entry i belongs to athlete i. Keep those three English labels, and do not replace them with translated medal names.

507.zh: 读入一个整数 n，判断它是不是完美数，并写出 true 或 false。完美数必须是正整数，而且恰好等于把自己除掉之后所有正因子相加的和。以 28 为例，它的正因子有 1、2、4、7、14 和 28，去掉 28 之后剩下的和仍是 28，所以 28 符合。1 的正因子只有自己，去掉以后和是 0，因此 1 不符合。零和负数也都不符合。因子必须整除，不能把不能整除的数算进去。
507.en: Read an integer n and decide whether it is perfect, then write true or false. A perfect number must be positive, and it must equal the sum of all positive divisors after the number itself is removed. Take 28 as an example. Its positive divisors are 1, 2, 4, 7, 14, and 28. Removing 28 leaves a sum of 28, so 28 qualifies. The only positive divisor of 1 is 1, so removing it leaves 0 and 1 does not qualify. Zero and negative values do not qualify either. A divisor must divide evenly.

508.zh: 读入一棵二叉树的根。某个结点的子树和，等于以它为根的那一部分里全部分点的值相加，包括它自己。缺失的孩子加进去的是 0。先统计每一种子树和出现过几次，再把出现次数最高的那些和找出来写掉。如果有多个和并列第一，就全部写出来，次序不限。不要只写其中的一个。题目保证每个子树和都能放进 32 位有符号整数。空孩子不单独成为一项。
508.en: Read the root of a binary tree. The subtree total of a node equals the sum of every node value in the part rooted there, counting that node's own value as well. A missing child contributes 0. Count how many times each subtree total appears, then find the totals that appear most often and write them. If several totals share the highest count, write every one of them, in any order. Do not keep only one of a tie. Every subtree total fits in a signed 32 bit integer. A missing child is not an extra item.

509.zh: 读入一个整数 N，范围从 0 到 30。把一列数记作 F。规定 F(0) 等于 0，F(1) 等于 1。当 N 大于 1 时，F(N) 等于前面相邻两项之和，也就是 F(N 减 1) 加上 F(N 减 2)。按照这个规定算出下标 N 对应的那一项，并把这一项写出来。不要把从 0 到 N 的整列都打出来。N 等于 0 或 1 时，直接写出上面规定的初值。下标从 0 开始，不是从 1 开始。
509.en: Read an integer N from 0 through 30. Call the sequence F. Set F(0) equal to 0 and F(1) equal to 1. When N is greater than 1, F(N) equals the sum of the two terms just before it, namely F(N minus 1) plus F(N minus 2). Compute the single term at index N under that rule and write it. Do not print every term from 0 through N. When N is 0 or 1, write the starting value assigned above. Indexes begin at 0, not at 1.

513.zh: 读入一棵非空二叉树，根一定存在。同一层的结点从左往右排，层本身从上往下排。找出深度最大的那一层，再取这一层最左边那个结点的值，并把该值写出来。根自己单独占最上面一层。整棵树只有根的时候，答案就是根上的值。不要改成最右边的结点，也不要用位置更高的叶子去代替最底下一层的最左结点。比较的是层的深度，不是结点值的大小。
513.en: Read a binary tree that is not empty, so a root exists. Nodes on one level run from left to right, and the levels themselves run from top to bottom. Find the level whose depth is greatest, then take the value of the leftmost node on that level and write it. The root alone fills the top level. When the tree contains only the root, the answer is the value stored at the root. Do not switch to the rightmost node, and do not replace the leftmost node of the bottom level with a leaf that sits higher. Compare depth, not node values.

515.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。深度相同的结点算作同一层，层的次序从上到下。对每一层，在该层的结点值里面找出最大的一个，再按从上到下的层序把这些最大值依次写出来。根所在的层是第一层。某一层只有一个结点时，这个结点的值就是该层的结果。不同层的结点不要放在一起比大小。如果树里一个结点都没有，就写出空的结果。每一层都要有自己的一项，不能把整棵树只留一个最大值。
515.en: Read a binary tree. Nodes that share one depth form one level, and levels are ordered from top to bottom. On every level, choose the biggest node value among the nodes there, then write those chosen values following the levels downward. The level that contains the root is the first level. When a level holds only one node, that node value is the result for the level. Do not rank nodes that sit on different levels against each other. If the tree contains no node, write an empty result. Keep one entry per level instead of one biggest value for the whole tree.

518.zh: 读入若干互不相同的硬币面额，再读入目标金额 amount。面额个数从 1 到 300，每个面额从 1 到 5000，amount 从 0 到 5000。每种面额都可以拿任意多枚。统计有多少种组合能使所选面额加起来正好等于 amount，并把组合数写出来。组合只关心每种面额用了几枚，不关心拿取的先后。凑不出来就写 0。答案能放进 32 位有符号整数。amount 为 0 时，一枚都不拿也算一种组合。
518.en: Read distinct coin denominations and a target amount. The denomination count runs from 1 to 300, each denomination runs from 1 to 5000, and amount runs from 0 to 5000. You may take as many coins as you want of each denomination. Count the combinations whose chosen denominations add up to exactly amount, and write that count. A combination records only how many coins of each denomination are used, not the sequence of picking them. Write 0 when no combination reaches the amount. The count fits in a signed 32 bit integer. When amount is 0, using no coins counts as one combination.

519.zh: 准备一个 m 行 n 列的矩阵，一开始每个格子都是 0。m 和 n 都从 1 到 10000。请实现三个操作。构造时读入 m 和 n。flip 在仍然等于 0 的格子中均匀随机选一个，把它改成 1，并返回这个格子的行下标和列下标，下标从 0 计。每次调用 flip 时，至少还剩一个 0。reset 把所有格子重新改回 0。flip 与 reset 加在一起最多调用 1000 次。每个当前为 0 的格子被选中的概率必须相同。
519.en: Prepare a matrix with m rows and n columns. Every cell starts as 0. Both m and n run from 1 to 10000. Implement three operations. Construction reads m and n. flip chooses one cell that is still 0, with equal chance among those cells, changes it to 1, and returns that cell row index and column index, counting from 0. Each flip call still has at least one 0 left. reset changes every cell back to 0. Calls to flip and reset together happen at most 1000 times. Every cell that is currently 0 must share the same chance of being chosen.

520.zh: 读入一个只含英文字母的单词 word，长度从 1 到 100。判断它的大写形式是否属于下面三种，并写出 true 或 false。第一种：每个字母都是大写。第二种：每个字母都是小写。第三种：只有第一个字母是大写，后面每一个字母都是小写。单词只有一个字母而且这个字母是大写时，也算符合第三种。这三种以外的混用都算不符合。不要忽略中间某个字母的大小写。比较时按字符本身的大小写，不按单词含义。
520.en: Read a word that contains only English letters. Its length runs from 1 to 100. Decide whether its capital letters match one of three patterns, and write true or false. In the first pattern, every letter is uppercase. In the second pattern, every letter is lowercase. In the third pattern, only the first letter is uppercase and every later letter is lowercase. A word of one letter that is uppercase also matches the third pattern. Any other mixture fails. Do not ignore the case of a letter in the middle. Judge the characters themselves, not the meaning of the word.

523.zh: 读入一列非负整数，再读入一个正整数作为除数。要判断这列数里有没有一段连续片段，片段至少盖住两个位置，而且片段里的数相加之后能被该除数整除。找到就写出 true，找不到就写出 false。数值零也算任意除数的倍数。列的长度在 1 到 105 之间，每一项在 0 到 109 之间，各项之和不超过 231 减 1，除数本身在 1 到 231 减 1 之间。
523.en: Read a row of non-negative integers and one positive divisor. Decide whether the row contains a contiguous block that covers at least two positions and whose values add up to a multiple of that divisor. Write true when such a block exists, and write false when none exists. The number zero counts as a multiple of every divisor. The row length runs from 1 to 105, each item runs from 0 to 109, the sum of every item is at most 231 minus 1, and the divisor runs from 1 to 231 minus 1.

524.zh: 读入一条原文，再读入若干候选词。原文和候选词都只含小写英文字母。某个候选词算作可达，是指只从原文中删掉零个或多个字母、不改剩余字母的相对次序，就能得到它。在所有可达的候选词里找出最长的一条并写出来。若有多条同样长，写出字典顺序靠前的那条。一条都达不到就写空串。候选词的条数不超过 1000，原文以及每条候选词的字母数也不超过 1000。
524.en: Read one source text and a list of candidate words. Every character is a lowercase English letter. A candidate counts as reachable when deleting zero or more letters from the source, without changing the relative order of what remains, produces that candidate. Among reachable candidates, find the longest one and write it. If several share that length, write the one that comes first in dictionary order. If none is reachable, write an empty result. The list holds at most 1000 candidates, and neither the source nor any candidate is longer than 1000 letters.

525.zh: 读入一条只由数字 0 和 1 组成的序列。从中选取一段连续位置，使这一段里 0 出现的次数与 1 出现的次数完全相同，并且在所有满足该平衡的段落中它最长。把这段所含元素的个数写成整数。如果整条序列里不存在次数相同的段落，就写出 0。序列长度在 1 到 105 之间，每个位置只能取 0 或 1。
525.en: Read a sequence made only of the digits 0 and 1. Choose a contiguous stretch in which the digit 0 occurs just as often as the digit 1, and choose the stretch with the greatest length among every balanced stretch. Write how many entries that stretch contains. If the whole sequence has no balanced stretch, write 0. The sequence length runs from 1 to 105, and every entry is either 0 or 1.

526.zh: 读入一个正整数 N，它最大是 15。把从 1 到 N 的每个整数各用一次，排成一列，位置同样从 1 数到 N。若对每个位置而言，放在那里的数可以被位置编号整除，或者位置编号可以被放在那里的数整除，二者至少成立一个，这列就称为优美排法。统计一共有多少种不同的优美排法，并把这个数目写出来。
526.en: Read a positive integer N whose maximum value is 15. Place each integer from 1 through N exactly once into a row whose slots are also numbered from 1 through N. A row is a beautiful layout when, for every slot, at least one fact holds: the integer sitting there can be divided evenly by the slot number, or the slot number can be divided evenly by the integer sitting there. Count how many different beautiful layouts exist and write that count.

528.zh: 读入一列正整数作为权重，下标从零开始。需要完成一次随机抽取：抽到某个下标的机会与该下标上的权重成正比，然后把抽到的下标写出来。列的长度在 1 到 10000 之间，每一项权重在 1 到 10^5 之间。这样的抽取最多进行 10000 次，各次之间互不影响，只要求单次概率与对应权重成正比。
528.en: Read a list of positive integer weights, with indexes starting at zero. Perform a random draw that selects one index with a chance proportional to the weight stored there, then write the selected index. The list length runs from 1 to 10000, and each weight runs from 1 to 10^5. The draw is requested at most 10000 times. Separate requests do not affect one another, and only the proportion on a single draw is required.

529.zh: 读入一块用字符表示的棋盘，以及一次点击的行号和列号。棋盘的高和宽都在 1 到 50 之间。M 表示还没揭开的雷，E 表示还没揭开的空格，B 表示已经揭开且周围八个方向都没有雷的空地，字符 1 到 8 表示已揭开格子四周的雷数，X 表示已经踩到的雷。点击一定落在 M 或 E 上，开局也不存在已经暴露的雷。点到雷时只把该格改成 X。点到四周都没有雷的空格时改成 B，并按同一规则继续揭开紧挨着的未揭开格子。点到四周至少有一颗雷的空格时，改成对应的数字字符并且不再扩散。把点击之后的整块棋盘写出来。对局结束时不必把其余的雷都揭开。
529.en: Read a character board plus one click given by a row index and a column index. Both height and width lie between 1 and 50. M marks a hidden mine, E marks a hidden empty cell, B marks an opened cell with no mine in any of the eight surrounding directions, a digit from 1 to 8 counts mines around an opened cell, and X marks a mine that was hit. The click is on M or E, and no mine is exposed at the start. Hitting a mine changes only that cell to X. Hitting an empty cell with no surrounding mine changes it to B and continues opening neighboring hidden cells by the same rule. Hitting an empty cell with at least one surrounding mine changes it to the matching digit and does not spread. Write the whole board after the click. When play stops, leave every remaining mine hidden.

530.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树，每个结点上的值都是非负整数，而且整棵树至少有两个结点。左子树中的值都比父结点小，右子树中的值都比父结点大。在任意两个不同结点之间取数值之差的绝对值，找出其中最小的那个结果并写出来。这道题与编号 783 考查的是同一计算。
530.en: Read a binary search tree in which every node stores a non-negative integer and the tree has at least two nodes. Values in a left subtree are smaller than the parent, and values in a right subtree are larger than the parent. Take the absolute gap between the stored numbers of every pair of distinct nodes, find the smallest gap, and write it. This task asks for the same quantity as problem 783.

532.zh: 读入一串整数以及另一个整数 k。从这串数里取出两个来自不同位置的数值，使它们差的绝对值恰好等于 k。把同一对数值颠倒次序仍视为同一对。统计这样互不相同的数值对一共有多少，并把数目写出来。这串数的长度不超过 10000，每个整数都在负 10000000 到正 10000000 之间。k 允许为 0，那时两个数值相等，但仍必须来自两个不同位置。
532.en: Read a series of integers together with another integer named k. Pick two values that sit at different positions and whose absolute gap equals k. Swapping the order of the same two values still counts as one pair. Count how many distinct pairs of values arise and write that count. The series holds at most 10000 integers, and every integer lies between -10000000 and 10000000. The integer k may be 0, in which case the two values are equal but still come from two different positions.

535.zh: 读入一条完整的网址。设计编码与解码两步：编码把这条网址收成一条更短的记号，解码再凭该记号还原出最初的网址。记号的具体样子可以自己规定，不要求与任何公开网站上的短链接相同。唯一必须遵守的是，同一条网址经过编码再解码之后，得到的文本与最初那条逐字相同。把编码结果和解码结果按调用顺序写出来。
535.en: Read one full web address. Design two steps, an encoding step and a decoding step. Encoding turns that address into a shorter token, and decoding uses the token to rebuild the address that was read. The shape of the token may be chosen freely and need not match a short link published by any public site. The required guarantee is that encoding an address and then decoding the token yields text identical to the address that was read. Write each encoding result and each decoding result in the order the steps are called.

537.zh: 读入两段用来书写复数的文本。每一段都写成紧凑的 a+bi，中间没有空白。字母 a 与 b 所代表的整数都落在负 100 到正 100 之间。按虚数单位的平方等于负一，求出这两段所写数值相乘的结果，再把结果写成同样的 a+bi。实部与虚部都要是整数，加号的位置和正负号都要符合这种紧凑写法，然后把结果文本写出来。
537.en: Read two strings that each name a complex number in the compact writing a+bi, with no blank characters inside. The integers standing for a and for b both lie between -100 and 100. Multiply the two numbers under the rule that the square of the imaginary unit equals negative one. Write the product as another string in the same a+bi writing, using integer real and imaginary parts, with the plus sign and any minus signs placed in that compact pattern.

538.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树的根。结点个数在 0 到 104 之间，所有结点上的数值互不相同，根保证是合法的搜索树。左子树只会出现比父结点更小的键，右子树只会出现比父结点更大的键。把每个结点改写为原树中所有大于或等于该结点原数值的键相加得到的和，再把改写后的整棵树写出来。题目记录里结点值两端出现的界限数字都是 104。
538.en: Read a search tree of the binary kind, beginning at its root. The number of nodes lies between 0 and 104, every stored number is unique, and the root satisfies the search-tree rule. A left branch holds only keys smaller than its parent, and a right branch holds only keys larger than its parent. Replace each node by the sum of every original key that is greater than or equal to that node's original number, then write the tree after those replacements. The recorded sheet lists 104 at both ends of the stored-number bound.

540.zh: 读入一个已经按升序排好的整数数组。除了一个数值只出现一次以外，其余每个数值都恰好出现两次。找出那个只出现一次的数值并写出来。数组长度在 1 到 100000 之间，每个元素在 0 到 100000 之间。完成查找时花费的时间应当保持在长度的对数级别，额外占用的空间应当保持为常数。
540.en: Read an array of integers that is already arranged in ascending order. Every value appears exactly two times, aside from one value that appears a single time. Find that lone value and write it. The array length runs from 1 to 100000, and each element runs from 0 to 100000. The search must stay within time logarithmic in the length, and the extra memory it uses must stay constant.

541.zh: 读入一条只含小写英文字母的文本，以及一个整数 k。文本有多长，k 取多大，两者都在 1 到 10000 之间。从左端起，每凑满 2k 个字母就处理一块：把这块靠前的 k 个字母前后对调，靠后的那些字母留在原地。若末尾剩下的字母不够 k 个，就把剩下的全部前后对调。若末尾至少有 k 个却不够 2k 个，只对调靠前的 k 个，再往后仍留在原地。把处理之后的整条文本写出来。
541.en: Read a text made only of lowercase English letters, together with an integer k. Both how long the text is and how large k is lie between 1 and 10000. Starting at the left, handle the letters in chunks of 2k. Inside a full chunk, swap the order of the opening k letters and leave the later letters where they are. If the final chunk holds fewer than k letters, swap all of those leftover letters. If it holds at least k letters but fewer than 2k, swap only the opening k letters and leave the later ones where they are. Write the text after this pass.

542.zh: 读入一个矩阵，格子里只有 0 和 1。对每一个格子，计算它走到最近的那个 0 需要多少步。一步只能走到上、下、左、右四个方向中的相邻格子，每步距离增加 1，斜向不算相邻。把每个格子的步数按原来的行列位置写成一个同样大小的矩阵。格子总数不超过 10000，并且矩阵中至少存在一个 0。
542.en: Read a matrix whose cells contain only 0 and 1. For every cell, compute how many steps are needed to reach the closest 0. A step may move only to a neighbor above, below, left, or right, each step adds 1, and a diagonal neighbor does not count. Write those step counts in a matrix of the same shape, keeping each count in its original row and column. The matrix holds at most 10000 cells, and it contains at least one 0.

543.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。结点个数在 1 到 104 之间，题目记录里结点值两端写出的界限数字都是 100。任意两个结点之间的路径长度按经过的边来数。找出边数最多的那条路径，它经过根或者完全不经过根都可以。把这条路径上的边数写出来。
543.en: Read a binary tree. The node count runs from 1 to 104, and the recorded sheet writes 100 at both ends of the node-value bound. Measure a route between two nodes by how many edges it uses. Find the route that uses the most edges. That route may go through the root, or it may avoid the root completely. Write the edge count of that route.

547.zh: 读入整数 N 和一张 N 乘 N 的方阵，N 在 1 到 200 之间。方阵里第 i 行第 j 列等于 1，表示两名同学直接相识，等于 0 表示没有这条直接联系。对角线上每一格都是 1，而且方阵对称，i 到 j 有联系时 j 到 i 也有。相识可以顺着链条传递，于是直接或间接连在一起的同学属于同一群。写出一共能分成多少个这样的群。
547.en: Read an integer N and an N by N square table, with N from 1 to 200. A 1 at row i and column j means two classmates know one another directly, while 0 means that direct link is missing. Every diagonal cell is 1, and the table is symmetric, so a link from i to j also appears from j to i. Acquaintance chains together, and classmates joined directly or through such a chain belong to one group. Write how many groups there are in total.

551.zh: 读入一条出勤字符串，长度在 1 到 1000 之间，每个字符只可能是 A、L 或 P。A 表示缺席，L 表示迟到，P 表示到课。判断这名学生能否得到出勤奖：缺席天数必须严格少于两天，并且不能出现连续三天或更长的迟到。两个条件同时成立就写出 true，否则写出 false。
551.en: Read an attendance string whose length runs from 1 to 1000. Each character is one of A, L, or P. A means absent, L means late, and P means the student came to class. Decide whether the student qualifies for an attendance prize. Absent days must be strictly fewer than two, and there must be no streak of three or more late days. Write true when both conditions hold, and write false otherwise.

554.zh: 读入一堵由 n 行砖拼成的墙，n 在 1 到 10000 之间。每块砖一样高，宽度可以不同，但每一行加起来的总宽度相同。一行里砖的块数不超过 10000，各行块数之和不超过 2 乘 10^4，单块宽度在 1 到 2 的 31 次方减 1 之间。要画一条从上到下的直线，不能贴着墙的左右外边。直线只擦到砖与砖的接缝时，不算击穿那块砖。找出最少会击穿多少块砖，并把这个块数写出来。
554.en: Read a wall built from n rows of bricks, with n from 1 to 10000. Every brick has the same height, widths may differ, and each row adds up to the same total width. A row contains at most 10000 bricks, the brick counts of all rows add up to at most 2 * 10^4, and a single width runs from 1 to 2^31 - 1. Draw one straight line from the upper edge down to the lower edge, not flush with either outer side. A line that only meets a seam between bricks does not break that brick. Find the smallest number of bricks such a line must break, and write that number.

557.zh: 读入一句由单词和空格组成的话。每个单词内部都是字母，相邻单词之间恰好隔着一个空格，句首和句尾都不再多出空格。把每个单词内部的字母从后往前重新排，单词与单词的先后保持不变，中间那些空格也留在原来的地方。把重排之后得到的整句话写出来。
557.en: Read one sentence made of words and spaces. Letters sit inside each word, exactly one space stands between neighboring words, and no extra space sits at the start or at the end. Rearrange the letters inside every word from back to front. Keep the sequence of the words unchanged, and keep each space between them in its current place. Write the full sentence produced by that rearrangement.

559.zh: 读入一棵可以有多个孩子的树。结点总数在 0 到 10000 之间，树高不超过 1000。这里的深度是从根走到最远一片叶子时，沿途结点的个数，根也算进去。没有任何结点时深度记为 0。找出最大深度并写出来。输入按一层一层给出，同一父亲的若干孩子之间用空记号隔开。
559.en: Read a tree in which a node may have many children. The total number of nodes runs from 0 to 10000, and the tree height is at most 1000. Depth here means how many nodes lie on a walk from the root to the farthest leaf, counting the root as well. When the tree has no nodes, the depth is 0. Find the greatest depth and write it. The input is listed level by level, and an empty mark separates the children that share one parent.

560.zh: 读入整数数组以及整数 k。数一数有多少段连续区间，区间内各数相加正好等于 k，然后把这个段数写出来。数组长度在 1 到 2 乘 104 之间，每个元素在负 1000 到 1000 之间，k 在负 10^7 到 10^7 之间。起点或终点不同的区间分开计数，即使它们的和一样。
560.en: Read an array of integers and an integer named k. Count how many contiguous intervals have entries that add up to exactly k, then write that count. The array length runs from 1 to 2 * 104, each entry runs from -1000 to 1000, and k runs from -10^7 to 10^7. Intervals with different starts or different ends are counted apart even when their sums are equal.

561.zh: 读入 2n 个整数。n 是 1 到 10000 之间的正整数，每个整数落在负 10000 到正 10000。把这些整数配成 n 组，每组两个。每一组只保留较小的那个数，再把各组留下的数相加。找出一种分组方式，使这个和最大，并把这个最大和写出来。
561.en: Read 2n integers. The positive integer n lies between 1 and 10000, and every integer lies between -10000 and 10000. Match the integers into n groups of two. From each group keep only the smaller integer, then add the kept integers. Find a matching that makes this sum as large as it can be, and write that greatest sum.

563.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。对任意结点，先分别求出左支全部数值之和与右支全部数值之和，缺掉的一支和记为 0，再取这两个和的正差，这个正差就是该结点的坡度。把每个结点的坡度加总，得到整棵树的坡度并写出来。任何一支上的数值之和，以及每个坡度，都落在 32 位整数可以表示的范围里。
563.en: Read a binary tree. For any node, add every number stored on its left branch and every number stored on its right branch, treating a missing branch as 0, then take the positive gap between those two sums. That gap is the node's tilt. Sum the per-node gaps into one tree-wide total and write it. The sum on any branch, and every tilt, stays inside the range of a 32-bit integer.

566.zh: 读入一个矩阵，再读入两个正整数 r 和 c，表示希望得到的行数和列数。原矩阵的高和宽都在 1 到 100 之间。按先行后列的次序取出原矩阵的全部元素，再按同样的次序填进 r 行 c 列的新矩阵。只有元素总数恰好等于 r 乘以 c 时，这次重排才算合法。合法就写出新矩阵，不合法就写出原来的矩阵。
566.en: Read a matrix along with a pair of positive integers called r and c. Those two integers name the wanted row count and column count. The height and the width of the starting matrix each lie between 1 and 100. Take every cell in row-then-column order and fill a fresh matrix of r rows and c columns in that same order. The reshape is legal only when the starting cell count equals r multiplied by c. Write the fresh matrix when the reshape is legal, and write the starting matrix when it is not.

567.zh: 读入两个只含小写字母的字符串 s1 和 s2，两者长度都在 1 到 10000 之间。判断 s2 中是否存在一段连续下标，这段的长度与 s1 相同，而且每个字母出现的次数都与 s1 一致。字母在这段里的先后可以不同。存在这样的一段就写出 true，不存在就写出 false。
567.en: Read two strings s1 and s2 that contain only lowercase letters. Both lengths lie between 1 and 10000. Decide whether s2 contains a stretch of consecutive indexes whose length equals the length of s1 and whose count of every letter matches s1. The order of letters inside that stretch may differ. Write true when such a stretch exists, and write false when it does not.

572.zh: 读入两棵都不为空的二叉树，名字分别是 s 和 t。判断 t 是否能与 s 的某一棵子树对上：形状完全一样，而且每个对应结点上的数值也一样。s 的子树由其中某个结点连同它下面的全部后代组成。整棵 s 也算它自己的一棵子树。能对上就写出 true，对不上就写出 false。
572.en: Read two binary trees that are both non-empty, named s and t. Decide whether t lines up with some subtree of s: the shape is the same, and the number stored at every matching node is the same. A subtree of s is one node of s together with every descendant under that node. The entire tree s also counts as a subtree of itself. Write true when a lineup exists, and write false when it does not.

575.zh: 读入一个偶数长度的整数数组，长度在 2 到 10000 之间，每个整数在负 100000 到正 100000 之间。不同的整数代表不同口味，每个整数代表一颗糖。把这些糖按颗数平均分给妹妹和弟弟。在颗数必须相同的前提下，找出妹妹最多可以拿到多少种口味，并把这个种类数写出来。
575.en: Read an integer array whose length is even and lies between 2 and 10000. Every integer lies between -100000 and 100000. Different integers stand for different flavors, and each integer stands for one candy. Split the candies so the sister and the brother receive equally many pieces. Under that equal count, find the largest number of flavors the sister can hold, and write that number.

576.zh: 读入五个整数 m、n、maxMove、startRow、startColumn。网格有 m 行 n 列，m 和 n 都在 1 到 50 之间，球从网格内部的 startRow 行 startColumn 列出发。每一步可以向上、下、左、右移动一格，也允许迈出边界。最多走 maxMove 步，maxMove 在 0 到 50 之间。统计有多少种走法能在不超过该步数时让球离开网格，不同步数出界都要计入。数目可能很大，写出它除以 10^9 加 7 的余数。
576.en: Read m, then n, then maxMove, then startRow, then startColumn. These are five integers. The grid has m rows and n columns, both m and n run from 1 to 50, and the ball begins inside the grid at row startRow and column startColumn. Each step moves up, down, left, or right by one cell, and a step may cross the boundary. No more than maxMove steps may be used, and maxMove runs from 0 to 50. Count the walks that carry the ball past the outer edge without exceeding that step limit, including exits on different step counts. The count may be huge, so write it modulo 10^9 plus 7.

581.zh: 读入一列整数，长度在 1 到 104 之间，每个整数都落在 -105 到 105。请找出一段连续下标，只把这一段按从小到大重排后，整列都变成升序，并且这段在所有满足条件的片段里最短。把这段含有的元素个数写出来。若整列一开始就已经升序，则写出 0。
581.en: Read a list of integers whose length is from 1 through 104, with every entry between -105 and 105 inclusive. Find one contiguous index span such that reordering only that span from small to large makes the whole list increase, and choose the shortest span that works. Write how many entries the span holds. If the list already increases from left to right, write 0.

583.zh: 读入两个只由小写英文字母组成的单词，每个单词的长度都在 1 到 500。每一步只能在其中一个单词里擦掉一个字母。请找出让两个单词变得完全一致所需的最少步数，并把这个步数写出来。比较时区分位置，字母顺序不同就不算一致。
583.en: Read two words built only from lowercase English letters. Each word has a length from 1 through 500. One move erases a single letter from one of the two words. Find the smallest number of moves that leaves the two words identical, and write that number. Order matters, so the same letters in a different order still differ.

589.zh: 读入一棵可以有多个孩子的树，结点个数在 0 到 104 之间，每个结点保存的整数在 0 到 10000 之间，树的高度不超过 1000。按先根次序写出结点上的数：先写当前结点，再从左到右处理各棵子树。空树就写出空序列。输入按层排列，同一父结点的孩子组之间用空标记隔开。
589.en: Read a tree in which a node may have many children. The node count is from 0 through 104, each stored integer is from 0 through 10000, and the height is at most 1000. Write the values in preorder: record a node before its children, and visit children from left to right. An empty tree produces an empty sequence. Input is listed level by level, with a null marker between sibling groups.

594.zh: 若一串数里的最大值与最小值相差恰好为 1，就称这串数和谐。读入一列整数，长度最多两万。在不改变先后次序的前提下，从中挑出若干个数，个数至少为 2，使挑出的数和谐，并且个数尽量多。把这个最大个数写出来。挑出的数不必在原列中相邻。若无法凑出，就写 0。
594.en: Call a selection harmonious when its largest entry and its smallest entry differ by exactly one. Read a list of integers of length at most 20000. Keeping the original relative order, pick at least two entries that form a harmonious selection, and make the pick as long as possible. Write that greatest length. Picked entries need not be neighbors in the list. If no pair qualifies, write 0.

598.zh: 有一张 m 行 n 列的表，一开始每个格子都是 0。m 与 n 都在 1 到 40000。随后读入一串更新，条数不超过 10000。每条更新给出正整数 a 与 b，把行号小于 a 且列号小于 b 的格子都加上 1，行号和列号都从 0 计起。a 在 1 到 m，b 在 1 到 n。全部更新做完后，找出表中最大的那个数字，并写出等于该数字的格子有多少个。
598.en: Start with a table of m rows and n columns, every cell set to zero. Both m and n lie in 1 through 40000. Then apply updates, at most 10000 of them. Each update gives positive integers a and b and adds one to every cell whose row index is below a and whose column index is below b, with indexes starting at zero. a is from 1 through m and b is from 1 through n. After the updates finish, find the biggest number in the table and write how many cells equal it.

599.zh: 两个人各自保存一份喜爱的餐馆名字，两份的长度都在 1 到 1000，每个名字的字符个数在 1 到 30。同一份里面没有重名，下标从 0 开始。找出同时出现在两份里的名字，并让该名字在两份中的下标之和最小。若有几个名字的和相同，就把它们全部写出来，次序随意。可以认为至少存在一个共同名字。
599.en: Two people each keep a list of preferred restaurant names. Both lists have length from 1 to 1000, and every name has from 1 to 30 characters. A name is never repeated inside one list, and indexes start at zero. Find names present on both lists whose indexes add to the smallest total. If several names share that total, write every one of them in any order. A shared name is guaranteed to exist.

605.zh: 花坛是一排格子，长度从 1 到 2 乘 104，格子里只有 0 或 1。0 表示空着，1 表示已经有花，并且现有的花互不相邻。再读入整数 n，范围是 0 到花坛长度。新花也不能种在相邻格子上。判断能不能再放下恰好 n 朵。能就写 true，不能就写 false。
605.en: A flowerbed is a row whose length runs from 1 to 2 times 104. Each plot is 0 or 1: a zero marks a vacant plot and a one marks an occupied plot, and no occupied plots currently touch. Also read an integer n from 0 through the row length. A new plant may not sit beside another plant. Decide whether exactly n extra plants can be placed under that rule. Write true when they can, and write false when they cannot.

609.zh: 读入若干条目录记录，条数在 1 到 2 乘 104，每条字符串长度不超过 3000，所有字符串长度之和不超过 5 乘 105。每条先给出目录路径，再列出其中的文件，文件名后用括号包住正文，各段用单个空格分开。同一目录中的名字互不相同。把正文完全一样的文件分成一组，每组至少两条路径。写出各组的完整路径，组与组之间以及组内的次序都可以自定。
609.en: Read directory records, from 1 to 2 times 104 of them. Each record string has length at most 3000, and the lengths add up to at most 5 times 105. A record begins with a directory path and then names files there, each name followed by its text inside parentheses, with single spaces between parts. Names inside one directory stay unique. Cluster files whose text is identical. Every cluster needs at least two full paths. Write the clusters. Ordering among clusters and inside a cluster may be chosen freely.

611.zh: 读入一列非负整数。按下标选出三个不同的位置，把这三个数值当成三条边长。若任意两条边的长度之和都严格大于剩下的那一条，这三个数就能构成三角形。统计有多少组下标满足该条件，并把组数写出来。数值重复时仍按下标区分，不同下标算不同的组。
611.en: Read a list of non-negative integers. Select three distinct indexes and treat those three values as edge lengths. The three values form a triangle when every pair of lengths adds up to strictly more than the remaining length. Count how many index triples satisfy that test, and write the count. Equal values stay distinct by index, so different index triples are separate.

617.zh: 读入两棵二叉树，每棵的结点数都在 0 到 2000，结点上的整数介于 -104 与 104。按相同位置把两棵树叠在一起。两边都有结点时，新结点保存两个值的和；只有一边有结点时，保留这一边的结点以及它下方的结构。写出叠好之后的树。其中一棵是空树时，结果就是另一棵。
617.en: Read two binary trees. Each tree contains from 0 to 2000 nodes, and every node value lies between -104 and 104. Overlay the trees by matching positions. When both positions contain a node, the result stores the sum of the two values. When only one side contains a node, keep that node and everything under it. Write the overlaid tree. If one tree is empty, the result is the other tree.

622.zh: 实现一个容量为 k 的环形队列。k 在 1 到 1000，存入的值在 0 到 1000，各类操作加起来最多调用 3000 次。元素按进入的先后离开，尾端绕回首端，因此空出来的位置还能再放入新元素。要能用 k 创建队列；查看首端和尾端，里面没有元素时写出 -1；放入一个值，成功写 true，已满写 false；去掉首端元素，成功写 true，已空写 false；还要能回答当前是否为空以及是否已满。
622.en: Implement a ring queue with capacity k. k is an integer from 1 to 1000, stored values lie from 0 to 1000, and all operations together are invoked at most 3000 times. Items depart in the order they arrived, and the tail wraps to the head so a freed slot can accept a later item. Support creating the queue from k, reading the head item and the tail item while writing -1 if nothing is stored, inserting a value with true on success and false when no slot remains, removing the head item with true on success and false when nothing is stored, and answering whether it is empty and whether it is full.

623.zh: 读入一棵至少含有一个结点的二叉树、整数 v，以及深度 d。根所在深度记为 1，d 从 1 取到原树最大深度再加 1。要在深度 d 插入一整层，新结点的值都是 v。对深度正好等于 d 减 1 的每个非空结点，新建一左一右两个孩子，值都为 v，并把该结点原有的左侧结构挂到新的左孩子下面，原有的右侧结构挂到新的右孩子下面。若 d 为 1，就新建值为 v 的根，旧树整体成为它的左侧结构。写出修改后的树。
623.en: Read a binary tree with at least one node, an integer v, and a depth d. The root has depth 1, and d runs from 1 through one past the current greatest depth. Insert a whole level of new nodes, each holding v, at depth d. For every occupied node at depth d minus 1, create one new left child and one new right child, both holding v. Attach the node's old left branch under the new left child, and attach the old right branch under the new right child. If d is 1, create a new root holding v and attach the old tree as its left branch. Write the tree after the edit.

628.zh: 读入一列整数，长度从 3 到 10000，每个数都在 -1000 到 1000 之间，任意三个数相乘的结果都落在 32 位有符号整数能表示的范围里。选出三个不同的位置，使这三个数的乘积达到最大，并把这个乘积写出来。负数参与相乘时符号要保留。
628.en: Read a list of integers whose length runs from 3 to 10000. Every entry lies between -1000 and 1000, and the product of any three entries fits in a 32-bit signed integer. Pick three different indexes so the product of their values is as large as possible, and write that product. Keep the sign when a negative entry takes part in the multiplication.

630.zh: 有若干门网课，门数在 1 到 104。每门课给出持续天数和最晚完成日，这两个正整数也都不超过 104。学习从第 1 天开始，同一时间只能学一门，而且一门课必须天天连续学完，并在它的最晚完成日当天或更早结束。找出最多可以完成的门数，并把这个门数写出来。可以放弃一些课。
630.en: Several online classes are available, from 1 to 104 of them. Each class gives a duration in days and a latest completion day, and both positive integers are at most 104. Study begins on day 1. Only one class can be studied at a time, a class must occupy consecutive days, and it must end on or before its latest completion day. Find how many classes can be completed at most, and write that count. Skipping some classes is allowed.

632.zh: 读入 k 份已经从小到大排好的整数列表。k 在 1 到 3500，列表里允许出现重复的数，每个数都在 -100000 到 100000。找出一个闭区间，使每一份列表都至少有一个数落在区间里面，并且区间按下列规则最小：先比较长度，更短的更小；长度相等时，左端点更小的更小。把这个区间的左端点和右端点写出来。
632.en: Read k lists of integers, each already arranged from small to large. k is from 1 to 3500, repeated values inside a list are allowed, and every value lies between -100000 and 100000. Find a closed interval that contains at least one value from every list and is smallest by this rule: compare lengths first and prefer the shorter one; if the lengths match, prefer the smaller left endpoint. Write the left endpoint and the right endpoint of that interval.

633.zh: 读入一个大于等于零的整数 c。问能不能挑出整数 a 与整数 b，让 a 自乘一次再加上 b 自乘一次，结果正好等于 c。能就写 true，不能就写 false。零可以入选，负数也可以入选，因为自乘之后负号会消失。只需要回答能否做到，不必列出具体的 a 与 b。
633.en: Read one integer c that is zero or positive. Ask whether some integers a and b exist so that a multiplied by itself, added to b multiplied by itself, equals c. Write true when they exist and write false when they do not. Zero may be chosen, and negative integers may be chosen, because multiplying a number by itself drops the sign. Only the yes or no result is required.

636.zh: 一台单线程机器上有 n 个函数，n 在 1 到 100，编号从 0 到 n 减 1。日志按时间顺序给出，每条包含编号、开始或结束标记，以及时间戳。不会有两个函数在同一时间戳开始或结束，每个函数结束时都会留下记录。函数可以再调用别的函数。某个函数单独占用的时间单位数，等于它自己真正执行的那段，它转去调用别人的时间要扣掉。按编号从小到大写出各函数单独占用的时间单位数。
636.en: A single-thread machine runs n functions, where n is from 1 to 100 and ids run from 0 through n minus 1. Logs arrive ordered by time. Each log carries an id, a start mark or a finish mark, and a timestamp. No two functions start or finish on the same timestamp, and every function logs its finish. A function may invoke another function. Exclusive duration is the count of time units a function itself is running, leaving out time spent in functions it invokes. Write those durations from the smallest id to the largest.

637.zh: 读入一棵非空的二叉树，每个结点上的整数都在 32 位有符号整数的范围之内。从根开始一层一层往下看，计算同一层所有结点值的平均数。按照从顶层到底层的顺序，把每一层的平均数写出来。某一层只有一个结点时，平均数就是这个结点本身的值。
637.en: Read a binary tree that is not empty. Every node holds a signed integer inside the 32-bit range. Starting at the root and moving downward one depth at a time, compute the mean of all values stored on that depth. Write those means from the top depth to the bottom depth. If a depth contains only one node, the mean is that node's own value.

638.zh: 商品种类至多 6 种，每种有自己的单价。另有至多 100 个礼包，每个礼包列出所含各种商品的件数，最后一个数是该礼包的售价。礼包可以多次购买。还给出每种商品需要买到的件数，每种至多 6 件。任何一种都不能买得比需求更多，哪怕总价会因此更低。在刚好买齐的前提下找出最低总花费并写出来。按单价单独购买也可以。
638.en: There are at most 6 kinds of goods, each with its own unit price, and at most 100 bundles. A bundle lists how many pieces of each kind it includes, and its last number is the selling price. A bundle may be bought more than once. You are also told how many pieces of each kind are required, at most 6 per kind. Do not obtain more pieces of any kind than required, even if the bill would become smaller. Find the lowest total cost that obtains exactly the required counts, and write that cost. Paying the unit price for single pieces is allowed.

643.zh: 读入 n 个整数以及一个长度 k，它们满足 1 小于等于 k、k 小于等于 n、n 小于等于 30000。每个整数都在 -10000 到 10000。找出一段连续区间，区间里恰好有 k 个数，并且这段数的平均数在所有这样的区间里最大。把这个最大平均数写出来。
643.en: Read n integers and a length k such that 1 is less than or equal to k, k is less than or equal to n, and n is at most 30000. Every integer lies between -10000 and 10000. Find a contiguous block holding exactly k numbers whose mean is the greatest among all such blocks, and write that mean.

645.zh: 原本从 1 到 n 的每个整数都应该出现一次。出错以后，其中一个数被改成了另一个本来就该出现的数，于是有一个数出现了两次，同时有一个数再也看不到。读入出错后的数组，它是乱序的，长度在 2 到 10000。先找出出现两次的数，再找出缺失的数，按这个次序写出两个数。
645.en: Each integer from 1 through n should have appeared once. After a mistake, one value was replaced by another value that already belonged in the collection, so one value shows up twice and another value is gone. Read the resulting array, which is unordered and has length from 2 to 10000. Find the value that shows up twice, then the value that is gone, and write those two values in that order.

647.zh: 读入一个字符串，它的长度不超过 1000。数一数有多少个连续片段顺着读和倒着读完全一样。起点不同或终点不同的片段都要分开计数，即使片段由同样的字符拼成。只含一个字符的片段也要计入。把总数写出来。
647.en: Read a string whose length does not exceed 1000. Count how many contiguous slices look the same when read forward and when read backward. Slices that start at different places or end at different places are counted apart, even if they are made of identical characters. A slice of one character counts too. Write the total.

648.zh: 读入一组词根和一句英文，字符全部是小写字母。词根的个数以及句中单词的个数都在 1 到 1000，每条词根的长度在 1 到 100，句中每个单词的长度不超过 1000。如果某个单词的开头能对上词典里的词根，就把它换成匹配上的最短词根。写出替换之后的整句，单词之间仍用空格隔开。对不上任何词根的单词保持不变。
648.en: Read a set of roots and one English sentence. Every character is a lowercase letter. The set contains from 1 to 1000 roots, the sentence contains from 1 to 1000 words, each root has length from 1 to 100, and each word in the sentence has length at most 1000. If the opening of a word matches one or more roots, replace that word with the shortest root that matches. Write the full sentence after replacement, with spaces still between words. A word that matches nothing stays as it is.

653.zh: 读入一棵搜索二叉树，再读入一个整数当作目标和。查看树里有没有两个不同的结点，它们保存的数相加正好等于这个目标。有就写 true，没有就写 false。沿着中序走会得到升序数列，但这里只要是否存在的结论，不用指出是哪两个结点。
653.en: Read one search tree of the binary kind, then read an integer to use as the target sum. Check whether two distinct nodes store numbers that add up to exactly this target. Write true when they do and write false when they do not. Walking the tree inorder yields an increasing sequence, but only the yes or no conclusion is required, not which nodes were used.

658.zh: 读入一个已经从小到大排好的整数数组，以及正整数 k 和整数 x。数组不是空的，长度不超过 10000，而且 k 总是小于数组长度。数组里每个数的绝对值以及 x 的绝对值都不超过 10000。找出离 x 最近的 k 个数。若两个数到 x 的距离一样，就优先留下更小的那个。把选中的数按从小到大的次序写出来。
658.en: Read an array of integers already arranged from small to large, plus a positive integer k and an integer x. The array is non-empty, its length is at most 10000, and k is always smaller than that length. The absolute value of each array entry and of x is at most 10000. Find the k entries nearest to x. If two entries are the same distance from x, keep the smaller one first. Write the chosen entries from small to large.

661.zh: 一张整数格子表表示一幅图的灰度。表中的整数在 0 到 255，行数和列数都在 1 到 150。对每一个格子，用它自己以及周围最多八个邻居的平均值替换原灰度，平均值要向下取整。位于边缘、邻居不到八个的格子，就用实际存在的那些邻居。写出处理之后的整张表。
661.en: An integer grid stores the gray level of a picture. Entries run from 0 through 255, and both the number of rows and the number of columns run from 1 through 150. Replace every cell by the floor of the mean of that cell together with up to eight neighbors around it. Cells on the border, which have fewer than eight neighbors, use whatever neighbors exist. Write the full grid after this replacement.

662.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，孩子位置允许为空，整棵树的格局与一棵铺满的二叉树一样，只是有些位置空着。某一层的宽度等于该层最左边的实结点和最右边的实结点之间的跨度，两端中间的空位也算进跨度。树的宽度取各层宽度中的最大值。把这个最大宽度写出来。答案保证能放进 32 位有符号整数。
662.en: Read a binary tree whose child slots may be empty. Its layout matches a completely filled binary shape, except some slots are vacant. The width of one depth is the distance from the leftmost occupied node on that depth to the rightmost occupied node, and vacant slots between those ends still add to the distance. The width of the tree is the greatest of those depth widths. Write that greatest width. The answer fits inside a 32-bit signed integer.

665.zh: 读入 n 个整数排成一行。n 在 1 到 104 之间，每个整数在 -100000 到 100000 之间。判断是否最多改掉其中一项，就能让这一行变成非递减：只要右边还有下一项，左边的数就不大于它。可以做到就写 true，否则写 false。
665.en: Read an integer array whose length is n. n lies from 1 to 104, and every integer lies from -100000 to 100000. Decide whether altering at most one entry can make the array non-decreasing: for every index i where i plus 1 is still valid, the left entry is less than or equal to the right entry. Write true if this is possible and write false otherwise.

667.zh: 读入两个正整数 n 与 k。写出长度为 n 的一列整数，其中 1 到 n 每个数恰好出现一次。再看相邻两项差的绝对值，这些绝对值里互不相同的个数必须正好等于 k。有多种列法时写出任意一种。约束是 1 小于等于 k，k 小于 n，并且 n 不超过 10^4。
667.en: Read two positive integers n and k. Write a sequence of length n in which each integer from 1 through n appears once. The absolute differences between neighboring entries must contain exactly k different numbers. When several sequences qualify, write any one of them. The bounds require 1 <= k < n and n at most 10^4.

668.zh: 读入三个正整数 m、n 和 k。设想一张 m 行 n 列的表，第 i 行第 j 列写着 i 与 j 的乘积，行列都从 1 编号。把全部格子里的乘积从小到大排列，相同乘积按格子个数重复占位。写出排在第 k 个位置上的乘积。m 和 n 都在 1 到 30000 之间，k 在 1 到 m 与 n 的乘积之间。
668.en: Read three positive integers m, n, and k. Picture a table of m rows and n columns. The cell at row i and column j stores the product of i and j, and both indexes begin at 1. Line up every cell product from small to large, repeating a product once for each cell that holds it. Write the product sitting at place k. Both m and n are between 1 and 30000 inclusive, and k is between 1 and the product of m and n inclusive.

669.zh: 读入一棵搜索树的根，以及整数下界 low 和上界 high。删去值不在闭区间内的结点，使留下的每个值都落在 low 与 high 之间。留下的结点必须维持原先的祖先与后代关系。这样处理之后的树是唯一的。写出新的根，它可能不再是原来的根。结点个数在 1 到 10^4 之间，结点值互不相同，每个值以及两个边界都在 0 到 10^4 之间，且下界不超过上界。输入本身已是合法的搜索树。
669.en: Read a search tree by its root pointer, plus integer bounds named low and high. Delete every node whose value lies outside the closed interval, so each remaining value sits between low and high. Nodes that stay must keep their earlier ancestor and descendant links. The tree produced this way is unique. Write the new root, which might no longer be the original root. The node count is from 1 to 10^4. Node values are unique. Each value and both bounds lie from 0 to 10^4, with low no greater than high. The input is already a valid search tree.

674.zh: 读入一列可能尚未排序的整数。从中找出下标连续、数值严格变大的一段，让这段的长度在所有同类片段里最长，并把长度写出来。只含一个数的片段也算数。数组长度在 0 到 10^4 之间。每个整数的绝对值不超过 10^9。
674.en: Read a row of integers that may not be sorted. Find a block of neighboring positions whose values strictly rise from left to right, and choose the block with the greatest length among all such blocks. Write that length. A block holding a single integer still counts. The row length is between 0 and 10^4. The absolute value of every integer is at most 10^9.

676.zh: 先读入若干互不重复的单词并保存下来，这些单词只含英文小写字母。随后每次读入一个查询词，判断能否只改动其中恰好一个字符，把它改成别的字符，使改后的拼写与已保存的某个单词完全相同。改零个或两个及以上字符都不算成功。对每个查询词写出是或否。查询词同样只含小写字母。
676.en: First read several words that do not repeat and store them. Every stored word uses only lowercase English letters. Then, for each query word, decide whether replacing exactly one of its letters by a different letter makes the new spelling identical to some stored word. Replacing no letter, or two or more letters, does not succeed. Write yes or no for every query. Query words also use only lowercase letters.

677.zh: 维护从字符串到整数的对应关系。insert 读入一个键和一个值：键是新的就记下这一对，键已存在就用新值换掉旧值。sum 读入一个前缀，把所有以它开头的键所对应的值相加，写出总和。键和前缀只含小写英文字母，长度各自从 1 到 50。每个值从 1 到 1000。两种操作加在一起最多进行 50 次。
677.en: Keep a correspondence from strings to integers. insert reads a key and a value: record the pair when the key is new, and replace the stored integer when the key is already recorded. sum reads a prefix and writes the total of every stored integer whose key opens with that prefix. Keys and prefixes contain only lowercase English letters, and each has length from 1 to 50. Every stored integer is from 1 to 1000. The two operations together run at most 50 times.

682.zh: 读入一串记号。记号可以是整数、加号、字母 D 或字母 C。整数就是该轮得到的分数。加号表示本轮分数等于此前最近两个仍有效分数之和。D 表示本轮分数等于最近一个仍有效分数的两倍。C 不产生分数，而是撤销最近一个仍有效分数。各轮结果会保留下来并影响后面的记号。把仍然有效的分数全部相加并写出。记号个数在 1 到 1000 之间，其中的整数在 -30000 到 30000 之间。
682.en: Read a row of tokens. A token may be an integer, a plus sign, the letter D, or the letter C. An integer is the score of that turn. A plus sign means the score of this turn equals the sum of the two latest scores that are still in force. D means this turn scores twice the latest score still in force. C creates no score; it cancels the latest score still in force. Outcomes stay recorded and can affect later tokens. Add every score that is still in force and write the total. The row holds between 1 and 1000 tokens, and each integer lies between -30000 and 30000.

684.zh: 本题里的树指连通且不含圈的无向图。读入的边来自 N 个结点的一棵树，另外又多加了一条边。结点编号是互异的 1 到 N。每条边给出两个端点，书写时左端编号更小。多加的边两端也在 1 到 N 之中，并且原树里没有它。请删去一条边，使余下部分重新成为 N 个结点的树。能删的边若不止一条，写出输入顺序里最末尾的那条，端点仍要左小右大。边数在 3 到 1000 之间，端点在 1 到 N 之间，N 等于边数。无向图这一说法于 2017 年写进题面。
684.en: Here a tree means a graph without direction that stays linked and contains no loop. The edges you read come from a tree on N nodes together with one extra edge. Labels are the distinct integers 1 through N. Each edge lists two endpoints, with the smaller label written on the left. The extra edge also joins labels in that range and was absent from the original tree. Delete one edge so the remainder is again a tree on N nodes. If more than one edge may be deleted, write the edge that stands last in the input order, still with the smaller label on the left. The edge count is from 3 to 1000. Endpoints lie from 1 to N, and N equals the edge count. The undirected wording was added to the statement in 2017.

685.zh: 带根的树在这里是有向图：恰有一个根，其他每个结点都能沿箭头从根走到，并且除根之外每个结点恰好一个父亲。读入的边来自 N 个结点的这样一棵树，再外加一条有向边。编号是 1 到 N。边从父亲指向孩子。外加边的两端都在 1 到 N，且原先不存在。删掉一条边之后，余下部分必须重新成为含有 N 个结点且仍带根的图。能删的边不止一条时，采用输入序列里排在最后的那条。边的条数在 3 到 1000 之间，端点整数在 1 到 N 之间，N 就是边数。
685.en: A rooted tree here means a graph with arrows and a single root. Every other node is reachable by following arrows from that root, and every node except the root has one parent. The edges you read come from such a tree on N nodes plus one extra directed edge. Labels run from 1 to N. An edge points from parent toward child. The extra edge joins two labels in that range and was not already there. Delete one edge so the graph that remains is a rooted tree on N nodes. When several deletions are possible, write the edge located furthest toward the end of the input. The count of edges is from 3 to 1000. Each endpoint is an integer from 1 to N, and N is that count.

690.zh: 每名员工有唯一编号、一份重要度，以及零个或多个直属下级编号。读入公司里全部员工的这些资料，再读入某一名员工的编号。把该员工本人的重要度，与顺着直属下级关系能够层层到达的所有人的重要度，全部加在一起并写出。隔了一层的下级也要计入。每人至多一名直属上司，可以带领多名下级。员工总数不超过 2000。
690.en: Every worker has a unique number, one importance score, and zero or more numbers of people who report directly. Read those records for the whole company, then read one worker number. Add that worker's own score to the scores of everyone who can be reached by walking down the direct-report links, and write the sum. People more than one step down still count. Each worker has at most one direct boss and may lead several people. The company has at most 2000 workers.

692.zh: 读入一份不会是空的单词清单和一个正整数 k。清单里的单词只由小写英文字母拼成。统计每个单词出现的次数，挑出次数最高的 k 个单词。写出时按次数由多到少排列。次数一样时，按字典序更靠前的单词排在更前面。k 不会大于不同单词的种数。比较时看整个单词，字母全是小写，因此没有大小写差别。
692.en: Read a word list that is not empty and a positive integer k. Each word is spelled with lowercase English letters only. Count the occurrences of every word and pick the k words whose counts are the highest. Write them so that a larger count comes before a smaller count. When two counts match, the word that comes earlier in dictionary order is written first. k is never larger than the number of distinct words. Compare entire spellings. There is no uppercase, so letter case never changes the order.

693.zh: 读入一个正整数，把它写成不带前导零的二进制，高位放在左边。从左往右查看每一对紧挨着的位。只要有一对两位相同，就判断这个整数不符合交替条件。只有每一对紧挨着的位都互不相同，才判断它符合。写出符合或不符合。因为整数至少为 1，位串至少含有一位。单独一位时没有相邻对，视为符合。
693.en: Read one positive integer and write it in binary with the high bit on the left and without leading zeros. Inspect each pair of bits that sit next to each other, moving from left to right. If any such pair holds two equal bits, decide that the integer fails the alternating test. Decide that it passes only when every neighboring pair holds two different bits. Write pass or fail. The integer is at least 1, so the bit string has at least one bit. A single bit has no neighbor pair and counts as a pass.

695.zh: 读入一张非空网格，格子里只有数字 0 和 1。1 代表陆地，0 代表水。上下左右四向贴边的陆地属于同一座岛，只在角上碰到不算连接。网格四条边界的外侧一律视为水。岛的面积等于其中陆地格子的个数。找出面积最大的岛并把面积写出来。整张网格都没有陆地时，写出 0。
695.en: Read a grid that is not empty. Every cell holds either the digit 0 or the digit 1. A 1 stands for land and a 0 stands for water. Land cells that share a full side, whether above, below, left, or right, belong to one island. Meeting only at a corner does not connect them. Treat everything beyond the four borders as water. An island's area equals how many land cells it holds. Find the island whose area is largest and write that area. When the grid contains no land at all, write 0.

696.zh: 读入一条只由字符 0 和字符 1 构成的字符串。统计有多少个非空的连续片段同时满足两点：片段中 0 的个数与 1 的个数相同，而且全部的 0 挤在一起、全部的 1 也挤在一起。同一片段在不同起点出现，就要按出现次数累加。写出这个总数。字符串长度在 1 到 50000 之间。
696.en: Read a string built only from the character 0 and the character 1. Count the non-empty contiguous pieces that meet two conditions at once: the piece holds equally many zeros and ones, and its zeros sit together in one block while its ones sit together in another block. When the same piece starts at several places, add one for each place. Write the resulting total. The string length is between 1 and 50000.

697.zh: 读入一列非空的非负整数。把某个数值出现次数的最大值称作这一列的度。找出一段连续下标，使这段自己的度与整列的度相同，并且这段的长度在所有满足条件的段里最短。写出该最短长度。整列长度在 1 到 50000 之间，每个整数在 0 到 49999 之间。
697.en: Read a non-empty column of non-negative integers. Call the degree of a column the greatest number of times any one value shows up. Find a block of consecutive indexes whose own degree equals the degree of the full column, and whose length is the shortest among every block that qualifies. Write that shortest length. The column length is between 1 and 50000, and each integer is between 0 and 49999.

699.zh: 在一条无限延伸的横轴上，按给出的先后放下正方形。每个正方形给出左端横坐标和边长，底边与横轴平行，并从高于一切已停稳方块的位置落下。必须等前一个完全停住，才开始下一个。黏性只在底边：只要与横轴或其他方块的接触长度为正就会固定住，侧面相贴不会提前粘上。每放完一个，记录此刻已停稳方块的最大高度。按放下顺序写出这些高度。方块个数从 1 到 1000，左端从 1 到 10^8，边长从 1 到 10^6。
699.en: On a horizontal axis that extends without end, drop squares in the listed sequence. Each square gives the horizontal coordinate of its left side and the length of a side. Its bottom stays parallel to the axis, and it falls from higher than every square that has already come to rest. Wait until the previous square has fully stopped before starting the next. Stickiness exists only on the bottom: it locks onto the axis or another square whenever the touching length is positive, while sides that merely meet do not lock early. After each drop, record the tallest height among squares now at rest. Write those heights in the same sequence as the drops. There are from 1 to 1000 squares, each left coordinate is from 1 to 10^8, and each side length is from 1 to 10^6.

700.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树的根，再读入整数 val。在树中寻找存放的数恰好等于 val 的结点。找到则写出以该结点为根的子树，找不到则写出空。结点个数在 1 到 5000 之间。每个结点里的数以及 val 都在 1 到 10000000 之间。输入保证该树是二叉搜索树。
700.en: Read the root pointer of a search tree that keeps its keys in order, and read an integer named val. Search the tree for the node that stores a number equal to val. When the node is found, write the branch whose top is that node. When no node stores that number, write null. The tree has between 1 and 5000 nodes. Every stored number, and val too, lies between 1 and 10000000. The input is guaranteed to be an ordered search tree.

701.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树的根，以及一个要放进去的整数。把该整数插进树中，插完之后整棵树仍须保持二叉搜索树的大小关系。新整数与树上已有的每个结点值都不同，这一点由输入保证。插法若有多种，只要结果仍是合法的二叉搜索树，写出任意一种的根即可。结点个数在 0 到 104 之间，结点值和待插入的整数都在 -108 到 108 之间，并且互不相同。
701.en: Read the root of an ordered search tree and an integer that must be placed into it. Place that integer so the tree still obeys search-tree ordering afterward. The new integer differs from every value already stored, and the input guarantees this. When several placements are valid, write the root of any one that remains a proper search tree. The node count is from 0 to 104. Every node value and the inserted integer lie between -108 and 108, and all of them differ.

703.zh: 做一个对象，在整数流中取出按大小排序后的第 k 大，重复的值按出现次数分别占位，并不是第 k 个不同的值。构造时读入 k 和一开始的整数流。之后每次 add 读入一个整数并放进流里，再写出此刻流中的第 k 大。k 从 1 到 104，初始长度从 0 到 104，流中的整数和每次新加入的值都从 -104 到 104，add 的调用不超过 104 次。每次询问时流里至少已有 k 个整数。
703.en: Make an object that reports the k-th biggest integer in a stream after sorting, where repeated values occupy separate places and the result is not the k-th distinct value.
