Construction reads k and the starting stream. Each later add reads one integer, places it into the stream, and writes the k-th biggest integer in the stream at that moment. k runs from 1 to 104, the starting length runs from 0 to 104, every stream integer and every newly placed value runs from -104 to 104, and add is called at most 104 times. Each query happens only when the stream already holds at least k integers.

704.zh: 读入长度为 n 的整数数组，数组已按从小到大排好，元素彼此不同，同时读入一个目标整数。在数组中寻找该目标。若目标出现，写出它的下标；若从未出现，写出 -1。n 位于 1 到 10000 的闭区间，每个元素位于 -9999 到 9999 的闭区间。下标从 0 起算。
704.en: Read an integer array whose length is n. The array is already arranged from smaller values to larger values, and the elements differ from one another. Also read one target integer. Look through the array for that target. If the target occurs, write its index. If it never occurs, write -1. n sits in the closed interval from 1 to 10000, and every element sits in the closed interval from -9999 to 9999. Indexes begin at 0.

705.zh: 自己做一个整数集合，禁止调用语言内置的哈希集合。要能完成三件事：把一个整数放进集合，同一个整数再次放入时仍只保留一份；询问某个整数此刻是否在集合中，在则写真，不在则写假；把某个整数移出集合，若集合里本来没有它就保持原样。涉及的整数都在 0 到 1000000 之间，操作次数合计在 1 到 10000 之间。
705.en: Make an integer collection on your own, and do not call a built-in hash collection from the language. It must do three things: put an integer into the collection, retaining a single copy when that integer is put again; ask whether an integer is in the collection now, writing true if so and false if not; take an integer out of the collection, leaving everything as it was when the integer was already missing. Integers involved lie between 0 and 1000000. The combined number of operations lies between 1 and 10000.

706.zh: 自己做一张从整数键到整数值的表，禁止调用语言内置的哈希表。put 收到键和值时，键若是首次出现就存下这一对，键若已有记录就改成新值。get 收到键时，表中有该键就写出对应值，没有就写出 -1。remove 收到键时，表中有该键就删去记录，没有就什么都不改。键和值都在 0 到 1000000 之间，操作次数合计在 1 到 10000 之间。
706.en: Make a table from integer keys to integer values on your own, and do not call a built-in hash table from the language. When put receives a key and a value, store the pair if the key appears for the first time, and change the stored value if a record already exists. When get receives a key, write the paired value if the table holds that key, and write -1 if it does not. When remove receives a key, delete the record if the table holds that key, and change nothing if it does not. Keys and values lie between 0 and 1000000. The combined number of operations lies between 1 and 10000.

707.zh: 实现一条下标从 0 计起的链表，单向或双向都可以。按下标取值，下标非法时写出 -1。在链的最前插入一个值，使新结点成为第一个。在链的最后接上一个值。在指定下标之前插入一个值；下标刚好等于当前长度时接到最后，下标更大时不做任何事。按下标删掉结点，下标非法时链表保持不动。所有的值都在 1 到 1000 之间，操作次数也在 1 到 1000 之间。不要使用语言自带的链表类型。
707.en: Implement a chain of nodes whose indexes start at 0. Either a one-direction chain or a two-direction chain is allowed. Read the value at an index, and write -1 when the index is illegal. Insert a value at the front so the new node becomes the first. Attach a value at the end. Insert a value just before a stated index; attach it at the end when the index equals the current length, and do nothing when the index is greater. Erase the node at an index, and leave the chain untouched when the index is illegal. Every value is between 1 and 1000, and the number of operations is also between 1 and 1000. Do not use a linked-list type supplied by the language.

709.zh: 读入一条字符串，长度在 1 到 100 之间，每个字符都是可打印的 ASCII。逐个查看字符：遇到大写英文字母时，换成该字母对应的小写；数字、空白、标点以及已经是小写的字母都原封不动。按原先顺序拼出新字符串并写出。不要增加或删除字符，也不要挪动任何字符的位置。
709.en: Read one string whose length is between 1 and 100. Every character is printable ASCII. Look at the characters one by one. When you meet an uppercase English letter, switch it to the matching lowercase letter. Digits, whitespace, punctuation, and letters that are already lowercase remain untouched. Join the characters in their previous order and write the new string. Do not add or delete characters, and do not shift any character to another position.

710.zh: 读入正整数 N，以及若干互不相同的黑名单整数，它们都来自半开区间，从 0 开始并且不到 N。每次需要等可能地写出该区间里一个不在黑名单上的整数。区间不包含 N 本身。N 在 1 到 1000000000 之间。黑名单的长度严格小于 100000 与 N 中的较小者，长度也可以是 0。重复抽取时，每个允许的整数应当拥有相同的机会。
710.en: Read a positive integer N and a list of distinct blacklist integers drawn from the half-open interval that begins at 0 and ends before N. Whenever a draw is requested, write an integer from that interval that is missing from the blacklist, with each allowed integer equally likely. The interval does not contain N itself. N is between 1 and 1000000000. The blacklist length is strictly smaller than the lesser of 100000 and N, and the length may be 0. On repeated draws, every permitted integer should have an equal chance.

713.zh: 读入一串正整数以及一个整数 k。数出有多少段连续的下标，使得这段里所有整数的乘积严格小于 k。不包含任何整数的空段不要计入。把数出的段数写出来。数组长度大于 0 并且不超过 50000。每个元素大于 0 并且小于 1000。k 满足大于等于 0 并且小于 10^6。
713.en: Read a sequence of positive integers and one integer k. Count how many blocks of consecutive indexes have a product, taken over every integer in the block, that is strictly smaller than k. Do not count an empty block that holds no integer. Write the number of blocks you counted. The sequence length is greater than 0 and no more than 50000. Each element is greater than 0 and smaller than 1000. k is at least 0 and smaller than 10^6.

714.zh: 读入每天的股票价格，下标就是天数，再读入一笔非负手续费。交易次数不限，但同一时刻最多持有一股，卖出之后才可以再次买入。每完成一次卖出都要付掉这笔手续费。写出能够得到的最大利润。价格的天数大于 0 且至多 50000，每天的价格大于 0 且小于 50000，手续费大于等于 0 且小于 50000。
714.en: Read the price of a share for each day, using the index as the day number, and read one fee that is not negative. Trades may happen any number of times, yet at most one share is held at the same moment, and another buy may happen only after a sale. Every completed sale pays that fee. Write the greatest profit that can be earned. The number of days is greater than 0 and at most 50000. Each day's price is greater than 0 and less than 50000. The fee is at least 0 and less than 50000.

715.zh: 做一个跟踪实数区间的模块，提供三个操作。addRange 给出左右端点，把半开区间中还没被跟踪的每个实数纳入跟踪。queryRange 仅当该半开区间里每个实数都正处于跟踪中时写出真，否则写出假。removeRange 让该半开区间里眼下仍被跟踪的每个实数停止跟踪。半开区间包含左端、不含右端，也就是满足左端小于等于 x 且 x 小于右端的全部实数。每次调用都有 0 小于左端、左端小于右端、右端小于 10^9。同一次测试中，addRange 和 removeRange 各自至多 1000 次，queryRange 至多 5000 次。
715.en: Build a module that follows intervals of real numbers and offers three operations. addRange takes a left end and a right end and begins following every real in that half-open interval which was not followed yet. queryRange writes true only when every real in the half-open interval is followed right now, and writes false in every other case. removeRange makes every real in the interval that is followed right now stop being followed. The half-open interval includes its left end and omits its right end, meaning every real x with left less than or equal to x and x less than right. Every call has 0 less than left, left less than right, and right less than 10^9. Within one test, addRange and removeRange each occur at most 1000 times, and queryRange occurs at most 5000 times.

717.zh: 读入一条只含数字0和1的比特序列，长度在1到1000之间。单独的0算一种符号，10和11各自算另一种符号。整条序列的末尾一定是0。判断每一种符合规则的切分是不是都会把末尾符号切成单独的那个0。若必然如此，写出true，否则写出false。
717.en: Read a sequence of bits whose length is from 1 to 1000. Every bit is either 0 or 1, and the sequence always ends with 0. One symbol is a lone 0. The other symbol is the pair 10 or the pair 11. Decide whether every split that uses only those symbols leaves the final symbol as a lone 0. Write true when that outcome is forced, and write false when some legal split ends with a two-bit symbol.

718.zh: 读入两个整数数组A和B。两个数组的长度都在1到1000之间，每个元素都是大于等于0且小于100的整数。找出A里一段连续片段和B里一段连续片段，使两段的数字与顺序完全一致。写出这样的片段能够达到的最大长度。
718.en: Read two integer arrays called A and B. Each array contains between 1 and 1000 values, and every value is an integer that is at least 0 and strictly less than 100. Find one contiguous block inside A and one contiguous block inside B that hold exactly the same numbers in the same order. Write the greatest length any such matching pair of blocks can reach.

719.zh: 读入整数数组nums以及正整数k。数组长度在2到10000之间，每个元素满足大于等于0且小于1000000。任意两个不同下标组成一对，距离取两数之差的绝对值。k至少为1，并且不超过全部无序对的个数。把所有距离按从小到大排列，写出排在第k位的距离。
719.en: Read an integer array nums and a positive integer k. The array length runs from 2 through 10000, and each entry is an integer in the half-open span from 0 to 1000000. Every unordered pair of distinct indexes has a distance equal to the absolute gap between its two values. The integer k is at least 1 and at most the count of those pairs. Order the distances from smaller to larger and write the distance that occupies position k.

720.zh: 读入小写单词数组words。数组长度在1到1000之间，每个单词长度在1到30之间。一个单词合格，是指从它末尾逐个删掉字母后，得到的每一个更短前缀也都出现在数组中。在合格单词里找出最长的一个；长度并列时取词典顺序更靠前的。若没有合格单词，写出空串。
720.en: Read an array words of lowercase strings. The array holds between 1 and 1000 entries, and each entry has length between 1 and 30. A word qualifies when every shorter prefix obtained by deleting letters only from its end is also present in the array. Among qualifying words, choose the one with the greatest length. If several still tie, choose the one that comes first in dictionary order. Write that word, or write an empty string when nothing qualifies.

721.zh: 读入账户列表accounts。列表长度在1到1000之间，每条含1到10个字符串，每个字符串长度在1到30之间。每条的第一项是姓名，后面是邮箱。两条记录只要共享任意一个邮箱就属于同一个人；仅仅姓名一样并不能合并。同一个人的记录使用同一个姓名。合并后每条以姓名开头，其余邮箱按词典顺序排列，各条之间的先后不限。写出合并结果。
721.en: Read a list of accounts. The list holds between 1 and 1000 records. Each record contains 1 to 10 strings, and each string has length 1 to 30. The opening string is a name and every later string is an email address. Join two records into one person whenever they share at least one address. Equal names by themselves do not force a join. After joining, keep a single name for that person. Write each result with the name first and the addresses in dictionary order. The results may be listed in any sequence.

724.zh: 读入整数数组nums。长度可以是0，至多到10000，每个元素在-1000到1000之间。某个下标称为平衡位置，是指它左边全部数值之和等于它右边全部数值之和，该下标上的数本身两边都不计入。某一侧没有数时，那一侧之和当作0。找出最靠左的平衡位置并写出下标；若不存在，写出-1。
724.en: Read an integer array nums. Its length may be 0 and is at most 10000, and each value lies between -1000 and 1000 inclusive. Call an index balanced when the total of every value strictly before it equals the total of every value strictly after it. The value stored at the index itself is excluded from both totals. A side with no values has total zero. Find the left-most balanced index and write it. Write -1 when the array has no balanced index.

725.zh: 读入一条单向链表和正整数k。链表长度在0到1000之间，结点中的整数在0到999之间，k在1到50之间。按结点原有先后，把链表切成恰好k段连续片段。各段结点数尽量接近，任意两段相差至多1，而且更靠前的段不能短于更靠后的段。链表较短时允许空段。按从前到后的顺序写出这k段。
725.en: Read a singly linked list and an integer k. The list contains between 0 and 1000 nodes, each node stores an integer from 0 through 999, and k is an integer from 1 through 50. Cut the nodes, without changing their order, into exactly k consecutive pieces. Keep the piece lengths as close as possible: any two pieces differ by at most one node, and a piece that occurs earlier is never shorter than a piece that occurs later. Empty pieces are allowed when the list is short. Write the k pieces from front to back.

726.zh: 读入一条化学式，长度在1到1000之间，只含字母、数字和圆括号，并且是合法式子。原子名由一个大写字母开头，后面可跟若干小写字母。数量大于1时，名字或括号后面紧跟数字；数量等于1时不写数字。两段式子直接相连仍是式子，括号包住的式子右侧还可以带倍数。统计每种原子的总数，按名字的词典顺序连成一串：先写名字，数量大于1再写数字，数量为1只写名字，中间不留空格。
726.en: Read a chemical formula whose length is from 1 to 1000. It uses only letters, digits, and round parentheses, and it is valid under these rules. An atom name begins with one uppercase letter and may continue with lowercase letters. A decimal multiplicity is attached to a name or a parenthesized group only when it is greater than one; a multiplicity of one is left unwritten. Joining two formulas makes another formula, and a multiplier may follow a parenthesized formula. Count each atom, then write one string with names in dictionary order. Append a count only when it exceeds one, and insert no spaces.

728.zh: 读入两个整数left和right，满足1小于等于left、left小于等于right、right小于等于10000。在这个闭区间里找出每个正整数，它的十进制写法里没有数字0，而且它可以被自己的每一位数字整除。按从小到大的顺序把这些整数全部写出来。
728.en: Read two integers left and right such that 1 is less than or equal to left, left is less than or equal to right, and right is less than or equal to 10000. Inside that closed interval, find every positive integer whose decimal writing contains no digit 0 and which can be divided evenly by each of its own digits. Write those integers from smallest to largest.

729.zh: 实现一个日程本，它提供book操作。每次读入整数start和end，两者都在0到10^9 之间，表示包含左端点、不含右端点的时段。若该时段与任何已保存时段有公共时间，就拒绝本次，写出false，并且不要保存它。若没有任何重叠，就保存它并写出true。同一组测试里book最多被调用1000次。
729.en: Build a calendar that supports a book operation. Each call reads two integers start and end, both in the range from 0 through 10^9, and names the half-open span that includes the left endpoint and excludes the right endpoint. If the new span shares any time with a span already stored, reject the call, write false, and leave storage unchanged. If there is no overlap, store the span and write true. One test performs at most 1000 book calls.

732.zh: 实现一个总会接受新日程的日历。每次book读入整数start和end，两者都在0到10^9 之间，并加入一段包含左端、不含右端的时间。某个时刻被k段已加入的时间同时覆盖，就形成k重叠加。每次加入之后，写出日历上出现过的最大叠加重数。同一组测试最多调用400次book。
732.en: Build a calendar that always stores the next booking. Each book call reads integers start and end from the range 0 through 10^9 and inserts the half-open span that includes start and excludes end. A depth of k means some moment of time lies inside k stored spans together. After each insertion, write the largest depth that occurs anywhere on the calendar. A single test makes at most 400 book calls.

733.zh: 读入一张整数网格表示的图像、起点行号sr、起点列号sc，以及新颜色newColor。行数和列数都在1到50之间，起点位于网格内部。每个像素以及newColor都是0到65535之间的整数。从起点开始，把原颜色与起点相同、并且只经过上下左右相邻格子就能到达的整片区域改成newColor。斜向相邻不算连通。写出改色之后的整张网格。
733.en: Read an image stored as an integer grid, a starting row sr, a starting column sc, and a replacement color newColor. Both the row count and the column count are from 1 to 50, and the start cell lies inside the grid. Every pixel and newColor is an integer from 0 through 65535. Recolor the start cell together with every cell reachable from it by steps that move only up, down, left, or right through cells whose original color equals the start color. Diagonal neighbors are not connected. Write the full grid after that recoloring.

735.zh: 读入整数数组asteroids，长度最多10000。每个整数都不为0，并且落在-1000到1000之间。绝对值表示体积，正号表示向右飞行，负号表示向左飞行，所有行星速度相同。同向飞行的行星不会相遇。迎面相撞时，体积小的消失；体积一样则两颗一起消失。找出碰撞全部结束后仍留在这一行的行星，按从左到右的顺序写出来。
735.en: Read an array asteroids of at most 10000 nonzero integers, each lying between -1000 and 1000. The absolute value is the size, a positive sign means motion to the right, and a negative sign means motion to the left. All of them travel at one shared speed. Bodies that travel in one shared direction never meet. Bodies that travel toward each other collide: the smaller one disappears, and equal sizes make both disappear. Write the bodies that remain, from left to right, once every collision is over.

739.zh: 读入一串按时间先后排列的每日气温。对其中每一天，只在它之后的日子里寻找第一次严格升高的气温，并写出相隔的天数。如果后面再也没有更高的气温，这一天对应的结果就写成0。按原来的日期顺序，把每一天得到的天数都写出来。
739.en: Read a sequence of daily temperatures stored in chronological order. For each day, look only at later days and find the soonest one whose temperature is strictly higher than the temperature on the current day. Write how many days separate those two dates. When no later day is warmer, write 0 at the current position. Print one integer for every input day and keep the same order as the temperatures you read.

744.zh: 读入已经按字母顺序排好的小写字母数组letters，以及一个目标小写字母target。数组长度在2到10000之间，并且至少包含两个互不相同的字母。找出数组中严格大于target的最小字母。字母表按环形处理：如果没有任何字母大于target，就改选数组里最小的字母。把选中的字母写出来。
744.en: Read a sorted array letters made of lowercase letters, plus one lowercase target letter. The array length is from 2 to 10000, and the array contains at least two letters that differ from each other. Find the smallest letter in the array that is strictly greater than the target. Treat the alphabet as circular: when no letter is greater than the target, select the smallest letter stored in the array instead. Write the letter you selected.

745.zh: 读入小写单词数组words，长度在1到15000之间，每个单词长度在1到10之间。下标为i的单词权重就是i。随后回答至多与单词个数相同的询问。每次询问给出一个前缀和一个后缀，两者长度都在0到10之间，并且只含小写字母。找出同时以该前缀开头、以该后缀结尾的单词中权重最大的一个，写出它的权重。没有匹配时写出-1。
745.en: Read an array words of lowercase strings. Its length is from 1 to 15000, and each word has length from 1 to 10. The word at index i has weight i. Then answer at most one query per word. Each query supplies a prefix and a suffix, both of length from 0 to 10, using lowercase letters only. Find the word of greatest weight that begins with the prefix and ends with the suffix, and write that weight. Write -1 when no word fits both ends.

746.zh: 读入非负整数数组cost，长度在2到1000之间，每一项花费在0到999之间。下标i是第i级台阶的费用。踏上某一级就必须支付对应费用，支付之后可以再向上跨一级或者跨两级。出发时可以站在下标0或者下标1，出发的那一级同样要付费。楼顶位于最后一级的上方。找出到达楼顶的最小总费用并写出来。
746.en: Read an array cost of nonnegative integers. Its length is from 2 to 1000, and every entry is an integer from 0 through 999. Paying the value at index i lets you step onto stair i. After that payment you may move up either one stair or two stairs. You may start at index 0 or at index 1, and the stair where you start must be paid too. The top of the staircase lies just beyond the final index. Find the smallest total payment that reaches the top and write it.

747.zh: 读入整数数组nums。数组长度在1到50之间，每个元素在0到100之间，而且其中最大的数值恰好只出现一次。判断这个唯一的最大值是否至少达到数组里其余每一个数的两倍。如果是，写出该最大值所在的下标；如果有别的数超过了它的一半，写出-1。
747.en: Read an integer array nums whose length is between 1 and 50. Every entry is an integer from 0 through 100, and the largest value occurs exactly once in the array. Check whether that unique maximum is at least twice as large as every remaining entry. If the check succeeds, write the index where the maximum sits. If some other entry is larger than half of the maximum, write -1.

748.zh: 读入牌照字符串licensePlate和单词数组words。牌照长度在1到7之间，可以包含数字、空格以及大小写字母。单词个数在10到1000之间，每个单词由1到15个小写字母组成。比较时忽略牌照中的数字、空格和大小写，只统计字母，某种字母出现几次，单词里就必须至少出现几次。找出满足这些次数的最短单词；长度相同则取数组中更靠前的一个。答案保证存在。写出该单词。
748.en: Read a license plate string and an array of words. The plate length is from 1 to 7 and may include digits, spaces, and letters of either case. The array length is from 10 to 1000, and every word is lowercase with length from 1 to 15. Ignore digits, spaces, and letter case on the plate. Each remaining letter must occur in the chosen word at least as often as it occurs on the plate. Find the shortest word that meets those counts. If several words share that shortest length, choose the earlier one in the array. Some answer is guaranteed. Write the chosen word.

752.zh: 有一把四位数字转盘锁，每一位都是0到9。从9再向前一格回到0，从0再向后一格回到9。初始显示为0000，每次只能转动其中一位一格。读入死亡组合列表deadends，长度在1到500之间，每项都是四位数字；再读入四位目标target，并且target不在死亡列表中。一旦显示变成死亡组合，锁就永久卡住。找出从初始显示到达target的最少转动次数；无法到达时写出-1。
752.en: A lock shows four digits, and each digit runs from 0 through 9. Moving forward from 9 wraps to 0, and moving backward from 0 wraps to 9. The display starts at 0000, and one move changes a single digit by one step. Read a list deadends containing 1 to 500 forbidden codes, each code using four digits, and read a four-digit target that is absent from that list. Reaching a forbidden code freezes the lock permanently. Find the fewest moves that change the start display into the target. Write -1 when every route is blocked.

753.zh: 保险箱的密码是长度为n的数字串，每一位取自0到k减1。n是1到4的整数，k是1到10的整数，并且k的n次方不超过4096。连续输入数字时，机器只用最近的n位与真正密码比较。写出一条最短的数字串，使每一种可能的密码都作为其中一段连续的n位出现过。任意一条达到最短的串都可以。
753.en: A safe password is a string of n digits, and each digit is chosen from 0 through k minus 1. The integer n lies from 1 to 4, the integer k lies from 1 to 10, and k raised to the power n is at most 4096. While digits are typed in one stream, the safe checks only the latest n digits against the secret. Write one shortest digit string such that every possible password occurs as some contiguous block of length n. Any string that achieves this shortest length is acceptable.

756.zh: 用单个字母表示的方块从下往上垒一座金字塔。读入底层字符串bottom，长度在2到8之间，以及允许规则列表allowed，长度在0到200之间。每条规则是长度为3的字符串，其中字母只来自A到G。规则ABC表示左下方为A、右下方为B时，可以在二者正上方放上C。往上一层就比下一层少一块，直到顶端只剩一块。判断能否垒到这个顶端。能则写出true，不能则写出false。
756.en: Stack blocks whose colors are single letters into a pyramid. Read a bottom row as a string of length 2 to 8, and read a list allowed of 0 to 200 rules. Each rule is a string of length 3, and every letter is chosen from A through G. A rule ABC allows block C to sit directly above the neighboring pair with A on the left and B on the right. Every higher row contains one fewer block than the row beneath it, until only one cap block remains. Decide whether some placement reaches that cap. Write true or write false.

762.zh: 读入两个整数L和R，满足1小于等于L、L小于等于R，并且两者都不超过10^6，同时R减L最多为10000。对闭区间中的每个整数，统计它的二进制写法里数字1的个数。若这个个数本身是质数，就把该整数算进去。注意1不是质数。写出被算进去的整数一共有多少个。
762.en: Read two integers L and R such that 1 is less than or equal to L, L is less than or equal to R, both values are at most 10^6, and R minus L is at most 10000. For every integer in that closed interval, count how many bits equal 1 in its binary writing. Keep the integer when that count is a prime number. Remember that the number 1 is not prime. Write how many integers are kept.

763.zh: 读入一条只由小写字母组成的字符串S，长度在1到500之间。把S切成若干段连续片段，片段数量要尽可能多，同时每一种字母最多只能出现在其中一个片段里，即使它在该片段内部重复也仍然算同一种。保持从左到右的原有顺序，写出每个片段包含的字符个数。
763.en: Read a string S that contains only lowercase letters and whose length is from 1 to 500. Divide S into contiguous pieces and use as many pieces as the following rule allows. Each letter of the alphabet may occur in at most one piece, even when that letter is repeated inside its own piece. Keep the original left-to-right order of the text. Write the number of characters in each piece.

765.zh: 有N对情侣坐在一排共2N个座位上。人和座位都用0到2N减1的整数编号，第i对情侣的编号是2i与2i加1。读入数组row，它的长度是4到60之间的偶数，而且它是从0到长度减1的一个排列。row里下标i存放的是开场时占据该座位的那个人的编号。一次操作可以让任意两个人对调座位。找出让每一对都坐到相邻座位所需的最少操作次数并写出来。
765.en: N couples sit in one row of 2N seats. People and seats use integers from 0 through 2N minus 1, and couple number i is the pair of ids 2i and 2i plus 1. Read an array row whose length is an even integer from 4 through 60. The array is a permutation of the integers from 0 through its length minus 1, and the value at index i is the person who starts in seat i. One operation lets any two people trade seats. Find the fewest operations that put every couple into a pair of neighboring seats, and write that count.

766.zh: 读入一个由整数构成的矩阵。它的行数和列数各自落在1到20这个闭区间内，矩阵里的每个数都落在0到99。如果每一条从左上角走向右下角的斜线上，出现的数字全都相同，就把这个矩阵叫作托普利茨矩阵。判断读入的矩阵是否具备这一性质。具备就写出true，不具备就写出false。
766.en: Read a matrix of integers. Its row count and its column count each lie between 1 and 20, and every entry is an integer from 0 through 99. Call the matrix Toeplitz when each diagonal that runs from the upper left toward the lower right holds only one repeated value. Decide whether the matrix you read has that property. Write true when it does, and write false when it does not.

767.zh: 读入一条只由小写字母构成的字符串S，长度落在1到500之间。把这些字母重新排成一条新的字符串，要求任意两个相邻位置上的字母都不一样。只要存在至少一种满足要求的排法，就写出其中任意一种。如果每种排法都会让某处相邻字母相同，就写出一个空字符串。
767.en: Read a string S made of lowercase letters, with length from 1 to 500. Rearrange those same letters into a new string so that no two positions that touch each other hold equal letters. If one or more valid rearrangements exist, write any one of them. If every rearrangement still places two equal letters side by side somewhere, write an empty string.

771.zh: 读入两个只含字母的字符串J和S，各自长度最多为50。J中的字符互不相同，每个字符表示一种宝石。S中的每个字符表示你持有的一颗石头。大写字母和小写字母算作不同种类，因此a与A不能互相匹配。统计S里有多少颗石头的种类也出现在J中，把这个数量写出来。
771.en: Read two strings J and S. Both contain only letters, and each string has length at most 50. Every character in J is unique and names one jewel type. Every character in S stands for one stone that you hold. Treat uppercase and lowercase as different types, so the letter a does not match the letter A. Count how many stones have a type that is also named in J, and write that count.

775.zh: 读入一条排列，长度至多5000，里面的整数恰好是从零排到长度减一的全体。若两个下标左小右大，而左边存放的数反而更大，这一对就算远距逆序。只比较紧邻的两个位置时，则叫做邻位逆序。统计这两种逆序各自出现了多少次。判断两个总数是否相同，相同就写出真，不同就写出假。
775.en: Read a permutation of length at most 5000 whose entries are exactly the integers from zero up to one less than that length. A distant inversion is any index pair with the left index smaller while the stored value on the left is larger. A neighbor inversion uses the same comparison but only on positions that sit side by side. Count both kinds. Write true when the two counts are equal and write false when they differ.

778.zh: 读入边长介于2与50之间的正方形高度表。表中各格互不相同，并且正好用完从零到边长平方减一的全部整数。时刻每增加一，各处水面就一起升高到该时刻。只有当相邻且共边的两格高度都不超过当前水面时，才可以从一格跨到另一格，格内移动不计额外时间，也不能越出边界。从左上角出发，找出最早能够站上右下角的时刻并写出来。
778.en: Read a square elevation table whose side length N lies between 2 and 50. The cells hold distinct integers and together they are exactly 0 through N squared minus 1. At each moment the water surface equals that moment everywhere. A step between cells that share a side is legal only while both elevations sit at or below the surface, movement inside a cell costs nothing, and the path must stay inside the table. Begin at the upper left cell and write the earliest moment the lower right cell becomes reachable.

781.zh: 读入至多1000个回答，每个回答都是0到999的整数。开口的兔子说出，除自己以外还有多少只与它同色。同一颜色里凡是开口的兔子，报出的数目必须一致，没开口的兔子则不产生记录。找出一种与全部回答都不矛盾的颜色分配，使兔子的总只数最小，并把这个最小只数写出来。
781.en: Read at most 1000 answers, each an integer from 0 through 999. A rabbit that speaks states how many companions share its color, not counting itself. Every speaker of one color must state the same companion count, while silent rabbits leave no record. Find a color assignment that agrees with every answer and uses as few rabbits as possible, then write that smallest total.

783.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树。树上结点个数介于2和100之间，每个结点保存的整数介于0和100000之间。从树上任取两个不同结点，计算它们所存数值相差的绝对值。在所有这样的取法里找出最小的差值，并把这个差值写出来。
783.en: Read a binary search tree holding between 2 and 100 nodes. Each node stores an integer from 0 through 100000. Select any two different nodes and compute the absolute gap between the integers they store. Among every such selection, find the smallest gap and write it.

784.zh: 读入一条长度介于1和12之间的字符串，字符只能是英文字母或数字。数字一律原样留下。每个字母都可以单独决定写成小写或大写，各个字母的决定互不牵连。把所有能够得到的不同字符串都找齐，按任意顺序写成一份清单。
784.en: Read a string whose length is from 1 to 12 and whose characters are only letters or digits. Leave every digit exactly as it stands. Each letter may be written in lowercase or uppercase on its own, and one letter's choice never constrains another. Collect every distinct string those choices can produce and write the collection in any order.

785.zh: 读入一张无向图的邻接表，结点个数介于1和100之间，编号从零连续排到个数减一。任何结点的邻居列表都不包含它自己，也不重复登记同一个邻居。若甲出现在乙的列表里，乙也一定出现在甲的列表里。判断能否把全部结点分成两组，使每条边的两端分属不同的组。能分成就写出真，不能就写出假。
785.en: Read an undirected graph given by neighbor lists. The node count is from 1 to 100, and labels run from zero through that count minus one. No list contains its own label, no neighbor is listed twice, and a link recorded from one end is also recorded from the other. Decide whether the nodes can be partitioned into two camps so that every link joins different camps. Write true if they can and false if they cannot.

786.zh: 读入一张已经从小到大排好的整数表，长度介于2和2000之间，每个整数介于1和30000之间，表里含有1以及若干质数。凡是左值严格小于右值的两数，都组成一个分数。把全部分数按从小到大的次序排好，再读入名次K，K至少为1，至多等于配对数。找出排在第K位的分数，把分子和分母作为两个整数写出来。
786.en: Read an ascending list of integers whose length is from 2 to 2000. Each integer is from 1 to 30000, and the list contains 1 plus some primes. Every pair with the left value strictly smaller than the right value forms a fraction. Also read a rank K that is at least 1 and at most the number of pairs. Order the fractions from smaller to larger, find the fraction sitting at rank K, and write its numerator and denominator as two integers.

791.zh: 读入两条仅由小写字母构成的字符串。第一条称为顺序串，长度至多26，每个字母至多出现一次。第二条称为待排串，长度至多200。重排待排串的字符时，若某字母在顺序串中更靠左，它在结果中也必须更靠左。顺序串里没有的字母，位置可以自由安排。写出任意一条满足上述先后关系的重排结果。
791.en: Read two strings made only of lowercase letters. The first is an order key of length at most 26 in which no letter repeats. The second is a body of length at most 200. While rearranging the body, a letter that stands further left in the order key must also stand further left in the result. Letters missing from the order key may be placed freely. Write any rearrangement that respects this precedence.

792.zh: 读入一条只含小写字母的主串，再读入至多5000条同样只含小写字母的单词，每条单词的长度至多50。若能从主串里删掉若干字符（也可以一个都不删），使剩下的字符按原相对次序拼成该单词，这个单词就算匹配。统计匹配成功的单词有多少条，并把这个条数写出来。
792.en: Read one main string of lowercase letters, then read at most 5000 words that are also lowercase, each of length at most 50. A word matches when deleting some characters from the main string, possibly deleting none, leaves exactly that word with the surviving characters still in their original relative order. Count the matching words and write the count.

793.zh: 把非负整数x的阶乘在十进制写法里末尾连续的零的个数记为函数值，并约定零的阶乘等于一。读入整数K，K落在从0到1000000000的闭区间里。找出有多少个非负整数x的函数值恰好等于K，并把这个个数写出来。
793.en: Let the score of a nonnegative integer x be how many zeros sit at the end of x factorial written in base ten, and treat the factorial of zero as one. Read an integer K from the closed interval that runs from 0 through 10^9. Count how many nonnegative integers x have a score exactly equal to K, and write that count.

794.zh: 读入三行三列的井字棋局面，每格只能是空格、字母X或字母O。两名玩家轮流把符号放进空格，先手永远放置X，后手永远放置O，已经有符号的格子不能再填。某一行、某一列或某一条对角线被三个相同的非空符号占满时，对局立刻结束；格子全部非空时也对局结束。结束后不允许再放置。判断这个局面是否可能在一盘遵守规则的对局里出现，可能就写出真，否则写出假。
794.en: Read a three by three tic-tac-toe position. Each cell is a space, the letter X, or the letter O. Players alternate filling empty cells, the opener always places X, the follower always places O, and an occupied cell stays untouched. Play ends at once when one row, one column, or one diagonal is filled by three matching non-space marks, and it also ends when no cell remains empty. After the end, no further placement is allowed. Decide whether this position can arise in a rule-following game. Write true if it can and false if it cannot.

795.zh: 读入一串整数，长度介于1和50000之间。再读入左右两个界限，界限与串中每个整数都落在0到109之间，而且左界限不大于右界限。考察每一段连续且至少含有一个元素的片段。若片段中的最大元素不小于左界限，同时也不大于右界限，该片段就算合格。统计合格片段的个数并写出来。
795.en: Read a list of integers whose length is from 1 to 50000, plus two bounds called left and right. Both bounds and every list entry lie in 0 through 109, and left is no greater than right. Look at every contiguous fragment that contains at least one entry. A fragment qualifies when its biggest entry is no smaller than left while also staying no larger than right. Count the qualifying fragments and write the count.

802.zh: 读入一张有向图，结点至多10000个，边至多32000条。编号从零排到结点个数减一，每个结点的出边列表已经按升序排好，并且列表里的编号互不相同。从某结点出发，每一步都必须沿着一条出边前进。若无论之后如何选择路线，走过有限步之后都一定会停在没有出边的结点上，则该起点是最终安全的。找出全部最终安全的结点，按编号从小到大写成一个数组。
802.en: Read a directed graph with at most 10000 nodes and at most 32000 edges. Labels run from zero through the node count minus one. Each node's outgoing list is sorted increasingly and holds distinct labels. From a chosen start, every step must follow one outgoing edge. The start is eventually safe when every possible continuation is forced to halt, after finitely many steps, on a node that has no outgoing edge. Find every eventually safe node and write the labels in increasing order.

803.zh: 读入由0和1构成的网格，行数与列数都介于1和200之间，其中1表示砖块。一块砖不会落下，仅当它直接挨着网格顶边，或者上下左右至少一个邻居是本身不会落下的砖。再按顺序读入若干次消除，次数不超过格子总数，每次位置互不相同且都在网格内部。处理一次消除时，若该格有砖就先去掉，然后统计因此新落下的砖块数目；该格本来没有砖则落下数目为零。按处理顺序把每次的落下数目写成一个数组。
803.en: Read a grid of zeros and ones with both dimensions from 1 to 200, where a one marks a brick. A brick stays put only if it touches the top border, or if at least one neighbor sharing a side is a brick that itself stays put. Then read a sequence of erasures, no longer than the cell count, each at a distinct cell inside the grid. On an erasure, remove the brick if one is present and count how many other bricks newly fall; an empty cell causes a count of zero. Write those counts in the same sequence.

807.zh: 读入一座边长介于2和50之间的方形城区，每格一栋楼，高度是0到100的整数，高度为零也算楼。从北、东、南、西看过去，天际线由该方向每条视线上最高的楼构成。允许把任意几栋楼各自加高任意的非负高度，但四个方向看到的天际线都必须与原来完全一致。找出全部加高量之和能够达到的最大值，并把这个和写出来。
807.en: Read a square city whose side length is from 2 to 50. Each cell holds one building whose height is an integer from 0 through 100, and a height of zero still counts as a building. From the north, east, south, or west, the skyline is formed by the tallest building on each line of sight. Any collection of buildings may be raised by any nonnegative amounts, yet the skyline seen from all four directions must stay exactly the same. Find the greatest possible sum of the raises and write that sum.

810.zh: 读入黑板上的若干非负整数，个数介于1和1000之间，每个数不超过2的16次方。Alice先行动，双方轮流擦掉恰好一个数。若某次擦除使剩下所有数的按位异或变为0，执行这次擦除的人判负。只剩一个数时，异或结果就是该数本身；一个数都不剩时，异或结果视为0。轮到某人而当前异或已经是0，则该人直接获胜。假定双方每一步都选对自己最有利的做法，判断Alice是否必胜，必胜写出真，否则写出假。
810.en: Read nonnegative integers on a chalkboard. Their count is from 1 to 1000, and each integer is at most two to the power 16. Alice acts first, and the players alternate erasing exactly one integer. A player loses upon making an erasure that leaves a bitwise exclusive-or of zero. With one integer left, that exclusive-or is the integer itself; with none left, it is treated as zero. A player who begins a turn while the exclusive-or is already zero wins immediately. Assume each side always chooses the move most favorable to itself. Write true when Alice has a forced win and false otherwise.

811.zh: 读入至多100条访问记录。每条记录是一个不超过10000的次数、一个空格，然后是一个域名。域名长度至多100，并且恰好包含一个或两个英文句点。访问某个域名时，把它左侧逐级去掉得到的每一个父域名，都要加上同样的次数。把所有出现过的域名连同各自累计次数都找出来，按次数、空格、域名的格式输出，排列顺序不限。
811.en: Read at most 100 visit records. Each record holds a count of at most 10000, one space, and then a domain. A domain has length at most 100 and contains exactly one or two periods. Visiting a domain also adds the same count to every parent obtained by dropping labels from the left, one label at a time. Find every domain that shows up, together with its summed count, and write lines of count, space, and domain in any order.

812.zh: 读入平面上3到50个互不重合的点，每个点的横纵坐标都是负50到50之间的整数。任意挑选三个点，当它们不共线时计算所围三角形的面积。在所有能围成的三角形里找出面积最大的一个，并把这个面积写出来。写出的数值与精确值相差不超过10的负6次方即算正确。
812.en: Read 3 to 50 points in the plane, with no two points occupying the same place. Each coordinate is an integer from -50 through 50. Pick any three points and, when they are not collinear, compute the area of the triangle they enclose. Find the largest such area and write it. A written number that differs from the exact area by at most 10 to the power of -6 counts as correct.

815.zh: 读入1到500条公交线路，每条线路列出1到500个车站，车站编号是小于1000000的非负整数。每条线路上的车按列表顺序循环不停。人从车站S出发，开始时没有乘坐任何车，只能通过上车前往车站T。每登上一条线路的车计一次。找出到达T所需的最少上车次数并写出来；如果无法到达，就写出负一。
815.en: Read from 1 to 500 bus routes. Each route lists from 1 to 500 stops, and every stop number is a nonnegative integer below 10^6. The vehicle on a route cycles through that list without end. A traveler begins at stop S while aboard nothing and may move toward stop T only by boarding. Each boarding of a route counts once. Write the smallest number of boardings that reaches T, or write -1 if T is unreachable.

816.zh: 读入一条长度介于4和12之间的字符串。它以左括号开头、以右括号结尾，中间只剩数字。这些数字原先组成一组平面坐标，分隔符、小数圆点以及空白都已被拿掉。还原时两个数之间必须先写逗号，紧接着再写一个空格。圆点前面至少要有一位数字，也不能留下无意义的前导零或末尾零，因此00、0.0、1.0以及以圆点开头的写法都不允许。找出所有可能的原始坐标写法，按任意顺序列出来。
816.en: Read a string of length 4 to 12. It starts with a left parenthesis, ends with a right parenthesis, and contains only digits in the middle. Those digits once formed a pair of plane coordinates after commas, decimal points, and spaces were deleted. Restore pairs with exactly one space following the comma. A decimal point must be preceded by at least one digit, and no extra zero may remain, so 00, 0.0, 1.0, and a form that opens with a point are all illegal. List every possible original writing in any order.

817.zh: 读入一条结点值互不相同的链表。设长度为N，则N介于1和10000之间，每个结点的值取自0到N减一。再读入这些值的一个子集，子集大小同样介于1和10000之间。子集中的两个值若在链表里占据相邻结点，就看成彼此相连。找出这些值在链表上被分成了多少段互不相邻的连续组件，并把段数写出来。
817.en: Read a linked list whose node values are all different. Let N be its length: N is from 1 to 10000, and each value is chosen from 0 through N minus 1. Also read a subset of those values whose size is likewise from 1 to 10000. Two subset values are linked when they occupy neighboring nodes. Find how many separate contiguous runs those values form along the list, and write the number of runs.

819.zh: 读入一段长度介于1和1000之间的文字，以及至多100个被禁单词。文字只含字母、空格和感叹号、问号、单引号、逗号、分号，不含连字符。每个被禁单词长度介于1和10之间，已经是小写且不带标点。统计时忽略大小写。挑出出现得最频繁、同时没有被列入禁词表的那个词。题目保证这样的词存在而且只有一个。把该词全部用小写写出来。
819.en: Read a paragraph of length 1 to 1000 and a banned list of at most 100 words. The paragraph contains only letters, spaces, and the marks exclamation, question, apostrophe, comma, and semicolon, with no hyphen. Each banned word has length 1 to 10, is already lowercase, and has no punctuation. Ignore case while counting. Find the word that occurs most often and is absent from the banned list. The task guarantees that this word exists and is unique. Write it entirely in lowercase.

820.zh: 读入1到2000个只含小写字母的单词，每个单词的长度介于1和7之间。一份编码包含一条以井号结束的参考串，以及与单词条数相同的一组下标。对每个单词，从它对应的下标开始，一直读到下一个井号之前（不含井号），得到的片段必须与该单词完全相同。找出能够覆盖全部单词的最短参考串，把它的长度写出来。
820.en: Read from 1 to 2000 words made only of lowercase letters, each of length 1 to 7. An encoding pairs a reference string that ends in a hash mark with one index per word. For every word, the slice that starts at its index and stops before the next hash mark, not including the mark, must equal that word exactly. Find a shortest reference string that covers every word and write the length of that string.

821.zh: 读入一条长度介于1和104之间、只含小写字母的字符串，再读入一个小写字母c，c在串中至少出现一次。对字符串的每一个位置，找出它离最近的c有多远：位置本身就是c时距离记为0，否则距离是下标之差的绝对值。按从左到右的顺序，把每个位置的最短距离写成一个整数数组。
821.en: Read a lowercase string of length 1 to 104, plus one lowercase letter c that occurs at least once. For every index, find how far it sits from the nearest c: the distance is 0 when that index itself holds c, and otherwise it is the absolute difference of the indexes. Write those shortest distances from left to right as a list of integers.

823.zh: 读入1到1000个彼此不同的整数，每个整数都大于1，并且不超过10^9。拿这些整数来搭二叉树，同一整数允许在多处结点上反复出现。凡是带有孩子的结点，其存放的数值必须等于两个孩子数值相乘。数一数符合上述乘法关系的树共有几棵。结果可能很大，先对10^9加7取模，再把余数写出来。
823.en: Read from 1 to 1000 distinct integers, each greater than 1 and at most 10^9. Build binary trees from these integers, and any integer may be used any number of times. Every non-leaf must store the product of the integers stored by its two children. Count how many such trees exist. The count may be huge, so reduce it modulo 10^9 plus 7 and write the remainder.

825.zh: 读入若干人的年龄，人数等于数组长度，介于1和2乘10000之间，每个年龄是1到120的整数。记两名不同用户为x与y。只要下面任一情况成立，x就不会向y发出好友请求：y的年龄不超过x的年龄的一半再加7，y的年龄大于x，或者y超过100而x小于100。其余情况下x会发出请求。请求不必被回送，也不能发给自己。统计产生的请求总数并写出来。
825.en: Read ages for several people. The count equals the array length and lies between 1 and 2 times 10^4, and each age is an integer from 1 to 120. Let x and y be two different users. User x sends y no friend request when any of the following holds: the age of y is at most half the age of x plus 7, the age of y exceeds the age of x, or y is above 100 while x is below 100. In every remaining case x does send a request. Requests need not be answered, and nobody messages themself. Count every request and write the total.

826.zh: 读入若干份工作的难度与收益，两份清单长度相等，介于1和10000之间。再读入若干名工人的能力，人数同样介于1和10000之间。难度、收益和能力都是1到100000之间的整数。每名工人最多承担一份难度不超过自己能力的工作，同一份工作可以被多名工人各自完成一次。承担不了任何工作的人收益记为零。找出全体工人收益之和的最大值并写出来。
826.en: Read difficulties and profits for several jobs, two lists of equal length from 1 to 10000. Also read abilities for several workers, with a worker count likewise from 1 to 10000. Each difficulty, profit, and ability is an integer from 1 through 10^5. Every worker takes at most one job whose difficulty does not exceed that worker's ability, and one job may be completed once by each of many workers. A worker who can take nothing earns zero. Find the largest sum of earnings and write that sum.

828.zh: 读入一条只含大写英文字母的字符串，长度介于0和10000之间。在某一段连续子串里，若某个字母恰好出现一次，它就算这段的独特字母。把每一段非空子串所含独特字母的个数全部加起来。内容相同但起止位置不同的子串要分别计算。总和可能非常大，先对10^9加7取模，再把余数写出来。
828.en: Read a string of uppercase English letters whose length is from 0 to 10^4. Inside one contiguous piece, a letter is distinctive when it appears exactly once in that piece. Add, across every nonempty piece, how many distinctive letters it holds. Pieces with the same text but different endpoints are counted apart. The total may be very large, so reduce it modulo 10^9 plus 7 and write the remainder.

830.zh: 从一串只含小写英文字母的文本里划分区段，文本长度至少为 1、最多为 1000。同一区段里的字母必须相同，而且这些字母的位置要紧挨在一起。每个区段用一对下标表示，左端与右端都算进去。找出所有跨度达到三个字母及以上的区段，按左端下标从小到大写出这些下标对。更短的区段不要写入答案。
830.en: Read a string that uses only lowercase English letters. The length is at least 1 and at most 1000. Split it into runs of identical letters that sit side by side. Describe each run with a closed index pair covering its first character and its last character. Keep a run only when it holds three or more letters. Order the kept pairs by rising start index and write that list. Drop every shorter run.

832.zh: 读入一张正方形的黑白图，边长至少为 1、至多为 20，每个格子只写 0 或 1，行数与列数相同。先把每一横排的格子左右颠倒过来，再把格子里的 0 改写成 1、把 1 改写成 0。两步都做完以后，把整张图按原有的行列规模写出来，格子里的数值只按上述规则改写。
832.en: Read a square binary picture whose side length is at least 1 and at most 20. Every entry is either 0 or 1, and the row count equals the column count. First reverse each row so the left end and the right end trade places. Then swap every 0 for a 1 and every 1 for a 0. Write the picture that remains after both changes. Do not change the size of the picture.

834.zh: 读入一棵没有方向、而且整棵连在一起的树。结点用 0 到 N 减 1 编号，边的条数正好是 N 减 1，N 的范围是 1 到 10000。每条边给出它连接的两个编号。两点之间的距离等于路径上经过的边数。对每个结点，把到其余结点的距离全部相加。按编号从小到大，写出这 N 个和。
834.en: Read one undirected tree that is connected. Nodes carry labels 0, 1, and so on up to N minus 1. There are exactly N minus 1 edges, and N is at least 1 and at most 10000. Each edge joins the two node labels stored in that pair. For a node, distance means how many edges lie on the unique path to another node. Add those distances over every other node. Write N sums, one per label, from the smallest label to the largest.

836.zh: 读入两个边与坐标轴平行的矩形。每个矩形用四个整数写出左下角和右上角，所有坐标都落在负 1000000000 到正 1000000000 这一段里。若公共部分的面积严格大于零，判定二者重叠并写出真。仅仅边贴着边，或者只碰到一个角时，公共面积是零，这时写出假。
836.en: Read two axis-aligned rectangles. Each one is four integers naming the lower left corner and then the upper right corner. Every coordinate is an integer from -1000000000 through 1000000000. They conflict when the area they share is strictly positive. Touching only along a side or only at a corner shares area zero, so that case is not a conflict. Write true when they conflict and write false otherwise. Edges stay parallel to the axes.

838.zh: 读入一排骨牌的起始姿态，长度 N 可以是 0，也可以大到 100000。字符只允许 L、R 和圆点。L 表示这块已经朝左推倒，R 表示朝右推倒，圆点表示还立着。每过一秒，朝左倒的会碰倒紧挨在左边、仍然立着的那一块，朝右则碰右边。一块立着的牌若左右同时被推，就保持立着。已经在倒的牌不会再给别的正在倒的牌追加推力。全部静止后，把姿态写成一串字符。
838.en: Read a line of upright tiles encoded as a string whose length N runs from 0 to 100000. The only characters are L, R, and a dot. L means that piece was shoved left, R means it was shoved right, and a dot means it is still vertical. Each second, a piece tipping left knocks the vertical neighbor on its left, and a piece tipping right knocks the vertical neighbor on its right. A vertical piece pushed from both sides at once stays upright. A piece already tipping adds no further shove onto another tipping piece. Write the string once every piece has stopped moving.

839.zh: 读入一组互不重复的小写单词。它们长短一致，而且彼此只是字母次序不同。单词个数至多 2000，单个单词长度至多 1000，二者相乘不超过 20000。若把甲词里两个位置不同的字母互换一次就能得到乙词，就说甲和乙靠近。靠近可以沿着链条传递，能连到一起的词归入同一簇，单独的词自己成簇。写出簇的个数。
839.en: Read a list of distinct lowercase words. Every word has the same length and is an anagram of the others. The list holds at most 2000 words, each word has length at most 1000, and the product of those two bounds is at most 20000. Call two words close when exchanging the letters at two different indexes of the first word makes it identical to the second. Closeness joins words into clusters: a word belongs to a cluster when a chain of close pairs links it to the others. Write how many such clusters the list contains. A word alone is its own cluster.

841.zh: 房间共有 N 间，N 至少为 1、至多为 1000，编号从 0 编到 N 减 1。人一开始在 0 号里面，别的房间起初都上着锁。每间房给出一串钥匙，钥匙本身就是房间编号。单间房最多 1000 把钥匙，所有房间合在一起最多 3000 把。手里有哪一间的钥匙，就能把那一间打开。已经打开的房间之间可以双向往返。判断是不是每一间最终都能打开，能则写出真，否则写出假。
841.en: Read the key lists for N rooms numbered from 0 up to N minus 1. N is at least 1 and at most 1000. You begin inside room 0, and every other room begins locked. A key is a room number. Room i may hold up to 1000 keys, and all rooms together hold at most 3000 keys. Holding the key for a room lets you open it. Travel between opened rooms may go either way. Write true when every room can be opened, and write false when some room stays shut.

842.zh: 读入一条只含数字字符的文本，长度至少为 1、至多为 200。把它切成不少于三段，每段读成一个非负整数，数值不得超过 2 的 31 次方减 1，从而放得进 32 位带符号整数。除了单独一个 0，任何一段都不许以 0 开头。从第三段开始，每一段都要等于紧挨着的前两段之和。若存在切法，写出任意一组这样的整数；若不存在，写出空的列表。
842.en: Read a digit string whose length is at least 1 and at most 200. Cut it into three or more pieces that form integers. Each integer is at least 0 and at most 2 to the power 31 minus 1, so it fits in a signed 32-bit cell. A piece may not start with 0 unless the whole piece is the single digit 0. From the third piece onward, each value must equal the sum of the two values before it. Write any such list of integers when a cut exists. Write an empty list when no cut works.

844.zh: 读入两段文本，每段长度从 1 到 200，字符只含小写字母以及代表删除的井号。从左往右扫描时，井号会删掉它左边还留着的一个字符；左边已经没有任何字符时，这个井号就不起作用。两段各自处理完毕后，判断剩下的内容是否一样。一样就写出真，不一样就写出假。
844.en: Read two strings, each of length from 1 to 200. Every character is a lowercase letter or a hash mark. A hash mark deletes the character that is still sitting immediately on its left, and it does nothing when the left side is already empty. Apply this rule from left to right on each string separately. Compare the two texts that remain. Write true when they match and write false when they differ. Hashes never insert a visible letter of their own.

845.zh: 读入一列整数，长度可以是 0，最多到 10000，每个整数也在 0 到 10000 之间。若一段连续位置先严格变大，到达一个顶点后再严格变小，而且顶点左右都至少还有一个数，这段就称为一座山，因此长度至少为 3。找出跨越位置最多的那座山，把它的长度写出来。如果整列里一座山都没有，写出 0。
845.en: Read a list of integers. The list length is from 0 to 10000, and each value is from 0 to 10000. A mountain is a contiguous segment that rises strictly, hits one crest, then falls strictly. Both the rising side and the falling side must contain at least one step, so the segment spans at least three positions. Find the mountain that covers the most positions and write that length. Write 0 when the list contains no mountain at all.

846.zh: 读入每张牌的点数，以及每组要求的张数。牌的张数从 1 到 10000，点数从 0 到 1000000000，每组张数至少为 1，并且不能超过牌的总数。判断能不能把所有牌分成若干组，每组张数恰好等于要求，组内点数是连续整数且各出现一次，每张牌只能进入一组。做得到就写出真，做不到就写出假。
846.en: Read the face values on a hand of cards and an integer group size. The hand has between 1 and 10000 cards. Each face value is an integer from 0 through 1000000000. The group size is at least 1 and at most the number of cards. Decide whether the cards can be packed into groups that each use that many cards, with no card reused. Inside a group the face values must be consecutive integers, each appearing once in that group. Write true when such a packing exists and write false otherwise.

850.zh: 读入至少 1 个、至多 200 个边与坐标轴平行的矩形。第 i 个给出左下与右上两个角的四个整数坐标，每个坐标在 0 与 1000000000 之间。求这些矩形盖住区域的并面积，同一块地方被盖住多次也只算一遍。并面积不超过 2 的 63 次方减 1，装得进 64 位带符号整数。结果可能非常大，写出该面积对 10 的 9 次方加 7 取余后的数。
850.en: Read at least 1 and at most 200 axis-aligned rectangles. Each rectangle supplies four integers for its lower-left corner and its upper-right corner. Every coordinate lies between 0 and 1000000000 inclusive. Compute the area of the union, so a region covered several times counts once. That area fits in a signed 64-bit integer and never exceeds 2 to the power 63 minus 1. The printed value may be huge, so write the area modulo 1000000007. Do not add an overlap a second time.

851.zh: 有 N 个人，编号从 0 到 N 减 1，N 在 1 和 500 之间。每人有一个互不相同的安静分数，分数本身也是 0 到 N 减 1 的整数。另外给出若干条钱的比较，每条说明甲的钱一定比乙多。这些比较互不重复，不会把同一个人跟自己比较，而且彼此不矛盾。比较的条数最多是 N 乘以 N 减 1 再除以 2。针对每一个人，在钱不少于他的人里面，包括他自己，找出安静分数最小的那位，按被询问者的编号顺序把选中者的编号写出来。
851.en: Read N people labeled from 0 through N minus 1, with N from 1 to 500. Each person has a distinct quiet score, and that score is an integer from 0 to N minus 1. A list of pairs states that one person is certainly richer than another. The list has no repeated pairs, no pair joins a person to himself, and the comparisons do not contradict one another. Its length is at most N times N minus 1, divided by 2. For each person, look at everyone whose money is at least as large as his, including himself. Among them, pick the person whose quiet score is smallest. Write those chosen labels in order of the person being asked about.

852.zh: 读入一条已经确认呈山脉形状的整数序列，长度从 3 到 10000，每个数从 0 到 1000000。序列先严格升高，到一个最高点之后再严格降低，直到末尾。最高点不会落在第一个位置，也不会落在最后一个位置，而且这样的最高点只有一个。把最高点的下标写出来，下标从 0 起算。
852.en: Read an array that is already known to rise and then fall. Its length is from 3 to 10000. Each entry is an integer from 0 to 1000000. Values climb strictly until a single crest, then drop strictly all the way to the end. The crest is neither the first entry nor the last entry. Write the index of that crest. Indexes begin at 0. There is exactly one such crest in the whole array.

853.zh: 读入终点距离，以及 N 辆车的出发位置和不变速度。N 从 0 到 10000，终点距离和每辆车的速度都不超过 1000000。出发位置互不相同，并且都在终点之前，位置与速度都按英里计量。大家走同一条单车道，后面的车不能超到前面去。追上之后就贴着前车，改用较慢的那一档速度，两车间隙视为零。就算正好在终点才追上，也算进同一队。单独一辆车自己也是一队。写出最终驶入终点的队伍数目。
853.en: Read a destination distance and the data for N cars sharing one lane. N runs from 0 to 10000. The destination and every speed are positive and stop at 1000000. Every starting spot is distinct and lies strictly before the destination. Spots and speeds are measured in miles and miles each hour. A car holds one speed until traffic ahead forces a change. A quicker car coming from behind is not allowed to pass. Once it draws level, both continue at the slower pace and the gap counts as zero. Joining exactly at the finish still forms a single pack. One car by itself is a pack. Write the number of packs that reach the finish.

856.zh: 读入一条已经左右配对好的括号文本，长度从 2 到 50，里面只有圆括号。里面什么都没有的一对，记作 1 分。两段各自合法的内容首尾相接，分数相加。把一段合法内容再外套一对括号，分数变成原来的二倍。只按这三条计算整段文本的分数，并把该分数写出来。嵌套和并列都要按同样的规则层层处理。
856.en: Read a parentheses string that is already balanced. Its length is from 2 to 50, and the only characters are round opening and closing brackets. A pair with nothing inside scores 1. Placing two balanced pieces one after another adds their scores. Wrapping one balanced piece in an extra pair doubles that score. Use only these scoring rules and write the score of the whole string. Nesting and side by side placement both follow the same rules.

859.zh: 读入两个只含小写字母的字符串，分别叫作 s 与 goal。两者长度各自至少为 1，至多为 2 乘以 10000。判断能否在 s 里挑选两个不相等的下标，把这两个位置上的字符互换恰好一次，使 s 变得和 goal 完全相同。下标从 0 起算。即使两串看起来已经相同，也必须真正交换一次。做得到写出真，做不到写出假。长度不同则直接写出假。
859.en: Read two strings called s and goal. Both use only lowercase letters. Each length is at least 1 and at most 2 times 10000. Decide whether one exchange inside s can make s identical to goal. The exchange picks two indexes that are not equal, both counted from 0, and trades the characters there. Exactly one such exchange must be performed, even when s and goal already look alike. Write true when that exchange exists and write false when it does not. Different lengths mean false.

862.zh: 读入一列整数 A 以及正整数 K。A 的长度从 1 到 50000，其中每个数在负 100000 和正 100000 之间，K 从 1 到 1000000000。考察所有连续且非空的区间，把区间内的数相加。在和至少达到 K 的那些区间中，找出包含个数最少的一个，把它的长度写出来。如果没有任何区间的和能够达到 K，写出 -1。
862.en: Read an integer list A and a positive integer K. The list length is from 1 to 50000. Each entry lies between -100000 and 100000. K lies between 1 and 1000000000. Look at every contiguous non-empty segment and add the values inside it. Among segments whose sum is at least K, choose one with the fewest entries. Write that entry count. Write -1 when no segment has a sum that large.

863.zh: 读入一棵非空的二叉树、树上的某个目标结点，以及整数 K。每个结点的数值互不相同，范围是 0 到 500，K 的范围是 0 到 1000。距离按边的条数计算，路径既可以走向孩子，也可以走向父结点。把与目标结点相距恰好 K 的所有结点的数值写出来，先后次序随意。只有当 K 等于 0 时，目标结点自己的数值才要写入。
863.en: Read a non-empty binary tree, one target node that sits on that tree, and an integer K. Every node value is unique and lies between 0 and 500. K lies between 0 and 1000. Distance counts edges, and a path may go through the parent as well as through children. Collect every node whose distance from the target is exactly K. Write the values of those nodes. Any order is acceptable. The target itself appears only when K is 0.

864.zh: 读入一张网格，行数与列数都至少为 1、至多为 30。圆点表示空地，井号表示墙，艾特符号表示出发点。小写字母是钥匙，大写字母是锁。钥匙的种类在 1 到 6 之间，每种恰好对应一把锁，所用字母按字母表从前往后成对出现。每一步只能朝上下左右走一格，不能走出边界，也不能踩进墙。踩到钥匙就收起来。没有对应钥匙时，锁会挡住去路。写出收齐每一把钥匙的最少步数；办不到就写出 -1。
864.en: Read a grid with at most 30 rows and at most 30 columns, and at least one of each. A dot is open floor, a hash is a wall, and an at-sign is the place you start. Lowercase letters are keys and uppercase letters are locks. There are between 1 and 6 key types, each with one matching lock, using the first letters in alphabet order. Each move steps one cell up, down, left, or right. You may not leave the grid or step onto a wall. Stepping on a key collects it. A lock blocks you unless its matching key is already collected. Write the fewest moves that collect every key. Write -1 when that cannot be done.

867.zh: 读入一个整数矩阵，行的数目从 1 到 1000，列的数目也同样从 1 到 1000。构造一个新矩阵，把原来位于第 i 行第 j 列的数，放到新矩阵的第 j 行第 i 列。新矩阵有多少行，就等于旧矩阵有多少列；新矩阵有多少列，就等于旧矩阵有多少行。数值本身不要改动，只改变所在的行列位置。把新矩阵写出来，下标从 0 起算。
867.en: Read a matrix of integers. The row count is from 1 to 1000, and the column count is also from 1 to 1000. Build a new matrix by moving the entry in row i and column j to row j and column i. The new row count equals the old column count, and the new column count equals the old row count. Write the new matrix. Indexes begin at 0. No entry changes its value, only its position.

869.zh: 读入一个正整数 N，N 至少为 1，至多为 1000000000。可以把十进制各位上的数字任意重排，也允许保持原来的次序，但排完以后最高一位不许是 0。判断能不能由此得到 2 的某个非负整数次幂。能得到就写出真，不能得到就写出假。重排时每一位原有数字都要保留，不能增删。
869.en: Read one positive integer N. N is at least 1 and at most 1000000000. You may rearrange its decimal digits in any order, and leaving them as they are is allowed. The first digit of the result must not be 0. Decide whether some rearrangement equals a power of two, meaning 2 raised to a nonnegative integer. Write true when such an arrangement exists and write false when none exists. Every original digit must be kept, with none added or dropped.

870.zh: 读入两个长度相等的整数数组，长度从 1 到 10000，两边的每个数都在 0 到 1000000000 之间。优势指的是：有多少个下标满足前一个数组在该位置上的数严格大于后一个数组。只允许重排前一个数组，后一个数组的次序不许改动。把优势尽量做大，写出任意一种能达到这个最大优势的重排结果。
870.en: Read two integer arrays of equal length. The length is from 1 to 10000. Every entry in either array is from 0 to 1000000000. The advantage is how many indexes i satisfy a strict greater-than test of the first array against the second at that same index. Reorder only the first array. The second array stays fixed. Make the advantage as large as possible. Write any reordering of the first array that achieves that largest advantage.

872.zh: 读入两棵二叉树，每棵树上的结点个数在 1 和 100 之间。从左往右只抄下叶子上的数值，叶子是指左右两边都没有孩子的结点。比较两串抄下来的数值。若数值和先后次序都完全一样，写出真，否则写出假。长在内部结点上的数值不参与比较。某棵树也可以只有单独的一个叶子。
872.en: Read two binary trees. Each tree contains between 1 and 100 nodes. Walk each tree from left to right and record only the leaves, which are nodes with no child on either side. Compare the two leaf lists. Write true when the lists are identical in both values and order. Write false when they differ. Values stored on internal nodes are ignored. A tree may be a single leaf.

874.zh: 机器人从原点出发，最初面朝北，活动范围是无限的平面。北是纵轴正方向，东是横轴正方向，南是纵轴负方向，西是横轴负方向。命令里的负二表示向左转 90 度，负一表示向右转 90 度，1 到 9 表示沿当前朝向前进对应的格数。若干格点被挡住。若下一步会进入被挡住的格点，机器人就留在当前格，随后的命令照常执行。在它停留过的全部整数格点中，写出到原点直线距离再平方之后的最大值。
874.en: Read commands for a robot and a list of blocked cells. The robot starts at the origin facing north on an endless flat plane. North is positive y, east is positive x, south is negative y, and west is negative x. Command -2 turns left by 90 degrees, command -1 turns right by 90 degrees, and a command from 1 through 9 walks that many cells forward. If the next cell is blocked, the robot stays where it is and later commands still run. Among all integer cells the robot occupies, write the largest squared straight-line distance from the origin.

875.zh: 读入各堆香蕉的根数，以及小时上限 H。堆数从 1 到 10000，每堆根数从 1 到 1000000000，H 不小于堆数且不超过 1000000000。每个小时只能选定一堆，从中吃掉不超过速度的根数；这一堆若更少，则把这一堆吃完，该小时内不再吃其他堆。要在 H 小时结束前吃完每一根。写出能够做到这一点的最小整数速度。
875.en: Read pile sizes and a time limit H in hours. There is at least 1 pile and at most 10000 piles. Each pile holds between 1 and 1000000000 bananas. H is at least the pile count and at most 1000000000. In one hour the eater selects a single pile and removes up to her speed in bananas from it. A smaller pile is finished, and she eats nothing else during that hour. She must finish every banana before H hours end. Write the smallest integer speed that makes this possible.

876.zh: 读入一条非空的单向链表，结点个数从 1 到 100。找出它的中点。个数为奇数时，正中间那个结点就是答案；个数为偶数时，正中间有两个结点，取更靠后的一个。从选中的结点出发，一直到链表末尾，把这一段写出来。链表头部是第一个结点，不要改动结点之间的连接顺序。
876.en: Read one non-empty singly linked list. The node count is from 1 to 100. Find a middle node. When the count is odd there is one central node, and that node is the answer. When the count is even there are two central nodes, and the answer is the later one. Write the list that begins at the chosen node and continues through the tail. The head is the first node. Do not reorder any links.

877.zh: 石子分成偶数堆并排成一条直线，堆数是 2 到 500 之间的偶数。每堆的石子数从 1 到 500，全部加起来是奇数，所以不可能分出平局。两人轮流行动，先手先拿。每一回合只能拿走当前最左端的一整堆，或者当前最右端的一整堆。双方都采取最优走法。若先手最终得到的石子严格更多，写出真；若后手更多，写出假。
877.en: Read a straight line of stone piles whose count is an even integer from 2 to 500. Every pile contains between 1 and 500 stones. Adding every pile produces an odd total, which removes the chance of a draw. Two players alternate, and the player who starts takes the first turn. A turn removes the entire pile now sitting at the left tip, or the entire pile now sitting at the right tip. Both sides choose the best moves they can. Write true when the starting player ends with strictly more stones. Write false when the other player ends with more.

878.zh: 读入两个不小于二的正整数 A 与 B，再读入正整数 N。凡是能被 A 整除，或者能被 B 整除的正整数，都记作魔法数。把全部魔法数按从小到大排成一列，取出位于第 N 位的那个。这个数可能极大，写出它除以 10^9+7 之后的余数。N 最大是 1000000000，A 与 B 各自最大是 40000。
878.en: Read two integers A and B, each at least 2 and at most 40000, plus a positive integer N that may be as large as 10^9. Call a positive integer magical when A divides it or when B divides it. Place every magical integer into one increasing column and select the entry that sits at place N. That entry can be enormous, so write the remainder after dividing it by 10^9 + 7.

880.zh: 读入记号串 S 以及从一计起的位置 K。S 以小写字母开头，后面只会出现小写字母和从二到九的数字，总长度不超过 100。从左往右看：遇到字母就接到当前纸条末尾；遇到数字 d，就把当时整张纸条再复制 d 减一份。不要把超长纸条真正生成出来。写出展开之后落在位置 K 的字母。K 最大可以到 1000000000，展开后的字母总数保证少于二的 63 次方。
880.en: Read a code string S and a one-based position K. S starts with a lowercase letter, uses only lowercase letters and digits from 2 through 9, and has length at most 100. Scan from the left: a letter is appended to a growing slip of text, and a digit d means that whole slip is copied again d minus 1 times. Do not build the enormous slip for real. Write the letter that lands at position K after the expansion. K may be as large as 10^9, and the expanded slip is guaranteed to hold fewer than 2 to the power 63 letters.

881.zh: 读入每个人的体重，以及一艘小船的载重上限 limit。同一艘船一次最多坐两人，船上体重相加也不能超过 limit。单独一人的体重绝不会超过这条上限。找出把所有人都运走最少要几艘船，并把艘数写出来。人数最多 50000，每个人的体重以及 limit 都不超过 30000。
881.en: Read the weight of every person and the load cap of one boat, called limit. A boat may seat one person or two people on a single trip, but the weights on board must add up to no more than limit. No person is heavier than that cap alone. Find how few boats are enough to ferry the whole group and write that count. The group has size at most 50000, and both each weight and the cap stay at most 30000.

884.zh: 读入两段话 A 和 B。一段话由空格切开的词组成，每个词只用小写字母，字符总数各自不超过 200，也可以一段都是空的。某个词如果只在其中一段里出现恰好一回，另一段里完全找不到，就把它记成罕用词。把全部罕用词收集起来，排列次序随意，写成一份清单交出来。
884.en: Read two passages named A and B. A passage is a sequence of words split by spaces, every word uses only lowercase letters, and each passage has length at most 200 characters, or it may be empty. Mark a word as rare when it shows up exactly one time inside one passage and cannot be found at all inside the other passage. Collect every rare word and write them as a list. Any order is acceptable.

885.zh: 读入行数 R、列数 C，以及起点的行号 r0 和列号 c0。行列都从零起算，左上方那一格是零行零列。人从起点出发，最初面朝右方，然后按顺时针向外绕行，朝向依次是右、下、左、上，同一朝向的直线每再出现一次就多迈一步。跨出矩形时迈步仍然发生，以后还可以再踏回矩形里面。把踏进矩形的格子坐标按第一次进入的次序全部写出来。R 与 C 都不大于 100，起点一定在矩形内，每个格子都会进入一次。
885.en: Read a row count R, a column count C, and a start cell given by row r0 and column c0. Indexes begin at zero, so the upper left cell is row 0 and column 0. Start there facing right, then move outward in a clockwise loop whose headings cycle through right, down, left, and up. Each time a heading comes around again, its straight run is one step longer. Steps that leave the rectangle still occur, and later steps may step back inside. Write every cell that lies inside, in the order it is entered the first time. R and C are each at most 100, the start cell is inside, and every cell is entered once.

887.zh: 读入鸡蛋枚数 K 和楼层总数 N。楼层用 1 到 N 编号。存在一个未知临界层 F，它可以是 0 到 N 中的任意整数。从比 F 更高的层扔下，蛋会破裂；从 F 本层或更低的层扔下，蛋保持完好。已经破裂的蛋不能再扔。每一次试投可以拿一枚完好的蛋，从任意一层扔下。无论 F 落在哪个允许的整数上，都要能把它确定下来。写出在最不利情形下仍然够用的最少试投次数。K 不超过 100，N 不超过 10000。
887.en: Read an egg count K and a floor count N. Floors are numbered from 1 through N. Some unknown threshold F is an integer from 0 through N. An egg breaks when tossed from any floor above F, and stays whole when tossed from floor F or from any lower floor. A broken egg cannot be tossed again. One trial tosses a single whole egg from one chosen floor. Identify F for every allowed threshold, and write the fewest trials that still suffice in the worst case. K is at most 100 and N is at most 10000.

888.zh: 读入两列糖果条的大小，一列属于甲，一列属于乙。某人的总量等于自己那一列全部大小相加，开局时两边总量一定不相等。双方各自拿出一条互换，互换之后两边总量必须变得一样。写出甲交出的那条大小，以及乙交出的那条大小。有多组可行互换时任意一组都可以，而且至少存在一组。每一列的条数不超过 10000，单条大小不超过 100000。
888.en: Read two columns of candy bar sizes, one held by person A and one held by person B. A person's total adds every size stored in that person's column, and the two totals start out unequal. They trade exactly one bar each so the totals become equal. Write the size given away by A and the size given away by B. When several trades work, any one pair is fine, and at least one pair exists. Each column has length at most 10000, and each bar size is at most 100000.

890.zh: 读入若干个单词和一条模式。模式与每个单词都只用小写英文字母，彼此长度相等，模式最长 20，单词个数最多 50。若能规定一种字母到字母的一一对应，把模式里的每个字母替换之后正好得到某个单词，这个单词就算匹配。两个不一样的字母不能映到同一个字母。把所有匹配的单词找出来，次序不限地写下来。
890.en: Read several words and one pattern. The pattern and every word use only lowercase English letters, they all have the same length, the pattern is at most 20 characters, and there are at most 50 words. A word matches when some one-to-one mapping of letters turns the pattern into that word: each letter goes to one letter, and two different letters never land on one shared letter. Find every matching word and write them in any order.

891.zh: 读入正整数序列 A。序列长度以及其中每个数都不超过 20000。考虑所有保持原来相对次序、可以不挨在一起、但不能为空的挑选。一次挑选的宽度等于其中最大的数减去最小的数。把每一次挑选的宽度全部累加，再对 10^9+7 取余，把余数写出来。
891.en: Read a sequence of positive integers named A. Both the length of A and every value in it are at most 20000. Consider every selection that keeps the original relative order, may skip values, and is not empty. The width of one selection is its largest value minus its smallest value. Add the width of every such selection and write that total modulo 10^9 + 7.

892.zh: 读入边长 N 不超过 50 的正方形格子表。表里每一格的数字表示该格向上堆了多少个棱长为 1 的小方块，数字本身也在 0 与 50 之间。两块小方块若有一面贴在一起，贴住的那两面不再暴露在外。把堆叠完成之后仍然露在外面的全部面积写出来。
892.en: Read a square grid whose side length N is at most 50. The number stored in a cell tells how many cubes of edge length 1 are stacked on that cell, and each stored number lies between 0 and 50. When two cubes share a face, those two faces are covered and no longer exposed. Write the total area of every face that stays exposed after the stacking is finished.

895.zh: 做出名为 FreqStack 的容器。push 接收一个介于 0 与 1000000000 之间的整数并放进容器。pop 取出出现次数最高的整数并把它写出来；若有多个整数的次数同为最高，就取最晚放进去的那一个。容器里没有整数时不会调用 pop。单独一份测试里 push 和 pop 各自至多 10000 次，所有测试合在一起这两种调用至多 150000 次。
895.en: Build a container named FreqStack. The operation push stores an integer x, and x lies between 0 and 10^9 inclusive. The operation pop removes the integer that currently occurs most often and writes it. When several integers share that highest count, pop removes the one stored most recently. pop is never asked for while the container is empty. Inside one test, push and pop each happen at most 10000 times. Across every test together, those two operations happen at most 150000 times.

896.zh: 读入整数序列 A。若任意靠前下标上的数都不大于靠后下标上的数，称它非降；若任意靠前的数都不小于靠后的数，称它非升。这两种情形只要有一种成立，就判定该序列单调，写出 true，否则写出 false。序列长度至多 50000，每个数都落在负 100000 到 100000 这个闭区间里。
896.en: Read a sequence of integers named A. Call it nondecreasing when every earlier index holds a value less than or equal to every later index. Call it nonincreasing when every earlier index holds a value greater than or equal to every later index. Judge the sequence monotonic when at least one of those two descriptions fits, and write true; otherwise write false. The length is at most 50000, and each value lies on the closed span from -100000 to 100000.

897.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树。结点总数落在 1 至 100 这一档。各个结点上的键互不相同，最小可以是 0，最大可以是 1000。按照中序的先后，把结点改接成一条只向右延伸的链：中序里最先的结点成为新的根，之后的结点只挂在前一个结点的右侧，谁也不再保留左侧孩子。把改接之后的树写出来。
897.en: Read a binary search tree. It contains between 1 and 100 nodes, and each node stores a distinct integer from 0 through 1000. Rewire the nodes into a chain that only grows to the right and follows inorder. The earliest node in that order becomes the new root. Every later node hangs only as the right child of the node before it, and every left child link is dropped. Write the tree after this rewiring.

898.zh: 读入非负整数序列 A。长度至多 50000，每个整数至多 10^9。对每一对左端不大于右端的下标，把这一段连续位置上的整数做按位或。很多段可能得到同一个数。统计一共出现过多少种不同的按位或结果，把种数写出来。
898.en: Read a sequence A of nonnegative integers. Its length is at most 50000, and each integer is at most 10^9. For every pair of indexes whose left end is not past the right end, compute the bitwise OR of the integers that sit on that contiguous span. Many spans may yield the same integer. Count how many different OR results appear and write that count.

901.zh: 做出 StockSpanner，用来记录一只股票逐日的价格。每次 next 读入当天价格，价格是 1 到 100000 之间的整数。当天的跨度等于从当天起连续向前看、价格都不高于当天价格的天数，当天自己也算一天。每次 next 都要把这个跨度写出来。一份测试最多调用 10000 次，全部测试加起来最多 150000 次。
901.en: Build a StockSpanner that records the daily price of one stock. Each call next reads that day's price, an integer from 1 through 100000. The span for the day is how many consecutive days, ending on that day and counting that day, have a price no higher than the price recorded for that day. Write the span after every call. One test makes at most 10000 calls, and all tests together make at most 150000 calls.

904.zh: 读入一排树，每棵树上水果的品种用一个整数表示。你只有两个筐，一个筐只能装同一个品种。可以从任意一棵树开始，摘下当前这棵树的一枚水果放进筐里，然后只能走到紧挨着的右边那棵。若再摘就会出现第三个品种，或者右边已经没有树，就必须停下。写出一次这样向右连续采摘所能收集的最多水果数。树的棵数至多 40000，品种编号不小于 0，并且严格小于棵数。
904.en: Read a row of trees, where an integer names the fruit variety on each tree. You carry two baskets, and one basket may hold only a single variety. Begin at any tree you choose, take one fruit from the current tree into the baskets, then step only to the tree immediately on the right. Stop when another fruit would introduce a third variety, or when no tree remains on the right. Write the largest number of fruits gathered on one such rightward trip. There are at most 40000 trees, and each variety index is at least 0 and strictly below the tree count.

907.zh: 读入正整数序列 A。序列长度和每个元素都不超过 30000。每一段连续位置都取出自己的最小元素，只含一个位置的段也要计入，最小元素就是它自己。把所有连续段的最小元素加在一起，再对 10^9+7 取余，把余数写出来。
907.en: Read a sequence of positive integers named A. Both its length and every entry are at most 30000. From each contiguous span, take the smallest entry in that span. A span that holds only one entry still counts, and its smallest entry is that entry itself. Add those smallest entries over every span and write the sum modulo 10^9 + 7.

909.zh: 读入边长 N 至多 20 的方格棋盘。方格用 1 到 N 乘 N 的编号标出，编号从西南角那一格起，相邻横排的走向彼此相反。某格记录若不是 -1，踩中后要改去记录中的编号，这种改道在一次移动里只发生一遍，即使新格子上又写着改道也不再连跳。编号 1 和最后的编号都没有改道。从编号 x 出发的一步，只能落到其后连续六个编号中、且没有越过终点的某一个。写出到达终点的最少步数，到不了就写 -1。
909.en: Read a square board whose side N is at most 20. Cells are labeled from 1 through N times N, starting at the southwest cell, and neighboring rows run in opposite directions. When a cell stores a value other than -1, landing there sends you to the stored label, and that redirect happens only once per move even if the new cell also stores a redirect. Label 1 and the final label never redirect. From label x, one move may land on one of the next six labels that does not pass the final label. Write the fewest moves that reach the final label, or write -1 if it cannot be reached.

910.zh: 读入非负整数序列 A 以及非负整数 K。序列长度、序列里的每个数，还有 K，都不超过 10000。对每一个数，要么加上 K，要么减去 K，只能改动一次。改完之后得到序列 B。写出 B 当中最大数与最小数之差能够小到什么程度。
910.en: Read a sequence A of nonnegative integers together with a nonnegative integer K. The length of A, every value in A, and K are all at most 10000. For each value, either add K or subtract K, and make that change only once. Call the finished sequence B. Write the smallest gap that can occur between the largest value in B and the smallest value in B.

911.zh: 读入一场选举的选票。第 i 张票在时刻 times[i] 投给编号 persons[i]。时刻严格变大，并且每个时刻都在 0 到 10^9 之内。候选人编号从 0 开始，不会超过票的张数。查询某个时刻 t 时，要找出当时得票最高的候选人，时刻正好等于 t 的票也计算在内。得票相同则最近拿到一票的人领先。每次查询的 t 都不小于第一张票的时刻。票的张数至多 5000，一份测试里的查询至多 10000 次。按查询次序把领先者的编号写出来。
911.en: Read ballots from an election. Ballot i chooses the candidate whose id is persons[i], and the stamp on that ballot is times[i]. Those stamps strictly increase, and every stamp lies between 0 and 10^9 inclusive. Candidate ids start at 0 and never exceed the ballot count. A query for a moment t asks which candidate has the most ballots by then, and a ballot stamped exactly at t counts. On a tie, the candidate who gained a ballot most recently among those tied is ahead. Every queried moment is at least as late as the first stamp. There are at most 5000 ballots, and one test asks at most 10000 queries. Write the leading candidate id for each query, in order.

914.zh: 读入一副纸牌，每张牌面写着一个整数。牌的张数至多 10000，牌面整数满足不小于 0 且小于 10000。判断是否存在不小于 2 的整数 X，能够把全部纸牌分成一组或多组，每组恰好有 X 张，而且同一组里的牌面整数彼此相同。存在这样的 X 就写 true，否则写 false。
914.en: Read a deck in which every card shows an integer. The deck has at most 10000 cards, and each shown integer is at least 0 and strictly below 10000. Decide whether some integer X of size at least 2 can partition the whole deck into one or more groups so that every group contains exactly X cards and every card in a group shows the same integer. Write true when such an X exists, and write false otherwise.

916.zh: 读入单词表 A 和单词表 B。单词只用小写字母，两张表的词数各自至多 10000，每个单词长度至多 10，A 里的词互不重复。若单词 b 里每个字母在单词 a 里出现的次数都不比 b 自己少，就说 a 盖住了 b。若 A 里的某个词能盖住 B 中的每一个词，这个词就是通用词。把 A 里所有通用词找出来，次序随意地写成一列。
916.en: Read two word lists, A and B. Every word uses only lowercase letters. Each list holds at most 10000 words, each word has length at most 10, and the words in A are all different from one another. Word a covers word b when every letter of b occurs in a at least as often as it occurs in b. Call a word from A universal when it covers every word in B. Find all universal words in A and write them in any order.

918.zh: 读入整数序列 A。长度至多 30000，每个数都在负 30000 到 30000 之间。把序列的首尾相接，看成一个圈。从圈上取一段连续的数，这段不能是空的，而且同一个位置最多出现一次，不能绕完一圈之后自己叠在一起。写出这种段里各数相加所能达到的最大值。
918.en: Read an integer sequence A of length at most 30000, with each value between -30000 and 30000. Join the first position to the last so the sequence forms a loop. Take one contiguous segment on that loop. The segment must contain at least one value, and it may use each position at most once, so it cannot lap the loop and overlap itself. Write the largest sum of the values inside any such segment.

920.zh: 读入整数 N、L 和 K，它们满足 0 小于等于 K，K 小于 N，N 小于等于 L，并且 L 小于等于 100。曲库里有 N 首彼此不同的歌，要排成一份长度恰好为 L 的曲目单，同一首歌允许出现多次。每首歌都要至少出现一回。某首歌若再次出现，它和上一次出现之间至少要隔着另外 K 首歌。数出满足这两条的曲目单一共有多少份，对 10^9+7 取余后写出来。
920.en: Read integers N, L, and K that satisfy 0 <= K < N <= L <= 100. A library holds N songs that differ from each other, and a playlist is a sequence of exactly L songs in which a song may appear more than once. Every song must show up one or more times. Before a song is used again, at least K other songs must sit between that reuse and the prior time it appeared. Count the playlists that obey both rules and write the count modulo 10^9 + 7.

921.zh: 读入一条只由左圆括号和右圆括号组成的符号串 S，长度不超过 1000。允许在任意地方补上左圆括号或者右圆括号。补完以后必须成为合法括号串：什么符号都没有算合法；两段合法串首尾相接仍然合法；把一段合法串放进一对互相匹配的括号里也合法。写出需要补上的最少符号个数。
921.en: Read a string S made only of opening and closing parentheses, with length at most 1000. You may insert extra opening or closing parentheses anywhere, including at either end. After those insertions the string must be valid. A string with no characters is valid. Placing two valid strings end to end keeps the result valid. Wrapping one valid string inside a single matching pair also keeps it valid. Write the fewest insertions that make S valid.

922.zh: 读入非负整数序列 A。它的长度是偶数，至少为 2，至多为 20000，每个数至多 1000。其中奇数值和偶数值正好各占一半。重新安排这些数，使偶数下标上放偶数，奇数下标上放奇数。任何满足这一条的安排都可以接受。把安排之后的序列写出来。
922.en: Read a sequence A of nonnegative integers. Its length is even, at least 2, and at most 20000. Each value is at most 1000. Half of the values are odd and the other half are even. Rearrange the values so that every even index holds an even value and every odd index holds an odd value. Any arrangement that meets this rule is acceptable. Write one such sequence.

923.zh: 读入整数序列 A 和整数 target。序列长度在 3 与 3000 之间，每个数在 0 与 100 之间，target 在 0 与 300 之间。统计下标三元组的个数，三个下标必须严格从小到大，对应的三个数相加正好等于 target。只要下标组合不同就分别计数，即使三个数的数值一样也不合并。个数可能很大，对 10^9+7 取余后写出。
923.en: Read an integer sequence A and an integer target. The length of A lies between 3 and 3000, each value lies between 0 and 100, and the target lies between 0 and 300. Count triples of indexes that are strictly increasing and whose three stored values add up to the target. Different index triples count separately even when the stored numbers are identical. The count may be large, so write it modulo 10^9 + 7.

924.zh: 读入无向图的邻接方阵，边长大于 1 且至多 300。方阵是对称的，值为 1 表示两端直接有连线，对角线上全是 1。另有一份最初染病的结点名单，名单非空而且短于结点总数，里面的编号都合法。一条连线的两端只要有一端已经染病，另一端也会染病，直到不能再扩散。扩散结束后的染病结点数记作 M。从名单里恰好去掉一个结点，让 M 尽可能小。有多个结点效果一样时，写出编号最小的那个。被去掉的结点后来仍可能因为扩散而染病。
924.en: Read an undirected graph as a square matrix whose side is greater than 1 and at most 300. The matrix is symmetric, an entry of 1 means the two nodes share a direct link, and every diagonal entry is 1. Also read a nonempty list of nodes that start infected. That list is shorter than the node count, and every id in it is valid. Infection crosses a direct link whenever at least one end is already infected, and this continues until it can spread no further. Let M be how many nodes are infected once it stops. Drop exactly one node from the starting list so that M becomes as small as possible. If several drops tie, write the smallest id. A dropped node may still become infected later through later spread.

925.zh: 读入两段由小写字母组成的文本，前一段是姓名，后一段是实际敲出来的内容。两段长度各自都不超过 1000。敲键时手指可能在同一个键上多停一会儿，于是某个字母会在结果里连续重复出现多次，但字母的种类和出现次序必须与姓名完全一致，既不能漏掉姓名里的字母，也不能凭空多出别的字母。判断这段敲击结果能不能由该姓名通过这种重复按键产生。能产生就写出真，否则写出假。
925.en: Read two strings made only of lowercase letters. The first is a person's name and the second is what the keyboard actually produced. Each string contains at most 1000 characters. While typing, a finger may rest on one key, so that letter can show up several times in a row. The sequence of distinct letters must still follow the name exactly: nothing may be skipped and no foreign letter may be inserted. Decide whether the typed text can be produced from the name under this repeated-key rule. Write true if it can, and write false if it cannot.

927.zh: 读入一条只含数字 0 和 1 的序列，长度至少为 3，至多 30000。要把整条序列切成三段，每段至少含一个数字。把每一段从头到尾看成一个二进制整数，开头多余的 0 不改变数值。三段所表示的数值必须彼此相等。若存在这样的切法，写出两个下标 i 与 j，满足 i 加 1 小于 j：第一段覆盖到下标 i，第二段从 i 的下一个位置开始并停在 j 之前，第三段从 j 一直到末尾。若怎么切都不行，就写出负一和负一。
927.en: Read a list of bits, each entry being 0 or 1. The list length is at least 3 and at most 30000. Split the whole list into three pieces and leave none of them empty. Interpret each piece as one binary integer, where zeros sitting at the front do not change the number. All three pieces must stand for the same integer. When such a split exists, write two indexes i and j with i plus 1 smaller than j. The first piece stops at i, the middle piece starts just after i and stops just before j, and the last piece starts at j. When no split works, write -1 and -1.

928.zh: 读入一张无向图的邻接方阵，边长大于 1 且不超过 300，对角线上全是 1，对称位置的数字相同，每格只取 0 或 1。另外读入一份最初染病的结点名单，名单长度至少为 1 且小于图的边长。只要两个结点之间有边，并且其中至少一个已经染病，另一个也会染病，这个过程一直持续到无法再扩散。现在允许从最初名单里彻底拿掉一个结点，连同它的全部连线一起删除，然后让疾病在剩下的图上扩散。选出删除之后最终染病结点数最少的那个结点。若有多个选择，写出编号最小的一个。
928.en: Read an undirected graph as a square matrix whose side is greater than 1 and at most 300. Diagonal cells are 1, the matrix is symmetric, and every cell is 0 or 1. Also read a list of nodes that start out infected. That list has at least one node and is shorter than the matrix side. Infection crosses any edge that touches an already infected node, and it keeps moving until nothing new can catch it. You may delete exactly one node from the starting list, together with every edge that touched it, and then let infection run on what remains. Write the deleted node that leaves the fewest infected nodes at the end. If several nodes tie, write the one with the smallest index.

930.zh: 读入一条只由数字 0 与 1 构成的序列，再读入一个目标和。序列长度至多 30000，目标和介于 0 和序列长度之间，序列中每个位置只会出现这两种数字。在序列上圈出一段连续区间，区间里至少要有一个数字，并把区间内的数字全部加起来。统计有多少段互不相同的区间能让这个和正好等于目标，起点或终点只要有一处不同就算另一段。把这段数作为答案写出来。
930.en: Read a list that contains only the digits 0 and 1, plus a target sum. The list holds at most 30000 entries, and the target lies between 0 and the list length. Choose a contiguous block that includes at least one entry and add the entries inside it. Count how many different blocks produce a total exactly equal to the target. Two blocks count separately whenever their starting index or ending index differs. Write that count.

933.zh: 实现一个只提供查询的计数器。每次查询带来一个时刻 t，单位是毫秒，并且保证后一次的 t 严格大于前一次。t 的范围是 1 到 1000000000。一次测试里查询次数至多 10000。每次查询都要统计最近 3000 毫秒内到来的次数，也就是落在闭区间从 t 减 3000 到 t 之间的全部查询，包含当前这一次。把这个次数写出来。
933.en: Build a counter that accepts one call at a time. Each call brings a time t measured in milliseconds, and every later call uses a strictly larger t than the one before it. Each t is an integer from 1 through 1000000000, and one test issues at most 10000 calls. For a call at time t, count every earlier call whose time lies inside the closed window from t minus 3000 through t, including the call happening now. Write that count for each call.

938.zh: 读入一棵二叉搜索树的根，再读入闭区间的下界与上界。结点总数从 1 起到二万，每个结点保存的整数互不相同，取值从 1 到 100000。下界与上界也在同一取值范围内，且下界不会超过上界。在树中找出每一个落在这个闭区间内的结点，把它们保存的整数全部相加，两端的边界值也要计入。最后把得到的总和写出来。
938.en: Read the root of a binary search tree together with a closed numeric window given by a low end and a high end. The tree holds between 1 and 20000 nodes. Every stored integer is unique and lies between 1 and 100000. The two ends of the window also lie in that same span, and the low end never exceeds the high end. Add every node value that falls inside the window, counting both ends. Write the resulting total.

942.zh: 读入一条只含字母 I 和 D 的指令，长度从 1 到 10000。令这条指令的长度为 N。写出 0 到 N 这 N 加 1 个整数的一种排列。对每一个位置 i，若指令第 i 个字母是 I，则排列里第 i 个数必须小于它右边相邻的数；若字母是 D，则第 i 个数必须大于右边相邻的数。任意一种满足全部相邻比较的排列都可以。
