942.en: Read a string made only of the letters I and D. Its length N is between 1 and 10000. Write one ordering of the integers 0 through N, which means the ordering contains N plus 1 numbers. At every index i, look at the letter in that place. When the letter is I, the number at index i must be smaller than the number immediately to its right. When the letter is D, the number at index i must be larger than the number immediately to its right. Any ordering that satisfies every adjacent comparison is acceptable.

946.zh: 读入两条长度相同的整数序列，分别表示压入次序和弹出次序。长度可以是 0，也可以大到 1000。两条序列里的数字互不相同，而且它们含有的数字集合完全一样，每个数字都落在 0 到 999。从空栈开始，只能把压入序列中的下一个数放进栈，或者把栈顶弹到输出。判断按这两种动作能否正好得到那条弹出次序，并且最后栈被清空。能做到就写出真，否则写出假。
946.en: Read two integer sequences of equal length. One lists the push order and the other lists the pop order. The shared length may be 0 and is at most 1000. Values inside both sequences are distinct, every value is below 1000, and the two sequences contain exactly the same multiset of numbers. Start from an empty stack. The only allowed actions are pushing the next unused value from the push order, or popping the current top into the output. Decide whether some mix of those actions can reproduce the pop order and leave the stack empty at the end. Write true when that is possible and false when it is not.

947.zh: 平面上有若干石头，每块石头占一个整数坐标，同一个坐标最多一块。石头个数从 1 到 1000，每个坐标分量都是小于 10000 的非负整数。一次操作可以拿走一块石头，但前提是网格上还留着另一块与它同一行或同一列的石头。求最多能进行多少次这样的操作，并把这个次数写出来。已经被拿走的石头不能再作为同行或同列的依据。
947.en: Stones sit on a plane at integer coordinates, with at most one stone on any single point. The number of stones is between 1 and 1000, and every coordinate component is a nonnegative integer below 10000. One move takes away a stone only when another stone still on the plane shares its row or its column. Find the greatest number of moves that can be performed, and write that number. A stone already taken away can no longer serve as the partner for a later move.

949.zh: 读入恰好四个数字，每个数字是 0 到 9 的整数。用这四个数字各一次，排成一个二十四小时制的时刻，写成五位文本，中间用冒号隔开。合法时刻从 00:00 到 23:59。离午夜过去得越久，时刻越大。在所有能排出来的合法时刻里找出最大的一个并写出来。如果四个数字怎样排列都得不到合法时刻，就写出空文本。
949.en: Read exactly four digits, each an integer from 0 through 9. Use every digit once and arrange them into a 24-hour clock time written as five characters with a colon in the middle. A legal time runs from 00:00 up to 23:59. A time counts as larger when more of the day has passed since midnight. Find the largest legal time these digits can form and write it. If no arrangement yields a legal time, write an empty string.

952.zh: 读入一组彼此不同的正整数，个数最少 1 个、最多 20000 个，其中每个整数至少为 1、至多为 100000。把每个整数看成图里的一个点。若两个整数拥有大于 1 的公约数，就在对应的两点之间连一条无向边。边只取决于这个条件，不要求两个数本身相等。在得到的图中找出点数最多的连通块，把这个点数写出来。没有任何边相连的孤立点，也单独算作一块。
952.en: Read a nonempty list of positive integers that are all different. The list holds at most 20000 numbers, and each number is at most 100000. Treat every number as a vertex. Draw an undirected edge between two vertices exactly when the two numbers share a divisor that is greater than 1. In the graph formed this way, find the connected piece that contains the most vertices and write how many vertices it has. A vertex with no edge still counts as a piece by itself.

953.zh: 读入若干个由小写字母拼成的单词，以及一份长度为 26 的字母顺序。单词个数从 1 到 100，每个单词的长度从 1 到 20。这份顺序是二十六位小写字母的一种排列，排在前面的字母更小。按照这份顺序比较相邻单词：先看第一个不同的字母，前者更小则顺序正确；若一个单词是另一个的前缀，较短的那个必须排在前面。判断整列单词是否已经按这个规则从小到大排好。是则写出真，否则写出假。
953.en: Read a list of words written with lowercase letters, plus an alphabet order whose length is 26. The list contains between 1 and 100 words, and each word contains between 1 and 20 letters. The order is one arrangement of the twenty-six lowercase letters, and a letter earlier in that arrangement is smaller. Compare neighboring words by the first position where they differ. The word with the smaller letter there must come first. If one word is a prefix of the next, the shorter word must come first. Decide whether the whole list is already sorted under this rule. Write true if it is, and write false otherwise.

958.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点个数从 1 到 100，每个结点的数值从 1 到 1000。判断它是不是一棵形状完整、底层靠左的二叉树。除了最深的那一层，上面每一层的结点数都必须达到该层所能容纳的最大个数。最深一层的结点必须从左向右紧挨着排，中间不能出现空位，但这一层不必排满。符合这个形状就写出真，否则写出假。
958.en: Read a binary tree that contains between 1 and 100 nodes. Every node stores an integer from 1 through 1000. Decide whether the tree is complete. Every level above the deepest one must hold as many nodes as that level can hold. On the deepest level, the nodes that exist must sit packed against the left side, with no gap between them, though that level need not be full. Write true when the tree meets this shape, and write false when it does not.

959.zh: 读入一张正方形的字符网格，边长最少是 1、最多是 30。每一格只写三种符号之一：正斜杠、反斜杠，或一个空格。正斜杠和反斜杠会把本格切成更小的块，空格则让本格保持完整。两块之间只要共享一段正长度的边界，就视为同一片。统计整张网格最终被分成多少片互不相连的区域，并把片数写出来。
959.en: Read a square character grid whose side length is between 1 and 30. Each cell holds one of three symbols: a forward slash, a backslash, or a space. A slash splits its cell into smaller pieces, while a space leaves that cell whole. Two pieces belong to the same region whenever they share a border of positive length. Count how many separate regions the lines carve across the whole grid, and write that count.

961.zh: 读入一条偶数长度的整数序列，长度从 4 到 10000，每个元素是小于 10000 的非负整数。若长度记为二倍的 N，则序列里恰好出现 N 加 1 种不同的数值，而且其中恰好有一种数值出现了 N 次，其余每种只出现一次。找出那个出现了 N 次的数值并写出来。
961.en: Read an even-length list of integers. The length is at least 4 and at most 10000, and every entry is a nonnegative integer below 10000. If the length is twice N, the list contains exactly N plus 1 different values, and exactly one of those values appears N times while each of the others appears once. Find the value that appears N times and write it.

966.zh: 读入一份词典和若干查询，两边的条数都从 1 到 5000，每条字符串长度从 1 到 7，并且只含英文字母。对每条查询按下面的优先次序找词典中的对应项：先找大小写完全一致的词；找不到再忽略大小写，取词典里最早出现的那一条；仍找不到就把查询中的元音字母 a、e、i、o、u 任意换成别的元音后再忽略大小写去比，同样取词典中最早的命中。三种都失败就对应空文本。按查询顺序写出全部结果。
966.en: Read a dictionary and a list of queries. Each side holds between 1 and 5000 strings, every string has length between 1 and 7, and every string uses English letters only. For each query, search the dictionary with this priority. First accept a string that matches every character including case. If none exists, ignore case and take the earliest dictionary entry that matches. If that also fails, treat letters a, e, i, o, and u as one interchangeable family, ignore case again, and take the earliest hit. If nothing hits, the result for that query is an empty string. Write the results in the same order as the queries.

968.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点个数从 1 到 1000，每个结点保存的数值都是 0。允许在某些结点上放置摄像头。放在某个结点上的摄像头可以照看它的父结点、它自己，以及它的直接孩子。选出一组放置位置，使得每个结点都被至少一个摄像头看到，并且摄像头的个数最少。把这个最少个数写出来。
968.en: Read a binary tree whose node count is between 1 and 1000. Every node stores the value 0. Cameras may be placed on chosen nodes. A camera sitting on a node watches that node's parent, the node itself, and the node's direct children. Choose a set of placements so that every node is watched by at least one camera, and so that the number of cameras is as small as possible. Write that smallest number.

969.zh: 读入一个整数排列，长度从 1 到 100，内容恰好是 1 到该长度的每个正整数各一次。一次煎饼翻转要选定一个正整数 k，k 不能超过当前长度，然后把前 k 个数倒过来。可以连续做若干次，也可以一次都不做。写出一串 k，按顺序执行这些翻转后，整个排列变成从小到大。只要翻转次数不超过长度的十倍，任何一串正确的 k 都算对。
969.en: Read a permutation of the integers from 1 through its own length. The length is between 1 and 100. A pancake flip picks a positive integer k no larger than the current length and reverses the prefix of that many entries. You may perform any number of flips, including none. Write a sequence of k values which, applied in order, leaves the list sorted from small to large. Any sequence that finishes the sort within ten times the length is accepted.

970.zh: 读入两个正整数 x 和 y，以及一个上界。x 和 y 各自从 1 到 100，上界从 0 到 1000000。一个整数如果可以写成 x 的某个非负整数次幂，再加上 y 的某个非负整数次幂，就称为强整数。指数从 0 开始，因此 x 或 y 的 0 次幂等于 1。找出所有不超过上界的强整数，每个数值只保留一次，顺序不限，把它们写出来。
970.en: Read bases x and y along with a ceiling. Both bases lie between 1 and 100, and the ceiling lies between 0 and 1000000. An integer counts as powerful when it equals x raised to a nonnegative power added to y raised to a nonnegative power. A power of 0 contributes 1. Collect every powerful integer that stays within the ceiling. Duplicate numbers are dropped, and order is irrelevant. Write the collected numbers.

971.zh: 读入一棵有 n 个结点的二叉树，以及一条长度为 n 的期望先序序列。n 从 1 到 100。每个结点的数值互不相同，并且都在 1 到 n 之间，期望序列里的数值也同样互不相同。翻转一个结点是指交换它的左子树和右子树。找出一组需要翻转的结点，使树的先序遍历与期望序列完全一致，并且翻转的结点尽量少。把这些结点的数值写出来，顺序不限。如果无论怎么翻转都无法对齐，就写出只含负一的列表。
971.en: Read a binary tree of n nodes and a desired preorder list of length n. The integer n is between 1 and 100. Every node value is unique and lies between 1 and n, and the desired list also contains each of those values once. Flipping a node means swapping its left subtree with its right subtree. Find a set of nodes to flip so the tree preorder matches the desired list, using as few flips as possible. Write the values of the flipped nodes in any order. If no choice of flips can make the preorder match, write a list that contains only -1.

973.zh: 平面上有若干坐标点，再给出正整数 K。点的个数至少为 K，并且不超过 10000。每个点的横纵坐标都是整数，绝对值都小于 10000，但不包含正负 10000 本身。距离按到原点的欧氏距离计算，原点是坐标都为 0 的点。找出距离原点最近的 K 个点。答案中点的先后次序可以任意，而且除次序外答案是唯一的。把这 K 个点写出来。
973.en: Read points located on a plane together with a positive integer K. There are at least K points and at most 10000 points. Each point uses integer coordinates, and each coordinate has absolute value strictly below 10000. Closeness is ordinary Euclidean distance from the origin, where both coordinates are 0. Select the K points nearest the origin. Order among the selected points may vary, and apart from order only one selection is correct. Write the selected points.

976.zh: 读入若干条正数长度，条数从 3 到 10000，每条长度是 1 到 1000000 的整数。从中挑出三条，当作三角形的三条边。三角形的面积必须大于 0，不能退化成一条线段。在所有满足条件的三条边里，找出周长最大的那一组，并把该周长写出来。如果任意三条都拼不出面积为正的三角形，就写出 0。
976.en: Read a list of positive integer lengths. The list holds between 3 and 10000 numbers, and each number is between 1 and 1000000. Pick three of them to serve as the sides of a triangle. The triangle must have area strictly above 0, so a flat line does not count. Among every valid triple, find the one whose perimeter is greatest and write that perimeter. If no triple forms a triangle with positive area, write 0.

977.zh: 读入一条已经按非递减顺序排好的整数序列，长度从 1 到 10000。每个整数的绝对值不超过 10000。把序列里的每个数各自平方，得到同样个数的新数，再把这些平方按非递减顺序排好并写出来。原序列里的负数平方后会变成正数，所以新序列的顺序不一定还能沿用原来的下标次序。
977.en: Read a list of integers that is already arranged in nondecreasing order. The length is between 1 and 10000, and the absolute value of each integer is at most 10000. Square every entry, producing one new number per entry. Arrange those squares into nondecreasing order and write the arranged list. Because a negative entry becomes positive after squaring, the new order need not follow the original indexes.

978.zh: 读入一条整数序列，长度从 1 到 40000，每个整数从 0 到 1000000000。一段连续片段称为湍流，是指相邻两项的大小关系在大于和小于之间来回交替。可以从偶数下标处要求先大后小，也可以从偶数下标处要求先小后大，两种交替都算。相等的相邻项会打断这种交替。只含一个元素的片段也算湍流，长度为 1。找出最长的湍流片段，把它的长度写出来。
978.en: Read a list of integers whose length is between 1 and 40000. Each integer is between 0 and 1000000000. A contiguous block is turbulent when every neighboring pair inside it is unequal and the direction of the inequality flips at each step. One pattern starts with a descent on even indexes and the other starts with an ascent on even indexes; either pattern qualifies. A block of a single entry counts as turbulent and has length 1. Find the longest turbulent block and write its length.

979.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点总数 N 从 1 到 100。每个结点上放着若干枚硬币，数量可以是 0，但不会超过 N，并且整棵树上的硬币总数正好等于 N。一次移动是选择一条连着父结点与子结点的边，把一枚硬币从一端挪到另一端，方向不限。求让每个结点最终都恰好持有一枚硬币所需要的移动次数，并把该次数写出来。
979.en: Read an N-node binary tree, where N is an integer from 1 through 100. Every node holds some number of coins. That number may be 0 and never exceeds N, and all coins in the tree sum to exactly N. One move picks an edge between a parent and a child, then shifts one coin across that edge. Shifting toward the parent or toward the child are both allowed. Compute how many such shifts are needed so each node ends with exactly one coin, and write the count.

980.zh: 读入一张网格，格子总数从 1 到 20。格子只有四种标记：1 是唯一的起点，2 是唯一的终点，0 是可以走进的空格，负一是不能进入的障碍。从起点出发，每次可以走上、下、左、右四个方向中的一格。路径必须走到终点，并且每一个非障碍格都要恰好经过一次，障碍格不能踩。统计这样的路径有多少条，并把条数写出来。起点也算经过。
980.en: Read a grid whose total number of cells is between 1 and 20. Cells use four marks: 1 is the single start, 2 is the single finish, 0 is an open cell that may be entered, and -1 is a blocked cell. From the start, each step moves one cell up, down, left, or right. A valid walk must reach the finish, enter every nonblocked cell exactly once, and never step on a blocked cell. The starting cell counts as entered. Count these walks and write how many there are.

981.zh: 实现一个按时间戳保存字符串的映射。它支持两种操作。保存操作读入键、值和时间戳，把这三项记下来。读取操作读入键和时间戳，要找出该键在不晚于这个时间戳的记录里，时间戳最大的那一次所保存的值。若该键没有任何不晚于该时刻的记录，就写出空文本。所有键和值都是长度在 1 到 100 的小写字母串。保存操作的时间戳严格递增，每个时间戳从 1 到 10000000。两种操作合计会被调用至多 120000 次。
981.en: Build a map that stores strings together with timestamps. It supports two operations. The store operation reads a key, a value, and a timestamp, and records all three. The fetch operation reads a key and a timestamp, then must find the recorded value for that key whose timestamp is the greatest one that is still no later than the requested time. If the key has no record at or before that time, write an empty string. Every key and every value is a lowercase string of length 1 to 100. Timestamps used by store calls increase strictly, and each timestamp is an integer from 1 to 10000000. Store and fetch together are invoked at most 120000 times.

984.zh: 读入两个整数 A 和 B，它们各自从 0 到 100。写出一条只含字母 a 和 b 的文本。文本长度必须等于 A 加 B，其中字母 a 恰好出现 A 次，字母 b 恰好出现 B 次。文本中不能出现连续三个 a，也不能出现连续三个 b。对于给出的 A 和 B，这样的文本一定存在。任意一条满足上述条件的文本都可以。
984.en: Read two integers A and B. Each of them is between 0 and 100 inclusive. Write a string that uses only the letters a and b. Its length must equal A plus B, the letter a must appear exactly A times, and the letter b must appear exactly B times. The string must not contain three a characters in a row, and it must not contain three b characters in a row. A string meeting these rules is guaranteed to exist for the supplied A and B. Any such string is acceptable.

985.zh: 读入一列整数，再读入若干次修改。每次修改带有一个加数和一个从零计的位置，把加数累加到该位置，并且这次改动会保留下来。每做完一次修改，就把当前数列里所有偶数相加，记下这个和。全部修改做完后，按修改的先后写出每一个和。数列长度、修改次数以及任一整数的绝对值都不超过 10000。位置永远落在数列下标范围内。
985.en: Read one column of integers and a sequence of edits. Each edit carries an addend and a zero-based position. Add the addend into the integer at that position and keep the updated value for later edits. After every edit, add all even integers currently in the column and remember that total. When the edits are finished, write the remembered totals in the same order as the edits. The column length and the edit count are each at most 10000, and every integer has absolute value at most 10000. Each position always lies inside the column.

986.zh: 读入两组闭区间。每一组内部按左端点递增，并且任意两段没有公共实数。一段闭区间覆盖从左端点到右端点的全部实数，两端都算在内。找出所有同时被第一组某段和第二组某段覆盖的实数范围，把每一段非空重叠写成新的闭区间。按左端点从小到大写出这些区间。每一组的段数都小于 1000。所有端点都是不小于零且严格小于 10^9 的整数。
986.en: Read two groups of closed intervals. Within each group the pieces are ordered by increasing left endpoint and no two pieces share a real number. One closed piece covers every real from its left endpoint through its right endpoint, counting both ends. Find every nonempty set of reals that lies inside some piece of the first group and also inside some piece of the second group. Write each such set as a closed interval, ordered by the left endpoint. Each group holds fewer than 1000 pieces. Every endpoint is an integer greater than or equal to zero and strictly less than 10^9.

987.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。把根放在第零行、第零列。左孩子的行号比父亲大一、列号比父亲小一；右孩子的行号比父亲大一、列号比父亲大一。先按列号从小到大分成若干组。同一列中，行号小的排在前面；行号也相同的，按结点保存的整数从小到大排。每一列输出一组整数，列与列之间保持从左到右的次序。结点个数介于 1 和 1000 之间，结点保存的整数也介于 0 和 1000 之间。
987.en: Read a binary tree and assign coordinates. The root occupies row zero and column zero. A left child occupies the next row and the column just left of its parent. A right child occupies the next row and the column just right of its parent. Bucket the nodes by column, taking the smallest column first. Inside a column, smaller row numbers come first, and nodes that share a row are ordered by the integer stored in the node, smaller first. Write one group of integers for each column, keeping the columns from left to right. The node count is between 1 and 1000, and each stored integer is between 0 and 1000.

989.zh: 读入一串十进制数位和另一个非负加数。数位左边是高位、右边是低位。先按这个位权还原成一个整数，再与加数做十进制加法。把和重新拆成同样方向的数位并写出来。若和比原来多一位，新的最高位放在最左边。样本中 1200 加上 34 得到 1234。另一份说明里 1231 对应数位序列一、二、三、一。每一位都是 0 到 9 的整数。
989.en: Read a row of decimal digits, highest place on the left, together with a second non-negative addend. Rebuild one integer from those digits, add the addend using ordinary base-ten arithmetic, and write the sum as digits with the same place order. If the sum needs one extra high digit, put that digit at the far left. One listed sample adds 34 to 1200 and gets 1234. Another note shows 1231 as the digit row one, two, three, one. Every digit in the written row is an integer from 0 through 9.

990.zh: 读入一到 500 条长度为四的字符串。每条由两个英文小写字母和中间的关系符组成，关系符要么是连续两个等号，要么是一个感叹号再加一个等号。两个字母代表变量，允许相同。判断是否存在一种给字母填整数的方案，使每条相等关系与每条不等关系同时成立。存在就写 true，不存在就写 false。
990.en: Read from 1 to 500 strings, each exactly four characters long. The first and last characters are lowercase English letters naming variables, and those two letters may match. The middle two characters are either a pair of equals signs, or an exclamation mark followed by one equals sign. Decide whether some integer labeling of the letters makes every equality and every inequality hold together. Write true when that labeling exists and write false when it does not.

991.zh: 屏幕开始时显示正整数 X。可用的按键只有两个：把屏幕上的数乘以二，或者把屏幕上的数减一。目标显示是正整数 Y。找出从 X 变到 Y 所需的最少按键次数并写出来。X 与 Y 都落在 1 到 10^9 的闭区间里。两种按键使用次数不限，先后次序也不限。乘二之后数字仍是整数，减一之后同样保持整数。
991.en: Read two positive integers X and Y. A display begins on X. The only working controls multiply the shown value by two or subtract one from the shown value. Find how few control presses are required to make the display equal Y, and write that count. Both inputs lie in the closed range from 1 to 10^9. Each control may be used any number of times, and the presses may come in any sequence. The shown value remains an integer after every press.

992.zh: 读入一串正整数以及整数 K。从这串数里取一段连续位置，若这段里不同整数的种类恰好等于 K，就把这段计为合格。同一种整数重复出现只算一种。统计合格段的总数并写出来。整串长度至多 20000。每个元素以及 K 都是介于 1 和整串长度之间的整数。空段不算，至少要含有一个位置。
992.en: Read a row of positive integers and one integer K. Take any contiguous block of positions. The block qualifies when the count of distinct integers inside it is exactly K. Extra copies of one integer still contribute only one distinct value. Count every qualifying block and write the total. The row length is at most 20000. Each element and K itself are integers from 1 through the row length. An empty block is never counted, so every block holds at least one position.

993.zh: 读入一棵每个结点数值都不同的二叉树，以及两个不同的目标值 x 和 y。根的深度是零，任一孩子的深度等于父亲深度加一。两个结点若深度相同但父亲不是同一个，就称为堂兄弟。结点个数介于 2 和 100，结点数值取自 1 到 100。判断存有 x 的结点与存有 y 的结点是否为堂兄弟。是则写 true，否则写 false。
993.en: Read a binary tree in which every stored integer is unique, plus two different targets x and y. The root has depth zero, and each child has depth one greater than its parent. Two nodes are cousins when their depths match and their parents differ. The tree holds between 2 and 100 nodes, and each stored integer is chosen from 1 to 100. Decide whether the node storing x and the node storing y are cousins. Write true when they are cousins and write false in every other case.

995.zh: 读入一条仅含 0 和 1 的比特列，以及正整数 K。一次动作选取长度刚好为 K 的连续位置，同时把其中的 0 改成 1、把 1 改成 0。求让整列变成全 1 的最少动作次数。如果怎样做都办不到，就写 -1。比特列的长度至多 30000，K 介于 1 和该长度之间。同一段位置允许在不同动作里再次被选到。
995.en: Read a bit row that contains only the values 0 and 1, plus a positive integer K. One action selects a block whose length is exactly K and flips every bit in that block at the same time, so each 0 turns into 1 and each 1 turns into 0. Find the fewest actions that make the entire row contain only ones. When no series of actions can do so, write -1. The row length is at most 30000, and K is an integer from 1 through that length. The same block of positions may be chosen again in a later action.

996.zh: 读入长度介于 1 和 12 的一串非负整数，每个数不超过十亿。把这些数重新排队，若排队后任意两个挨着的数之和都是某个整数的平方，则这种排队合格。统计合格排队的种数并写出来。只要存在一个位置上的数不相同，两种排队就视为不同。同一个数出现多次时，按它们所在的位置区分，而不是合并成一种。
996.en: Read a row of non-negative integers whose length is from 1 to 12. Each entry is at most one billion. Rearrange the entries. A rearrangement qualifies when every two neighbors add up to the square of some integer. Count the qualifying rearrangements and write that count. Two rearrangements are distinct whenever at least one position holds unequal entries. When one value occurs several times, the arrangements are told apart by where those copies sit rather than collapsed into one.

997.zh: 人数为 n，编号从 1 连续编到 n。读入若干条信任记录，每条是两个不同编号，表示前者信任后者。若某编号不信任任何别人，同时其余每个编号都信任它，而且同时符合这两点的编号只有一个，就把该编号写出来。没有这样的编号就写 -1。n 至多 1000，记录条数至多 10000，记录两两不重复。
997.en: Read an integer n and a list of trust records. Labels run from 1 through n. Each record holds two different labels and means the first label trusts the second. A label is the judge when it trusts nobody else, every remaining label trusts it, and it is the only label meeting both tests. Write that label. Write -1 when no label meets the tests. n is at most 1000, the record count is at most 10000, and the records do not repeat. Every label stays inside 1 through n.

999.zh: 棋盘是八行八列。其中恰好一格放着白车，记作大写 R。其余格子可以是空位句点、白象大写 B 或黑卒小写 p。大写算己方，小写算对方。车只能沿水平或竖直方向直线前进，不能进入或越过白象，可以停在黑卒所在的格子上把它吃掉，也可以在碰到边界之前自己决定停下。只走一步，统计能吃到的黑卒数目并写出来。
999.en: Read an eight by eight board. Exactly one cell holds a white rook written as uppercase R. Every other cell is a dot for empty, an uppercase B for a white bishop, or a lowercase p for a black pawn. Uppercase means friendly and lowercase means opposing. The rook slides in a straight horizontal or vertical line. It may not enter or cross a bishop. It may stop on a pawn and capture it, or stop early by choice, or stop when the rim blocks it. Count the pawns capturable in one slide and write that number.

1002.zh: 读入至多 100 条单词，每条长度也至多 100，单词里只有英文小写。若某个字母在每一条单词中都出现，就按各条单词里该字母出现次数的最小值，把同样多个该字母放进结果。某条单词里缺少它，结果里就不放。写出这些字母，排列次序可以任选。次数按逐条比较后的下限计算，不按总和计算。
1002.en: Read at most 100 words, each of length at most 100, using only lowercase English letters. When a letter occurs inside every word, place that letter into the result as many times as its smallest count among the words. If any word lacks the letter, leave it out. Write the collected letters. Their order may be chosen freely. The kept count is the lower bound across words, not a sum of the counts.

1003.zh: 字母只使用 a、b、c。单独三个字母 a、b、c 依次相连视为合格。把一条合格串切成左右两截，两截都允许为空，再把 a、b、c 插在两截之间，得到的新串仍合格。这个插入可以层层套用。读入一条长度不超过 20000 的串，判断它是否合格。合格写 true，不合格写 false。串中每个字符只能是这三个字母之一。
1003.en: Letters are limited to a, b, and c. The three-letter sequence abc counts as valid on its own. Cutting a valid sequence into a left part and a right part, either part allowed to be blank, then placing abc between the parts, produces another valid sequence. Placements like this may be nested. Read one sequence whose length is at most 20000 and decide whether it is valid. Write true when it is valid and write false when it is not. Every character is one of a, b, or c.

1004.zh: 读入一条只含 0 和 1 的数列，以及整数 K。最多可以把 K 个 0 改写成 1，其余数字必须原样保留。改写之后，找出一段连续且里面全是 1 的最长区间，把区间长度写出来。数列长度至多 20000。K 介于 0 和数列长度之间。若一个 0 都不改也能得到全 1 的区间，同样按实际长度计算。
1004.en: Read a row that stores only 0 and 1, together with an integer K. At most K entries that are 0 may be rewritten as 1, and every remaining entry must stay as it is. After the rewrites, find a contiguous span filled entirely with ones whose length is as large as possible, and write that length. The row length is at most 20000. K is an integer from 0 through the row length. A span that is already filled with ones without any rewrite still counts at its real length.

1005.zh: 读入一串整数和正整数 K。每一步任选一个下标，把该下标上的数换成相反数，同一下标可以反复被选。正好执行 K 步之后，把串中全部整数相加。找出能够达到的最大和并写出来。串的长度与 K 都至多 10000，每个整数介于 -100 和 100 之间。步数必须刚好用完，不能少做。
1005.en: Read a row of integers and a positive integer K. Each step selects one index and replaces the integer at that index by its opposite sign. Selecting one index on several steps is allowed. After exactly K steps, add every integer in the row. Find the biggest attainable total and write it. Both the row length and K are at most 10000, and every integer lies between -100 and 100 inclusive. The step budget must be spent in full, with no steps left unused.

1006.zh: 读入正整数 N，范围是 1 到 10000。把 N、N 减一，依此降到 1 排成一行。相邻两数之间按乘、除、加、减的次序循环填入运算符，用完四种后再从头循环。先从左向右处理所有乘与除，除法结果向下取整，十乘以九再除以八得到十一；加减留到乘除全部完成后再从左向右计算。写出最终的整数。这个整数保证能放进三十二位有符号范围。
1006.en: Read a positive integer N in the closed range from 1 to 10000. Line the integers up as N, then one less, continuing down until 1. Between neighbors, cycle the four operator stages product, quotient, plus, and minus. Handle every product and every quotient by scanning from the left side toward the right side before any plus or minus is applied. Quotient results round downward, and the worked sample of ten times nine over eight yields eleven. After that scan, apply plus and minus from the left side toward the right side as well. Write the final integer. It is guaranteed to fit in a signed 32-bit range.

1009.zh: 读入非负整数 n，满足 0 小于等于 n 且 n 小于 109。把 n 写成二进制时不保留前导零；若 n 本身是零，二进制就写成一个零。然后把每个零换成一、每个一换成零，宽度保持不变。再把这串二进制按原样解释成十进制整数并写出来。不要额外补位，也不要删掉末尾的位。
1009.en: Read a non-negative integer n that satisfies 0 <= n < 109. Express n in binary and drop any leading zero. When n is zero, the binary form is a single zero. Then exchange every zero bit for a one bit and every one bit for a zero bit, keeping the width unchanged. Interpret the resulting bits as a binary integer and write the ordinary decimal value. Do not insert extra bits and do not drop a trailing bit.

1010.zh: 读入每首歌持续的秒数。要数的是下标对：前一个下标必须小于后一个下标，两首歌的秒数之和可以被 60 整除。把这样的下标对一共有多少写出来。歌曲条数不超过 6 乘以 104，每首歌的秒数是 1 到 500 之间的整数。同一首歌不能和自己配对，顺序不同的同一对只算一次。
1010.en: Read the length of each song in seconds. Count index pairs whose earlier index is smaller than the later index and whose lengths add to a multiple of 60. Write how many such pairs exist. The song count is at most 6 times 104, and each length is an integer from 1 through 500. A song is never paired with itself, and two orders of the same indexes count once because only the increasing index order is kept.

1011.zh: 包裹已经按传送顺序排好，第 i 件的重量记为 weights 的第 i 项。每天只能从尚未运走的最前面连续取若干件，不能跳过或重排，当天重量之和不得超过船的运力。全部包裹要在 D 天内运完。找出可行的最小运力并写出来。约束是 1 小于等于 D，D 小于等于包裹件数，件数小于等于 50000。单件重量是 1 到 500 的整数。
1011.en: Read weights kept in conveyor order and a day limit D. On one day the ship takes a nonempty contiguous block from the front of whatever packages remain. Packages may not be skipped or reordered. The weight taken on that day must not exceed capacity. All packages must depart within D days. Find the smallest capacity that allows this schedule and write it. The bounds are 1 <= D <= weights.length <= 50000. Each weight is an integer from 1 through 500.

1017.zh: 读入整数 N，范围从 0 到 10^9。用负二作为基数，把 N 表示成一串字符，每个字符只能是 0 或 1。从右端起，各位的权依次是负二的零次方、一次方、二次方，依此类推。这些位与权相乘再求和必须等于 N。若整串不是单个 0，就不要在左边补 0。把这串字符写出来。
1017.en: Read an integer N from 0 through 10^9. Write N using base negative two as a string of characters, where every character is either 0 or 1. Starting at the rightmost place, the place weights are successive powers of negative two, beginning with the zeroth power. The weighted sum of the digits must equal N. Do not place extra zeros on the left unless the whole string is the single character 0. Write that string.

1018.zh: 读入长度至多 30000 的一条 0、1 序列。对每个从最左端起、到下标 i 为止的前缀，把前缀里的 0 和 1 当成二进制，左边是高位。若该二进制数可以被 5 整除，这一项答案写 true，否则写 false。按 i 从小到大把全部答案依次写出来。序列中的每一项不是 0 就是 1，下标从零开始。
1018.en: Read a sequence of 0s and 1s whose length is at most 30000. For every prefix that begins at the leftmost entry and stops at index i, treat the prefix as a binary integer whose first bit is the high bit. Write true for that index when the integer can be divided by 5 with no remainder, and write false otherwise. Emit the booleans in increasing index order, one per prefix. Each entry of the sequence is either 0 or 1, and indexes begin at zero.

1019.zh: 读入一条链表。结点个数在 0 到 10000 之间，每个结点保存的整数在 1 到 10^9 之间。顺着指针往后看，为每个结点找出离它最近且数值严格更大的那个结点；若后面不存在更大的数值，该位置记为 0。按从头到尾的顺序把这些数值写成一列并输出。相等的数值不算更大，必须严格超过当前结点。
1019.en: Read one linked list. The node count is an integer from 0 through 10000, and every node stores an integer from 1 through 10^9. Walking forward from each node, find the closest later node whose stored integer is strictly greater. If no later node is greater, record 0 for that position. Write the recorded integers from the head node through the tail node. An equal stored integer does not count as greater, so the later value must be strictly above the current node.

1020.zh: 读入由 0 和 1 组成的网格，0 表示海，1 表示陆地。站在陆地格子上，可以向上下左右走到相邻的陆地格子，也可以直接跨出网格外沿。数一数那些怎么走都跨不出去的陆地格子，把个数写出来。行数与列数都介于 1 和 500，每一行一样长，格子里只有 0 或 1。海格子不能当作落脚点。
1020.en: Read a grid filled with 0 and 1. A 0 stands for water and a 1 stands for land. Standing on land, a step may move up, down, left, or right onto neighboring land, or a step may cross outside the outer rim. Count land cells for which no chain of steps can cross outside, and write the count. Both the number of rows and the number of columns lie between 1 and 500. All rows share one length, and every cell is either 0 or 1. Water cells cannot be used as footing.

1021.zh: 读入长度不超过 10000 的合法括号串，字符只有左括号和右括号。先把它切成若干不可再切开的最小合法段，这些段按顺序拼回去必须等于原串。对每一段删掉最外层的那一对括号，也就是段首的左括号和段尾的右括号。把各段剩下的字符按原来的先后接成一条新串并写出来。
1021.en: Read a valid bracket string whose length is at most 10000. Each character is either an opening bracket or a closing bracket. Cut the string into primitive chunks that are nonempty, valid, and impossible to divide into two shorter nonempty valid chunks. Joining those chunks in order restores the original string. On every chunk, delete the outer pair, meaning the opening bracket at its start and the closing bracket at its end. Join the leftover characters in their original order and write the new string.

1022.zh: 读入结点值只为 0 或 1 的二叉树，结点个数介于 1 和 1000。每一条从根走到叶子的路径都按途经的 0 和 1 组成一个二进制数，根上的位是最高位，叶子上的位是最低位。把所有叶子对应的二进制数相加，写出这个和。数据保证该和可以放进三十二位整数。只有走到叶子的路径才计入，中途结点单独不成数。
1022.en: Read a binary tree that stores only 0 or 1 in each node. The node count is between 1 and 1000. Each walk from the root down to a leaf builds a binary integer: the bit at the root is the highest place and the bit at the leaf is the lowest place. Add the binary integers of every leaf and write that total. The supplied cases keep the total inside a 32-bit integer. Only walks that reach a leaf are included, so a node in the middle does not form a number by itself.

1025.zh: 黑板一开始写着整数 N，N 的范围是 1 到 1000。爱丽丝与鲍勃轮流改写这个数，爱丽丝先改。每一步选择正整数 x，x 必须小于当前数，而且当前数除以 x 的余数为零，随后把当前数减去 x。选不出合法 x 的一方失败。双方都采取对自己最有利的走法。判断爱丽丝是否会赢，会赢写 true，否则写 false。
1025.en: A board starts with an integer N, and N lies between 1 and 1000. Alice and Bob take alternate turns changing that integer, with Alice going first. A turn chooses a positive integer x that is smaller than the current integer and leaves a zero remainder when the current integer is divided by x. The chosen x is then subtracted from the current integer. Whoever has no legal x loses. Both sides choose the move that helps them most. Decide if Alice has a win. Write true when she does and write false when she does not.

1026.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，结点个数介于 2 和 5000，每个结点里的整数介于 0 和 100000。当一个结点位于另一个结点通往根的链上，而且两者不是同一结点时，计算它们所存整数之差的绝对值。在所有这种配对中找出最大的绝对值并写出来。根上面没有更靠上的结点。差值只在这条链上的配对里比较。
1026.en: Read a binary tree holding between 2 and 5000 nodes. Every node stores an integer from 0 through 100000. When one node lies on the chain that runs from another distinct node up toward the root, compute the absolute difference between the two stored integers. Search every such pair and write the greatest absolute difference. No node sits above the root on that chain. Differences are compared only for pairs that stand in this chain relation.

1028.zh: 从一份先序记录把二叉树重建出来。根的层级记作 0，某个结点的层级为 D 时，它的孩子层级是 D 加 1。每个结点先写下与层级相同个数的连字符，紧接着写下它保存的正整数。若某结点只带一个孩子，这个孩子一定挂在左边。结点总数从 1 到 1000，每个保存的整数从 1 到 1000000000。读入整段记录，写出还原之后的树根。
1028.en: Read a preorder transcript and rebuild the binary tree it describes. The top node sits at level zero, and a child sits one level below its parent. Each entry begins with a run of hyphens whose count equals that level, then gives the positive integer stored there. When a node owns a single child, that child hangs on the left side. The tree holds from 1 to 1000 nodes, and every stored integer lies between 1 and 1000000000. Write the root of the recovered tree.

1030.zh: 读入两个正整数，分别当作网格的行数和列数，再读入一个起点格子的行号与列号。行号从 0 取到行数减 1，列号从 0 取到列数减 1。行数和列数都落在 1 到 100 之间，起点一定落在网格里面。把每一个格子写成坐标，按它到起点的曼哈顿距离由近到远排列。曼哈顿距离等于行差的绝对值加上列差的绝对值。距离相同的格子谁先谁后都可以。写出排好的全部坐标。
1030.en: Read two positive integers that give how many rows and columns a grid has, plus the row and column of one start cell. Row indexes run from 0 up to the row count minus 1, and column indexes run the same way. Both dimensions lie between 1 and 100, and the start cell lies inside the grid. List every cell as a coordinate pair, ordered by Manhattan distance from the start, nearer cells first. That distance is the absolute row gap plus the absolute column gap. Cells that share a distance may appear in any mutual order. Write the full list.

1034.zh: 读入一块若干行若干列的颜色网格，以及起点的行号、列号和一种准备涂上的新颜色。格子里的整数就是该处原来的颜色。行数和列数都在 1 到 50 之间，各种颜色含新颜色在内都在 1 到 1000 之间，起点落在网格内。颜色相同并且共享一条边的格子属于同一片区域。区域中的格子如果有一边挨着区域以外，或者它贴着整张网格的外沿，就算这片区域的边缘。把含有起点的那片区域的边缘涂成新颜色，别的格子保持原样。写出涂完的网格。
1034.en: Read a grid of colors with several rows and columns, the row and column of a start square, and a new paint value. Each stored integer is the color already there. Both dimensions run from 1 to 50, every color including the paint value runs from 1 to 1000, and the start square lies inside the grid. Squares that share a color and touch along a side belong to one region. A square of that region lies on its edge when one side touches a square outside the region, or when the square sits on the outer rim of the whole grid. Paint every edge square of the region that contains the start, using the new paint value, and leave every other square as it was. Write the finished grid.

1037.zh: 读入平面上的三个点，每个点写成一对整数，横纵坐标都落在 0 到 100 的闭区间里，输入里点的个数固定是三个。判断这三个点能不能算作一枚有效的回旋镖。三个位置必须彼此不同，同时它们不能共处同一条直线。两个条件一起成立就写出真。只要任意两点重合，或者三点排成一条直线，就写出假。
1037.en: Read three points that sit on a flat plane. Each point is a pair of integers, and every coordinate is an integer from 0 through 100. The input always contains exactly three points. Judge whether those points form a valid boomerang. All three locations must differ from one another, and they must fail to lie on one common straight line. Write true when both rules hold. Write false when any two points coincide or when the three points are collinear.

1038.zh: 读入一棵搜索树的根。树上结点个数在 1 到 100 之间，每个结点保存的整数也在 0 到 100 之间，并且互不重复。左孩子比父结点小，右孩子比父结点大，两侧挂着的部分同样遵守这条次序。把每个结点改写成一个新整数，新值等于改写前所有不比该结点旧值小的那些数之和。写出改写之后的树根。
1038.en: Read one search tree through the pointer to its top node. The node count lies between 1 and 100. Every stored integer also lies between 0 and 100, and the values never repeat. Any key in a left branch is smaller than the parent key, and any key in a right branch is larger. Both branches obey the same ordering. Replace each key by the sum of every original key that is at least as large as that key. Write the top node after this replacement.

1040.zh: 数轴没有尽头，石子放在互不相同的整数位置上。石子颗数从 3 到 10000，每个位置从 1 到 1000000000。当前最左或最右的那颗叫做端部。每一手拿起一颗端部的石子，把它放到一个空着的整数点上，放下之后它不能还占据最左或最右。若无论放在哪里它都仍然占据端部，这一手就不允许。石子占满一段连续整数时无法再动手，对局停止。找出停止前最少能走多少手，以及最多能走多少手。先写较小的次数，再写较大的次数。
1040.en: Read distinct stone positions along an endless axis. The count of stones runs from 3 to 10000, and each coordinate is an integer from 1 to 1000000000. A stone counts as an end when it currently holds the least or greatest coordinate. One move lifts an end stone and drops it on an empty integer so the dropped stone is not an end afterward. A lift is illegal when every empty landing would leave that same stone as an end. Play stops once the occupied spots form an unbroken block of integers. Find the fewest legal moves that can reach a stop, and the most legal moves that can be spent before a stop. Write the two counts with the smaller one first.

1047.zh: 读入一条只含小写英文字母的字符串，长度从 1 到 20000。只要还有两个相同字母紧挨在一起，就把这一对抹掉。抹掉之后两边可能重新贴住，于是继续寻找下一对。一直做到再也找不到相邻而又相同的字母为止。最终剩下的内容不会因抹掉次序不同而改变。写出这条剩下的字符串。
1047.en: Read one string made only of lowercase English letters. Its length is an integer from 1 through 20000. Whenever two copies of the same letter stand side by side, erase that pair. Letters that were farther apart may become neighbors after an erasure, so keep scanning. Stop when no neighboring pair shares a letter. The remaining characters do not depend on which eligible pair is erased first. Write the remaining string.

1048.zh: 读入若干个只由小写英文字母构成的单词。单词个数从 1 到 1000，每个单词的长度从 1 到 16。若在较短单词的某个位置塞进恰好一个字母就能得到较长单词，就把较短的那个称作较长那个的前驱。从这份名单里挑出单词排成一列，要求前一个是后一个的前驱。单独一个单词也算长度为 1 的列。找出最长一列包含多少个单词，并把这个长度写出来。
1048.en: Read several words built from lowercase English letters only. The list holds between 1 and 1000 words, and each word spans between 1 and 16 letters. Call the shorter word a forerunner of the longer one when placing exactly one extra letter into the shorter word, at any index, yields the longer word. Pick words from this list and line them up so each word is a forerunner of the next. One lone word is a line of length 1. Find how many words the longest line can contain, and write that count.

1049.zh: 读入若干块石头的正整数重量。块数从 1 到 30，每块重量从 1 到 100。每一轮任选两块来碰撞。两块一样重时，两块都消失。不一样重时，较轻的消失，较重的变成二者重量的正差值。一直进行到最多只留一块。在所有选择次序里，找出最后这块石头可能出现的最小重量。什么都不剩时，这个重量记为 0。把该最小重量写出来。
1049.en: Read the positive integer weights of a pile of stones. The pile contains from 1 to 30 stones, and each weight is an integer from 1 to 100. On every turn, select any pair and smash them. Equal weights make both stones disappear. Unequal weights make the lighter stone disappear and replace the heavier weight by their positive difference. Keep going until one stone or none remains. Over every sequence of choices, find the least weight that the final stone can have. Use 0 when the pile can be cleared completely. Write that least weight.

1051.zh: 读入一排学生的身高。人数从 1 到 100，每个身高是 1 到 100 的整数。目标是让整排身高变成非递减。可以圈出一部分人，只在这些人之间任意调换座位，没被圈出的人留在原来的座位上。找出最少需要圈出多少人，才能在这种调换之后让整排变成非递减。把这个最少人数写出来。
1051.en: Read the heights of students standing in one row. The row length is from 1 to 100, and each height is an integer from 1 to 100. The row should end up sorted so height never falls as you walk from left to right. You may mark some students and rearrange only those marked students among the seats they already occupy. Everyone left unmarked stays in the same seat. Find the smallest number of marked students that makes such a rearrangement possible. Write that number.

1052.zh: 书店按分钟营业，分钟数等于顾客数组的长度，这个长度从 1 到 20000。每一分钟进来的人数在 0 到 1000 之间，他们在该分钟结束时全部离开。生气标记只取 0 或 1。标记为 1 时，这一分钟进来的人都不满意。标记为 0 时，这些人都满意。老板可以选定连续的若干分钟保持平静，这段长度记为 X，X 从 1 到分钟数，而且这种平静只能用一次。没被这段盖住的生气分钟仍然让顾客不满意。找出全天最多能让多少名顾客满意，并把这个人数写出来。
1052.en: Read a per-minute arrival count, a mood flag for each minute, and an integer X. The open period lasts from 1 to 20000 minutes, X is at least 1 and at most that period, each arrival count is from 0 to 1000, and each flag is 0 or 1. People who arrive during a minute leave when it ends. A flag of 1 makes that minute's visitors unhappy, while a flag of 0 makes them happy. The owner may pick one block of X back-to-back minutes and force every flag inside it to behave as calm. That block may be used only a single time. Find the largest total of happy visitors achievable in the whole period, and write it.

1054.zh: 读入仓库里的一排条码。条码的个数从 1 到 10000，每个编号都是 1 到 10000 之间的整数。把这些编号重新排成一行，使得任意两个紧挨着的位置都不会出现同一个编号。只要满足相邻互异，具体先后可以任选。输入保证这样的排法一定存在。写出你选中的那一排编号。
1054.en: Read one sequence of barcode integers. The sequence length runs from 1 to 10000, and every value also runs from 1 to 10000. Produce a new order of the same multiset of values. In that order, neighboring positions must hold different numbers. Any order that meets this neighbor rule is acceptable. The input always admits at least one such order. Write the values in the order you chose.

1073.zh: 读入两个以负二为基数的整数，各自写成 0 与 1 的数组，左端是最高位，右端是最低位。数组长度从 1 到 1000，每一位只可能是 0 或 1。除了表示零的那个单元素数组以外，左端不能是 0。某一位上的 1 代表负二的对应次幂。把两个整数相加，再用同一种没有前导零的数组把和写出来。
1073.en: Read two integers written in base negative two. Each integer arrives as an array of bits 0 and 1, with the highest place on the left and the lowest place on the right. Each array length is from 1 to 1000, and every bit is 0 or 1. A 1 in a place stands for the matching power of negative two. Neither array has a leading zero, except that zero itself is the single entry 0. Add the two integers. Write the sum in the same bit array form, again without a leading zero.

1074.zh: 读入一个整数矩阵和一个目标整数。行数与列数都在 1 到 300 之间，每个元素在负 1000 到 1000 之间，目标整数在负 100000000 到 100000000 之间。一块子块由连续的若干行与连续的若干列相交而成，而且不能是空的。两块只要有一条边界下标不一样就算作不同的块。找出元素加起来恰好等于目标整数的子块一共有多少，并把这个块数写出来。
1074.en: Read an integer matrix together with a target integer. The matrix has between 1 and 300 rows and between 1 and 300 columns. Every entry lies between -1000 and 1000. The target lies between -100000000 and 100000000. A block is a nonempty rectangle made from consecutive rows and consecutive columns. Two blocks count as distinct when at least one boundary index differs. Count how many blocks have entries adding up to the target. Write that count.

1078.zh: 读入一段文本和两个词。文本里的词用空格隔开，文本总长度从 1 到 1000，两个词的长度各自从 1 到 10，词中只有小写英文字母。从左到右查看紧连的三个词。当前两个词依次正好是读入的那两个词时，把第三个词记下来。同一段里可以记下不止一次。按从左到右的次序写出记下来的全部词。
1078.en: Read a passage and two words called the lead word and the follow word. Spaces separate the words of the passage. The passage length is from 1 to 1000 characters, each of those two words has length from 1 to 10, and every word uses lowercase English letters only. Scan consecutive triples of words from left to right. Whenever the opening pair of a triple matches the lead word and then the follow word, record the remaining word of that triple. Several matches may occur. Write the recorded words in left to right order.

1079.zh: 读入一套活字，每块活字上面刻着一个大写英文字母，块数从 1 到 7。可以只用其中一部分，但同一块不能使用两次。用选出的活字排成一行，字母次序不同就算不同结果，什么都不排不算。刻着相同字母的活字彼此没有区别。找出一共能排出多少种非空的字母序列，并把这个数目写出来。
1079.en: Read a collection of letter tiles. Each tile shows one uppercase English letter, and the number of tiles is from 1 to 7. You may use any nonempty subset of the tiles, but each physical tile is used at most once. Arrange the chosen tiles in a row. Two arrangements differ when their letter order differs. Tiles that show the same letter are interchangeable. Count every distinct nonempty sequence that can be formed this way, and write the count.

1089.zh: 读入一条整数数组，长度事先固定，范围从 1 到 10000，每个数只取 0 到 9。针对原来就存在的每一个 0，在它后面再补一个 0，并把右侧的数依次向末尾挪动。由补出来的 0 不要再次追加。挪出原长度之外的数全部舍弃，因此长度保持不变。直接在这条数组上完成修改，然后把修改后的数组写出来。
1089.en: Read an integer array whose length stays fixed. The length runs from 1 to 10000, and every entry is an integer from 0 through 9. For each zero that was already present, place one extra zero directly after it and shift later entries toward the end. Do not repeat the process on a zero that was created as a copy. Discard anything that would extend past the original length, so the length stays unchanged. Perform the change inside the same array, then write the array.

1091.zh: 读入一个阶数为 N 的正方形格子，N 从 1 到 100，每个格子只写 0 或 1。0 表示可以走进去，1 表示被挡住。一条路线从两个下标都是 0 的角落出发，走到两个下标都是 N 减 1 的对角。每一步可以迈进周围八格里的一格，斜向也算，而且经过的格子都必须写着 0。路线长度按经过的格子个数计算，两头的格子都要计入。找出最短路线有多长。没有路线时写出负 1，否则写出该长度。
1091.en: Read an N by N grid of zeros and ones. N is an integer from 1 to 100. A zero can be entered and a one is blocked. A route begins at the corner whose two indexes are both zero and finishes at the corner whose two indexes are both N minus 1. Each step moves into one of the eight neighboring cells, including diagonals, and every cell on the route must hold zero. The length of a route counts every cell visited, including both ends. Find the smallest such length. Write -1 when no route exists, otherwise write that length.

1093.zh: 对 0 到 255 这些整数做了抽样，计数数组的长度固定是 256，下标 k 上的数字表示整数 k 被抽到的次数。样本总个数从 1 到 1000000000。出现次数最高的那个整数保证只有一个。按最小数、最大数、平均数、中位数、出现次数最高的数这个次序写出五个浮点数。样本个数为奇数时，中位数取排序后正中央的那个数。样本个数为偶数时，中位数取正中央两个数的算术平均。绝对误差不超过 1e-5 即可接受。
1093.en: Read a histogram of length 256 for the integers 0 through 255, where slot k tells how many times the value k was drawn. The total number of draws is from 1 to 1000000000. Exactly one value occurs most often. Write five floating point numbers in this order: smallest value, largest value, average, median, and the most frequent value. When the draw count is odd, the median is the central value after the draws are sorted. When the draw count is even, the median is the arithmetic mean of the two central values. A result within an absolute error of 1e-5 is acceptable.

1104.zh: 想象一棵没有尽头的二叉树，每个结点都有左右两个孩子，下一行的结点数正好是上一行的两倍。用从 1 开始的正整数逐行填写，根单独占第一行。奇数行自左向右变大，偶数行自右向左变大，行与行的数字首尾相接、没有空缺。读入一个目标标号，它在 1 到 1000000 之间。找出从最上面走到这个标号时经过的每一个标号，按自上而下的次序写出这条标号序列。
1104.en: Picture an endless binary tree in which every node owns a left child and a right child, so each lower row holds twice as many nodes as the row above it. Positive integers starting at 1 fill the nodes row by row, and the top row holds only the first label. On odd rows the numbers grow from the left side toward the right side. On even rows the numbers grow from the right side toward the left side. Successive rows continue the integer sequence without gaps. Read one target label between 1 and 1000000. Find every label visited while walking downward from the top node to that target. Write those labels from the top downward.

1105.zh: 读入已经排好先后的若干本书，以及每一层书架允许的总宽度。每本书用两个正整数描述，先写厚度，再写高度。本数从 1 到 1000。厚度、高度和层宽都落在 1 到 1000，而且单本厚度不会超过层宽。摆的时候不能打乱原有先后。同一层里厚度相加不得超过层宽，这一层的高度取该层各书高度里的最大值。书架的总高度等于每一层高度相加。找出能够达到的最小总高度，并把这个高度写出来。
1105.en: Read books already lined up, plus the width allowed on every shelf. Book number i is described by two positive integers, thickness first and height second. There are between 1 and 1000 books. Thickness, height, and shelf width each lie between 1 and 1000, and no single book is thicker than the shelf. Keep the original sequence while placing them. On one shelf the thicknesses must add up to at most the width, and that shelf's height is the tallest book placed there. The full bookcase height is the sum of its shelf heights. Find the smallest bookcase height achievable under these rules, and write it.

1108.zh: 读入一条有效的网际协议第四版地址。它包含四段十进制数字，相邻两段之间是一个点号，输入保证这段文本确实合法。把每一个点号单独换成左方括号、点号、右方括号这三个字符，各段里的数字都保持不变，也不要增加、删除或重排这四段。写出替换结束后的整段字符串。
1108.en: Read one valid Internet Protocol version 4 address as text. It holds four decimal sections separated by single dots, and the input is guaranteed to be a legal address. Replace each dot by the three characters left bracket, dot, and right bracket. Leave every digit unchanged, and do not insert, delete, or reorder the four sections. Write the full string after those replacements are done.

1110.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，以及一份要删掉的数值名单。结点个数不超过 1000，每个结点的数值在 1 到 1000 之间并且互不相同。名单长度也不超过 1000，其中的数值同样互不相同，而且都落在 1 到 1000。把名单里出现过的结点全部摘掉。某个结点被摘掉后，它还留着的每个孩子都变成一棵独立树的根。剩下的几棵互不连接的树形成一片林子。按任意先后写出这些树的根。
1110.en: Read a binary tree and a list of values that must be removed. The tree contains at most 1000 nodes. Every node stores a distinct integer from 1 to 1000. The removal list has length at most 1000, its entries are distinct, and each entry also lies between 1 and 1000. Erase every node whose value appears on that list. When a node is erased, each child that remains becomes the top of its own tree. The surviving pieces form a collection of separate trees. Write the tops of those trees in any order you like.

1111.zh: 读入一条只含左右圆括号而且本身合法的字符串，长度从 1 到 10000。把每个字符分进甲组或乙组，两组都要各自成为合法的括号串，每个字符恰好进入一组，组内还要保持原有的相对次序。空片段的深度是 0。两段合法片段首尾相接时，深度取两边里较大的那个。在一段合法片段外包上一对匹配括号时，深度比内部多 1。让两组深度里较大的那个尽量小。写出与原串等长的数组，用 0 表示分到甲组，用 1 表示分到乙组。多种分法都可行时，写出任意一种。
1111.en: Read a parentheses string that is already valid and has length from 1 to 10000. It contains only round opening and closing brackets. Assign every character to group A or group B so that each group is itself a valid parentheses string, every character is used once, and each group keeps the original relative order. The depth of an empty piece is 0. Joining two valid pieces yields the larger of their depths. Wrapping a valid piece in one matching pair increases its depth by one. Make the larger of the two group depths as small as possible. Write an array of the same length as the input, using 0 for group A and 1 for group B. If several assignments work, write any one of them.

1122.zh: 读入两个整数数组。它们的长度都不超过 1000，里面的整数都在 0 到 1000 之间。后一个数组里的数互不相同，而且每个数都在前一个数组里出现过。把前一个数组重新排列。凡是也出现在后一个数组里的数，要维持它们在后一个数组中的彼此先后。后一个数组里没有的数，按从小到大集中到尾巴上。写出排好的前一个数组。
1122.en: Read two integer arrays. Each array has length at most 1000, and every value lies between 0 and 1000. Values inside the second array are unique, and each of them occurs somewhere in the first array. Reorder the first array. Values that also occur in the second array must keep the same mutual order they have there. Values absent from the second array must be gathered at the tail and sorted from low to high. Write the reordered first array.

1123.zh: 读入一棵有根的二叉树。结点个数在 1 到 1000 之间，每个结点的数值在 1 到 1000 之间且互不相同。没有孩子的结点称作叶子。最上面那个结点的深度记为 0，每个孩子都比它的父亲深一层。在全部叶子里面，留下深度最大的那些。它们共同的祖先是仍能包住每一个这样叶子的最深结点。写出这个祖先结点。
1123.en: Read a rooted binary tree holding between 1 and 1000 nodes. Each node stores a distinct integer from 1 to 1000. Call a node a leaf when it has no child. The top node has depth 0, and every child is one level below its parent. Among all leaves, keep those whose depth is greatest. Their shared ancestor is the deepest node whose branch still contains every one of those leaves. Write that ancestor node.

1128.zh: 读入若干张骨牌，每张牌用两个整数表示上下两半的点数。牌的张数从 1 到 40000，每一半的点数从 1 到 9。两张牌如果本来就相同，或者把其中一张转动 180 度之后变得相同，就当作一对匹配。别的转动角度不算。在前一个下标严格小于后一个下标的前提下，统计匹配的牌对一共有多少，并把这个对数写出来。
1128.en: Read a list of dominoes, each written as two integers for its two halves. The list length runs from 1 to 40000, and each half shows an integer from 1 to 9. Treat two dominoes as matching when they already show the same ordered pair, or when turning one of them by 180 degrees makes the ordered pairs agree. Other turns do not count. Count index pairs where the earlier index is strictly smaller and the two dominoes match. Write that count.

1137.zh: 有一条下标从 0 开始的数列。第 0 项是 0，第 1 项是 1，第 2 项是 1。当下标 k 不小于 0 时，下标 k 加 3 的那一项等于下标 k、k 加 1 与 k 加 2 这三项相加。读入一个整数 n，范围从 0 到 37。找出第 n 项并把它写出来。这个结果一定能放进 32 位有符号整数，上界是 2 的 31 次方减去 1。
1137.en: A numeric sequence is indexed from 0. Index 0 holds 0, index 1 holds 1, and index 2 holds 1. For every index k that is at least 0, the term at index k plus 3 equals the sum of the terms at indexes k, k plus 1, and k plus 2. Read an integer n in the closed range from 0 to 37. Find the term at index n and write it. The result always fits in a signed 32 bit integer, so it is at most two to the power 31, minus one.

1143.zh: 读入两段文本，每段只含小写英文字母，长度至少为 1、至多为 1000。可以从每段里丢掉任意多个字符，留下的字符必须保持原先的先后次序。两边留下的内容要完全一样，并且在所有合法留法里尽量长。把这个共同内容的长度写出来。若两段没有任何能对上的非空内容，就写 0。
1143.en: Read two strings made only of lowercase English letters. Each string has length at least 1 and at most 1000. Characters may be dropped from either string, but whatever stays must keep its original relative order. The two remaining pieces must be identical, and they should be as long as any legal choice allows. Write that shared length. If the strings have no matching non-empty piece, write 0.

1145.zh: 读入一棵有 n 个节点的二叉树和先手选中的值 x。n 是奇数，节点值是 1 到 n 的不同整数，并且满足 1 <= x <= n <= 100。先手已经把值为 x 的节点涂红。后手必须另选一个不同的值涂成蓝色。之后双方轮流，每次只能从自己已经涂过的节点出发，给尚未涂色的父亲或左孩子或右孩子涂色，无路可走就空过。双方都无法再涂时，涂得更多的一方获胜。判断后手是否存在必胜的选点，能则写 true，不能则写 false。
1145.en: Read a binary tree of n nodes and a value x already chosen by the first player. The count n is odd, node values are the distinct integers from 1 through n, and 1 <= x <= n <= 100. The first player has painted the node holding x. The second player must paint a different value. Players then alternate. A turn paints one unpainted neighbor of a node that player already owns, and a neighbor means the parent, the left child, or the right child. A player who cannot paint skips. When both must skip, whoever painted more nodes wins. Decide whether the second player has a first choice that forces a win. Write true or false.

1154.zh: 读入长度为 10 的日期文本，第 5 位和第 8 位是短横线，其余都是数字，格式为四位年份、两位月份、两位日。这个日期是公历里真实存在的一天，范围从 1900 年 1 月 1 日到 2019 年 12 月 31 日。把这一天是所在年份的第几天写出来，1 月 1 日算第 1 天。二月在闰年按 29 天计，在平年按 28 天计。年份上界是 2019。
1154.en: Read a date stored as a 10-character text. Characters at the fifth and eighth places are hyphens, and every other character is a digit, so the shape is a four-digit year, a two-digit month, and a two-digit day. The date is a real Gregorian day from January 1, 1900 through December 31, 2019. Write which day of that year it is, counting January 1 as day 1. February has 29 days in a leap year and 28 days otherwise. The latest year allowed is 2019.

1157.zh: 用一条整数序列建好一个查询结构。序列长度在 1 到 20000 之间，每个整数也在 1 到 20000 之间。之后最多到来 10000 次提问。每次提问给出闭区间的左端、右端和一个次数下限，左端不超过右端，两端都在下标范围内，而且次数下限一定严格大于该区间长度的一半。在这个连续下标范围内找出出现次数达到下限的整数并写出来。若没有这样的整数，写 -1。
1157.en: Prepare a lookup from one integer list. The list length is from 1 to 20000, and every stored integer is also from 1 to 20000. After that, at most 10000 questions arrive. A question names a closed index span and a count floor. The left index is not past the right index, both indexes lie inside the list, and the floor is always strictly more than half the span length. Write the integer that occurs at least that many times inside the span. If no integer reaches the floor, write -1.

1160.zh: 读入一份单词清单和一串字母库存，全部由小写英文字母组成。清单里的单词个数在 1 到 1000 之间，每个单词以及库存的长度都在 1 到 100 之间。某个单词能被拼出，当且仅当它所需要的每种字母的个数都不超过库存里该字母的个数。把所有能拼出的单词的长度相加，把这个和写出来。同一份库存不能在一个单词内部被重复透支。
1160.en: Read a word list and one stock of letters. Every character is a lowercase English letter. The list contains between 1 and 1000 words, and each word as well as the stock has length between 1 and 100. A word can be spelled exactly when every letter it needs is available at least as many times in the stock. Sum the lengths of all words that can be spelled, and write that sum. Counts in the stock cannot be overdrawn inside a single word. The list cap is 1000.

1170.zh: 对一条非空的小写字符串，先确定其中字典序最小的字母，再数这个字母出现了几次，把次数当作该串的分数。读入两组字符串：待查组和对照词表。每组的条数都在 1 到 2000 之间，每条的长度都在 1 到 10 之间。针对待查组里的每一条，数出对照词表中分数严格更大的词有多少个。按待查组原来的顺序，把这些个数写成一列整数。
1170.en: Score a non-empty lowercase string by finding its alphabetically earliest letter and counting how often that letter occurs. Read two groups of strings: a question group and a comparison bank. Each group holds between 1 and 2000 strings, and every string has length between 1 and 10. For each question, count how many bank entries have a strictly higher score. Write those counts as one integer per question, preserving the question order. Both groups are capped at 2000 strings.

1171.zh: 读入一条链表。节点个数在 1 到 1000 之间，每个节点保存的整数绝对值不超过 1000。只要还找得到一段连续节点，它们的数值相加正好等于 0，就把这一整段摘除，并让断开的两侧重新连上。不断重复，直到再也没有和为 0 的连续段。写出最终链表的头。若多种摘除顺序都能清完，写出其中任意一种结果即可。
1171.en: Read one linked list. It contains between 1 and 1000 nodes, and every stored integer has absolute value at most 1000. Whenever a contiguous run of nodes adds up to zero, remove that entire run and reconnect the two sides. Continue until no zero-sum run is left. Write the head of the list that remains. If more than one removal order can finish the cleanup, any finished list is acceptable. The node cap is 1000.

1175.zh: 把整数 1 到 n 各用一次排成一列，位置从 1 开始编号，并且 1 <= n <= 100。每个质数都必须放在质数位置上。质数是大于 1、又不能写成两个更小正整数相乘的整数。统计满足这条限制的排列有多少种。总数可能非常大，写出它对 10^9+7 取余后的结果。
1175.en: Place each integer from 1 through n once in a row. Positions are numbered starting at 1, and n is an integer with 1 <= n <= 100. Every prime number must occupy a prime position. A prime is an integer greater than 1 that is not a product of two smaller positive integers. Count the placements that obey this rule. The count may be very large, so write it modulo 10^9 + 7. The upper bound on n is 100.

1178.zh: 读入一批小写单词和一批谜面。单词条数在 1 到 100000 之间，每条长度在 4 到 50 之间。谜面有 1 到 10000 条，每条恰好 7 个互不相同的小写字母。一个单词能回答某条谜面，必须含有该谜面排在最前的那个字母，而且单词里用到的字母都能在这条谜面里找到。对每条谜面分别统计能回答它的单词个数，按谜面原来的次序把这些个数写成一列。
1178.en: Read a bank of lowercase words and a list of puzzle strings. The bank holds between 1 and 100000 words, and each word has length 4 through 50. There are between 1 and 10000 puzzles, each made of exactly 7 different lowercase letters. A word answers a puzzle only if it includes that puzzle's opening letter and every letter used by the word also occurs in the puzzle. For each puzzle, count the answering words. Write those counts in the original puzzle order. The bank cap is 100000.

1184.zh: n 座车站围成一圈，编号从 0 到 n-1，且 1 <= n <= 10000。读入长度为 n 的路程表，第 i 项是车站 i 到车站 (i+1) 对 n 取余后那一站的距离，每段距离是 0 到 10000 的整数。车辆既能沿顺时针开，也能沿逆时针开。再读入起点站和终点站，二者都是合法编号。写出乘客从起点到终点的较短路程。
1184.en: Stops numbered 0 through n - 1 form a loop, and n is an integer from 1 to 10000. Read a travel table of length n. Entry i is the distance from stop i to stop (i + 1) modulo n, and every distance is an integer from 0 to 10000. A vehicle may run clockwise or the opposite way. Also read a departure stop and an arrival stop, both legal indexes. Write the shorter travel distance a rider needs between those two stops. The distance cap is 10000.

1185.zh: 读入三个整数，按顺序表示日、月和年。这三个数必然对应 1971 到 2100 年之间某一个真实的公历日子。判断这一天是星期几。写出的结果必须是 Sunday、Monday、Tuesday、Wednesday、Thursday、Friday、Saturday 这七个英文名字中的一个。计算时按公历处理闰年，二月可能有 29 天。允许的最晚年份是 2100。
1185.en: Read three integers meaning, in order, the day, the month, and the year. The date is always a valid Gregorian day, and the year is between 1971 and 2100. Decide which weekday that date falls on. The written name must be one of Sunday or Monday or Tuesday or Wednesday or Thursday or Friday or Saturday. Apply Gregorian leap-year rules, so February may contain 29 days. The latest permitted year is 2100.

1189.zh: 读入一条长度为 1 到 10000 的字符串，其中每个字符都是英文小写。要用这些字符尽量多地拼出单词 balloon，同一个字符至多使用一次。每拼一份都要消耗一个 b、一个 a、两个 l、两个 o 和一个 n。写出最多能够拼成的份数。某种必需字母用尽之后，就不能再多拼一份。长度上界是 10000。
1189.en: Read one string whose length is between 1 and 10000. It contains lowercase English letters only. Use those letters to build the greatest count of balloon spellings, and use each letter at most once. Every copy consumes one b, one a, two l letters, two o letters, and one n. Write the largest number of copies that can be built. After a needed letter is exhausted, no extra copy can be built. The length bound is 10000.

1190.zh: 读入一条长度在 0 到 2000 之间的字符串。它只包含小写英文字母和圆括号，而且所有括号都已正确配对。先处理最里面的一对括号，把这对括号之间的文字前后对调，然后按同样办法处理更外面的各对，直到每一对都处理过。写出最终文字。结果里面不得保留任何括号字符。长度上界是 2000。
1190.en: Read a string whose length is from 0 to 2000. It holds only lowercase English letters and round parentheses, and all parentheses are correctly paired. Begin with the innermost pair and flip the text sitting inside that pair, then apply the same flip to pairs farther outward until every pair has been handled. Write the finished text. No parenthesis character may remain in the result. The length bound is 2000.

1200.zh: 读入一组互不相同的整数。个数在 2 到 100000 之间，每个整数都介于 -1000000 和 1000000 之间。考察任意两个数的差的绝对值，先确定其中最小的那个差值。把所有达到这个最小差值的数对都找出来。每一对都让较小的数写在前面。再把这些数对按升序全部写出来。数值上界是 1000000。
1200.en: Read a list of distinct integers. Its length is between 2 and 100000, and every integer lies between -1000000 and 1000000. Consider the absolute gap between every two values and determine the smallest gap that occurs. Collect every pair of values whose absolute gap equals that smallest gap. Write each pair with the lesser value before the greater value, and write the collected pairs in ascending order. The magnitude bound is 1000000.

1201.zh: 若一个正整数能被 a、b、c 当中至少一个数整除，就把它算作本题里的丑数。读入四个正整数 n、a、b、c。它们各自介于 1 和 10^9 之间，而且 a、b、c 三者的乘积介于 1 和 10^18 之间。把从小到大数起的第 n 个丑数写出来。结果保证落在 1 到 2 乘 10^9 这个区间里。乘积上界是 10^18。
1201.en: Treat a positive integer as ugly in this task when at least one of a, b, and c divides it. Read four positive integers n, a, b, and c. Each of them lies between 1 and 10^9, and the product of a, b, and c lies between 1 and 10^18. Write the n-th ugly integer when the ugly integers are listed from smallest to largest. The result is guaranteed to lie between 1 and 2 times 10^9. The product bound is 10^18.

1202.zh: 读入一条只含小写英文字母的字符串，长度在 1 到 100000 之间，另读入若干组可交换的下标。组数在 0 到 100000 之间，下标从 0 计起，并且都落在字符串内部。任意一组下标上的两个字符可以交换任意多次，反复交换还能在互相连通的位置之间搬运字母。写出经过这些交换之后，按字母表顺序排在最前的那条字符串。规模上界是 100000。
1202.en: Read a string of lowercase English letters whose length is between 1 and 100000, plus a collection of index pairs that may be exchanged. The collection holds between 0 and 100000 pairs. Indexes start at 0 and always lie inside the string. Letters at any listed pair of indexes may be exchanged any number of times, and repeated exchanges can move letters among positions connected through these pairs. Write the alphabetically earliest string reachable by such exchanges. The size bound is 100000.

1203.zh: 共有 n 件任务，它们属于至多 m 个小组，限制为 1 <= m <= n <= 3 * 104。读入 group，其中 group[i] 表示第 i 件任务的小组编号，没有小组时记为 -1。任务和小组都从 0 编号，有的小组可以一件任务都没有。再读入 beforeItems，beforeItems[i] 列出必须出现在第 i 件任务左边的任务，且不会指向自己。写出一种顺序，让同组任务连成一段，并满足全部先后约束。多种顺序都可以时写出任意一种；无法安排时写出空列表。
1203.en: There are n tasks belonging to at most m groups, with 1 <= m <= n <= 3 * 104. Read group, where group[i] names the group of task i and is -1 when the task has none. Tasks and groups are numbered from zero, and a group may own no task. Also read beforeItems. The list beforeItems[i] names tasks that must appear somewhere left of task i, and a task does not point at itself. Write an order where tasks of one group occupy one contiguous block and every predecessor constraint holds. If several orders work, write any. If none works, write an empty list.

1207.zh: 读入一条整数序列。序列长度在 1 到 1000 之间，每个整数也介于 -1000 和 1000 之间。分别统计每一种取值出现了几次。判断这些出现次数是不是彼此都不一样。若没有任何两种取值共享同一个次数，写 true；只要有两种取值的次数相同，就写 false。长度和数值的界限都是 1000。
1207.en: Read a sequence of integers. Its length is between 1 and 1000, and each integer also lies between -1000 and 1000. Count the appearances of every distinct value. Decide whether those appearance totals are pairwise different. Write true when no two values share one total. Write false as soon as two values occur the same number of times. Both the length bound and the value bound are 1000.

1208.zh: 读入两条长度相同的小写字符串 s 和 t，公共长度在 1 到 100000 之间，再读入预算 maxCost，范围是 0 到 1000000。把 s 某一位置上的字符改成 t 同一位置上的字符，花费等于两个字符编码之差的绝对值。在 s 中寻找一段连续区间，使它改成 t 中对齐的那段时花费总和不超过预算，并且这段尽量长。写出这段的长度。若不存在任何可行区间，写 0。预算上界是 1000000。
1208.en: Read two lowercase strings s and t that share one length from 1 to 100000, plus a budget maxCost from 0 to 1000000. Turning the character at one index of s into the character at the same index of t costs the absolute gap between their character codes. Search s for a contiguous span that can be rewritten into the aligned span of t while the summed cost stays within the budget, and make that span as long as possible. Write its length. If no span fits the budget, write 0. The budget bound is 1000000.

1209.zh: 读入一条只含小写英文字母的字符串，长度在 1 到 100000 之间，再读入整数 k，满足 2 <= k <= 10000。每当有 k 个彼此相邻、而且字母完全一样的字符，就把这 k 个字符删除，并让删除处的左右文字重新相连。反复执行，直到再也找不到这样的一段。写出最后留下的字符串。最终结果只有一种。长度上界是 100000。
1209.en: Read a string of lowercase English letters with length from 1 to 100000, and read an integer k satisfying 2 <= k <= 10000. Whenever k letters are neighbors and all of them are the same character, delete those k letters and join the text on both sides of the deletion. Repeat until no such run can be found. Write the string that remains at the end. Only one final result is possible. The length bound is 100000.

1217.zh: 若干筹码放在数轴上，它们的位置由一个列表给出。列表长度在 1 到 100 之间，每个位置是 1 到 10^9 的整数，开始时同一处可以有多枚筹码。任意一枚都可以移动任意次：每次移动 2 个单位的花费是 0，每次移动 1 个单位的花费是 1。把所有筹码集中到同一个位置，目标位置可以自由选择。写出完成集中所需的最小总花费。位置上界是 10^9。
1217.en: Chips lie on a number line and their positions come from one list. The list length is between 1 and 100, each position is an integer from 1 to 10^9, and several chips may start on one spot. Any chip may move any number of times. A move of 2 units costs 0, and a move of 1 unit costs 1. Gather every chip onto one shared position, and the destination may be chosen freely. Write the smallest total cost of that gathering. The position bound is 10^9.

1221.zh: 一条只由字母 L 和 R 构成的字符串，当两种字母的个数一样多时，称为平衡串。读入的字符串 s 本身已经是平衡串，长度在 1 到 1000 之间，每个字符只能是 L 或 R。要把 s 切成若干段，各段按原顺序拼接后仍是整条 s，而且每一段自己也是平衡串。写出最多可以切成的段数。长度上界是 1000。
1221.en: A string built only from the letters L and R counts as balanced when the two letters occur the same number of times. The input string s is already balanced. Its length is between 1 and 1000, and every character is L or R. Split s into pieces that stay in their original order and together rebuild s, while each piece is balanced by itself. Write the largest number of pieces this split can have. The length bound is 1000.

1232.zh: 在平面上读入一组点，点的个数在 2 到 1000 之间，而且没有重复的点。每个点由横坐标和纵坐标两个整数组成，两个坐标都介于 -10000 和 10000 之间。判断全部的点是不是位于同一条直线上。如果是，写 true；如果不是，写 false。坐标绝对值的上界是 10000。
1232.en: Read a set of points on the plane. There are between 2 and 1000 points, and no point is repeated. Each point is two integers, one horizontal coordinate and one vertical coordinate, and both coordinates lie between -10000 and 10000. Decide whether all of the points rest on one single straight line. Write true when they do. Write false when they do not. The coordinate magnitude bound is 10000.

1234.zh: 读入长度为 n 的字符串。n 是 4 的倍数，并且 1 <= n <= 100000。字符串中只会出现 Q、W、E、R 这四个字母。当四个字母各自恰好出现 n 除以 4 次时，这串文字算作平衡。可以把其中一段连续片段替换成同样长度的任意文字。写出能够让整串变平衡的最短片段长度。若原串已经平衡，写 0。长度上界是 100000。
1234.en: Read a string of length n. The length is a multiple of 4, and 1 <= n <= 100000. The only letters present are Q, W, E, and R. The text counts as balanced when each of those four letters occurs exactly n divided by 4 times. One contiguous fragment may be replaced by any text of equal length. Write the shortest fragment length that can make the whole text balanced. If the original text is already balanced, write 0. The length bound is 100000.

1235.zh: 一共有 n 份兼职，n 介于 1 和 5 乘 10000 之间。第 i 份从 startTime[i] 做到 endTime[i]，报酬为 profit[i]。开始时刻严格早于结束时刻，结束时刻不超过 10^9，每份报酬是 1 到 10000 的整数。时间范围互相重叠的两份不能一起承接。一份在时刻 X 结束时，可以马上承接另一份在时刻 X 开始的工作。选出互不冲突的若干份，写出所能获得报酬的最大值。时间上界是 10^9。
1235.en: There are n part-time jobs, and n lies between 1 and 5 times 10000. Job i occupies the half-open schedule from startTime[i] until endTime[i] and pays profit[i]. Each start is strictly earlier than its end, every end is at most 10^9, and every pay is an integer from 1 to 10000. Two jobs whose time ranges overlap cannot both be accepted. A job ending at time X may be followed immediately by another job opening at time X. Choose a conflict-free set and write the largest total pay. The time bound is 10^9.

1239.zh: 读入一个字符串数组。数组长度在 1 到 16 之间，每条字符串的长度在 1 到 26 之间，内容只含小写英文字母。按原来的相对次序挑出若干条，可以跳过一些，再把挑出的字符串首尾相接。接成的新串里，每个字符至多出现一次。在所有满足这个条件的接法中，写出新串的最大长度。如果任何挑法都会重复字母，这个长度就是 0。单条字符串的长度上界是 26。
1239.en: Read an array of strings. The array length is between 1 and 16, every string has length between 1 and 26, and the letters are lowercase English letters. Choose some of the strings while keeping their original relative order, skipping any you do not want, and join the chosen strings end to end. In the joined result each character occurs at most once. Among all joins that obey this limit, write the greatest length. If every choice repeats a letter, that length is 0. The per-string bound is 26.

1249.zh: 读入一条长度在 1 到 100000 之间的字符串。每个字符要么是左圆括号，要么是右圆括号，要么是小写英文字母。要删掉尽量少的括号，删除位置不限，让剩下的内容成为合法括号串。空文本、只剩字母的文本、两段合法文本直接相连、以及用一对括号包住一段合法文本，都算合法。写出任意一条删除之后仍然合法的字符串。长度上界是 100000。
1249.en: Read a string of length between 1 and 100000. Every character is a left parenthesis, a right parenthesis, or a lowercase English letter. Delete as few parentheses as possible, at any indexes, so the remaining text is a valid parenthesis string. Empty text, text made only of letters, two valid texts placed one after another, and one valid text wrapped by a matching pair all count as valid. Write any string that is valid after such a deletion. The length bound is 100000.

1252.zh: 准备一张 n 行 m 列的表，一开始每个格子都是 0。n 和 m 都是 1 到 50 的整数。接着读入 1 到 100 次操作。每次操作指定一个行号和一个列号，编号从 0 开始，并且不会超出表格边界。该次操作要把这一整行和这一整列的每个格子都加上 1，行列交叉的那一格因此会被加上两次。全部操作完成后，统计当前数值为奇数的格子个数并写出来。操作次数上界是 100。
1252.en: Prepare an n-by-m table whose cells all start at 0. Both n and m are integers from 1 to 50. Then read between 1 and 100 operations. Each operation names one row and one column. Indexes start at 0 and stay inside the table. The operation adds 1 to every cell of that row and every cell of that column, so the cell where they cross is increased twice. After all operations finish, count the cells whose current value is odd and write the count. The operation bound is 100.

1254.zh: 读入一张矩形格子表，格子里只有 0 和 1。0 表示一块陆地，1 表示一格水。上下左右四个方向彼此贴邻的陆地算作同一片岛。若这片岛不接触表的最外圈，并且它外侧紧挨的每一格都是水，就把它记为被水围住的岛。找出这样的岛一共有几片，并把片数写出来。表的行数和列数都在 1 到 100 之间。
1254.en: Read a rectangular grid whose cells hold only 0 or 1. A 0 is land and a 1 is water. Land cells that touch through the four straight directions belong to one island. Count an island as enclosed when it does not touch the outer border and every cell immediately outside its land is water. Find how many enclosed islands the grid contains and write that count. Both the number of rows and the number of columns are between 1 and 100.

1260.zh: 读入一张 m 行 n 列的整数表，以及移动次数 k。把所有格子按行从左到右、再从上到下一格接一格看成一条环。每移动一次，每个整数都沿这条环前进一格：同一行里靠右一格，行尾的整数落到下一行的行首，右下角的整数回到左上角。把恰好移动 k 次之后的整张表写出来。m 和 n 各自不超过 50，表中整数的绝对值不超过 1000，k 在 0 到 100 之间。
1260.en: Read an integer table with m rows and n columns together with a shift count k. View the cells as one ring that runs left to right across a row and then continues at the start of the next row. Each shift slides every integer one step along that ring: a cell moves one place right, a value at the end of a row drops onto the first cell of the following row, and the bottom-right value wraps onto the top-left cell. Write the table after exactly k shifts. m and n are each at most 50, every stored integer lies between -1000 and 1000, and k lies between 0 and 100.

1266.zh: 读入平面上按先后顺序给出的若干个整点，每个点带有横坐标和纵坐标。必须依照给出的先后顺序走完这些点。每一秒只能做一种移动：单独沿横轴走一格，单独沿纵轴走一格，或者横轴和纵轴同时各走一格。找出从第一个点走到最后一个点所需的最少秒数，并把这个秒数写出来。点数在 1 到 100 之间，每个坐标的绝对值不超过 1000。
1266.en: Read an ordered list of points on a plane. Each point stores an integer x coordinate and an integer y coordinate. Travel must follow the listed order from the first point through the last. During one second a traveler may step one unit along the horizontal axis only, one unit along the vertical axis only, or one unit on both axes at the same time. Find the smallest number of seconds needed to pass through every point and write that number. The list contains between 1 and 100 points, and each coordinate lies between -1000 and 1000.

1268.zh: 读入若干互不重复的商品名称，以及顾客正在键入的检索词。名称和检索词都只含小写英文字母。检索词每多出现一个字母，就按当时已经出现的词头，从名称里挑出以该词头开头的那些。同一时刻最多写出三个名称；符合的名称若多于三个，只保留字典序更靠前的三个。按字母出现的先后，把每一轮的名单依次写出来。名称条数和检索词长度都不超过 1000。
1268.en: Read a catalog of distinct product names and a query that a shopper types one letter at a time. Names and the query use only lowercase English letters. After each newly typed letter, look at the prefix formed so far and collect catalog names that begin with it. Write at most three names for that prefix. When more names match, keep only the three that come earliest in dictionary order. Print one group for every prefix length, following the order of the typed letters. The catalog size and the query length are each at most 1000.

1275.zh: 读入若干落子坐标，每条坐标是三行三列棋盘上的行号和列号。棋盘开始全空。先手记为 A，棋子是 X；后手记为 B，棋子是 O。记录按落子先后排列，两人轮流，A 先下，格子不会重复，并且都符合规则。若某一方先用三个相同棋子连成一行、一列或一条斜线，写出获胜者 A 或 B。若格子已经占满且无人连成三子，写出 Draw。若仍有空格且还没有人获胜，写出 Pending。落子条数在 1 到 9 之间，行列下标只取 0、1、2。
1275.en: Read a list of moves on a blank three by three board. Each move gives a row index and a column index. Player A uses the mark X and always plays first. Player B uses the mark O. The moves alternate, never reuse a cell, and obey ordinary play. If three equal marks line up in a row, a column, or a diagonal, write A or B for the player who finished that line. If every cell is occupied and nobody has three in a line, write Draw. If empty cells remain and nobody has won, write Pending. The list holds between 1 and 9 moves, and every index is 0, 1, or 2.

1281.zh: 读入一个正整数 n，它的取值范围是 1 到 10^5。把 n 按十进制逐位拆开。先把这些数字全部相乘，再把这些数字全部相加，然后用乘积减去和，把得到的差写出来。只有一位时，乘积与和都等于这一位本身，因此差是 0。计算时只使用十进制数字，不要把正负号或其他符号算进去。
1281.en: Read one positive integer n. Its value is at least 1 and at most 10^5. Split n into separate decimal digits. Multiply those digits together, add those same digits together, and subtract the sum from the product. Write the resulting difference. When n has only one digit, the product and the sum are both that digit, so the written difference is 0. Use only the decimal digits of n and leave out any sign or separator.

1283.zh: 读入一串正整数和一个阈值。再选定一个正整数当作除数。每个原数都除以这个除数，商一律向上取整，然后把全部商加总。找出能使这个总和小于或等于阈值的最小除数，并把该除数写出来。这样的除数一定存在。数组长度不超过 5 乘 10^4，每个原数不超过 10^6，阈值不小于数组长度，也不超过 10^6。
1283.en: Read a list of positive integers and a threshold. Choose one positive integer to act as a divisor. Divide every list value by that divisor, round each quotient up to a whole number, and add the rounded quotients. Find the smallest divisor that keeps this total less than or equal to the threshold, and write that divisor. A suitable divisor is guaranteed to exist. The list length is at most 5 times 10^4, each value is at most 10^6, and the threshold is at least the list length and at most 10^6.

1287.zh: 读入一个已经按非递减顺序排好的整数数组。当中有且只有一个整数，它出现的次数严格多于元素总数的四分之一。找出这个整数，并把它单独写出来，不要附带次数。数组长度介于 1 和 10^4 之间，每个元素介于 0 和 10^5 之间。因为顺序已经排好，相等的数一定彼此相邻。
1287.en: Read an integer array that is already arranged in non-decreasing order. Exactly one value occurs strictly more often than one quarter of the entries. Find that value and write it by itself, without writing how often it occurs. The length is between 1 and 10^4, and every entry is between 0 and 10^5. Because the order is already sorted, equal values sit next to one another.

1290.zh: 读入一条非空的单链表，结点按从前到后的顺序相连。每个结点只保存 0 或 1。链头是高位，链尾是低位，整条链就是某个整数的二进制写法。把这条链表示的数换成十进制整数，并把那个整数写出来。结点总数不超过 30，链上不会出现 0 和 1 以外的数字。
1290.en: Read a non-empty singly linked list whose nodes run from front to back. Every node stores either 0 or 1. The head is the high bit and the tail is the low bit, so the chain spells one integer in binary. Convert that binary spelling into a decimal integer and write the decimal value. The chain contains at most 30 nodes, and no node stores a digit other than a single bit.

1293.zh: 读入一张 m 行 n 列的格子图，以及一个整数 k。格子里的 0 可以走，1 是障碍。每一步只能走到上下左右相邻的一格。从左上角走到右下角的途中，最多可以清掉 k 个障碍。找出这样走到终点所需的最少步数并写出来；若任何走法都到不了，就写 -1。起点和终点都是可走的格子。m 和 n 都不超过 40，k 至少为 1，并且不超过格子总数。
1293.en: Read an m by n grid and an integer k. A cell that holds 0 is open and a cell that holds 1 is blocked. One step moves into a neighboring cell up, down, left, or right. While walking from the upper-left corner to the lower-right corner, at most k blocked cells may be cleared. Find the fewest steps such a walk can take and write that count. If no walk can arrive, write -1. Both corners begin open. m and n are each at most 40, and k is at least 1 and at most the number of cells.

1295.zh: 读入一串正整数。对其中每一个整数，数一数它的十进制写法一共有几位。位数是偶数的整数才计入，位数是奇数的忽略。把符合条件的整数一共有多少个写出来。数组长度介于 1 和 500 之间，每个整数介于 1 和 10^5 之间。一位数只有一位，不能计入；两位、四位以及更长的偶数位都要计入。
1295.en: Read a list of positive integers. For each integer, count how many decimal digits its written form uses. Keep the integer when that digit count is even, and skip it when the count is odd. Write how many integers in the list have an even digit count. The list length is between 1 and 500, and each integer is between 1 and 10^5. A one-digit value uses a single digit, so it is skipped. Two-digit values and every longer even length are kept.

1296.zh: 读入一串整数以及一个正整数 k。判断这些整数能否分成若干组，使每一组都恰好含有 k 个整数，并且组内按从小到大排列后，相邻两个整数的差都是 1。如果可以全部分完，写出 true；如果会剩下无法入组的整数，写出 false。k 不小于 1，数组长度不超过 100000，每个整数位于 1 和 1000000000 之间。同一个整数出现多次时，每次出现都要单独入组。
1296.en: Read a list of integers and a positive integer k. Decide whether those integers can be split into groups that each contain exactly k values, where ordering a group from small to large makes every neighboring pair differ by 1. Write true when every integer can be placed into such a group, and write false when some integers would remain outside every group. k is at least 1, the list length is at most 100000, and each integer lies between 1 and 1000000000. If a value is repeated, each copy must join a group on its own.

1299.zh: 读入一个整数数组。除最后一项以外，每一项都改成它右侧全部原值里最大的那个。最后一项一律改成 -1。按原来的位置顺序，把替换完成后的整段数组写出来。数组长度介于 1 和 10^4 之间，每个元素介于 1 和 10^5 之间。若数组只有一项，写出的内容就是单独一个 -1。比较时只看该项之后的原始数值。
1299.en: Read an integer array. Change every entry except the final one into the largest original value that sits strictly to its right. Change the final entry into -1. Write the full array after those replacements, keeping the original positions. The length is between 1 and 10^4, and each entry is between 1 and 10^5. When the array holds a single entry, the written result is just -1. Each comparison uses the original values that follow that position.

1300.zh: 读入若干个整数，外加一个希望靠近的数值。选定一个整数作为上限。数组里凡是比上限大的数都改成这个上限，不超过上限的数保持原样，然后把数组求和。找出能使这个和与目标值的绝对差最小的上限；若有多个上限同样接近，写出其中最小的上限。这个上限不必是数组里原来就有的数。数组长度不超过 10^4，每个元素和目标值都介于 1 和 10^5 之间。
1300.en: Read an integer array and a target. Choose an integer cap. Every array value larger than the cap is replaced by the cap, while values that do not exceed the cap stay unchanged, and the values are then added. Find the cap whose resulting sum is as close as possible to the target when closeness is measured by absolute difference. If several caps tie, write the smallest cap. The cap does not have to be a number already stored in the array. The length is at most 10^4, and every array value and the target lie between 1 and 10^5.

1302.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。没有左孩子也没有右孩子的结点是叶子。从根往下数深度，找出离根最远的全部叶子，把这些叶子上的数值相加，并把这个和写出来。树中结点个数介于 1 和 10^4 之间，每个结点的值介于 1 和 100 之间。若整棵树只有根，根自己就是最深的叶子，写出根的值。更靠近根的叶子不要加进这个和。
1302.en: Read a binary tree. A leaf is a node that has neither a left child nor a right child. Measure depth downward from the root and collect every leaf that sits at the greatest depth. Add the values stored on those leaves and write the sum. The tree contains between 1 and 10^4 nodes, and each node value is between 1 and 100. If the tree consists of only a root, that root is the deepest leaf, so write its value. Leaves closer to the root do not enter the sum.

1304.zh: 读入一个整数 n，它的范围是 1 到 1000。写出任意 n 个彼此不同的整数，使它们相加的结果恰好是 0。这些整数的先后顺序可以自己决定。当 n 等于 1 时，能写的只有 0。当 n 更大时，可以让正数和负数成对抵消；若还剩下一个位置，就用 0 补上。同一个整数不能在列表里出现两次。
1304.en: Read an integer n whose value is between 1 and 1000. Write any n integers that are all different from one another and add up to exactly 0. Their order may be chosen freely. When n equals 1, the only value that works is 0. For a larger n, a positive integer and a negative partner can cancel, and a leftover slot can hold 0. The same integer must not appear twice in the written list.

1305.zh: 读入两棵二叉搜索树，其中任意一棵都允许是空的。收集两棵树里每一个结点保存的整数，按从小到大排成一个列表并写出来。每棵树至多有 5000 个结点，每个结点的值介于负的 10^5 和 10^5 之间。同一个整数若出现多次，就要在列表里按次数重复写出，不能合并成一项。空树不提供任何整数。
