1305.en: Read two binary search trees. Either tree may be empty. Collect every integer stored on a node of either tree, arrange those integers from smallest to largest, and write the list. Each tree has at most 5000 nodes, and each node value lies between -10^5 and 10^5. If the same integer occurs more than once, repeat it in the list once for every occurrence instead of collapsing the copies. An empty tree contributes no integers.

1306.zh: 读入一串不会小于零的整数，再读入出发时的下标。人一开始站在这个起始下标上。站在下标 i 时，下一步只能落到 i 加上该处的数，或者 i 减去该处的数，而且落点必须仍然落在数组里面。判断能否经过若干步到达某个存放着 0 的下标。能到达就写出 true，不能到达就写出 false。数组长度不超过 5 乘 10^4，每个元素都小于数组长度，起始下标也在合法范围内。
1306.en: Read an array of nonnegative integers and a starting index. A walker begins on that index. From index i the next landing place must be i plus the value stored there, or i minus that value, and the landing index must remain inside the array. Decide whether some sequence of jumps can reach any index whose stored value is 0. Write true when such an index can be reached and false when it cannot. The array length is at most 5 times 10^4, every stored value is smaller than the length, and the start index is inside the array.

1310.zh: 读入一个正整数数组，再读入若干条查询。每条查询用左端下标和右端下标标出一个闭区间。对每条查询，把数组里从左端到右端的元素依次做按位异或，得到一个结果。按查询原来的顺序，把全部结果写成一个数组。数组长度和查询条数都不超过 3 乘 10^4，每个元素不超过 10^9。每条查询的右端不小于左端，并且两端都落在数组下标范围里。
1310.en: Read an array of positive integers and a list of queries. Each query names a closed span with a left index and a right index. For every query, combine the array values from the left index through the right index by bitwise exclusive or, producing one result. Write those results as an array that follows the original query order. Both the array length and the query count are at most 3 times 10^4, and each array value is at most 10^9. Every right index is at least the matching left index, and both indexes stay inside the array.

1313.zh: 读入一条长度为偶数的整数列表，内容按成对的方式压缩存放。从左向右，每相邻两个数组成一对：前一个数是重复次数，后一个数是被重复的值。依照这些对的先后，把每个值按其次数展开，再把各段首尾相接，写出展开后的整条列表。原列表长度在 2 到 100 之间，每个整数也在 1 到 100 之间。
1313.en: Read an even-length list of integers that stores a compressed run. Moving from left to right, take the numbers as adjacent pairs. The first number of a pair is how many times to repeat, and the second number is the value being repeated. Expand every pair in that same order, place the repeated values one after another, and write the full expanded list. The input length is between 2 and 100 and is even, and every integer is between 1 and 100.

1317.zh: 读入一个整数 n，它介于 2 和 10^4 之间。无零正整数是指十进制写法中一位 0 都不出现的正整数。找出两个这样的正整数，使它们相加正好等于 n，并把这两个数按任意顺序写成一对。已知至少存在一种合法拆法。若有多种拆法，写出其中任意一种即可。两个数都必须是正的，也不能含有数字 0。
1317.en: Read an integer n between 2 and 10^4. A no-zero positive integer is a positive integer whose decimal digits include no zero at all. Find two such positive integers that add up to exactly n, and write the pair in either order. At least one valid pair is guaranteed. When several pairs work, any one of them may be written. Both numbers must stay positive, and neither number may contain a zero digit.

1319.zh: 读入计算机台数 n 以及若干条网线。计算机编号从 0 到 n 减 1。每条网线连接两台不同的计算机，而且同一对不会重复出现。一次操作可以把一条已经接好的网线拆下来，再接到两台目前没有直接相连的计算机上。找出让每台计算机都能到达其他每一台，最少要做几次这样的拆接，并把次数写出来。若网线数量根本不够，写出 -1。n 不超过 10^5，网线条数也不超过 10^5。
1319.en: Read a computer count n and a list of cables. Computers are numbered from 0 through n minus 1. Each cable joins two different computers, and the same pair is never listed twice. One operation detaches a cable that already joins two computers and attaches it between two computers that are not directly joined. Find the fewest operations that let every computer reach every other computer, and write that count. If the cables are too few for that outcome, write -1. Both n and the cable count are at most 10^5.

1329.zh: 读入一张 m 行 n 列的整数矩阵。从某个格子出发，行号和列号每次都同时增加 1，直到走出矩阵，这些格子算作同一条斜线。把每一条斜线里的整数按从小到大重新放回原斜线，斜线之间不要交换整数。写出整理之后的整张矩阵。m 和 n 都不超过 100，矩阵里的每个整数都在 1 到 100 之间。
1329.en: Read an integer matrix with m rows and n columns. Starting at a cell, the cells reached by increasing both the row and the column by one until the matrix ends form one diagonal. Rearrange the integers on every such diagonal into increasing order and place them back on that same diagonal. Do not move an integer from one diagonal onto another. Write the whole matrix after every diagonal has been ordered. Both m and n are at most 100, and every matrix entry is an integer from 1 to 100.

1332.zh: 读入一个只由字母 a 和 b 构成的字符串，长度在 0 到 1000 之间。一次操作可以删去其中一个正读和反读相同的子序列。被删掉的字符必须保持它们在原串中的相对先后。找出把所有字符都删光、使字符串变成空串所需的最少操作次数，并把这个次数写出来。输入本身已经是空串时，次数为 0。
1332.en: Read a string built only from the letters a and b. Its length is between 0 and 1000. One operation deletes a single subsequence that reads the same forward and backward. The chosen characters must keep the relative order they had in the original string. Find the fewest operations that remove every character and leave the string empty, and write that count. When the input is already empty, the count is 0.

1337.zh: 读入一张 m 行 n 列的矩阵和一个整数 k。每行只含 1 和 0，1 代表军人，0 代表平民，而且每行的 1 都站在 0 的前面。军人更少的一行更弱；军人人数相同时，行号更小的一行更弱。找出最弱的 k 行，按从弱到强的顺序把它们的行号写出来。m 和 n 都在 2 到 100 之间，k 介于 1 和行数 m 之间。
1337.en: Read an m by n matrix and an integer k. Each row contains only 1 and 0. A 1 marks a soldier and a 0 marks a civilian, and every 1 in a row stands before every 0. A row is weaker when it contains fewer soldiers. When two rows contain the same soldier count, the row with the smaller index is weaker. Find the k weakest rows and write their indexes from weakest toward strongest. Both m and n are between 2 and 100, and k is between 1 and the row count m.

1353.zh: 读入若干场会议，每场会议给出开始日和结束日。在同一天里最多只能参加一场会议。某场会议可以在它的开始日到结束日之间的任意一天参加，两端都算在内。找出能够参加的会议场数的最大值，并把这个数目写出来。会议场数不超过 10^5。开始日和结束日都是 1 到 10^5 之间的整数，而且结束日不会早于开始日。
1353.en: Read a list of meetings. Each meeting gives a start day and an end day. On any single day, at most one meeting may be attended. A meeting may be attended on any day from its start day through its end day, and both endpoints count. Find the largest number of meetings that can be attended and write that number. There are at most 10^5 meetings. Every start day and every end day is an integer from 1 to 10^5, and the end day is never earlier than the start day.

1380.zh: 读入一张 m 行 n 列的整数矩阵，矩阵里的整数两两不同。某个整数若是它所在那一行里的最小值，同时又是它所在那一列里的最大值，就把这个整数当作幸运数。找出矩阵中的全部幸运数，按任意顺序写成一个列表。若一个都没有，写出空列表。m 和 n 都介于 1 和 50 之间，每个整数介于 1 和 10^5 之间。
1380.en: Read an m by n matrix of integers in which every value is different from the others. Call a value lucky when it is the smallest value in its own row and also the largest value in its own column. Find every lucky value and write them as a list in any order. Write an empty list when the matrix contains none. Both m and n are between 1 and 50, and every integer is between 1 and 10^5.

1383.zh: 读入工程师人数 n、可选人数上限 k，以及两串等长的速度和效率。工程师按 1 到 n 编号，两串分别给出对应的速度和效率。从中选出至多 k 名不同的工程师。团队表现等于所选速度之和，再乘以这些人所带效率里的最小值。找出最大表现，再对 109 加 7 取余，把余数写出来。n 不超过 105，每名工程师的速度不超过 105，效率不超过 108。
1383.en: Read an engineer count n, a selection limit k, and two equal-length lists of speeds and efficiencies. Engineers are numbered from 1 through n, and the two lists give the matching speed and efficiency of each engineer. Choose at most k distinct engineers. A team's performance equals the sum of the chosen speeds multiplied by the smallest efficiency among the chosen engineers. Find the largest performance any allowed team can reach, reduce it modulo 109 plus 7, and write the remainder. n is at most 105, each speed is at most 105, and each efficiency is at most 108.

1385.zh: 读入两列整数以及一个非负整数 d。对第一列里的每一个数，查看第二列有没有某个数，使两者相差的绝对值不超过 d。若一个都找不到，这个数就记为合格。把合格个数写出来。两列的长度都介于 1 与 500，每个整数都介于负 1000 与 1000，d 介于 0 与 100。
1385.en: Read two columns of integers together with a nonnegative integer d. A number from the first column qualifies when the second column contains nothing whose absolute gap from it is at most d. Write how many numbers qualify. Each column holds from 1 to 500 integers, every integer lies between -1000 and 1000 inclusive, and d lies between 0 and 100 inclusive.

1389.zh: 读入两串一样长的整数，一串是待放入的数值，另一串是槽位。长度介于 1 与 100，每个数值也介于 0 与 100。答案起初空无一物。依序号由小到大处理：把当前数值塞进答案里槽位所标明的地方，该处原有内容连同更靠后的内容统一后移一格。每个槽位都保证落在此刻已放入个数的合法范围里。全部塞完后，把整条答案写出。
1389.en: Read two equal-length integer sequences, one holding values to place and the other holding slots. Their shared length is from 1 to 100, and each value is from 0 to 100. Start from an empty result. Walking in index order, drop the current value into the result at the named slot, shifting the occupant of that slot and everything after it one step toward the end. Every slot is promised to be legal for the result built so far. Write the finished result.

1396.zh: 实现一套地铁进出记录。乘客用整数编号，站名由字母或数字组成。进站记下编号、站名与时刻，同一乘客同时最多待在一站。出站记下编号、站名与更晚的时刻。查询给出起点站和终点站，把至今所有从起点不换乘直达终点的行程耗时取平均后写出来。只有至少走过一趟的路线才会被问到。进出按时间先后出现，出站时刻严格晚于对应进站。调用总次数不超过 20000，编号和时刻介于 1 与 106，站名长度介于 1 与 10。平均值与精确结果相差不超过 105 即算正确。
1396.en: Build a transit log with three actions. checkIn stores a rider id, a station name, and a time, and a rider occupies only one station at once. checkOut stores that same id leaving a station at a later time. getAverageTime takes a start station and an end station and writes the mean duration of every direct trip between them seen so far. A query arrives only after at least one such trip exists. Events come in time order, and each departure is strictly later than its matching arrival. There are at most 20000 operations. Ids and times run from 1 to 106. Station names use letters and digits and have length 1 to 10. A mean within 105 of the exact value is accepted.

1423.zh: 一排卡牌，每张写着一个正整数点数，全部记在 cardPoints 里。一共要抽走恰好 k 张。每一次只能从这一排当前的最左端或最右端抽走一张。得分等于抽到的点数相加。把能够得到的最高得分写出来。牌的张数介于 1 与 100000，单张点数介于 1 与 10000，k 介于 1 与张数之间。
1423.en: A row of cards stores positive point values in cardPoints. Remove exactly k cards. Each removal takes one card from whichever end is currently the left end or the right end. The score equals the sum of the values removed. Write the highest score that can be reached. The row length is from 1 to 100000, each value is from 1 to 10000, and k is from 1 up to the row length.

1437.zh: 读入一条只含 0 与 1 的数列 nums，以及整数 k。判断任意两个值为 1 的位置，中间严格隔开的下标个数是否都不少于 k。若全部满足，写出 true，否则写出 false。数列长度介于 1 与 100000，k 介于 0 与该长度之间，没有其它取值。
1437.en: Read a list nums made only of zeros and ones, plus an integer k. Decide whether every pair of ones has at least k indices lying strictly between those two ones. Write true when the rule holds for every pair and false otherwise. The list length is from 1 to 100000, k is from 0 through that length, and no other values appear in the list.

1438.zh: 读入整数列 nums 和上限 limit。要找一段连续而且非空的区间，使区间内部任意两数之差的绝对值都不超过 limit，并写出最长的那种区间含有多少个数。若整列里一段都合规的都找不到，写出 0。列长介于 1 与 100000，每个数介于 1 与 1000000000，limit 介于 0 与 1000000000。
1438.en: Read an integer list nums and a bound named limit. Find one contiguous nonempty segment in which every pair of entries differs by at most limit, and write how many entries sit in the longest such segment. Write 0 when no segment qualifies. The list length runs from 1 to 100000, each entry runs from 1 to 1000000000, and limit runs from 0 to 1000000000.

1439.zh: 读入一个 m 行 n 列的整数矩阵，每一行都已经按不下降次序排好，再读入正整数 k。每一行恰好挑选一个格子里的数，把挑出的 m 个数相加，得到一种和。在全部挑法产生的和里面，找出从小到大排在第 k 位的那个和并写出来。m 与 n 都介于 1 与 40，k 不超过 200 与 n 的 m 次方这两者里较小的一个，格子里的数介于 1 与 5000。
1439.en: Read an m by n integer matrix whose every row is already sorted in nondecreasing order, and read a positive integer k. Choose exactly one entry from each row and add the chosen entries together. Among every sum that can arise this way, find the sum standing at position k when the sums are ordered from small to large, and write it. Both m and n are from 1 to 40, k is at most the smaller of 200 and n raised to the power m, and every matrix entry is from 1 to 5000.

1442.zh: 读入整数列 arr。要数出三下标 i、j、k 的组数。下标从 0 起，i 必须小于 j，j 必须小于等于 k，k 必须小于列长。把从 i 一直到 j 前一格的所有数做按位异或，再把从 j 一直到 k 的所有数做按位异或，只有两段结果相同才算一组。把组数写出来。列长介于 1 与 300，每个数介于 1 与 100000000。
1442.en: Read an integer list arr. Count triples of indices i, j, and k. Indices start at 0, i must be strictly before j, j must be at most k, and k must be strictly before the list length. The bitwise exclusive or of the slice from i through the cell just before j must equal the bitwise exclusive or of the slice from j through k. Write how many triples satisfy that equality. The length is from 1 to 300, and each value is from 1 to 100000000.

1446.zh: 读入一条仅由小写英文字母构成的字符串。把它的能量定义成某一段的长度，这一段必须非空，而且从头到尾只重复同一个字母。在所有这样的片段里取最长的长度，把该长度写出来。字符串的长度介于 1 与 500，不会出现大写、数字或空格。
1446.en: Read a string made only of lowercase English letters. Define its power as the length of a nonempty stretch that repeats one letter from start to end of that stretch. Among all such stretches, take the longest length and write it. The string length is from 1 to 500 inclusive, and uppercase letters, digits, and spaces do not occur.

1455.zh: 读入一句由单个空格隔开的句子，以及一个检索词。句子和检索词都只用小写字母，句子长度介于 1 与 100，检索词长度介于 1 与 10。若某个单词的开头一段连续字符正好等于检索词，这个单词就算命中。写出最早命中的单词在句中的序号，序号从 1 起算。多个命中时保留最靠前的那个。一个都没有就写出 -1。
1455.en: Read a sentence whose words are separated by one space, and read a search term. Both use lowercase English letters. The sentence length is from 1 to 100 and the term length is from 1 to 10. A word hits when its opening contiguous characters equal the term exactly. Write the 1-based position of the earliest hit. If several words hit, keep the leftmost one. If none hit, write -1.

1461.zh: 读入一条只含字符 0 和 1 的字符串 s，以及整数 k。判断长度恰好为 k 的每一种 0 与 1 的排列，是否都在 s 里作为连续片段出现过。全部出现就写出 true，缺任何一种就写出 false。s 的长度介于 1 与 5 乘 10^5，k 介于 1 与 20。
1461.en: Read a string s that contains only the characters 0 and 1, plus an integer k. Decide whether every pattern of length exactly k built from those two characters appears somewhere inside s as a contiguous piece. Write true when every pattern appears and false when any pattern is missing. The length of s is from 1 to 5 times 10^5, and k is from 1 to 20.

1463.zh: 读入一块 rows 行 cols 列的樱桃园，格子里的非负整数表示该格樱桃颗数。两台机器一起采摘：一号的起点在第 0 行第 0 列，二号的起点在第 0 行的最后一列。每一步两台都下降恰好一行，列号可以减一、保持不变或加一，但不能走出园子。落到同一格时樱桃只被收走一次，收走后该格变成零。两台最后都要停在最下面一行。把它们合计能摘到的最多颗数写出来。行数和列数都介于 2 与 70，每格介于 0 与 100。
1463.en: Read a rows by cols orchard grid. Each cell holds a nonnegative count of cherries. Two machines pick together: the first starts at the upper-left cell and the second starts at the upper-right cell. On every step both drop exactly one row, and each may change its column by minus one, zero, or plus one, while staying inside the grid. Cherries in a cell are taken only once, even if both machines land there together, and that cell then holds zero. Both machines must finish on the bottom row. Write the largest total they can gather. Both dimensions are from 2 to 70, and each cell is from 0 to 100.

1464.zh: 读入整数列 nums。从中挑出两个不同的位置，把每个位置上的数各自减一，再把这两个差相乘。在所有不同位置的挑法里面，把这个乘积的最大值写出来。列长介于 2 与 500，每个数介于 1 与 1000。
1464.en: Read an integer list nums. Choose two different positions, subtract one from each chosen value, and multiply those two differences. Write the largest product that any choice of two positions can produce. The list length is from 2 to 500, each value is from 1 to 1000, and the two positions must not be the same index.

1465.zh: 一块高为 h、宽为 w 的矩形蛋糕，再读入若干水平切割距离和竖直切割距离。水平距离从顶边往下量，竖直距离从左边往里量。沿全部这些距离切完以后，找出面积最大的一块，把该面积对 10^9 加 7 取余后写出来。h 与 w 都介于 2 与 10^9。每一组切割至少有一条，条数小于对应边长与 100000 里较小的那个，切割位置互不相同，并且严格落在蛋糕内部。
1465.en: Read the height h and the width w of a rectangular cake, plus a list of horizontal cut distances and a list of vertical cut distances. A horizontal distance is measured down from the top edge, and a vertical distance is measured in from the left edge. After every listed cut is applied, find the piece with the greatest area and write that area modulo 10^9 plus 7. Both h and w lie between 2 and 10^9. Each cut list has at least one entry and is shorter than the smaller of the matching side and 100000. Cut positions are distinct and fall strictly inside the cake.

1470.zh: 读入长度恰好为 2n 的整数列。前一半依次叫 x1 到 xn，后一半依次叫 y1 到 yn。把它改写成 x1、y1、x2、y2 这样交错的次序，一直排到 xn、yn。把改写后的整列写出来。n 介于 1 与 500，列中每个数介于 1 与 1000。交错之后长度仍然是 2n，不增也不减。
1470.en: Read an integer list whose length is exactly 2n. The opening half is x1 through xn and the closing half is y1 through yn. Rewrite the list so the items alternate as x1, y1, x2, y2, and so on, ending with xn, yn. Write the rewritten list. n is from 1 to 500, and each stored value is from 1 to 1000.

1480.zh: 读入整数列 nums。另写一条等长的新列，下标从 0 起，第 i 项等于 nums 从第一项一直累加到第 i 项的总和。把这条新列完整写出来。原列长度介于 1 与 1000，每个数介于负 1000000 与 1000000。新列与原列等长，下标一一对应。
1480.en: Read an integer list nums. Build a new list of the same length whose entry at index i, counting from zero, equals the sum of nums from the first entry through index i. Write the whole new list. The input length is from 1 to 1000, and each value is from -1000000 to 1000000.

1482.zh: 花园里有 n 朵花，第 i 朵在第 bloomDay[i] 天才会开放，而且每朵最多被用一次。要做成 m 束，每一束都必须用 k 朵当天已经开放、并且在园中位置彼此紧挨着的花。写出为了凑齐 m 束至少要等到的天数。如果无论等到哪一天都凑不齐，写出 -1。n 介于 1 与 100000，开放日介于 1 与 1000000000，m 介于 1 与 1000000，k 介于 1 与 n。
1482.en: A garden has n flowers. Flower i opens on day bloomDay[i] and may be used in only one bunch. Assemble m bunches, where each bunch needs k flowers that are already open on that day and sit next to one another in the garden. Write the earliest day on which those m bunches can be assembled. Write -1 when no day is late enough for that to happen. n is from 1 to 100000, each bloom day is from 1 to 1000000000, m is from 1 to 1000000, and k is from 1 to n.

1486.zh: 读入两个整数 n 与 start。生成长度为 n 的数列，下标 i 从 0 算到 n 减 1，第 i 项等于 start 加上 2 乘以 i。把数列中全部数做按位异或，把得到的结果写出来。n 介于 1 与 1000，start 介于 0 与 1000。数列里的每一项都要参与这次按位异或，不能漏掉。
1486.en: Read two integers n and start. Form a list of length n. At index i, counting from zero up to n minus one, store start plus twice i. Combine every stored value with bitwise exclusive or and write the single result. n is from 1 to 1000, and start is from 0 to 1000.

1512.zh: 读入整数列 nums。数一数有多少对下标满足前面的下标严格小于后面的下标，并且这两个位置上的整数彼此相等。把这个对数写出来。列长介于 1 与 1000，每个整数介于 1 与 100。同一对下标只统计一次，顺序不能颠倒。
1512.en: Read an integer list nums. Count ordered index pairs in which the earlier index is strictly smaller than the later index and the two stored integers are equal. Write that count. The list length is from 1 to 1000, and each integer is from 1 to 100.

1518.zh: 起初手里有 numBottles 瓶装满的饮料。每喝完一瓶就多出一个空瓶。每当空瓶个数凑够 numExchange，就可以换回一瓶新的满瓶，换来的同样可以喝完再继续换。写出按这个规则最多能喝完多少瓶。初始满瓶数介于 1 与 100，每次兑换所需的空瓶数介于 2 与 100。
1518.en: Start holding numBottles full drinks. Finishing one drink produces one empty bottle. Whenever the empty bottles on hand reach numExchange, trade that many for one new full drink, which may later be finished and traded again. Write the largest number of drinks that can be finished under this rule. The starting count is from 1 to 100, and the number of empty bottles required for a trade is from 2 to 100.

1539.zh: 读入一条严格递增的正整数列 arr，以及正整数 k。从 1 开始的正整数里，有些数从未出现在这条列中。把这些缺失的数按从小到大排好，写出排在第 k 位的那个。列的长度、列里的每个数以及 k 本身，都介于 1 与 1000。
1539.en: Read a strictly increasing list of positive integers called arr, together with a positive integer k. Some positive integers, starting from 1, never occur in the list. Order those missing values from small to large and write the value standing at place k. The list length, every listed value, and k are each from 1 to 1000.

1551.zh: 有一条长度为 n 的数列，下标 i 从 0 起，第 i 项等于 2 乘以 i 再加 1。一次改动选出两个下标，让其中一个数减少 1，另一个数增加 1。目标是让整条数列里的每个数都变成同一个值。测试数据保证这一定办得到。写出最少需要的改动次数。n 介于 1 与 10000。
1551.en: A list of length n stores, at index i counting from zero, the value twice i plus one. One change picks two indices, decreases one stored value by 1, and increases the other stored value by 1. Success means every stored value has become identical. The tests promise that this goal can always be reached. Write the fewest changes required. n is from 1 to 10000.

1572.zh: 读入一个正方形的整数矩阵。从左上通向右下的那一条叫做主斜线，从右上通向左下的那一条叫做另一条斜线。先把主斜线上的数全部相加，再把仅仅落在另一条斜线上、还没有被主斜线加过的数也加进去。把这个和写出来。边长介于 1 与 100，每个格子里的数也介于 1 与 100。
1572.en: Read a square matrix of integers. One slanted line runs from the upper left toward the lower right, and the other slanted line runs from the upper right toward the lower left. Add every value on the first line, then add values that lie on the second line and were not already included. Write that sum. The side length is from 1 to 100, and every cell is also from 1 to 100.

1573.zh: 读入一条只含字符 0 和 1 的字符串 s。把它切成三段，每一段都不能是空的，而且三段按原次序拼回去必须正好得到 s。只有当三段各自包含的字符 1 个数完全一致时，这种切法才计数。把合法切法的个数对 10^9 加 7 取余之后写出来。s 的长度介于 3 与 100000。
1573.en: Read a string s made only of the characters 0 and 1. Cut it into three pieces that are each nonempty and that concatenate, in the original order, back to s. A cut counts only when the three pieces contain identical counts of the character 1. Write how many such cuts exist, after reducing the count modulo 10^9 plus 7. The length of s is from 3 to 100000.

1576.zh: 读入一条字符串，字符只包括小写字母和问号。每个问号都要换成某一个小写字母，其余字符一个都不许改。换完以后，任意紧邻的两位都不能相同。已知去掉问号之后，原文里本来就没有紧邻重复。任何一种符合要求的结果都可以，而且在这些限制之下结果一定存在。把换好的字符串写出来。整条长度介于 1 与 100。
1576.en: Read a string whose characters are lowercase letters and question marks. Replace each question mark by some lowercase letter, and do not alter any other character. After the replacements, no two equal letters may stand in neighboring positions. Aside from the question marks, the original text already has no neighboring repeats. Any string that meets the rule is acceptable, and one such string is guaranteed to exist under these limits. Write the finished string. Its length is from 1 to 100.

1579.zh: 一张无向图有 n 个点，边分成三类。第一类只有 Alice 可以走，第二类只有 Bob 可以走，第三类两个人都可以走。每条边给出类别和两个端点，并且两个方向都能通过。在两个人仍然都能从任意一点到达其余每一个点的前提下，找出最多能删去多少条边。如果无论保留哪些边都做不到这一点，写出 -1。n 和边的条数都不超过 100000。端点介于 1 与 n，类别是 1、2 或 3，同一类别配同一对端点不会重复出现。
1579.en: An undirected graph has n nodes and three kinds of links. Kind 1 may be walked only by Alice, kind 2 only by Bob, and kind 3 by either person. Each link is given as a kind plus two endpoints and may be crossed in either direction. Remove as many links as possible while both people can still reach every node starting from any node. Write that largest count, or write -1 when no set of remaining links lets both of them do so. Both n and the link count are at most 100000. Endpoints lie from 1 to n, kinds are 1, 2, or 3, and each kind with the same two endpoints appears only once.

1600.zh: 实现一本王位继承簿。构造时读入国王的名字，他在继承次序里排第一。birth 给一位仍在世的父母追加一个孩子，这个孩子比该父母已经登记的子女都更年幼。death 把某人标成已去世。查询时按家族次序写出仍在世的名字：从国王开始，本人若还在世就先写出，再按从年长到年幼处理每一个孩子的整支后代。名字只含小写字母，长度介于 1 与 15。birth 与 death 合计至多调用 105 次。交给 death 的名字一定已经出现过，每次出生时父母都还活着，孩子的名字互不相同。
1600.en: Implement a throne book. The constructor reads the king's name, and that person stands first in the succession. birth adds a child to a parent who is still alive, and the new child is younger than every child already recorded for that parent. death marks a person as no longer alive. A query writes the living names in family order: begin at the king, write a person when that person is still alive, then walk each child's full branch from oldest to youngest. Names use only lowercase letters and have length from 1 to 15. Together, birth and death are invoked at most 105 times. A name sent to death has already appeared, each birth names a living parent, and child names are distinct.

1603.zh: 实现一个停车场。车位分成大、中、小三种，构造时分别给出三种还空着的数量。addCar 收到 1、2 或 3，依次表示大车、中车和小车。一辆车只能进入与自身种类相同的车位。若该种类仍有空位，就占用一个并写出 true，否则写出 false。三种数量都介于 0 与 1000，addCar 至多被调用 1000 次。
1603.en: Implement a parking lot with large, medium, and small stalls. The constructor receives how many free stalls of each size exist. addCar is passed 1, 2, or 3, meaning a large car, a medium car, or a small car. A car may enter only a stall of its own size. If that size still has a free stall, occupy one and write true; otherwise write false. Each size count is from 0 to 1000, and addCar is invoked at most 1000 times.

1608.zh: 读入一列非负整数，项数介于 1 与 100，每一项介于 0 与 1000。找出一个整数 x，让不小于 x 的项的个数正好是 x。x 可以从未在原列中露过面。存在时把这个 x 写出来，不存在时写出 -1。这样的 x 至多只有一个。
1608.en: Read a list of non-negative integers. The list holds from 1 to 100 entries, and each entry is from 0 to 1000. Find an integer x for which the number of entries that are not smaller than x equals x itself. That integer is allowed to be absent from the list. Write x when such a value exists, and write -1 when it does not. There is never more than one possible x.

1609.zh: 读入一棵二叉树。节点总数介于 1 与 100000，节点上的整数介于 1 与 1000000。把根记作第 0 层，孩子所在层号逐代加一。偶数层的数值必须全为奇数，并且由左向右越来越大，相邻两项不能相等。奇数层的数值必须全为偶数，并且由左向右越来越小，相邻两项也不能相等。判断整棵树是否符合这些层规则，符合写出 true，否则写出 false。
1609.en: Read a binary tree that contains from 1 to 100000 nodes, with every stored integer from 1 to 1000000. Treat the root as level 0 and add one to the level number for each younger generation. Every even level must hold only odd integers and must climb as the scan moves from the left side toward the right side, with no ties. Every odd level must hold only even integers and must drop along that same scan, again with no ties. Write true when the whole tree obeys these level rules, and write false when it does not.

1614.zh: 读入一条长度介于 1 与 100 的表达式，字符只含数字、加减乘除和圆括号，并且括号已经配平。按下面的口径度量嵌套：什么都没有时深度是 0；单独一个既不是左括号也不是右括号的符号深度也是 0；两段各自合法的片段首尾相接，深度取两段中较大者；用一对圆括号包住一段合法片段，深度比内部多 1。写出整段表达式的嵌套深度。
1614.en: Read one expression whose length is from 1 to 100. Its symbols are digits, plus, minus, times, divide, and round parentheses, and the parentheses are already balanced. Measure nesting by these rules. Nothing at all has depth 0. One symbol that is neither an opening parenthesis nor a closing parenthesis also has depth 0. Placing two balanced pieces end to end keeps the larger depth. Surrounding one balanced piece with a single parenthesis pair adds one. Write the depth of the entire expression.

1619.zh: 读入一列整数。列长是 20 的倍数，并且落在 20 到 1000 之间，每一项落在 0 到 100000 之间。先丢掉最小的那百分之五，再丢掉最大的那百分之五，对余下的整数求算术平均。把这个平均数写出来。与精确值的差距不超过 10 的负五次方，仍然算作正确。
1619.en: Read a list of integers. Its length is a multiple of 20 and lies between 20 and 1000, and every integer lies between 0 and 100000. Drop the lowest five percent of the values, then drop the highest five percent. Compute the arithmetic average of whatever is left and write that average. A written value whose distance from the exact average is at most 10 to the power of minus 5 still counts as correct.

1624.zh: 读入一条仅由小写英文字母组成的串，长度介于 1 与 300。在串里寻找两个一样的字母，只统计夹在它们中间、不含两端字母的那段有多长。在所有这样的配对里保留最长的一段。若某个字母从未重复出现，写出 -1，否则写出那段中间部分的长度。被统计的部分必须在原串里挨在一起。
1624.en: Read a string made only of lowercase English letters, with length from 1 to 300. Search for two copies of the same letter and count only the symbols lying strictly inside that pair, leaving both copies out of the count. Keep the pair whose inside stretch is the longest. Write -1 when no letter is repeated anywhere. Otherwise write the length of that inside stretch. The stretch has to sit in one unbroken piece of the original string.

1629.zh: 读入一串被按下的小写字母，以及同样长度的松开时刻表。长度 n 介于 2 与 1000，每个松开时刻是不超过 109 的正整数，并且严格变大。第 0 个字母在时刻 0 落下，其后每个字母都在前一个字母松开的瞬间落下。第 0 次的按住时长等于它的松开时刻，其后每一次的时长等于本次松开时刻减去上一次松开时刻。同一个字母可以反复出现。把按住最久的字母写出来；若有几个并列，写字母表中更靠后的那个。
1629.en: Read a lowercase string of keys that were pressed and a release-time list of the same length. That length n runs from 2 to 1000. Each release time is a positive integer no larger than 109, and the times strictly increase. The first key goes down at time 0, and every later key goes down at the instant the previous key comes up. The first hold lasts exactly its own release time. Each later hold lasts the gap between its release time and the previous release time. A letter may show up more than once. Write the letter that was held the longest. If several letters share that longest hold, write the letter that comes later in the alphabet.

1631.zh: 读入一张高度网格。行数与列数各自介于 1 与 100，每个格子的高度介于 1 与 1000000。从左上角的格子出发，每次只能走向正上、正下、正左或正右的邻格，终点是右下角。一条路线的开销定义成路线上前后相邻两格高度之差的绝对值里的最大者。在所有能走到终点的路线中找出开销最小的一条，并把这个开销写出来。
1631.en: Read a grid of heights with from 1 to 100 rows and from 1 to 100 columns. Every cell stores an integer from 1 to 1000000. Begin in the upper-left cell. Each step may enter only the neighboring cell directly above, below, left, or right. The walk must finish in the lower-right cell. The toll of a walk is the biggest absolute height gap between two cells that the walk enters one after another. Among walks that reach the finish cell, write the smallest toll.

1636.zh: 读入一列整数，列长介于 1 与 100，每个整数介于 -100 与 100。按照各个数值出现的次数由少到多重新排列整列。若两个数值出现的次数一样多，则数值更大的排在更前面。把排完之后的整列写出来，次数相同的数值要保持降序，不能打乱这条次序。
1636.en: Read a list of integers whose length is from 1 to 100, with each integer from -100 through 100. Reorder the whole list so that a value seen fewer times stands before a value seen more times. When two values are seen the same number of times, put the larger value ahead of the smaller one. Write the list after this reordering is finished. Keep that larger-before-smaller rule for every tie, and do not scramble values that share a count.

1640.zh: 读入目标序列 arr，以及若干小段 pieces。arr 里的整数两两不同，各小段里的整数合在一起也两两不同。arr 的长度介于 1 与 100，小段的段数不超过这个长度，各小段长度之和正好等于 arr 的长度，每个整数介于 1 与 100。这些小段可以按任意先后拼接，但每一段内部的次序必须保持原样。判断能否拼出 arr，能则写出 true，不能则写出 false。
1640.en: Read a target sequence arr and several short blocks called pieces. Integers inside arr are pairwise different, and integers across all blocks are pairwise different too. The length of arr is from 1 to 100, the block count does not exceed that length, the blocks together hold exactly as many integers as arr, and every integer is from 1 to 100. Blocks may be lined up in any order, yet the order inside a single block must stay untouched. Write true when the blocks can be joined into arr, and write false when they cannot.

1641.zh: 读入整数 n，范围是 1 到 50。只准使用 a、e、i、o、u 五个元音，统计长度为 n 的串有多少条在字典次序上不下降。不下降是指：除了末尾字母，每个字母要么与右侧相邻字母相同，要么在字母表里位于右侧相邻字母的前方。把满足条件的串的条数写出来。
1641.en: Read an integer n in the range from 1 to 50. Using only the five vowels a, e, i, o, and u, count the strings of length n that never descend in dictionary order. Never descending means that, apart from the final letter, every letter is either identical to its right-hand neighbor or stands earlier in the alphabet than that neighbor. Write how many strings meet the length and the order rule.

1642.zh: 读入每栋楼的高度，楼的数量介于 1 与 100000，每栋高度介于 1 与 1000000。再读入砖块数量与梯子数量，砖块不超过 1000000000，梯子不超过楼的数量。从下标 0 出发，只能走向紧邻的下一栋。下一栋不更高时可以直接过去。下一栋更高时，要么用掉一架梯子，要么用掉高度差那么多块砖。砖和梯子可以随意分配。写出这样仍能抵达的最大下标。
1642.en: Read the height of each building. There are from 1 to 100000 buildings, and each height is from 1 to 1000000. Also read a supply of bricks, at most 1000000000, and a supply of ladders, at most the building count. Start at index 0 and move only to the immediate next building. If the next building is not taller, the move costs nothing. If it is taller, spend either one ladder or a number of bricks equal to the height gap. Bricks and ladders may be spent in any pattern. Write the largest index that can still be reached.

1646.zh: 读入整数 n，范围是 0 到 100。造一条长度为 n 加 1 的数列：位置 0 填 0，位置 1 填 1。若某个 i 使 2 倍的 i 落在 2 与 n 之间，则偶数位置 2i 抄录位置 i 的数。若 2i 加 1 也落在 2 与 n 之间，则该奇数位置填上位置 i 与位置 i 加 1 两处之和。把造好的数列中最大的整数写出来。
1646.en: Read an integer n from 0 to 100. Build a list whose length is n plus 1. Slot 0 stores 0 and slot 1 stores 1. Whenever an index i makes twice i fall between 2 and n inclusive, the even slot at twice i copies the number stored at i. Whenever twice i plus 1 also falls between 2 and n inclusive, that odd slot stores the sum of the numbers at i and at i plus 1. Write the largest integer stored anywhere in the finished list.

1647.zh: 读入一条只含小写英文字母的串，长度介于 1 与 105。某个字母的频次指它在串里露面的次数。若任意两个不相同的字母频次都不一样，这条串就合格。每次只能删掉一个字符。写出为了让串合格而必须删掉的最少字符个数。
1647.en: Read a string that contains only lowercase English letters and whose length is from 1 to 105. The frequency of a letter is the number of times that letter shows up. The string qualifies when every pair of different letters has two different frequencies. One deletion removes a single character. Write the smallest count of deletions that makes the string qualify.

1648.zh: 读入各种颜色一开始各有多少球。颜色种数介于 1 与 100000，每种颜色的球数介于 1 与 1000000000。顾客想买的总数 orders 至少为 1，并且不超过全部库存与 1000000000 里较小的那个。卖出某颜色的一颗球时，售价等于卖出前该颜色还剩的球数，卖完该颜色少一颗。出售顺序可以自定。写出卖满 orders 颗之后能拿到的最大总售价，并对 1000000000 加 7 取余后再写出。
1648.en: Read how many balls of each color are in stock at the start. The color count is from 1 to 100000, and each color starts with from 1 to 1000000000 balls. The buyer wants orders balls, where orders is at least 1 and at most the smaller of the full stock and 1000000000. Selling one ball of a color earns a price equal to how many balls of that color remain just before the sale, and that color then has one ball fewer. The sale order may be chosen freely. Write the greatest total price after exactly orders sales, reduced modulo 1000000000 plus 7.

1649.zh: 读入指令序列，长度介于 1 与 105，每个指令值也介于 1 与 105。从空序列起步，按原有先后把每个指令值插进去。某次插入的花费，等于当时序列里严格更小的个数与严格更大的个数这两者中的较小者，相等的值两边都不算。把每一次花费相加，再对 10 的 9 次方加 7 取余，写出余数。
1649.en: Read an instruction list whose length is from 1 to 105, where each instruction value is also from 1 to 105. Start with an empty sequence and insert the values in their original order. The cost of one insertion is the smaller of two counts already in the sequence: values strictly below the newcomer, and values strictly above it. Values equal to the newcomer belong to neither count. Add every insertion cost, reduce the total modulo 10 to the 9th power plus 7, and write the remainder.

1652.zh: 读入一条环状整数表 code，表的项数记作 n，另外还有整数 k。n 介于 1 与 100，每一项也介于 1 与 100，k 介于 1 减 n 与 n 减 1。所有位置要一起改写。k 为正时，位置 i 改成它后方连续 k 项之和。k 为负时，改成它前方连续绝对值为 k 那么多项之和。k 为 0 时，每一项都改成 0。最后一项的后方是第一项，第一项的前方是最后一项。把改写后的整条表写出来。
1652.en: Read a circular list code of length n together with an integer k. n is from 1 to 100, every entry is from 1 to 100, and k lies between 1 minus n and n minus 1. Change every position at the same moment. When k is positive, position i becomes the sum of the k entries that follow it. When k is negative, it becomes the sum of the entries that precede it, taking a count equal to the absolute value of k. When k is 0, every position becomes 0. The follower of the last entry is the first entry, and the predecessor of the first entry is the last entry. Write the whole list after the change.

1653.zh: 读入一条只由字母 a 与字母 b 组成的串，长度介于 1 与 105。所谓平衡，是指不存在一对下标 i 小于 j，使得较前的位置是 b 而较后的位置是 a。允许删去任意多个字符，剩下的字符仍保持相对次序。写出让剩下的串达到平衡所需要的最少删除次数。
1653.en: Read a string made only from the letter a and the letter b, with length from 1 to 105. Call the string balanced when no index pair i less than j has b in the earlier spot and a in the later spot. Any number of characters may be deleted, and the characters that stay keep their relative order. Write the fewest deletions that leave a balanced string.

1654.zh: 读入禁区列表、向右步长 a、向左步长 b，以及家的坐标 x。禁区个数介于 1 与 1000。a、b 以及每个禁区坐标都介于 1 与 2000，x 介于 0 与 2000。禁区互不重复，家也不落在禁区。从坐标 0 出发。向右一次正好移动 a，向左一次正好移动 b。不能接连两次向左，不能落在禁区，也不能落到负坐标。允许先越过家再折返。写出正好落到 x 的最少步数；做不到就写出 -1。
1654.en: Read a list of blocked spots, a rightward step a, a leftward step b, and a home coordinate x. The blocked list holds from 1 to 1000 spots. a, b, and every blocked coordinate are integers from 1 to 2000, while x is from 0 to 2000. Blocked spots are unique, and home is not blocked. Start at coordinate 0. One rightward move travels exactly a, and one leftward move travels exactly b. Two leftward moves may not happen back to back. Landing on a blocked spot or on a negative coordinate is not allowed. Passing home and coming back later is allowed. Write the fewest moves that land exactly on x, or write -1 when no such trip exists.

1655.zh: 读入整数列 nums 与订单列 quantity。nums 的长度 n 介于 1 与 105，每个元素介于 1 与 1000，列中不同的取值最多 50 种。订单条数 m 介于 1 与 10，每条订单索取的份数介于 1 与 105。判断能否把 nums 中的整数分发出去，使第 i 位顾客正好得到第 i 条订单所写的份数，而且这位顾客分得的每一份都是同一个数，同时每一位顾客都分到。能分出则写出 true，否则写出 false。
1655.en: Read an integer list nums and an order list quantity. nums has length n from 1 to 105, each entry is from 1 to 1000, and at most 50 different values occur. There are m orders, m is from 1 to 10, and each order requests from 1 to 105 copies. Decide whether the entries in nums can be handed out so that customer i receives exactly the count written in order i, every integer that customer receives is the same value, and every customer is included. Write true when such a handout exists, and write false otherwise.

1656.zh: 实现一个按编号向外送出字符串的流。编号是 1 到 n 的整数，n 介于 1 与 1000。每个字符串长度正好为 5，并且只含小写字母。插入正好发生 n 次，每次编号都不重复。构造时把游标设成 1。每存入一对编号和字符串后，如果游标上的编号已经在流中，就从游标起取出最长的一段已经到齐的连续编号，按编号从小到大把对应字符串写出来，再把游标改成这段末尾编号再加 1。若游标上的编号还没到，写出空列表。
1656.en: Implement a stream that sends strings out in id order. Each id is an integer from 1 to n, and n is from 1 to 1000. Every string has length exactly 5 and uses only lowercase letters. Exactly n inserts happen, and each insert uses a different id. On construction, set the cursor to 1. After one id and its string are stored, if the id under the cursor is already present, take the longest block of present ids that starts at the cursor and has no holes, write their strings from smaller id to larger id, and set the cursor to one past the last id of that block. If the id under the cursor is still absent, write an empty list.

1657.zh: 读入两个只含小写英文字母的单词，长度各自介于 1 与 105。允许两种改动，次数不限，也可以只改其中一边。第一种改动是对调两个已经出现过的字符。第二种改动是挑两个已经出现过的字符，把前者的每一次露面都换成后者，同时把后者的每一次露面都换成前者。判断经过若干次改动后，两边能否变成同一个单词。能则写出 true，不能则写出 false。
1657.en: Read two words that contain only lowercase English letters. Each word has length from 1 to 105. Two kinds of edits are allowed any number of times, and either word may be edited. The first edit swaps two characters that already occur. The second edit picks two characters that already occur, replaces every sighting of the first with the second, and at the same time replaces every sighting of the second with the first. Decide whether some edits can make both words into one identical word. Write true when they can, and write false when they cannot.

1658.zh: 读入整数列 nums 与整数 x。列长介于 1 与 105，每个元素介于 1 与 104，x 介于 1 与 109。一次操作只能去掉当前最左端或最右端的一个元素，并把 x 减去这个元素。列会因为去掉元素而变短，后续操作看到的是变短后的列。若能把 x 正好减成 0，写出最少的操作次数；做不到就写出 -1。
1658.en: Read an integer list nums and an integer x. The list length is from 1 to 105, each entry is from 1 to 104, and x is from 1 to 109. One operation removes either the current leftmost entry or the current rightmost entry and subtracts that entry from x. The list grows shorter after each removal, so later operations see the shorter list. Write the fewest operations that bring x down to exactly 0. If exact zero cannot be reached, write -1.

1659.zh: 读入四个整数：行数 m、列数 n、内向者人数与外向者人数。m 和 n 都介于 1 与 5，两种人数都介于 0 与 m 乘 n 和 6 的较小值之间。人可以有一部分不放入网格。内向者的起始心情分是 120，每多一个上下左右紧邻的居住者就减去 30。外向者的起始心情分是 40，每多一个这样的紧邻居住者就加上 20。整张网格的分数是所有入住者心情分之和。写出能够达到的最高网格分数。
1659.en: Read four integers: a row count m, a column count n, how many introverts are available, and how many extroverts are available. Both m and n are from 1 to 5, and each headcount is from 0 up to the smaller of m times n and 6. Some people may be left out of the grid. An introvert begins at 120 mood points and loses 30 for every occupied cell directly above, below, left, or right. An extrovert begins at 40 mood points and gains 20 for every such occupied neighbor. The grid score is the sum of mood points over people who were placed. Write the highest grid score that can be reached.

1662.zh: 读入两个字符串数组 word1 与 word2。每个数组的段数介于 1 与 103，每一段的长度也介于 1 与 103，两个数组各自的字符总数都不超过 103，字符均为小写字母。把一个数组里的各段按原有先后粘成一条串。判断两条粘出来的串是否逐字符相同。相同则写出 true，不同则写出 false。
1662.en: Read two arrays of strings named word1 and word2. Each array holds from 1 to 103 pieces, each piece has length from 1 to 103, the total number of characters in each array is at most 103, and every character is a lowercase letter. Glue the pieces of one array in their existing order to form a single string. Decide whether the two glued strings match character by character. Write true when they match, and write false when they differ.

1663.zh: 读入两个整数 n 与 k。n 介于 1 与 105，k 介于 n 与 26 乘 n。把 a 到 z 依次记成 1 到 26，一条小写串的总分是其中每个字母对应数字相加。写出长度正好为 n、总分正好为 k、并且在字典次序里最小的那条小写串。
1663.en: Read two integers n and k. n is from 1 to 105, and k is from n to 26 times n. A lowercase letter scores its place in the alphabet, so a scores 1, b scores 2, and so on until z scores 26. A lowercase string scores the sum of its letters. Write the string that has length exactly n, scores exactly k, and is the smallest such string in dictionary order.

1664.zh: 读入整数列 nums。列长介于 1 与 105，每个元素介于 1 与 104。必须正好删掉一个元素，删掉之后右侧元素的位置会整体前移。若剩下的列中，奇数位置上的数相加等于偶数位置上的数相加，这列就算公平。统计有多少种删法能让剩下的列公平，并把这个数目写出来。位置从 0 起算。
1664.en: Read an integer list nums. Its length is from 1 to 105, and each value is from 1 to 104. Delete exactly one element. After the deletion, every element that stood to the right shifts one place toward the front. Call the remaining list fair when the numbers on odd positions add up to the same total as the numbers on even positions. Count how many choices of the deleted element leave a fair list, and write that count. Positions are numbered from 0.

1665.zh: 读入若干任务，每项任务给出实际消耗和开工门槛。任务个数介于 1 与 105。消耗与门槛都是介于 1 与 104 的整数，并且消耗不会高于门槛。着手做某项任务时，手头能量必须不少于它的门槛；做完后能量减少实际消耗。任务的先后可以自由安排。写出做完每一项任务至少要准备的初始能量。
1665.en: Read several tasks. Each task lists an actual cost and a start threshold. The task count is from 1 to 105. Both the cost and the threshold are integers from 1 to 104, and the cost is never above the threshold. Beginning a task requires energy on hand at least equal to its threshold, and finishing it subtracts the actual cost. The tasks may be ordered freely. Write the least initial energy that still finishes every task.

1668.zh: 读入字符串 sequence 与单词 word。二者都只含小写英文字母，长度各自介于 1 与 100。若把 word 原样首尾相连重复 k 遍之后，得到的结果是 sequence 里面一段连续内容，则 k 可以当作重复次数。写出 word 在 sequence 里能够取得的最大重复次数。若 word 一次都没有作为连续内容出现，这个最大次数记为 0，照样写出。
1668.en: Read a string sequence and a word. Both contain only lowercase English letters, and each has length from 1 to 100. A repeat count k is allowed when word copied back to back exactly k times shows up as one contiguous stretch inside sequence. Write the largest k that word can achieve inside sequence. If word never shows up as a contiguous stretch, that largest k is 0, and write 0.

1669.zh: 读入两条单向链表以及两个位置 a 和 b。第一条的节点数在 3 到 104 之间，第二条在 1 到 104 之间。a 至少为 1，b 不小于 a，并且 b 必须停在第一条倒数第二个节点之前。把第一条里从位置 a 到位置 b 的整段摘掉，再把第二条原样接到这个缺口上。写出接好之后那条链的头。
1669.en: Read two singly linked chains plus two positions a and b. The first chain holds from 3 to 104 nodes, and the second holds from 1 to 104 nodes. Position a is at least 1, b is at least a, and b must stop before the second-to-last node of the first chain. Cut out every node of the first chain whose place runs from a through b, then attach the whole second chain into that opening. Write the head of the chain that is left.

1670.zh: 实现一种整数序列，能在最前、正中、最后三处放入和取出。刚建好时里面没有任何元素。三种放入分别把一个值放到最前、正中或最后；三种取出把对应位置的值拿掉并写出来，若拿之前已经空了就写 -1。元素个数为偶数、正中出现两个候选时，总是动靠前的那个。把 6 放进一条五项序列的正中时，它落在第二项和第三项之间。从一条六项序列的正中取出时，拿掉的是第三项。每个值在 1 到 109 之间，六种调用合计不超过 1000 次。按调用次序写出每次取出的结果。
1670.en: Implement an integer sequence that supports inserts and removals at the front, at the center, and at the rear. A fresh object starts with nothing inside. The three insert calls place a value at the front, the center, or the rear. The three removal calls take the value at that spot and write it, or write -1 when the sequence was already empty. If the length is even and two center spots exist, always touch the earlier spot. Placing 6 at the center of a five-item sequence puts it between the second item and the third. Removing the center of a six-item sequence takes the third item. Each stored value is from 1 through 109, and the six calls together happen at most 1000 times. Write every removal result in call order.

1672.zh: 读入一张记录客户存款的整数表。行数与列数各自介于 1 和 50，格子里的金额介于 1 和 100。每一行对应一位客户，行内每个格子是他在某一家银行里的存款。把同一行的数字全部相加，得到这位客户名下的资产。在所有客户里找出资产最高的一位，并把该资产写出来。
1672.en: Read a grid of integers whose row count and column count each lie between 1 and 50. Every cell holds an amount from 1 through 100. Each row belongs to one customer, and each cell is the money that customer keeps at one bank. Add every cell in a row to obtain that customer's wealth. Find the customer whose wealth is largest and write that wealth.

1673.zh: 读入一串整数和一个正整数 k。数组长度在 1 到 105 之间，每个元素在 0 到 109 之间，k 不超过数组长度。从中保留恰好 k 个数，并保持它们原来从左到右的相对次序。在所有长度同为 k 的保留结果里，找出字典序最小的那一条：从左往右第一次出现差别时，较小的数字更优。把这条结果写出来。
1673.en: Read a list of integers together with a positive integer k. The list length is from 1 to 105, each entry is from 0 through 109, and k does not exceed the list length. Keep exactly k entries while preserving their original left-to-right order. Among every kept sequence of that length, find the one that is smallest in dictionary order: at the first index where two candidates disagree, the smaller entry wins. Write that sequence.

1674.zh: 读入偶数个整数排成的一条序列，另给上限 limit。长度 n 介于 2 和 105，每个元素以及 limit 都介于 1 和 105。一次改动可以把任意一个元素换成 1 到 limit 里的另一个整数。若对每个下标 i，位置 i 与位置 n 减 1 再减 i 上的两数之和都相同，这条数组就算配对成功。找出让它配对成功所需的最少改动次数，并写出来。
1674.en: Read an even-length integer list and an upper bound called limit. The length n is from 2 to 105, and every entry as well as limit lies between 1 and 105. One change replaces any single entry with a different integer chosen from 1 through limit. The list counts as paired when, for every index i, the entry at i plus the entry at n - 1 - i equals one common total. Find how few changes are required to reach that state and write the count.

1675.zh: 读入 n 个正整数，n 介于 2 和 105，每个数介于 1 和 10^9。对任意元素可以反复做两种改动：偶数可以整除以 2，奇数可以乘上 2。偏移量指当前所有元素里最大值与最小值的差。在允许任意次改动之后，找出能够达到的最小偏移量并写出来。
1675.en: Read n positive integers, with n from 2 to 105 and each value from 1 through 10^9. Any value may be edited repeatedly under two rules: an even value may be divided by 2, and an odd value may be multiplied by 2. The deviation is the gap between the largest and the smallest value present after those edits. Find the smallest deviation that can be reached and write it.

1678.zh: 读入一条命令字符串，它的长度在 1 到 100 之间，并且只由三种片段按任意次序拼接而成。单独的字母 G 保持不变，成对的空括号换成字母 o，带字母的片段 (al) 换成 al。顺着从左到右的原次序，把每一段替换后的字符接成一条新字符串，然后把这条字符串写出来。
1678.en: Read one command string whose length sits between 1 and 100. The text is formed only by the tokens G, (), and (al), arranged in any order. Keep every lone G as the letter G. Replace every empty pair of parentheses with the single letter o. Replace every (al) token with the two letters al. After each token has been replaced, join the pieces from left to right without inserting extra characters, and write that final string.

1679.zh: 读入一串正整数和一个目标和 k。数组长度在 1 到 105 之间，每个元素以及 k 都在 1 到 109 之间。每一步选出两个数，它们相加正好等于 k，然后把这两个数从数组里去掉。同一个数不能使用两次。找出最多能进行多少步，并把这个步数写出来。
1679.en: Read a list of positive integers and a target k. The list length is from 1 to 105, and every entry as well as k lies between 1 and 109. In one step, choose two entries that add up to k and delete both of them. A single entry may be used only once. Find the largest number of such steps that can be carried out and write that count.

1680.zh: 读入一个整数 n，范围是 1 到 10^5。依次取出 1、2、一直到 n，把每个数的二进制写法按这个先后次序首尾粘在一起，形成一条只由 0 和 1 组成的长串。将这条长串解释成一个二进制整数，换成十进制之后再对 10^9 加 7 取余，最后把余数写出来。
1680.en: Read an integer n in the closed range from 1 to 10^5. Take the binary writing of every integer from 1 through n and glue those writings together in increasing order, forming one long string of bits. Interpret that string as a binary integer, convert it to decimal, reduce it modulo 10^9 + 7, and write the remainder.

1681.zh: 读入一串整数和一个正整数 k。数组长度不超过 16，并且能被 k 整除，k 至少为 1。每个元素介于 1 和数组长度之间。把数组拆成 k 份，每份个数相同，且同一份里不能出现两个相等的数。一份的不兼容度是该份最大值减去最小值。找出这些不兼容度加总后的最小结果。做不到这种拆分时写出 -1。顺序在一份内部没有意义。
1681.en: Read a list of integers and a positive integer k. The list length is at most 16 and is divisible by k, while k is at least 1. Every entry lies between 1 and the list length. Split the list into k groups of equal size so that no group contains two equal values. A group's incompatibility is its largest value minus its smallest value. Find the smallest possible total of those incompatibilities, or write -1 when no such split exists. Order inside a group does not matter.

1684.zh: 读入一条由互不相同的小写字母组成的允许串，以及若干待查单词。允许串长度在 1 到 26 之间，单词条数在 1 到 104 之间，每个单词长度在 1 到 10 之间，字母都是小写英文。若某个单词里出现的每个字符都能在允许串里找到，就把它算作合格。统计合格单词的个数并写出来。
1684.en: Read an allowed string of distinct lowercase letters and a list of words. The allowed string has length from 1 to 26, the list holds from 1 to 104 words, and each word has length from 1 to 10. Every character is a lowercase English letter. A word qualifies when each of its characters also occurs inside the allowed string. Count the qualifying words and write that count.

1685.zh: 读入一条已经按非递减次序排好的整数数组。长度介于 2 和 105，每个元素介于 1 和 104，并且后一个不会比前一个小。对每个下标 i，把该位置的数与其余每个位置的数做差，取绝对值后再全部相加。按原下标顺序写出每个位置对应的这个和。
1685.en: Read an integer list that is already arranged in non-decreasing order. Its length is from 2 to 105, every value is from 1 to 104, and each value is less than or equal to the next one. For each index i, subtract that entry from every other entry, take the absolute value of each difference, and add those amounts. Write the sums in the original index order.

1688.zh: 读入队伍总数 n，范围是 1 到 200。比赛一轮轮进行，直到只剩一支队伍。若眼下参与的数量为双数，则两两捉对，进行一半场数，一半队伍留下。若眼下是单数，则随机让一支队伍直接留下，其余两两捉对，场数是减一之后再除以二，留下的队伍数是该场数再加一。把直到冠军出现为止一共进行的场数写出来。
1688.en: Read the team count n, an integer from 1 to 200. Rounds continue until a single team remains. When the live count is even, teams pair off, half as many games are played, and half of the teams stay. When the live count is odd, one team stays without playing, the others pair off, the games played equal the count minus one then divided by two, and the teams that stay equal that game count plus one. Write how many games occur before a champion remains.

1689.zh: 读入一个由数字组成的字符串 n，长度在 1 到 105 之间，没有前导零，表示一个正整数。一种特殊的正整数要求每一位只能是 0 或 1，并且自身不能有前导零。找出若干个这种特殊正整数，使它们相加恰好等于 n，并写出所需个数的最小值。
1689.en: Read a digit string n whose length is from 1 to 105. It has no leading zero and stands for a positive integer. Call a positive integer special when every digit is 0 or 1 and the integer itself has no leading zero. Find how few special positive integers are needed so that they add up to n, and write that minimum count.

1690.zh: 一排石子共 n 块，n 介于 2 和 1000，每块的价值介于 1 和 1000。两人轮流取石，先手先取。每回合只能拿走最左或最右那一块，得分等于拿走之后剩下所有石子的价值之和。石子取完后，分高者赢。双方都按让自己得分优势最大的方式行动。写出先手得分减去后手得分的差。
1690.en: A row holds n stones, n is from 2 to 1000, and each stone is worth from 1 to 1000. Two players alternate turns, and the first player starts. On a turn a player must take either the leftmost or the rightmost remaining stone and scores the sum of the values still left afterward. Play ends when no stone remains, and the higher score wins. Both players act to make their own score advantage as large as possible. Write the first player's score minus the second player's score.

1691.zh: 读入 n 个长方体，n 介于 1 和 100，每条棱长介于 1 和 100。每个长方体给出三条棱。可以任选其中若干个叠成一摞。若下方那一个的三条棱分别都不短于上方那一个对应的三条棱，就可以把上方放上去。叠之前允许把某个长方体的三条棱任意交换次序。找出叠好之后高度的最大值并写出来。高度按竖直方向那条棱累计。
1691.en: Read n boxes, where n is from 1 to 100 and every edge length is from 1 to 100. Each box is described by three edge lengths. Select any subset and stack the chosen boxes. A box may sit on another only when each of the lower box's three edges is at least as long as the matching edge of the upper box. Before stacking, the three edges of a box may be reassigned in any order. Find the greatest total height of a valid stack and write it. Height is the sum of the vertical edges.

1694.zh: 读入一条电话号码字符串，长度在 2 到 100 之间，里面至少有两个数字，其余只可能是空格或短横线。先删掉所有空格和短横线。再从左往右每三个数字划成一块，直到剩下四个或更少。剩下两个就单独成一块，剩下三个也单独成一块，剩下四个则拆成两块、每块两个数字。块与块之间用短横线连接。不允许出现只含一个数字的块，含两个数字的块最多两块。把整理后的号码写出来。
1694.en: Read a phone-number string whose length is from 2 to 100. It contains at least two digits, and every other character is a space or a dash. First drop every space and every dash. Then, moving from left to right, cut the digits into groups of three until four or fewer digits remain. Two leftover digits form one group, three leftover digits form one group, and four leftover digits form two groups of two. Join the groups with dashes. A group of a single digit is forbidden, and at most two groups of length two may appear. Write the formatted number.

1695.zh: 读入一串正整数。数组长度介于 1 和 105，每个元素介于 1 和 104。在里面圈出一段连续的下标区间，区间里的数值必须彼此都不一样。该区间的得分定义为其中全部数值相加的结果。只准圈出一段，不能拆成多段再合并。找出所有合法区间里最高的得分，并把这个得分写出来。
1695.en: Read a list of positive integers. The length is from 1 to 105, and each value is from 1 to 104. Choose one contiguous index span whose values are all different from each other. The score of a span is the total of every value inside it. Only one span may be chosen. Find the highest score among all legal spans and write that score.

1696.zh: 读入一串整数和一个正整数 k。数组长度与 k 都介于 1 和 10^5，每个整数介于 -10^4 和 10^4。人从下标 0 出发，目标是下标 n 减 1。每一步可以从 i 跳到 i 加 1 直到 n 减 1 与 i 加 k 中较小者的任意下标，不能越出数组。得分是沿途落到的每个位置上的数值之和，起点和终点都算。找出可达的最高分数并写出来。
1696.en: Read an integer list and a positive integer k. Both the length and k lie between 1 and 10^5, and each integer lies between -10^4 and 10^4. Start at index 0 and aim for index n - 1. From index i a jump may land on any index from i + 1 through the smaller of n - 1 and i + k, without leaving the list. The score is the sum of the values at every index that is landed on, including the start and the end. Find the largest reachable score and write it.

1700.zh: 读入两个等长的 0 和 1 数组，长度在 1 到 100 之间。0 表示圆三明治，1 表示方三明治。students 从左到右是排队顺序，sandwiches 从左到右是栈顶到栈底。每一轮看队首：若他喜欢当前栈顶，就拿走并离队；否则他回到队尾，三明治不动。当队里剩下的人都不喜欢栈顶时停止。写出这时还没吃到的人数。
1700.en: Read two equal-length arrays of zeros and ones, each of length from 1 to 100. Zero means a round sandwich and one means a square sandwich. students lists people from the front of the line toward the back, and sandwiches lists food from the top of a stack toward the bottom. Each round, look at the person in front: if that person wants the top item, they take it and leave; otherwise they move to the back and the item stays. Stop when nobody still waiting wants what is on top. Write how many people are still waiting.

1704.zh: 读入一条字符个数为双数的字母串 s，长度在 2 到 1000 之间，只含大小写英文字母。把它从中间切成前后两段，两段长度相同。若两段里元音的个数相同，就判定它们相似。元音只计 a、e、i、o、u 以及对应的大写 A、E、I、O、U。相似则写出 true，否则写出 false。
1704.en: Read a string s whose length is even and lies between 2 and 1000. It contains only uppercase and lowercase English letters. Cut it at the midpoint into a front half and a back half of equal length. Treat the halves as alike when they contain the same count of vowels. A vowel is a, e, i, o, or u, and the matching capital letter counts too. Write true when the halves are alike, and write false otherwise.

1705.zh: 读入一对等长的整数序列，名字分别是 apples 与 days，共同长度记为 n。n 介于 1 和 2 乘 10000，两个数组里的数都介于 0 和 2 乘 10000。第 i 天新长出 apples 里第 i 个那么多果子，这些果子再过 days 里对应的天数就腐烂，不能再吃；只有两边同时为 0 时这一天才没有新果子。每天最多吃一个，而且可以在 n 天结束后继续吃还没坏的。找出最多能吃掉多少个，并写出来。
1705.en: Read two integer lists named apples and days, both of length n. n is from 1 to 2 * 10000, and every stored number is from 0 to 2 * 10000. On day i, apples[i] new apples appear, and they spoil after days[i] days, so they cannot be eaten once that delay has passed. A day grows nothing only when both entries are 0. At most one apple is eaten per day, and eating may continue after day n while any apple is still fresh. Find the most apples that can be eaten and write that count.

1710.zh: 读入若干种箱子和一个容量 truckSize。种类数在 1 到 1000 之间。每种给出箱子个数以及每箱装载的单元数，这两个数都在 1 到 1000 之间。truckSize 是车上最多能放的箱子个数，范围是 1 到 10^6。在箱子总数不超出 truckSize 的前提下，可以任意挑选。找出车上单元总数的最大值并写出来。
1710.en: Read several box types and a capacity called truckSize. There are between 1 and 1000 types. Each type gives a box count and a per-box unit count, and both of those numbers lie between 1 and 1000. truckSize is the most boxes the truck may carry, from 1 through 10^6. Any types may be chosen provided the box count never passes truckSize. Find the largest total of units that can ride on the truck and write it.

1716.zh: 读入天数 n，范围是 1 到 1000。从某周的周一算起，第一天存入 1。周二至周日的存入额逐日增加 1。之后每个新周一的存入额都比上一周的周一高出 1，同一周内仍然逐日增加 1。把第 n 天结束时已经存入的总金额写出来。
1716.en: Read a day count n from 1 to 1000. Deposits start on a Monday with 1. From Tuesday through Sunday of that week, each day deposits one more than the day before. Every later Monday deposits one more than the Monday before it, and inside a week the amount still rises by one each day. Write the total saved when day n ends.

1720.zh: 读入一条编码数组 encoded 和一个非负整数 first。原数组 arr 有 n 个非负整数，n 介于 2 和 104，encoded 的长度是 n 减 1，其中每个数以及 first 都介于 0 和 10^5。编码规则是 encoded 的第 i 项等于 arr 的第 i 项与第 i 加 1 项做按位异或，并且 arr 的开头等于 first。按这个关系还原出整个 arr 并写出来。答案唯一。
1720.en: Read an encoded list and a non-negative integer first. The hidden list arr holds n non-negative integers, n is from 2 to 104, the encoded list has length n - 1, and every encoded value as well as first lies between 0 and 10^5. The rule is that encoded[i] equals arr[i] bitwise-xor arr[i + 1], and arr[0] equals first. Rebuild the whole of arr from that rule and write it. The result is unique.

1721.zh: 读入一条单向链表的头节点，以及一个整数 k。节点总数记为 n，它满足 1 小于等于 k、k 小于等于 n、n 小于等于 10^5。每个节点保存的整数介于 0 和 100。下标从 1 开始数。将从头开始的第 k 个节点里的数值，与从末尾开始的第 k 个节点里的数值对调，最后把链表头写出来。
1721.en: Read a singly linked chain's head together with the integer k. Let n be the node count. The bounds are 1 <= k <= n <= 10^5, and each node stores an integer from 0 through 100. Positions are counted from 1. Exchange the stored value of the k-th node from the front with the stored value of the k-th node from the rear, then write the head of the list.

1725.zh: 读入若干矩形，每个用长度和宽度表示。矩形个数在 1 到 1000 之间，两条边都介于 1 和 10^9，而且长和宽不相等。一个矩形能切出边长为 k 的方块，当且仅当 k 不超过它的两条边。先找出所有矩形能切出的最大方块边长，再统计有多少个矩形能够切出这个边长，把这个数目写出来。
1725.en: Read a list of rectangles, each given as a length and a width. The list holds from 1 to 1000 rectangles, both edges lie between 1 and 10^9, and the two edges of a rectangle differ. A rectangle can be cut into a square of side k exactly when k does not exceed either edge. First find the largest square side that any rectangle can produce, then count how many rectangles can produce a square of that same side, and write the count.

1732.zh: 读入名叫 gain 的一串整数，它含有 n 项，n 介于 1 和 100，每个差值介于 -100 和 100。骑行从海拔 0 出发，一共经过 n 加 1 个点。gain 的第 i 项是从点 i 到点 i 加 1 的海拔变化，可正可负。把每个点的海拔求出来，找出其中的最高海拔并写出来。起点也要参与比较。
1732.en: Read the integer list named gain, which holds n entries. n is from 1 to 100, and each difference is from -100 through 100. A ride starts at altitude 0 and visits n + 1 points. The entry gain[i] is the altitude change from point i to point i + 1 and may be positive or negative. Compute the altitude of every point, find the highest one, and write it. The starting point takes part in the comparison.

1734.zh: 读入一条整数序列，它比某个奇数 n 少一项。n 至少是 3，至多是 100000。另有一条隐藏排列，里面恰好是从 1 到 n 的每个正整数各出现一次。序列中每一项都等于隐藏排列里相邻两项做按位异或的结果。把这条隐藏排列按原有先后完整写出来。符合条件的排列只有一种。
1734.en: Read an integer sequence that is one entry shorter than an odd count n. The count n is at least 3 and at most 100000. A hidden ordering contains each integer from 1 through n exactly once. Every entry of the sequence equals the bitwise exclusive or of two neighboring entries in that ordering. Write the hidden ordering from front to back. Only one ordering fits.

1736.zh: 读入四个钟面数字，中间夹着一个冒号，其中若干位写成问号。每个问号都要换成一位十进制数字，使结果表示当天真实存在的时刻。最早的合法时刻是零点整，最迟的合法时刻是二十三点五十九分，两端都算合法。在所有能通过校验的填法里，找出钟面上最晚的一个，并按两位、冒号、两位的样子写出来。输入保证至少有一种填法合法。
1736.en: Read four clock digits with a colon between the hour pair and the minute pair. Some digits may be question marks. Replace every question mark with one decimal digit so the text names a real time of day. Legal times run from midnight through 23:59, and both ends count. Among every filling that passes this check, find the latest clock face and print it with two digits, a colon, and two digits. Some legal filling always exists.

1738.zh: 读入一张非负整数矩阵，行数与列数都介于 1 和 1000 之间，每个格子的数值不超过 1000000。再读入一个从 1 起算的正整数 k，k 不超过格子总数。对任意格子，把它与左上角围成的闭矩形里全部格子做按位异或，得到该格子的坐标值。在所有坐标值中找出从大到小的第 k 个，并把它写出来。
1738.en: Read a matrix of non-negative integers. Both the row count and the column count lie between 1 and 1000, and every cell is at most 1000000. Also read a positive integer k that starts counting at 1 and never exceeds the cell count. For any cell, take the closed rectangle from the top-left corner through that cell and combine every cell inside it with bitwise exclusive or. That result is the cell score. Find the kth largest score and write it.

1742.zh: 读入小球编号的下界和上界。两个边界都介于 1 和 100000 之间，而且下界不会高于上界。闭区间里的每个整数都是一颗球的编号。把球放进盒子时，盒子号码等于编号各位数字之和。统计每个盒子最终装进多少颗球，找出装得最多的盒子，并把那个数量写出来。并列最多时，写出其中任意一个盒子的数量即可。
1742.en: Read a lower label and an upper label for balls. Both labels lie between 1 and 100000, and the lower label is never above the upper label. Every integer in that closed span names one ball. Drop each ball into the box whose index equals the sum of the decimal digits of the label. Count how many balls land in each box, find a box with the greatest count, and write that count. If several boxes tie, any one of those counts is fine.

1744.zh: 读入每种糖果的存量，种类数至多 105，单项存量也至多 105，种类从零起编。较小编号没有吃光时，较大编号不能动。日历从第零日开始，存量没耗尽之前每个日历日都要吃掉不少于一颗，已经清空的种类可以在同一日接着吃后面的种类。再读入至多 105 条询问，每条包含心仪种类、心仪日和单日上限，心仪日至多 109。判断在单日颗数从不超出该上限时，心仪日当天能否吃到心仪种类。按询问顺序写出真或假。
1744.en: Read how many candies of each type are in stock. There are at most 105 types, and each stock is at most 105. Types are numbered from zero. A higher type stays locked until every lower type is finished. The calendar starts at day zero, and at least one candy is eaten on every day until the stock is gone. Once a type is finished, a later type may be eaten on that same day. Also read at most 105 queries. Each query names a wished type, a wished day, and a daily cap. The wished day is at most 109. Decide whether that type can be eaten on that day without ever passing the cap. Write true or false for each query in order.

1748.zh: 读入一列整数。列的长度介于 1 和 100 之间，列中每个整数也介于 1 和 100 之间。若某个数值在整列里只出现一次，就称它独有。把所有独有数值相加，写出这个总和。出现两次以及更多次的数值全部排除，不参加求和。
1748.en: Read one column of integers. The column length is between 1 and 100, and every integer in it is also between 1 and 100. Call a value unique when it occurs exactly once in the whole column. Add every unique value and write the total. Leave out every value that occurs twice or more often.

1752.zh: 读入一列整数，长度介于 1 和 100 之间，每个元素也介于 1 和 100 之间，允许出现重复。先把同一批数排成前后都不下降的一列，再把整列循环平移任意格，平移零格也算在内。判断读入的这一列能否由这样的平移产生。能产生就写出真，不能产生就写出假。
1752.en: Read a column of integers of length between 1 and 100. Each entry is between 1 and 100, and repeated entries are allowed. Picture those same numbers arranged so that no entry is smaller than the one before it, then rotate the whole column by any number of steps, including a rotation of zero steps. Decide whether the column you read can come from that rotation. Write true if it can, and false if it cannot.

1758.zh: 读入一条只由字符 0 与字符 1 构成的字符串，长度介于 1 和 104 之间。一次改写可以把某一处的 0 变成 1，或者把某一处的 1 变成 0。如果任意两个紧邻字符都不相同，这条字符串就称为交替。找出让它成为交替所需的最少改写次数，并把次数写出来。
1758.en: Read a string whose length is between 1 and 104 and whose characters are only 0 and 1. One edit changes a single 0 into a 1, or a single 1 into a 0. Call the string alternating when every pair of neighboring characters differs. Find how few edits are enough to reach an alternating string, and write that count.

1763.zh: 读入一条字符串，长度介于 1 和 100 之间，字符只含英文的大写字母和小写字母。若一段连续片段里，每个已经出现的字母都同时具备大写与小写两种写法，这段片段就称为美好。找出美好片段里最长的一段。长度相同的时候，写出起点最靠左的那段。整段文本里若找不到美好片段，就写出空串。
1763.en: Read a string of length between 1 and 100 made only of English capital letters and English small letters. A contiguous piece is nice when every letter that shows up in it shows up in both a capital form and a small form. Find the longest nice piece. When several pieces share that length, write the piece whose start sits farthest left. When the text has no nice piece, write an empty result.

1791.zh: 读入一组无向边。节点用 1 到 n 编号，n 介于 3 和 100000 之间，边数恰好等于 n 减 1。这些边组成一颗星：有且仅有一个枢纽，它与其余每个节点各连一条边，此外不存在任何额外连线。找出这个枢纽的编号并写出来。输入保证这些边确实是一颗合法的星。
1791.en: Read a set of undirected edges. Nodes are numbered from 1 through n, n is between 3 and 100000, and the edge count equals n minus 1. The edges form a star: exactly one hub is joined to every remaining node, and no further link exists. Find that hub and write its number. The edges are guaranteed to form a valid star.

1816.zh: 读入一句英文，长度至多 500。词与词之间只用一个空格分开，句首和句尾都没有空格，每个词里的字符仅限拉丁字母，大写与小写都允许。再读入正整数 k，它不会大于词的个数。只保留从左边数起的前 k 个词，其余丢掉，保留下来的词仍用单个空格串起来。把截短后的句子写出来。
1816.en: Read an English sentence whose length is at most 500. One space stands between words, neither end of the sentence has a space, and every word uses only capital or small English letters. Also read a positive integer k that is not larger than the word count. Keep only the leftmost k words, drop the rest, and join the kept words with one space. Write the shortened sentence.

1818.zh: 读入两条长度同为 n 的正整数序列。n 介于 1 和 100000 之间，每个数也不超过 100000。绝对差值和等于同一下标上两数之差的绝对值全部相加。允许把第一条里至多一个位置，换成第一条里已经出现过的某个数，用来压低这个和。写出替换之后能达到的最小和，再对 1000000007 取余。
1818.en: Read two sequences of positive integers that share a length n. The length n is between 1 and 100000, and every value is at most 100000. The absolute gap total adds the absolute difference of the two values at each shared index. You may replace at most one entry of the first sequence by a value that already occurs somewhere in that first sequence, in order to shrink the total. Write the smallest total obtainable after that optional replacement, then reduce it modulo 1000000007.

1846.zh: 读入一列正整数，个数至多 100000，每个数至多 1000000000。可以不限次数地重排整列，也可以把任意一项改成比它更小的正整数。结束后第一项必须是 1，而且相邻两项差的绝对值不得超过 1。在满足这两条限制的前提下，让列中某一项尽可能大，并把这个最大可能值写出来。
1846.en: Read a column of positive integers. The column holds at most 100000 entries, and each entry is at most 1000000000. You may reorder the column any number of times, and you may lower any entry to a smaller positive integer any number of times. When you stop, the first entry must equal 1, and the absolute difference of any two neighbors must be at most 1. Under those two limits, make some entry as large as possible and write that largest attainable value.

1877.zh: 读入偶数个正整数。个数 n 介于 2 和 105 之间，而且每个数都不超过 105。把它们分成 n 除以 2 组，每个数恰好属于一组，一组由两个数相加得到组内和。各组的和里会有一个最大者。选择一种分组，使这个最大者尽量小，并把该数值写出来。
1877.en: Read an even number of positive integers. The count n lies between 2 and 105, and every integer is at most 105. Split them into n divided by 2 pairs so that each integer belongs to exactly one pair. A pair total is the sum of its two integers. One of those pair totals is the greatest. Choose a split that makes this greatest total as small as possible, and write that value.

1984.zh: 读入若干名学生的分数。人数至多 1000，每名学生的分数介于 0 和 100000 之间。再读入正整数 k，k 至少为 1 且不超过人数。任意挑选 k 个分数，用其中的最高分减去最低分。找出一种挑选，使这个差值最小，并把该最小差值写出来。
1984.en: Read the scores of several students. There are at most 1000 scores, and each score lies between 0 and 100000. Also read a positive integer k, with k at least 1 and no larger than the number of scores. Pick any k scores and subtract the lowest chosen score from the highest chosen score. Find a pick that makes this gap as small as possible, and write that smallest gap.

2021.zh: 用数轴表示一条笔直街道。读入至多 105 盏路灯，每盏灯给出中心与半径。中心落在负 108 到正 108 之间，半径介于 0 和 108。一盏灯覆盖从中心减去半径到中心加上半径的每个整数点，两端都算。某个整数点的亮度等于覆盖它的灯数。找出亮度最高的整数点；若有多个，写出坐标最小的那个。
2021.en: A straight street is a number line. Read at most 105 street lamps, each with a center and a radius. Every center lies between negative 108 and positive 108, and every radius lies between 0 and 108. A lamp covers each integer from its center minus its radius through its center plus its radius, including both ends. The brightness of an integer point equals how many lamps cover it. Find an integer point of greatest brightness. If several points tie, write the smallest coordinate.

2022.zh: 读入一条整数序列，长度至多 5 乘以 104，每个整数至多 105。再读入目标行数和目标列数，二者都是正整数且各自至多 4 乘以 104。当序列长度正好等于行数乘以列数时，按先行后列的顺序把序列填进这张表，每行从左向右填满后再换下一行，然后把整张表写出来。长度对不上时，写出一张空表。
2022.en: Read one integer sequence whose length is at most 5 times 104, with each integer at most 105. Also read a desired row count and a desired column count. Both counts are positive and each is at most 4 times 104. When the sequence length equals rows times columns, fill a table in row-major order, completing a row from left to right before starting the next row, and write the whole table. When the length does not match, write an empty table.

2037.zh: 数轴上座位的个数和学生的人数都记作 n。n 介于 1 和 100 之间，每个座位坐标和每个学生坐标都介于 1 和 100 之间。一开始允许多个座位或多名学生停在同一点。一次移动让一名学生的坐标增加 1 或减少 1。结束时每名学生都要占用一个座位，而且同一个座位不能分给两个人。把完成入座所需的步数最小值写出来。
2037.en: A number line holds n seats and n students. The count n is between 1 and 100, and every seat coordinate and every student coordinate is between 1 and 100. Several seats or students may begin on the same point. One move raises or lowers one student coordinate by 1. At the end, every student must occupy a seat, and one seat cannot be given to two people. Find the fewest moves that finish such an assignment, and write that number.

2038.zh: 读入一条只含字母 A 与字母 B 的字符串，长度至多 100000。两人轮流删除一个字母，先手是甲。甲删除的字母必须是 A，而且它左右两侧当时也都是 A。乙删除的字母必须是 B，而且它左右两侧当时也都是 B。位于字符串最左端或最右端的字母不能删除。轮到某人时如果没有任何可删字母，这个人判负。双方都以最佳方式行动。判断甲是否获胜，获胜写出真，否则写出假。
2038.en: Read a string of length at most 100000 that contains only the letters A and B. Two players take turns deleting one letter, and player A starts. Player A may delete a letter only when it is A and both letters beside it are also A at that moment. Player B may delete a letter only when it is B and both letters beside it are also B at that moment. A letter at the far left end or the far right end cannot be deleted. A player with no legal deletion on their turn loses. Both sides act in the strongest way. Decide whether player A wins, and write true or false.

2043.zh: 编写一套简易账户。账户个数 n 至多 100000，编号从 1 连续排到 n。读入每个账户的起始余额，余额以及随后每一笔金额都不超过 1000000000000。接下来处理转账、存入和取出，每一种至多被调用 104 次。账号必须落在 1 到 n 的闭区间里。从某账户转出或取出的金额不得超过它当时的余额。合法调用要改写余额并记成功，非法调用保持余额不变并记失败。按调用次序写出每次是成功还是失败。
2043.en: Build a small account system. The account count n is at most 100000, and ids run from 1 through n. Read each starting balance. A balance and every later money amount are at most 1000000000000. Then process transfer, deposit, and withdrawal calls, with at most 104 calls of each kind. Every account id must lie in the closed span from 1 through n. Money moved out of an account must not exceed the balance it holds then. A legal call rewrites balances and counts as success. An illegal call keeps balances as they were and counts as failure. Write success or failure for each call in order.

2096.zh: 读入一棵二叉树，节点个数 n 介于 2 和 105 之间。每个节点保存一个 1 到 n 之间的整数，这些整数互不相同。再读入起点的值与终点的值，两者不同，且都落在 1 到 n 之间。找出从起点节点走到终点节点的一条最短路线。每一步用一个大写字母表示：去左孩子写 L，去右孩子写 R，去父亲写 U。把这些字母按行走顺序连成字符串并写出来。
2096.en: Read a binary tree whose node count n is between 2 and 105. Each node stores an integer from 1 through n, and those integers are all different. Also read a start value and an end value. The two values differ, and both lie between 1 and n. Find a shortest route from the start node to the end node. Mark each step with one capital letter: L when moving to the left child, R when moving to the right child, and U when moving to the parent. Join those letters in walking order and write the string.

2164.zh: 读入一列整数，长度介于 1 和 100 之间，每个整数也介于 1 和 100 之间，下标从 0 开始。偶数下标上的那些数要按不下降的次序重新安放，奇数下标上的那些数要按不上升的次序重新安放。一个数只能留在与原来奇偶性相同的下标上。把重新安放后的整列写出来。
2164.en: Read a column of integers whose length is between 1 and 100. Each integer is also between 1 and 100, and indexes begin at 0. Place the values from even indexes into nondecreasing order, and place the values from odd indexes into nonincreasing order. A value may stay only on an index of the same parity as before. Write the whole column after both placements.

2165.zh: 读入一个整数，它的绝对值不超过 1000000000000000。只允许重排它的十进制各位数字，原来的正负号必须原样保留，重排之后也不能出现前导零。在这些限制下让这个整数的数值尽可能小，并把结果写出来。输入若是负数，写出的结果也必须仍是负数；输入若是非负数，结果也保持非负。
2165.en: Read an integer whose absolute value is at most 1000000000000000. You may only rearrange its decimal digits. The original sign must stay as it was, and the result must not contain a leading zero. Under those limits, make the numeric value as small as possible and write the resulting integer. A negative input must stay negative, and a non-negative input must stay non-negative.

2166.zh: 实现一个位集合，长度 size 介于 1 和 100000 之间，一开始每一位都是 0，下标从 0 排到 size 减 1。需要支持：把某一位改成 1，把某一位改成 0，把所有位同时翻转，询问是不是每一位都为 1，询问是不是至少有一位为 1，统计当前等于 1 的位数，以及把各位从左到右拼成只含字符 0 和 1 的字符串。全部调用加起来至多 100000 次，其中拼字符串至多 5 次。按调用顺序写出每次询问和每次拼串的结果。
2166.en: Implement a bit collection whose length size is between 1 and 100000. Every bit starts as 0, and indexes run from 0 through size minus 1. Support setting one index to 1, setting one index to 0, inverting all bits at once, asking whether every bit is 1, asking whether at least one bit is 1, counting how many bits equal 1, and joining the bits from left to right into a string of characters 0 and 1. The combined call count is at most 100000, and the joined string is requested at most 5 times. Write each answer and each joined string in call order.

2167.zh: 读入一串车厢，字符只含 0 和 1，长度介于 1 与 2 乘 10^5 之间，因此也不会超过 200000。字符 1 表示这节车厢装了违禁货物。可以反复拆除：拆掉当前最左一节花费 1，拆掉当前最右一节花费 1，从任意位置拆掉一节花费 2。标记为 0 的车厢可以留下，但每一节标记为 1 的车厢最终都要被拆掉。空串视为已经清理干净。写出完成清理的最少时间。
2167.en: Read a line of cars made only of the characters 0 and 1. Its length is between 1 and 2 * 10^5, so it is also at most 200000. A character 1 means that car holds illegal goods. You may repeatedly detach the current leftmost car for a cost of 1, detach the current rightmost car for a cost of 1, or detach a car at any index for a cost of 2. Cars marked 0 may stay, but every car marked 1 must eventually be detached. An empty line is already clean. Write the least time that finishes the cleanup.

2169.zh: 读入两个非负整数，每一个都不超过 100000。当两个数都还不是零时，从较大的那个减去较小的那个；如果两者相等，这次相减会让其中一个变成零。一直减到至少有一个数变成零为止。统计一共做了多少次减法，并把次数写出来。
2169.en: Read two non-negative integers, and neither integer exceeds 100000. While both values are still nonzero, subtract the smaller value from the larger value. If the two values are equal, that subtraction turns one of them into zero. Keep going until at least one value becomes zero. Count how many subtractions occur, and write that count.

2170.zh: 读入一列正整数，长度介于 1 和 100000 之间，每个数也不超过 100000。所谓交替，是指从第三项开始，每一项都等于再往前隔一项的那个数，并且每一项都不同于紧挨在它前面的那一项。一次操作可以把任意一个位置改成任意正整数。找出让整列满足交替所需的最少操作次数并写出来。只有一项的列本身已经满足交替。
2170.en: Read a column of positive integers. Its length is between 1 and 100000, and every integer is at most 100000. Call the column alternating when, starting at the third entry, every entry equals the entry two places earlier, and every entry differs from the entry directly before it. One operation changes any chosen position into any positive integer. Find the fewest operations that make the column alternating, and write that count. A column that holds only one entry is already alternating.

2171.zh: 读入若干个袋子里的魔法豆颗数。袋子个数介于 1 和 100000 之间，每一袋的颗数也不超过 100000。可以从任一袋中取走任意颗，取走的豆子不许再放回任何一个袋子。取完以后，每个仍然非空的袋子必须装有相同的颗数，完全取空的袋子允许存在。找出需要取走的最少总颗数，并把这个总数写出来。
2171.en: Read how many magic beans sit in each bag. The bag count is between 1 and 100000, and no bag holds more than 100000 beans. You may remove any number of beans from any bag, and removed beans may not go back into a bag. After the removals, every bag that is still nonempty must hold an equal count, and fully emptied bags are allowed. Find the smallest total number of beans that must be removed, and write that total.

2180.zh: 读入一个范围上限，它是介于1与1000之间的正整数。考察从1一直到该上限的每个整数，把每一位上的数码加总。加总结果若能被2整除，这个整数就算一次。把符合条件的整数一共有多少个写出来。1也要纳入检查，上限本身同样要检查。
2180.en: Read one positive integer bound that is at most 1000. Walk every whole number from 1 through that bound. Add the decimal digits of the current number. Count it when that total is divisible by two. Write how many such numbers exist inside the closed range. Include both the lower end 1 and the bound itself. The bound is never smaller than 1.

2181.zh: 读入一条链表。节点个数落在3到2乘100000之间，每个节点里的整数落在0到1000之间。链的第一格和最后一格都是0，并且任意两格相邻时不会同时为0。0把中间的非零整数切成若干段。对每一段，把段内整数相加，用一个新格子记下这个和。按原顺序把这些新格子串起来，新链里不再出现0。写出新链的起始格子。
2181.en: Read a singly linked chain whose length is between 3 and 2 times 100000. Each stored integer is between 0 and 1000. The first cell and the last cell both hold 0, and no two neighboring cells are both 0. Those zeros split the nonzero values into segments. Replace every segment by one cell holding the total of its values, keep the segment order, and drop every zero. Write the first cell of the resulting chain.

2182.zh: 读入一串只含小写英文字母的文本，以及一个正整数上限。文本长度与上限都介于1和100000之间，且上限不会大于文本长度。用文本里出现过的字母重新排成一条新文本，同一种字母可以少用或不用。新文本里，同一种字母挨在一起的次数不得超过该上限。在所有满足这条限制的新文本中，找出字典序最大的一条并写出来。比较时，从左往右看第一个不同的字母，靠后的字母更大；若较短的一条是较长一条的前缀，则较长的那条更大。
2182.en: Read a string made only of lowercase English letters and a positive integer cap. Both the length and the cap sit between 1 and 100000, and the cap is at most the length. Build a new string from those letters. You may skip some letters. In the new string, no letter may sit next to itself more times than the cap allows. Among every string that obeys the cap, write the one that is largest in dictionary order. Compare from the left: at the first mismatch, the letter later in the alphabet wins. If the shorter string is a prefix of the longer one, the longer string wins.

2183.zh: 读入长度不超过10^5的一列正整数，以及另一个正整数除数。除数和每个元素都不超过10^5，长度和除数至少是1。从这列里任取两个不同位置，左边的位置必须更靠前。把这两个位置上的数相乘，若乘积能被除数整除，这对位置就算一次。统计一共有多少对，并把这个数目写出来。位置从0起算，靠后的下标必须严格大于靠前的下标。
2183.en: Read a list of positive integers whose length is at most 10^5, plus a positive divisor that is also at most 10^5. Every stored value is at least 1 and at most 10^5, and the length is at least 1. Choose two distinct indexes, with the left index strictly smaller than the right index. Multiply the two values. Count the choice when the product is a multiple of the divisor. Write the total number of such choices. Indexes start at zero.
